body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. title: RELIANCE -IoT interThrone : (12/20/2018)
body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. In addition, Unlimit has partnered with established IoT stakeholders such as BSNL, Cisco Jasper, PTC, Software AG Cumulocity IoT, and IBM Watson IoT to provide dedicated IoT solutions in the field of Automotive, Industry 4.0, Transport & Logistics, and Government projects. This will enable both Indian and multi-national organizations to excel their IoT business with an efficient go to market strategy and by scaling business processes with a high-service reliability at low ownership costs. body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. In addition, Unlimit has partnered with established IoT stakeholders such as BSNL, Cisco Jasper, PTC, Software AG Cumulocity IoT, and IBM Watson IoT to provide dedicated IoT solutions in the field of Automotive, Industry 4.0, Transport & Logistics, and Government projects. This will enable both Indian and multi-national organizations to excel their IoT business with an efficient go to market strategy and by scaling business processes with a high-service reliability at low ownership costs. title: RELIANCE -IoT interThrone : (12/20/2018)
body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. In addition, Unlimit has partnered with established IoT stakeholders such as BSNL, Cisco Jasper, PTC, Software AG Cumulocity IoT, and IBM Watson IoT to provide dedicated IoT solutions in the field of Automotive, Industry 4.0, Transport & Logistics, and Government projects. This will enable both Indian and multi-national organizations to excel their IoT business with an efficient go to market strategy and by scaling business processes with a high-service reliability at low ownership costs. Hosting Platform: Reliance Group Category of Event: Hackathon(Idea submission based) Mode of Event Participation: Online followed by offline Nature of Event: Competition only with Prize Number of Rounds of this event: 2 Event Winner Prize: 1st Prize-INR 1,00,000,Cash prize and 1-year subscription to UNLIMIT platform worth 8,00,000 INR and 1st Runner upINR 75,000,Cash prize and a 1-year subscription to UNLIMIT platform worth 8,00,000 INR and 2nd Runner up,1-year subscription to UNLIMIT platform worth 8,00,000 INR Last Date to Register: 27-Jan-2019 Event Start Date/Time: 19-Dec-2018/19:00 PM More Details and Event Registration URL: https://www.hackerearth.com/sprints/unlimit-iot-hackathon/ Provision for Duty Leave: Nil Provision for Academic Bonus points: 5 points for winning the competition (higher will be applicable) To avail participation benefits, submit your details to Training and Placement Cell on following link: https://shortto.com/cpedata

title: RELIANCE -IoT interThrone : (12/20/2018)
body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. In addition, Unlimit has partnered with established IoT stakeholders such as BSNL, Cisco Jasper, PTC, Software AG Cumulocity IoT, and IBM Watson IoT to provide dedicated IoT solutions in the field of Automotive, Industry 4.0, Transport & Logistics, and Government projects. This will enable both Indian and multi-national organizations to excel their IoT business with an efficient go to market strategy and by scaling business processes with a high-service reliability at low ownership costs. title: RELIANCE -IoT interThrone : (12/20/2018)
body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. title: RELIANCE -IoT interThrone : (12/20/2018)
body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. In addition, Unlimit has partnered with established IoT stakeholders such as BSNL, Cisco Jasper, PTC, Software AG Cumulocity IoT, and IBM Watson IoT to provide dedicated IoT solutions in the field of Automotive, Industry 4.0, Transport & Logistics, and Government projects. This will enable both Indian and multi-national organizations to excel their IoT business with an efficient go to market strategy and by scaling business processes with a high-service reliability at low ownership costs. title: Campus Hiring Challenge - AHC 5.0 : (12/20/2018)
body: This challenge involves a participant to play games on the topic “Accolite Hiring Challenge” which would have questions related to IT, SW Engineering, Data Structures, Problem Solving etc. 1. Download EduThrill App for hiring contest 2. Go to Dashboard and Play games under the topic “AHC 5.0” – having questions on various skills. You need to play games under sub-topic “Campus Hiring” 3. title: RELIANCE -IoT interThrone : (12/20/2018)
body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. In addition, Unlimit has partnered with established IoT stakeholders such as BSNL, Cisco Jasper, PTC, Software AG Cumulocity IoT, and IBM Watson IoT to provide dedicated IoT solutions in the field of Automotive, Industry 4.0, Transport & Logistics, and Government projects. This will enable both Indian and multi-national organizations to excel their IoT business with an efficient go to market strategy and by scaling business processes with a high-service reliability at low ownership costs. title: RELIANCE -IoT interThrone : (12/20/2018)
body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. title: RELIANCE -IoT interThrone : (12/20/2018)
body: To support digital transformation mega trend Reliance ADA Group founded UNLIMIT as an independent unit to develop and support IoT in the best possible way for the Indian market. Launched in 2016, UNLIMIT is the only dedicated IoT business unit in India. Spearheaded by Jürgen Hase, CEO and his team, UNLIMIT is driven by an in-depth knowledge of the Indian market and an unparalleled end-to-end IoT offering. The IoT offering ranges from managed connectivity to devise management and application software to any form of analytics. In addition, Unlimit has partnered with established IoT stakeholders such as BSNL, Cisco Jasper, PTC, Software AG Cumulocity IoT, and IBM Watson IoT to provide dedicated IoT solutions in the field of Automotive, Industry 4.0, Transport & Logistics, and Government projects. This will enable both Indian and multi-national organizations to excel their IoT business with an efficient go to market strategy and by scaling business processes with a high-service reliability at low ownership costs. title: Prevention from Dengue fever : (10/31/2018)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a mosquito which is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset . In containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 meters from the breeding site. To protect yourself , please take care following measures : - Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. -All hostel student/staff to ensure that Desert Cooler installed at their rooms to be kept dry when not in use. -When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. -Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. - Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. - Aerosol knockdown or surface .insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label

title: Extension to apply for optional full term internship for b.tech CSE/IT students passing out in 2019 : (10/30/2018)
body: Dear Student, The dates to apply for optional full term internship for all final Year B.tech CSE/IT students Passing out in 2019 has been extended till 3rd November, 2018. Optional full term internship can be done in two modes: 1) In an Company/Organization: a) For Company & Organization it is to notify you all that the students who want to go for the internship in next semester are require to submit the form on the link given below: Link: www.shortto.com/company b) You have to submit the confirmation letter given by the company showing that you are selected for internship with joining details, stipend details & duration of your internship. c) Internship with 'No Stipend' will not be recommend by the department. 2) Via MOOC'S approved by the department: a) Students can opt for internship via MOOC'S through reputed online platform with either a Master/Nano degree etc in which a group of courses for a technology are opt together. b) The MOOC'S needs to be approved by the department before student enrolls for the same. c) Students can apply for approval of course in the given link below: Link: www.shortto.com/moocs d) Minimum duration of course should be 6 Months. e) A student is required to invest 4 hours everyday in a classroom where facilitator will be appointed to take the attendance & insured discipline. f) Students will be allowed to register for backlogs, appear for reappear & improvement exams, if any, but the university will not be responsible for providing a clash free schedule. IMPORTANT: It is mandatory to upload your offer letter in PDF format only & students need to submit their hard copy of offer letter to Ms. Aakriti in 34-201A in the given timeline only. Please Note that the last date for submit the documents is 3rd November, 2018. a) Student might be call for the Internship Approval Committee for the approval of optional/full term internship. b) Student should not join the organization before the approval from the department. c) Internship Approval Committee date is 14th November, 2018. All the students are requested to available in the campus on the given date for the approval of their optional full term internship. For the issuance of training letter for students undergoing optional full term internship, they must fill the details on the given link below: Link: https://tinyurl.com/cseintern2018 Note: Students who are going on internship through campus placement they need not to submit the google form.

title: "India Innovation Challenge Design Contest 2018 by DST and Texas Instrument" : (9/6/2018)
body: Dear Students, Texas Instruments (TI) invites all student innovators, thinkers and makers of the country to join the revolution, who have a dream to create something new, aspire to make a difference, contribute to India's success towards becoming an Innovation Hub. Give your ideas a jump-start by sculpting your innovation with technical support from Texas Instruments, business mentorship from IIMB, funding, Tools and prizes of INR 8.2 crore from DST& TI. < Design- using Innovative products with technical mentorship & resources from TI. < Incubate - with mentors from India's smartest brains from IIMB. < Launch - your product with funding and prizes from DST& TI. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA < The contest is open for all Indian engineering students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate Doctoral degrees with Indian engineering colleges. < All the participants must be Indian Nationals. <TI will be providing TI tools worth up to USD 200 for each team free of cost. You must use all TI devices in your solution. HOW TO REGISTER <Create an account on MyGov: https://www.mygov.in. <Go to website: https://innovate.mygov.in and click on the "INDIA INNOVATION CHALLENGE" icon. This will direct you to contest page. <On the "INDIA INNOVATION CHALLENGE" contest page, scroll to the participate section and click on "Login to Participate". Enter the login credentials and you'll be redirected to home page of website: https://innovate.mygov.in. <Click on the "INDIA INNOVATION CHALLENGE" icon AGAIN to be redirected to contest web page. <On the "INDIA INNOVATION CHALLENGE" contest page, scroll towards the end of page to the submission form. <You will have to enter details as required in the Registration Page and follow further instructions on the portal. <Upon successful submission, you will receive a confirmation email. <For any additional information, you will be contacted via email. <All correspondence shall be through email or SMS on mobile number provided by you at the time of registration. Organizers are not liable in case of SMS/ email delivery failures. REGISTRATION DATE Registration Phase: June 2018 – 10th September 18 AWARDS AND FUNDING <INR 20 Lacs seed funds to top 10 start-ups. <INR 5 Lacs product development funds to select semi-finalists teams. <INR 30K stipends to select Semi-finalists teams. <Free TI Tools worth up to INR 70 Lacs to participants. <15000+ certificates spread across the whole contest. <600+ types of cash prizes spread throughout the contest totalling up to INR 50 Lacs. Recognition for the Faculty (Mentors) of the Semi-finalists and Finalists teams. title: JSW Foundation's Udaan Scholarship for Undergraduate & Diploma Student for the session 2018-19 on Vidyasaarathi Scholarship Portal- reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180827/001) : (8/27/2018)
body: Dear Students, Vidyasaarathi is a technology-enabled initiative by NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Limited (NSDL e-Gov) to bridge the gap in education finance in the country through an online platform. Students can search and apply for various education finance schemes they are qualified for. JSW Foundation is the social development arm of JSW with an ideology that every life is important and must be given fair opportunities to make best out of it. JSW Foundation offers Udaan Scholarship for Undergraduate and Diploma students. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 09-10-2018 Link for applying scholarship: www.vidyasaarathi.co.in The students can apply for JSW Foundation’s Udaan Scholarships schemes on the Vidyasaarthi Scholarship Portal. The detail & eligibility criteria of the schemes are as under:- Scholarship Scheme for Undergraduate Student Scholarship Name: - JSW Foundation's Udaan Scholarship for Under Graduate Students Description: - This scholarship program is designed for students pursuing a graduation course. This scheme is not applicable for JSW employees and their Children. Eligibility Criteria for the Scholarship: - Qualification Criteria: Minimum 50% in HSC Course Name: Any under Graduate Course Income from all sources: Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 5,00,000/- (Five lakh only) The Following Documents Must be uploaded on the scholarship portal:- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Latest Income Certificate 5) Student Bank passbook 6) 10th, 12th Marksheet & LPU Result (Provisional Academic Transcript) – except 1st year students 7) Current year fees receipts (2018-19 Session) 8) Bonafide certificate & Admission Letter from institute 9) Domicile certificate 10) Optional document--PAN No./Voter Card/Passport All documents uploaded shall be clear and must be in .jpeg or .png format only Scholarship Amount (INR) to be awarded to the selected students: - Upto Rs. 60,000/- Scholarship Scheme for Diploma Students Scholarship Name: - JSW Foundation's Udaan Scholarship for Diploma Students. Description: - This scholarship program is designed for students pursuing full time Diploma (10+3) course in any stream. This scheme is not applicable for JSW employees and their Children. Eligibility Criteria for the Scholarship: - Qualification Criteria: Minimum 50% in SSC Course Name: Any Diploma Income from all sources: Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 5,00,000/- (Five lakh only) The Following Documents Must be uploaded on the scholarship portal:- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Latest Income Certificate 5) Student Bank Passbook 6) 10th Marksheet & LPU Result (Provisional Academic Transcript) – except 1st year students 7) Current year fees receipts (2018-19 Session) 8) Bonafide Certificate & Admission Letter from Institute 9) Domicile Certificate 10) Optional Document--PAN No./Voter Card/Passport All documents uploaded shall be clear and must be in .jpeg or .png format only Scholarship Amount (INR) to be awarded to the selected students: - Upto Rs. 25,000/- The Scholarship will be Awarded to Students as per the following Preferences:- a. Preference will be given to Girls b. Preference will be given to students who are Orphan c. Preference will be given to differently abled students d. Preference will be given to students from DIZ (Direct Impact Zone) locations i.e. JSW Plants / Ports. The instructions for creating login id & password and to apply for scholarships are mentioned in the Student Manual which is enclosed for your reference. You have to fill annual tuition fee & Examination fee on portal and if you are getting any scholarship from the Govt. or LPU or any other private organization then the scholarship amount must be specified at the appropriate place. You have to give your request for Vidyasaarathi Bonafide Certificate & Admission Letter for JSW Foundation’s Udaan Scholarship on or before 05-10-2018 at SSIV Cell, Block No.32, Room No.102 (Window No.-03). The Vidyasaarathi Bonafide Certificate & Admission Letter will be issued to you after receiving the photocopy of aforesaid documents. In case of any confusion / problem in applying for the scholarship on Vidyasaarathi Scholarship Portal, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­ (between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: Santoor Women’s Scholarship only for 2018 Batch Girls Students of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka & Telangana for the session 2018-19 -reg.(Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180824/001) : (8/24/2018)
body: Dear Students, The Santoor Scholarship program is an initiative of Wipro Consumer Care and Wipro Cares. The program intends to financially support girls from disadvantaged backgrounds, who wish to pursue higher education after class 12th. Launched in 2016-17, the program offers support to 900 students every year, across the states of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Telangana. It is a recurring annual program and the selected students are supported for the duration of their higher education. The support covers tuition fees and incidental expenses. Over the last two years, approximately 1800 students have received support through the Santoor Women’s Scholarship Program. Besides students inclined towards professional courses, those showing a keen interest in pursuing their higher education in the fields of humanities, liberal arts and sciences are strongly encouraged to apply. Preference is given to students from backward districts. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 15-09-2018 Eligibility Santoor Women’s Scholarships program is exclusively for girls from underprivileged and disadvantaged backgrounds. To be eligible to apply, the prospective scholars must:- 1) Have completed their class 10th in a Local Government School. 2) Complete their class 12th in a Government School/Junior College in the academic year 2017-18. 3) Have enrolled for a full time recognized diploma/graduate program beginning 2018-19, of a minimum three years & more. (Only Fresh Girl Students of 2018 Batch Can Apply For This Scholarship) 4) The girl students must be from Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Telangana. 5) The enclosed scholarship application form must be filled. The Following Documents Must be Enclosed with the Application Form 1) One recent colour passport size photo 2) Photocopy of applicant passbook (other than Gramin Bank) 3) Photocopy of Aadhaar Card 4) Photocopy of class 10 certificate 5) Photocopy of class 12 certificate Scholarship Amount Per Year The students would be given Rs.24,000/- per annum till they complete their course of study. Students are permitted to utilize the scholarship for tuition fees or other expenses incidental to education. Terms and Conditions 1) Any application which does not meet the prerequisites is liable to be rejected. 2) Wipro Cares reserves the sole right to offer the scholarship and also has the right to modify/reject/withdraw and/or discontinue the offer without assigning any reason. No other body/agency is authorized to make any offer on the Santoor Women’s Scholarship. Girl students who want to apply for scholarship have to submit the application form for the verification along with all documents in SSIV Cell, Building No.32, Room No.102 (Window No.-03). After verification, the verified application form must be sent by the student through Regd. Post or Reliable Courier on the following address latest by 10-09-2018:- Wipro Cares – Santoor Scholarship, Doddakannelli, Sarjapur Road, Bangalore, Karnataka – 560035. In case of any problem in applying for the Santoor Women’s Scholarship, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­ (between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: Invite to participate in conduct of Survey in Punjab : (8/24/2018)
body: About: The Annual Status of Education Report (ASER) is the largest citizen-led annual survey of children in rural India. The Survey is Facilitated and conducted by Pratham (NGO) every year since 2005, the survey seeks to understand children’s status of schooling and basic learning in India. Each year, almost all rural districts in the country are surveyed with the support of volunteers from local organisations and institutions such as Lovely Professional University. ASER reaches over 600,000 children (aged 3 to 16) annually through 25,000 volunteers. Division of Admissions in association with ASER (Annual Status of Education Report 2018) is conducting a survey in 2 districts of Punjab. The Survey will be conducted in villages of Jalandhar and Hoshiarpur districts in month of September or October 2018. Applications are invited from students of nearby cities for the conduct for Survey. Process for conduct of Survey 1. Fill online application form 2. title: Training for CISCO Cyber Operations in CISCO Network Academy at Lovely Professional University : (8/21/2018)
body: We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with CISCO has started new training program on Cyber Operations. The CCNA Cybersecurity Operations curriculum provides an introduction to the knowledge and skills needed for a Security Analyst working with a Security Operations Center team. It teaches core security skills needed for monitoring, detecting, investigating, analyzing and responding to security events, thus protecting systems and organizations from cybersecurity risks, threats and vulnerabilities. By the end of the course, students will be prepared to: 1. Understand cybersecurity operations network principles, roles and responsibilities as well as the related technologies, tools, regulations and frameworks available. 2.Apply knowledge and skills to monitor, detect, investigate, analyze and respond to security incidents. 3. Apply for entry-level jobs as Assoicate Security Analyst and Incident Responder. 4. Take the Cisco CCNA Cybersecurity Operations Certification exam. CCNA Cybersecurity Operations is a hands-on, career-oriented course with an emphasis on practical experience to help students develop specialized skills to sucessfully handle the tasks, duties, and responsibilities of an associate-level Security Analyst working in a Security Operations Center (SOC). Advantages to pursue training program in CISCO Network Academy 1.Training certificate from CISCO after training 2.Discount in CCNA Certification after training 3.Access to Online Curriculum and interactive tools 24 x 7 from anywhere 4.CISCO Facilitates Placement Assistant to CCNA graduates 5.State of the art online assessments Including quizzes, chapter and final exams, and simulation-based skills exams Requirement Basic Operating System (Windows, Linux) and networking concepts Registration detail: Duration of training: 25th August 2018 to 15th November 2018 Venue: Block-38 (Research and development) - Lovely Professional university Training cost: Rs. 4000 Registration Process: 1.An amount of Rs. 4000 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Cisco Network Academy” 2.Student need to fill the registration form on www.tinyurl.com/netacadlpu by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3.Student once register cannot withdraw the application 4.Registration fees is non refundable 5.Seats are First Come First Serve basis. title: Participation notice for 4th International Conference on Computing Sciences (ICCS) “Feynman-100” : (8/16/2018)
body: We are pleased to inform you that 4th International Conference on Computing Sciences (ICCS) “Feynman-100” is being organized jointly by School of CSE, School of CA and Division of R&D on 30th August 2018. Reputed international faculty members from renowned institutions are participating in the conference. Keynote address will be delivered by the following eminent academicians: Richard Hill Professor and Head Department for Computer Science Huddersfield University, UK Valentina E. Balas Professor Faculty of Engineering Aurel Vlaicu University of Arad, Romania For more details and list of tracks you can visit the conference website link (http://conferences.lpu.in/iccs/index.php). a) For School of CSE and CA, 30th August will be a non-teaching day (in lieu of that next Saturday i.e. 1st September would be a teaching day). CSE and CA faculty members who are deputed in other Schools are permitted to plan make up or adjust their classes for participating in the conference. b) For faculty members, registration fee as participant has been reduced to Rs 700/- (against Rs 1000/- earlier). Moreover, it is compulsory for faculty members of CSE and CA (deputed in parent or other schools) to register as participant in the conference. Those faculty members whose paper is accepted for this conference, need not register as participant. For allied departments of CSE and CA, participation is optional. c) For Post Graduate students M.Tech CSE (1st and 2nd Year), MCA (2nd and 3rd Year) and M.Sc. Computer Science (2nd Year) participation is mandatory. For other students of the LPU, participation is optional. For LPU students, participation fee has been reduced to Rs. 350/-. (against Rs. 500/- for other student participants). Those students who will be participating in the conference on 30th August will be awarded duty leave for their Saturday classes (Hence they are exempted from 1st September classes). d) The following facilities will be given to the registered Participants: a. Faculty Participant: Certificate of participation, Registration Kit, Lunch and refreshment. b. Student Participants: Certificate of participation, Registration Kit, refreshment coupon. e) Registration can be done online at the below mentioned link: Link: http://conferences.lpu.in/iccs/studentregistration.aspx In case of any query, you can contact following officials: CSE participants Mr. Dalwinder Singh (94630-09764) CA participants Mr. Deepak Mehta (88377-03475) General queries Dr. Varun Kumar (97800-36447)

title: Call for Enrolment- YES Bank Case Study challenge : (8/14/2018)
body: YES BANK Transformation Series is India’s largest case study competition. In the past 6 years, it has moved from a national level case study competition to a platform for crowd sourcing solutions from students of B-schools and Tech institutes for live challenges faced by businesses across the world. For Edition 7, they have joined hands with 12 partners across sectors to give students the opportunity to address India’s urban development challenges and other issues of national importance through Collaboration as a Service’. Important dates: Date Event 18 July-20 Aug,2018 Campus Connect 31st Aug, 2018 Last date for submission of case solutions 5th Oct, 2018 Rollout of Final Case Study 30th Nov, 2018 Grand Finale (Top 15 teams to present the case) Rules : Each member of the team must be a full-time student with a recognized university. Students can form a team of up to three members. All members of the team must be from the same university. Registrations can only be done online. YES BANK Transformation Series reserves the right to check the validity of the registration information submitted at any point of time. Once you have registered your team, no changes will be accepted. Any deviation from the above will result in immediate disqualification of the entire team. Students, who are on an International Exchange program from Indian Universities, are eligible to participate in YES BANK Transformation Series, but they must ensure that at least one of the three members, will be available to present their work, if their entry is shortlisted. There is no cap on the number of participating teams from a college. title: 106th Indian Science Congress at LPU : (8/13/2018)
body: 106th Indian Science Congress Theme: Future India: Science & Technology January 3rd to January 7th 2019, LPU · It gives us immense pleasure to share with you that the Lovely Professional University is hosting the 106th Indian Science Congress scheduled from January 3rd to January 7th 2019. Indian Science Congress Association (ISCA) Membership · Indian Science Congress is organized every year by the Indian Science Congress Association (An Professional Autonomous body of Department of Science & Technology, Ministry of Science & technology, Govt. of India). · To be a participant/paper presenter (author/co-author) in the event, it is mandatory to become a member (Annual/Life Member/Student Member) of Indian Science Congress Association (ISCA) prior to registration for the event. Details of Membership Student Member (For Students upto undergraduate level only) - Rs. 100/- Annual Membership – Rs. 250/- Life Membership – Rs. 2,000/- · Students who are interested to become ISCA member are requested to fill ISCA membership form and prepare the Demand Draft of the payment in favor of “The Indian Science Congress Association” payable at Kolkata. All forms must be sent to the following address – The Indian Science Congress Association 14, Dr. Biresh Guha Street Kolkata-700017 · Membership Form can be downloaded from following link – http://www.sciencecongress.nic.in/pdf/Members_Form.pdf · A copy of the form must be submitted to the “Local Secretariat, 106th Indian Science Congress, Block 29 (Level II), Office of the Pro-Chancellor”. · Student Membership forms must be forwarded by HoS/HoD of the concerned School. Paper Presentation (Oral / Poster) at 106th Indian Science Congress · All papers to be submitted for presentation at the 106th Indian Science Congress must be sent to the Concerned Sectional Presidents. Each paper must be accompanied by three copies of abstracts (within 100 words, without any sketches, tables, etc.) and a copy of the full paper and CD (Typed in MS Word). The name of the Section where the paper is to be presented should be indicated. For detailed instructions about paper presentation and contact Details of Concerned Section President refer attached Annexure A. Last date for submitting papers to Sectional President is 15th September, 2018. · To know more about ISCA membership and 106th ISC registration, visit http://www.sciencecongress.nic.in & http://isc2019.org For any other clarification, please contact: Dr. Saurabh Satija, Local Secretariat, 106th Indian Science Congress Block 29 (Level II), Office of the Pro-Chancellor Ph. +91-1824-444309; Email ID: isc106@lpu.co.in; saurabh.21958@lpu.co.in

title: Call for Application: IEEE Empower a Billion Lives competetion : (8/10/2018)
body: Applications are open for IEEE Empower a Billion Lives which is expected to be a biennial global competition, that challenges teams from around the world to develop innovative solutions that can bring cost-effective energy, and its life transforming impact, to billions of unserved and underserved people. The competition is organized by IEEE, an all-volunteer organization whose goal is to foster technological innovation and excellence for the benefit of humanity. The IEEE Empower a Billion Lives competition is agnostic to energy sources, technologies, and business models. Solutions will be evaluated on both their technical innovation and business viability to rapidly and sustainably scale to one billion customers. Online Round: Teams will submit proposals online. Teams meeting the requirements as noted by judges will be able to compete in one of five Regional Rounds. Regional Round: Each Regional Round will have winners in each track. There will be additional special prizes, including prizes for student teams. Winning teams will have to participate in a field evaluation to be eligible to participate in the Global Final. Global Final: All succeeding teams will compete in the Global Final. The total anticipated prize purse is $1 Million. Categories Track 1: Decentralized Model(Tr1) Commercially available solution (Tr1A) Emerging solution (Tr1B) Track 2: Centralized Utility Model (Tr2) Commercially available solution (Tr2A) Emerging solution (Tr2B) Benefits Learning opportunity: Learn about one of the most pressing issues facing humanity from experts in the field Huge untapped market potential: A market of 1.1 billion unserved people is one of the largest market opportunities today Exposure: Winners of the regional rounds and the global round will be featured on press releases, social media, and various media outlets Networking: Participate in banquets and other social events with participants active in the sector Sponsored field pilot: Winners of the regional round will be provided enough funding to complete a 2-month long field pilot Significant Prize Monies: Amongst the regional rounds and global final winners a maximum $1 Million dollar prize purse will be distributed Impact The impact of affordable energy access on families and communities can be profound, providing positive outcomes in areas of health, food security, education, increased productivity, digital and financial inclusion, and livelihood and lifestyle changes.\ Eligibility Criteria 1. The competition is completely open to all, including student groups, small- and medium-sized companies, research labs, international corporations, and non-profit organizations. 2. Contest is open to residents of the United States of America and other countries, where permitted by local law, who are the age of eighteen (18) and older. 3. Employees of Sponsor, its agents, affiliates and their immediate families are not eligible to enter Contest. 4. Teams may be subject to rules imposed by their institution or employer relative to their participation in contests and should check with their institution or employer for any relevant policies. 5. Void where prohibited by law.Competition Schedule 1. The inaugural Empower a Billion Lives Competition (EBL 1) will consist of three competition rounds in four stages – Online Round Regional Rounds Field Evaluation Global Final Round. 2. Field performance will be evaluated between the regional and final competition. The EBL final round for EBL 1 will be held in Baltimore in 2019. 3. The EBL competition will operate on a two-year cycle, with online rounds and regional rounds in the first year, followed by field tests and a global final in the second year. Registration Link: http://www.empowerabillionlives.org/

title: Training for CISCO Cyber Operations in CISCO Network Academy at Lovely Professional University : (8/9/2018)
body: We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with CISCO has started new training program on Cyber Operations. The CCNA Cybersecurity Operations curriculum provides an introduction to the knowledge and skills needed for a Security Analyst working with a Security Operations Center team. It teaches core security skills needed for monitoring, detecting, investigating, analyzing and responding to security events, thus protecting systems and organizations from cybersecurity risks, threats and vulnerabilities. By the end of the course, students will be prepared to: 1. Understand cybersecurity operations network principles, roles and responsibilities as well as the related technologies, tools, regulations and frameworks available. 2.Apply knowledge and skills to monitor, detect, investigate, analyze and respond to security incidents. 3. Apply for entry-level jobs as Assoicate Security Analyst and Incident Responder. 4. Take the Cisco CCNA Cybersecurity Operations Certification exam. CCNA Cybersecurity Operations is a hands-on, career-oriented course with an emphasis on practical experience to help students develop specialized skills to sucessfully handle the tasks, duties, and responsibilities of an associate-level Security Analyst working in a Security Operations Center (SOC). Advantages to pursue training program in CISCO Network Academy 1.Training certificate from CISCO after training 2.Discount in CCNA Certification after training 3.Access to Online Curriculum and interactive tools 24 x 7 from anywhere 4.CISCO Facilitates Placement Assistant to CCNA graduates 5.State of the art online assessments Including quizzes, chapter and final exams, and simulation-based skills exams Requirement Basic Operating System (Windows, Linux) and networking concepts Registration detail: Duration of training: 25th August 2018 to 15th November 2018 Venue: Block-38 (Research and development) - Lovely Professional university Training cost: Rs. 4000 Registration Process: 1.An amount of Rs. 4000 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Cisco Network Academy” 2.Student need to fill the registration form on www.tinyurl.com/netacadlpu by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3.Student once register cannot withdraw the application 4.Registration fees is non refundable 5.Seats are First Come First Serve basis. body: The Education Department of Sant Nirankari Mandal had been providing Scholarships to the meritorious students pursuing traditional courses like B.A., B.Sc., B.Com, Diploma in Engineering, Hotel Management, BBA, BCA, M.Com, M.A., MCA, Diploma/Degree or Training in any Sport, Instrumental Music/Vocal Music from a recognized Institution in India, etc. till they complete their education and settle in life. Last date for the scholarship is 30th September 2018 Eligibility Criteria 1. Students must secure 60% and above in class 10th and 10+2. 2. The most needy and promising students who have not been able to secure 60% marks due to some specific reasons or circumstances beyond their control. The amount of reimbursement will be as under: For 60% and above marks = 100% of Tuition fee For 50% to 59% marks = 50% of Tuition fee (The maximum ceiling of the benefit will be Rs.50,000/- per year per student or the Tuition Fee payable in each year, whichever is less.) 3. 1st year students of all the courses mentioned above are eligible. 4. In case of renewal students, the students must secure at least 60 % marks every year. 5. Student’s detained in any semester / year examination due to shortage of attendance are not eligible. 6. The income of the family from all sources should not be more than Rs.3.50 lakh per annum. 7. Copy of latest pay slip and I.T. Returns of all the earning members of the family or Copy of the Family Income Certificate issue by the Area SDM or any other officer authorized in this behalf by the Revenue Department indicating that the total annual income of the family is not more than Rs. 3.5 lakh. Documents to be attached with scholarship application form: 1. One Passport size photo. 2. A copy of latest pay slip and I.T. Returns of all the earning members of the family OR Income Certificate issued by the Area SDM. 4. Academic transcript (i.e. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Graduation DMC etc. 5. Copy of Ration Card /Aadhar Card / Voter I-Card / Pass-Port / Pan-Card or any other residence proof. 6. Copy of bank passbook and a cancelled cheque of saving bank account of applicant for remittance of financial assistance. The Bank Account should be in the name of student. Name of student, bank account no. & IFSC Code must be mentioned on the copy of passbook/cheque. The date of issue of Income Certificate should not be more than three months prior to the date of submission of application. 7. Fee Receipts (attested from accounts department). 8. Admission letter -- Student have to apply for Admission Letter before 24-09-2018 by sending their request through email to Ms. Partigya at partigya.20092@lpu.co.in and collect it from SSIV Cell, Block No.32, Room No.102 (Window No.-03). Also you have to submit the photocopy of aforesaid documents before receiving the Admission Letter. 9. A certificate by the institution stating that :- (a) The candidate will not/has not been granted scholarship under any scheme of other private organization or religious or spiritual organization or Government authorities, (b) Has not taken admission through Management Quota or any other Quota (c) Confirm that his/her family income from all sources does not exceed Rs.3.50 lakhs per annum. Note: 1. The students have to submit the completely filled application form in SSIV Cell (Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No.-3. The verified scholarship application form must be collected from the SSIV Cell & sent on below mentioned address before last date i.e. 30.09.2018:- Sant Nirankari Mandal, Sant Nirankari administrative Block, Nirankari Complex, Nirankari Chownk, Burari Road, Delhi – 110009 2. The students are advised to mention their latest mobile number & email id on scholarship application form for proper communication. 3. The detailed guidelines along with the application form are enclosed for your reference & can also be checked from the link:- Link:- https://www.nirankari.org/ In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on any working day in Block No.32, Room No.102 between 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM. title: Scholarship for Minorities students has been opened on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2018-19 - reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180726/002) : (8/9/2018)
body: Fresh Students: Students come under Minorities i.e. Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain and Zoroastrians (Parsis) can apply for the Post Matric Scholarship and Merit Cum Means scholarship on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2018-19. The link for applying for the scholarship is as under: Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Last date for the scholarship is 30th September 2018 Eligibility Criteria 1. Scholarship will be awarded to the students who have secured not less than 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous final examination. 2. The annual income of whose parents/guardian from all sources does not exceed Rs.2.00 lakh in case of Post Matric Scholarship and 2.5 lakh in case of Merit Cum Means Scholarship. 3. The student obtaining benefits under this scholarship scheme shall not be allowed to avail of benefits under any other scholarship scheme implemented by State Government / UT Administration, for the same purpose. Documents required for uploading on NSP Scholarship Portal are mentioned below:- 1. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Diploma DMC, Graduation DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) 2. Fee Receipts (Duly stamped from accounts department). 3. Self -Declaration of minority community certificate by the students. 4. The latest Income Certificate (Issued by the designated State/UT authority). 5. Aadhaar Card of student (linked with bank account). 6. Bank Passbook Copy of student (linked with Aadhar Card). 7. Domicile / Residence Certificate 8. Recent Passport Size Photo (1) Renewal Students: Students whose scholarship cases are sanctioned for the session 2017-18 and who have received the scholarship amount in his/her bank account have to register again for scholarship for the session 2018-19 as renewal case. Also the students have to submit the copy of scholarship received proof i.e. bank account statement. Note: While entering the university detail students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – PUNJAB District – KAPURTHALA, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). If the students selects the wrong university name other than mentioned above then his/her case will not be forwarded online by the university and students will be responsible themselves for the rejection of the scholarship case. All the eligible students have to submit the above mentioned documents in SSIV Cell, Block No. 32, Room No.102, Window No. 3 before the last date as mentioned on the scholarship portal. ­­Students must provide valid contact details and email Ids for communication. In case of wrong information provided by the students, then we will not be able to communicate with students and the student will be responsible for the rejection of online scholarship application. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on any working day in Block No.32, Room No.102 between 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM. Note: The Students can check the complete eligibility for the scholarship scheme and other instructions in the attached file.

title: Registration for Re-appear/Improvement examination to be conducted in Aug-Nov, 2018. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180806/001) : (8/6/2018)
body: The interface for registration of Re-appear/Improvement examination to be conducted in August to November 2018 has been opened for all students. Certain modifications have been made in the re-appear application process wherein the process has been shortened for the convenience of the students. Now, a student having ‘E’ grade(s) in any course code(s) (of any term) will be automatically registered in all his/her ‘E’ grade courses from the backend. In case, a student does not want to appear in some of the registered courses then he/she can de-register the course(s) through the provided interface. For the final selected courses, the student is required to directly pay the fee for the ‘E’ grade courses, thus omitting the first step of registration process. In case, a course is de-registered by mistake then the same can be registered again by the student through the online interface. The detailed procedure is attached for reference. The tentative dates of examination for each course code have also been mentioned against the course code, so that the students can select their courses and prepare for them accordingly. The fee for re-appear registration is Rs. 350/- per course code and the last date with this fee is 16th August, 2018. Note that after 16th August, 2018 (12.00 a.m. onwards), the fee for registration will be increased to Rs. 500/- per course code and the last date with this fee is 18th August, 2018. Note: The student who fails to pay fee by 18th August 2018 will be automatically de-registered in the pending ‘E’ grade courses for which they have not paid the fee and these courses shall stop reflecting in their account. For any scheduled lectures falling in the time slot of the examination, duty leave shall be given to the student for those lectures only (particularly in the time slot of exam time) . In addition, duty leave shall also be given to the student for classes scheduled one hour prior and one hour after the time of examination. Important dates:- Registration start date 4th August, 2018 Last date of registration (without late fee) 16th August, 2018 Last date of registration (with late fee) 18th August, 2018 Commencement of examination 24th August, 2018

Students can search and apply for various education finance schemes they are qualified for. Due to unaffordable and increasing fees structure of the higher education in India many students misses out on the higher education due to lack of funds. Those students that are willing to pursue higher education and need financial support can use Vidyasaarathi platform to avail the required financial support. Students seeking for education scholarship can search and apply for various education finance schemes that they are qualified for Last date to apply for the scholarship is 31-08-2018 Link for applying scholarship: www.vidyasaarathi.co.in The students can apply for the various types of scholarships on the Vidyasaarthi Scholarship Portal. title: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles –reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180803/003) : (8/3/2018)
body: Registration process for Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles has been started on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2018- 19. Last date for the scholarship is 31st October 2018 The link for National Scholarship Portal is as under:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Eligibility Criteria for applying on PMSSS 1. Wards/widows of deceased CAPFs & AR personnel died in harness/election duty, wards of personnel disabled due to causes attributable to Government service and Wards of Ex-CAPFs & AR personnel in receipt of Gallantry Awards. 2. Wards/widows of retired and serving CAPFs & AR Personnel. (Personnel below Officer Rank). 3. Pursuing first professional degree programme in the field of Engineering, BBA, BCA, B. Pharma, B.SC (Agriculture etc.), MBA and MCA etc. 4. Having minimum 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent in case of new applicant. Or For applicants applying under renewal category, it is mandatory to pass the each subsequent academic year of the professional courses being pursued by them with minimum 50% marks. 5. Wards admitted in 2nd year of technical/professional Bachelor Degree Course (BE / B. Tech. etc.) through lateral entry after completion of Diploma courses are eligible for PMS. 6. In case of applicant passed XII exam from CBSE, marks obtained in best of five subjects out of 500 will be considered for calculating the percentage of marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ). Documents to be uploaded on NSP Scholarship Portal are as under:- 1. PPO/Discharge Certificate/Book (Mandatory for category A to F) (Refer attached guidelines). 2. Disability Certificate (Mandatory for category B & D) (Refer attached guidelines). 3. Death Certificate (Mandatory for category A & C) (Refer attached guidelines). 4. Certificate of Gallantry award (Mandatory for category E) (Refer attached guidelines). 5. Service Certificate to be issued by the Head of Office (H.O.O) in case of serving personnel as per Annexure- A. (Refer attached guidelines). 6. Attested scanned copy of the Mark sheet MEQ i.e. XII/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent. 7. Copy of Aadhar Card (linked with bank account). 8. Copy of Bank Passbook (Aadhar number linked with bank account is mandatory). 9. Domicile/ Resident Certificate. 10. Caste Certificate (SC / OBC/ ST) if applicable. 11. One passport size photo. Renewal Students: Students whose scholarship cases are sanctioned for the session 2017-18 and who have received the scholarship amount in his/her bank account have to register again for scholarship for the session 2018-19 as renewal case. Also the students have to submit the copy of scholarship received proof i.e. bank account statement. All the eligible students have to submit the above mentioned documents in SSIV Cell, Block No. 32, Room No.102, Window No. 3 before the last date i.e. 31.10.2018. ­­The students are advised to submit latest mobile number & email id for proper communication. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on any working day in Block No.32, Room No.102 between 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM. Note: 1. body: Scholarship Scheme for Award of Financial Assistance for Education (Scholarship) to the Children of Beedi Workers, Iron Ore, Manganese Ore & Chrome Ore Mine (IOMC) Workers, Limestone & Dolomite Mine (LSDM) Workers & Cine Workers, has been started on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2018- 19. Last date for the scholarship is 31st October 2018 The link for National Scholarship Portal is as under:- Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Eligibility Criteria 1. Either of the parents of the students should be Beedi, Iron Ore Manganese & Chrome Ore Mines, Limestone & Dolomite Mines, Cine worker with atleast 6 months service. This also includes Contract/Gharkhata workers. 2. Total monthly Income of the Worker’s family from all sources should not exceed as under :- a) Beedi Workers - Rs.10,000/- per month b) Mine Workers – The income criteria is as under:- i) The Mine workers doing manual, unskilled, highly skilled and clerical work are eligible for availing all facilities under different welfare schemes of Labour Welfare Organization irrespective of the wages paid to them. ii) The persons employed in supervisory and managerial capacity are eligible for availing the facilities under different welfare schemes subject to the wage limit of Rs.10,000/- per month. c) Cine workers – “An amount not exceeding Rs.8,000/- per month where such amount is paid monthly or an amount not exceeding Rs.1,00,000/- where it is paid by way of lump sum or installments, as remuneration of a cine worker for the purpose of this Act.”. 3. The students must have passed the last qualifying examination in first attempt. 4. The students pursuing studies through Correspondence are not eligible. 5. The students should have taken regular admission for studies at recognized institutions/universities in any course of general or technical education, including engineering and agricultural studies. 6. Students who receive scholarship or stipend from any other source will not be granted under this Scheme. 7. The Students should have separate bank account. In case of Joint Account, the first name should be of the student. Documents to be uploaded on NSP Scholarship Portal are as under:- 1. Copy of the Identity card of the worker. 2. Copy of front page of Bank Pass Book or Cancelled Cheque (which should contain details of the account holder/beneficiary). 3. title: Scholarship for Disabled students has been opened on National Scholarship portal for the session 2018-19-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180726/003) : (7/26/2018)
body: Scholarship for Disabled students has been opened on National Scholarship portal for the session 2018-19. The link for applying for the scholarship is as under: Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Last date for the scholarship is 31st October 2018 Eligibility Criteria 1. Students having more than 40 % disability and having a valid certificate of disability are eligible. 2. Not more than two children with disabilities of the same parents will be entitled to receive benefits of the scheme. 3. A scholarship holder under this scheme will not be holding any other scholarship / stipend. 4. Parents/guardian’s income from all sources does not exceed Rs.2,50,000/- per annum. Documents required for uploading on NSP scholarship portal are mentioned below:- 1. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Diploma DMC, Graduation DMC, Provisional Academic Transcript etc.) 2. Disability Certificate issued by the competent authority designated by the District Medical Officer/Civil Surgeon of Government Hospital. 3. Scanned copy of Parental Income Certificate (Duly signed by Revenue Authority / Tehsildar. Form 16 is not acceptable. 4. Fee Receipt of current course year. 5. Student Photograph. 6. Copy of Aadhar Card/Enrollment(linked with Bank Passbook). 7. Copy of the passbook clearly showing the account number and name of student(linked with Aadhar Card). Note: While entering the university detail students have to select the University name as per the following detail:- State – PUNJAB District – KAPURTHALA, University Name – Lovely Professional University, JULLUNDER (AISHE CODE-U-0379). If the students selects the wrong university name other than mentioned above then his/her case will not be forwarded online by the university and students will be responsible themselves for the rejection of the scholarship case. All the eligible students have to submit the above mentioned documents in SSIV Cell, Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No. 1 before the last date as mentioned on the scholarship portal. Students must provide valid contact details and email IDs for communication. In case of wrong information provided by the students, then we will not be able to communicate with students and the student will be responsible for the rejection of online scholarship application. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on any working day in Block No.32, Room No.102 between 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM. Note: The Students can check the complete eligibility for the scholarship scheme and other instructions in the attached file.

title: Scholarship provided by HDFC for the students undergoing a crisis situation, for the session2018-19. (LPU/DOE/IC/180726/001) : (7/26/2018)
body: HDFC has started the Educational Crisis Scholarship Support’ ECSS programme to provide support to children facing personal or economic problems. Last Date of Submitting Application is: 15th August 2018. Who can apply for scholarship? 1. Students pursuing Undergraduate/Postgraduate Fulltime/Part-Time Degree/Diploma courses in Colleges or Universities recognized under UGC. 2. Students undergoing a crisis situation i.e.sudden occurrence of an incident that has created a situation where the student/family requires support, sudden job loss, Sudden death / separation of parents, Accident/death of siblings, sudden onset of a critical or life threatening illness. The incident leading to a crisis should be within the preceding two years. 3. The Scholarship will cover the total annualCollege/University Fee up to a maximum of Rs. 25,000/- of the selected candidates. 4. Duration of scholarship will be maximum two years and every year candidate needs to re-apply and re-qualify for the scholarship. 5. The Selection of the candidate/ scholarship will be done as per the criteria defined by management of HDFC Bank. 6. Application form and application details are available on www.hdfcbank.com/scholarship. The application can be submitted either online or as a hard copy. 7. The Application form can be submitted at any branch of HDFC Bank. Do not forget to get the form endorsed by the branch manager before submission. Note: - Formats for Income from parents&self-employedare available on HDFC website https://www.hdfcbank.com/htdocs/common/ECSS_scholarship.htm and students have to collect verification form by institute from Ms. HarjitKaurat Block No. 32, Room No. 102, CabinNo. 22. The following documents are mandatory and to be attached with the scholarship application form:- 1. Family Income Proof Certificate. 2. Copy of the last passed examination (10th onwards). 3. If students arefrom OBC/SC/ST, then they need to attach the certificate of the same. 4. Copy of Aadhaar card. 5. Copy of Saving Bank passbook of student. The students have to submit the completely filled application form along with above mentioned documents in SSIV Cell at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No.-1. The verified scholarship application form must be collected from the SSIV Cell &submitted in any branch of HDFC Bank after the signatures of Bank Manager. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information & Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) on any working day between 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

title: Any Student (any category) Can Apply for the Scholarship on the Vidyasaarathi Scholarship Portal for the session 2018-19-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180629/001) : (7/23/2018)
body: Dear Students, Vidyasaarathi is a technology-enabled initiative by NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Limited (NSDL e-Gov) to bridge the gap in education finance in the country through an online platform. Students can search and apply for various education finance schemes they are qualified for. Due to unaffordable and increasing fees structure of the higher education in India many students misses out on the higher education due to lack of funds. Those students that are willing to pursue higher education and need financial support can use Vidyasaarathi platform to avail the required financial support. Students seeking for education scholarship can search and apply for various education finance schemes that they are qualified for. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 31-07-2018 Link for applying scholarship: www.vidyasaarathi.co.in The students can apply for the various types of scholarships on the Vidyasaarthi Scholarship Portal. The detail & eligibility criteria of the various schemes are as under:- Sr. No. Scholarship Agency Eligibility Criteria for the Scholarship Required Documents (All documents uploaded shall be clear and must be in .jpeg or .png file only) Scholarship Amount 1. SNL Bearings scholarship for students pursuing B.Sc Qualification criteria : Minimum 50% in SSC, Minimum 50% in HSC Course Name : B.Sc.-Bachelor of Science Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 500000/- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Proof of Income 5) Student Bank passbook/Kiosk 6) Class 10 and Class 12 Marksheet 7) Current year fees receipts 8) Bonafide certificate from institute 9) Optional document---PAN No/Domicile certificate 15,000/- (Per Annum) 2. SNL Bearings scholarship for students pursuing B.E/B. Tech (After Class 12) Qualification criteria: Minimum 50% in SSC, Minimum 50% in HSC Course Name: B.Tech. Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 500000/- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Proof of Income 5) Student Bank passbook/Kiosk 6) Class 10 and Class 12 Marksheet 7) Current year fees receipts 8) Bonafide certificate from institute 9) Optional document---PAN No/Domicile certificate 25,000/- (Per Annum) 3. SNL Bearings scholarship for students pursuing Diploma (After Class 10) Qualification criteria : Minimum 50% in SSC Course Name : Diploma (After Class 10) Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 500000/- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Proof of Income 5) Student Bank passbook/Kiosk 6) Class 10 Marksheet 7) Current year fees receipts 8) Bonafide certificate from institute 9) Optional document---PAN No/Domicile certificate 20,000/- (Per Annum) 4. Thomson Reuters scholarship for students pursuing Bachelor of Law (LLB) Qualification criteria : Minimum 50% in SSC, Minimum 50% in HSC, Minimum 50% in Graduation Course Name : L.L.B.-Bachelor of Law or Laws Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 600000/- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Proof of Income 5) Student Bank passbook/Kiosk 6) 10th ,12th & Graduation Marksheet 7) Current year fees receipts 8) Admission Letter 9) Bonafide certificate from institute 10) Optional document--PAN No/Domicile certificate 25,000/- (Per Annum) 5. Thomson Reuters scholarship for students pursuing Master of Commerce (M.Com) Qualification criteria : Minimum 50% in SSC, Minimum 50% in HSC, Minimum 50% in Graduation Course Name : M.Com. - Master of Commerce Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 600000/- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Proof of Income 5) Student Bank passbook/Kiosk 6) 10th ,12th & Graduation Marksheet 7) Current year fees receipts 8) Admission Letter 9) Bonafide certificate from institute 10) Optional document--PAN No/Domicile certificate 10,000/- (Per Annum) 6. Thomson Reuters scholarship for students pursuing Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) Qualification criteria : Minimum 50% in SSC, Minimum 50% in HSC Course Name : B.Com.-Bachelor of Commerce Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 600000/- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Proof of Income 5) Student Bank passbook/Kiosk 6) 10th & 12th Marksheet 7) Current year fees receipts 8) Admission Letter 9) Bonafide certificate from institute 10) Optional document--PAN No/Domicile certificate 7,000/- (Per Annum) 7. Thomson Reuters scholarship for students pursuing MBA/ PGDBM/ MFM/ MMS Qualification criteria : Minimum 50% in SSC, Minimum 50% in HSC, Minimum 50% in Diploma, Minimum 50% in Graduation Course Name : M.B.A., P.G.D.M.-Post-Graduate Diploma in Management, M.M.S.-Master of Management Studies, M.F.M. -Master of Financial Management (MFM) Scheme is available to only student whose family income is less than or equal to 600000/- 1) Applicant Photo 2) Proof of Identity 3) Proof of Address 4) Proof of Income 5) Student Bank passbook/Kiosk 6) 10th,12th & Graduation Marksheet 7) Current year fees receipts 8) Admission letter 9) Bonafide certificate from institute 10) Optional document--PAN No/Domicile certificate 50,000/- (Per Annum) The instructions for creating login id & password and apply for the various types of scholarships are mentioned in the Student Manual which is enclosed for your reference.You have to fill annual tuition fee & Examination fee on portal, if you have getting scholarship from the Govt. or LPU or any other organization then the scholarship amount must be specified at the appropriate place. You have to apply for Bonafide Certificate& Admission Letter for Vidyasaarthi scholarship on or before 27-07-2018 from SSIV Cell, Block No.32, Room No.102 (Window No.-01) or send email at baljinder.kumar@lpu.co.in for scan copy of the certificates.You have to submit the photocopy of aforesaid documents before receiving the Bonafide Certificate & Admission Letter. title: Nirankari Rajmata Scholarship Scheme for the session 2018-19-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180721/001) : (7/21/2018)
body: Sant Nirankari Charitable Foundation has launched a Scholarship Scheme to provide Financial Assistance to Meritorious Students to pursue Professional and Technical Courses for Graduation and Post-Graduation levels and who excel in sports and cultural activities at State/National. Only Tuition Fee will be paid. (The maximum ceiling of the benefit will be Rs. 50,000/- per year per student or the Tuition Fee payable in each year, whichever is less).The applicant must have the offer of admission in hand in any of the following disciplines in the Institutions/Colleges recognized by the State/Central Government and have secured not less than 90% marks in Class XII of the examination:- a) Graduate Degree in any discipline of Engineering. b) MBA / PGDM. c) Architecture. d)LLB after securing a minimum of 90% marks in Class XII and passing Entrance Test for LLB or after qualifying Degree Exams. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30-09-2018. Procedure for applying scholarship: (a) Duly filled-in application form with all the requisite documents should be submitted to the Member Education, Sant Nirankari Charitable Foundation 80-A, Avtar Marg, Nirankari Colony, Delhi, India Postal Code: 110009 on or before the closing date for submission of applications viz September 30, 2018. No application will be received after this date. (b) No column of the form should be left blank. (c) Cheques to successful candidates will be distributed by December 31, 2018. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA / CONDITIONS: 1. The applicant should be a regular student of any Institution/College recognized by Central/State Government, admitted through a competitive written test. 2. The income of the family from all sources, to which the applicant belongs to, should not be more than Rs.3.50 lakh per annum. 3. The applicant/applicant’s family should submit latest pay slips and I.T.R of all the earning family members or a family Income Certificate issued by the SDM or any other officer authorized in this behalf by the Revenue Department indicating that the total annual income of the family is not more than Rs. 3.50 lakh. The date of issue of Income Certificate should not be more than three months prior to the date of submission of application. 4. The students who have taken scholarship from any other source (from University/Institute/External Agency/State or Central Govt.) cannot apply for this Scholarship. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED (1) Duly filled-in and affixed photographed application form on the prescribed format for each academic year. (2) A copy of latest pay slip and I.T. Returns of all the earning members of the family. OR Copy of the family Income Certificate issued by the Area SDM. (3) The Admission Slip/letter by which the applicant has been offered admission by the University/Educational Institution. (4) Mark Sheets of all previous academic qualifications, starting from Class –X like Class X, XII, Graduation DMC’s etc. (5) Copy of latest fee receipts issued by the University/Institutes. (6) Details of the fee including Tuition Fee, Library, Hostel, Books etc. duly signed by the Accounts Department of the University/Institute may be attached with the application. (7) A certificate by the institution stating that (a) the candidate will not/has not been granted scholarship under any scheme of other private organization or religious or spiritual organization or Government authorities,(b) has not taken admission through Management Quota or any other Quota(c) confirm that his/her family income from all sources does not exceedRs.3.50 lakhs per annum. (8) Copy of Ration Card/Aadhar Card / Voter I-Card / Pass-Port / Pan-Card or any other residence proof. (9) Statement of Bank Account of the father/mother/self for the last six months. (10) Copy of bank passbook and a cancelled cheque of saving bank account of applicant for remittance of financial assistance, in cases where the applicant has already deposited the fee in the Institute /College and is seeking reimbursement. The Bank Account should be in the name of student. Name of student, bank account no. & IFSC Code must be mentioned on the copy of passbook/cheque. Otherwise, fee should be paid directly to the Institute / College. Note: (1) All the documents, testimonials submitted with the application form should be self-attested. Incomplete form will not be considered for grant of scholarship. (2) The applicants are required to submit application on prescribed format of SNCF along with all requisite documents. The application complete in all respect can also be submitted online through E-Mail Id educationdept@nirankarifoundation.org. (3) The detailed guidelines along with the application form are enclosed for your reference & can also be check from the link:- https://nirankarifoundation.org/nirankari-rajmata-scholarship-scheme-2018-19/ In case of any confusion / problem in applying for the scholarship on Nirankari Rajmata Scholarship Scheme, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, (SSIV Cell) in 32-102 ­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: Personality assessment for 2018 Admission Batch (7/18/2018)
body: Traits such as personality, intelligence, attitude, and beliefs are important characteristics to measure and assess. Whether you are hiring people, helping team members understand themselves and their relationships with others, or trying to figure out what you want to do with your life, its useful to assess these types of "hidden," less obvious attributes. One way to gather this information is through psychometric tests Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to conduct Personality Assessment for 2018 Admission batch to measure their Personality type. Why Personality test? · Objective and impersonal, allowing candidates to be compared in ability terms without bias. · It provides information on type of environment the candidate prefers to work within. · It gives an insight into the candidate’s preference for behaviours and opportunity to focus on areas of improvement. What Do Personality Test Measure? · Interest tests measure how people differ in their motivation, values, and opinions in relation to their interests. · Personality tests measure how people differ in their style or manner of doing things, and in the way they interact with their environment and other people. · Designed to measure candidates suitability for a role based on the required personality characteristics and cognitive skills Pathway to appear for Assessment:Login into your UMS >> UMS Navigation >> LMS >> Personality Assessment Test Head Centre For Professional Enhancement

title: Fentress Architects announces the 2018-2019 Fentress Global Challenge, an international design competition for young and student architects : (7/17/2018)
body: Title: Fentress Architects announces the 2018-2019 Fentress Global Challenge, an international design competition for young and student architects. About: - As in years past, the theme is consistent with the firm’s expertise in airport design and aviation, challenging applicants to envision an airport of the future. The design concept shall be submitted in PDF format and include: Up to 8 pages in 11-inch x 17-inch format, landscape orientation Participants of the (FGC) are encouraged to re-envision the terminal building in the year 2075. Concepts will integrate Fentress’ Touchstone 2: Use context to create identity. More on Fentress’ Eight Touchstones of Design In line with the speculative nature of the competition, participants should seek to improve every dimension of the airport terminal building. All entries should delve into one or more broad topic related to airport architecture and the future of aviation such as mobility, urbanization, globalization, technology, flexibility, security, project feasibility, and passenger experience in 2075. Designs must center on one of these airports, or one of comparable size: · ATLANTA GA, US (ATL) · BEIJING, CN (PEK) LONDON, GB (LHR) · CHICAGO IL, US (ORD) · TOKYO, JP (HND) · LOS ANGELES CA, US (LAX) · PARIS, FR (CDG) · DALLAS/FORT WORTH TX, US (DFW) · FRANKFURT, DE (FRA) · HONG KONG, HK (HKG) The submission must take into account existing runways and land restrictions of the chosen airport. Participants should create a new airport concept that replaces current terminal structures. Organizer: - Fentress Link to Participate: - https://fentressglobalchallenge.com/user/register Deadline: - The schedule for the competition is: Design Submission – May 31, 2019 Shortlist Announcement - July 1, 2019 Winners Announcement – July 29, 2019 Architectural Event – Fall 2019 Award: - 1ST PLACE - US$15,000 The top prize includes US$10,000 cash and the opportunity to accompany Curt Fentress to a prestigious architectural event where you will receive your award. Airfare, lodging, and entrance fee will be paid for by Fentress Architects, not to exceed US$5,000. Winners are responsible for obtaining necessary visas and paperwork. If entering as a group, the monetary prize and attendance at the architectural event will be distributed equally. 2ND PLACE - US$2,000 3RD PLACE - US$1,000 2 PEOPLE's CHOICE AWARDS - US$1,000 Website: - https://fentressglobalchallenge.com/ For queries contact us:- Phone Nos:- Mr. Arvind Mishra - 8755657679 Kapil Kaushal - 9814818964 Email ID: - kapil.22622@lpu.co.in
