title: Last date for applying in Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council Scholarship for the session 2018-19 has been extended till 10.08.2018-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180716/001) : (7/16/2018)
body: Sikh Human Development Foundation, USA (SHDF) and Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council (Regd.), New Delhi invite applications for SHDF scholarships from regular students studying in recognized colleges and Universities for Professional Degree/Diploma Courses like Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Medical, Nursing, Home Science, Architecture, Agriculture, Business Management, B.Ed., Journalism, C.A etc. Eligibility Criteria for Fresh and Renewal:- 1. Minimum 60 % marks in previous two examinations. 2. Total Family Income from all sources should not exceed Rs. 1,80,000per year. 3. Every student must have his/her valid email ID as all the communications will be done through email ID only. List of documents required for Fresh/ Renewal Applicants are mentioned below:- 1. Three recent photographs -Good quality colored passport size (Paste TWO photographs at appropriate place in the Application Form and ONE with your name on the backside of it in an envelope to be attached to the form). 2. Mark sheets of 10th Class Examination, Sr. Secondary Examination & later exam, if any (Self Attested) required in case of fresh applicant and DMC of last 2 semesters or 1st year required for Renewal. 3. DMC /Attested copies of Gazette (for the Examinations passed during 2017-2018) of professional courses. 4. Fees receipts paid for the academic year 2018-19 (Self Attested). No handwritten Receipts will be accepted. 5. Copy of Death certificate(s), if father/mother is not alive. 6. Proof of family income (both parents):- Must attach attested copy of latest Income Tax Return / Employer Certificate/Pension Certificate mentioning yearly income, original valid certificate from the Tehsildar or village Sarpanch (stating agriculture land’s acreage and annual income). For daily wage labourers, small shopkeepers (specify type of shop), self-employed persons (who have filed no income tax return) provide original affidavit, stating income from all sources as per the appropriate enclosed format. Note for Renewal Applicants:- A) The student eligible for Renewal of Scholarship and whose professional course is going to be completed during current year or next year will have to attend at least one Seminar / Workshop for his/her improvement of Communication skills, Personality Development, Moral Science, Human Values and career Guidance during the year. B) Candidates will also be required to appear for Interview. This interview shall be based on the subject matter contained in the recommended book “Naitik Sikhya” (prescribed by Guru Gobind Singh Study Circle, Ludhiana), General Knowledge and about content of the course for which scholarship is to be paid. Application form and detailed instructions are available on Nishkam website www.nishkam.org. The last date for applying for this scholarship has been extended till 10th August 2018. The queries in connection with Nishkam Scholarship can be done on contact no. 011-28333842 and 28334477. The students have to submit the completely filled application form in SSIV Cell (Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No.-1. The verified scholarship application form must be collected from the SSIV Cell & sent to the Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council on the following address by Speed/ Registered Post or courier and marking, “SHDF Scholarship-2018” on the top of the envelope:- Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council (Regd.), Nishkam Bhawan, B-Block, Tilak Vihar, New Delhi – 110018 In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information &Verification (SSIV) Cell on all working days between 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Note: The Students can check the advertisement and Guidelines/Instructions/eligibility criteria for NEW and RENEWAL students in the attached file.

title: India Innovation Challenge Design Contest 2018 by DST and Texas Instrument. : (7/13/2018)
body: Dear Students, Texas Instruments (TI) invites all student innovators, thinkers and makers of the country to join the revolution, who have a dream to create something new, aspire to make a difference, contribute to India's success towards becoming an Innovation Hub. Give your ideas a jump-start by sculpting your innovation with technical support from Texas Instruments, business mentorship from IIMB, funding, Tools and prizes of INR 8.2 crore from DST& TI · Design- using Innovative products with technical mentorship & resources from TI · Incubate - with mentors from India's smartest brains from IIMB · Launch - your product with funding and prizes from DST& TI ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA · The contest is open for all Indian engineering students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate Doctoral degrees with Indian engineering colleges. · All the participants must be Indian Nationals · TI will be providing TI tools worth up to USD 200 for each team free of cost. You must use all TI devices in your solution. HOW TO REGISTER · Create an account on MyGov: https://www.mygov.in · Go to website: https://innovate.mygov.in and click on the "INDIA INNOVATION CHALLENGE" icon. This will direct you to contest page · On the "INDIA INNOVATION CHALLENGE" contest page, scroll to the participate section and click on "Login to Participate". Enter the login credentials and you'll be redirected to home page of website: https://innovate.mygov.in · Click on the "INDIA INNOVATION CHALLENGE" icon AGAIN to be redirected to contest webpage · On the "INDIA INNOVATION CHALLENGE" contest page, scroll towards the end of page to the submission form · You will have to enter details as required in the Registration Page and follow further instructions on the portal. · Upon successful submission, you will receive a confirmation email. · For any additional information, you will be contacted via email. · All correspondence shall be through email or SMS on mobile number provided by you at the time of registration. Organizers are not liable in case of SMS/ email delivery failures. REGISTRATION DATE: Registration Phase: June 2018 – Aug 2018 AWARDS AND FUNDING · INR 20 Lacs seed funds to top 10 start-ups · INR 5 Lacs product development funds to select semi-finalists teams · INR 30K stipends to select Semi-finalists teams · Free TI Tools worth up to INR 70 Lacs to participants · 15000+ certificates spread across the whole contest · 600+ types of cash prizes spread throughout the contest totalling up to INR 50 Lacs · Recognition for the Faculty (Mentors) of the Semi-finalists and Finalists teams Note: All students who are going to register themselves for this challenge are required to fill their details in the link given below: Link: https://tinyurl.com/India-ICD-2018 For any query:Email: manish.19164@lpu.co.in

title: Any Student (any category) Can Apply for the Scholarship on the Vidyasaarathi Scholarship Portal for the session 2018-19-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180629/001) : (7/12/2018)
body: Dear Students, Vidyasaarathi is a technology-enabled initiative by NSDL e-Governance Infrastructure Limited (NSDL e-Gov) to bridge the gap in education finance in the country through an online platform. Students can search and apply for various education finance schemes they are qualified for. Due to unaffordable and increasing fees structure of the higher education in India many students misses out on the higher education due to lack of funds. Those students that are willing to pursue higher education and need financial support can use Vidyasaarathi platform to avail the required financial support. Students seeking for education scholarship can search and apply for various education finance schemes that they are qualified for. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 31-07-2018 Link for applying scholarship: www.vidyasaarathi.co.in The students can apply for the various types of scholarships on the Vidyasaarthi Scholarship Portal. title: A Soft Skill Event- Mock Drive for students from Lovely Faculty of Technology and Sciences (7/2/2018)
body: Subject: A Soft Skill Event- Mock Drive for students from Lovely Faculty of Technology and Sciences Dear Students Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a Mock Drive for practicing the practical aspects required in cracking the placement interview. Real time demonstration of behavioral skills is the basic rationale behind the inclusion of Mock drives which includes group discussion as well as personal interview and it is also one of the selection techniques in company placements. None of the other techniques test the candidates managerial skills like communication skills, knowledge and ideas regarding a given subject, capability to co-ordinate and lead, etc. as well as a group discussion. The students will be provided a platform to practice intonation with different aspects. The students will have to showcase their speaking skills amongst the participants, which will boost their confidence to speak correctly. The objective of conducting the Mock drive is to provide candidates with an opportunity to test out their GD and interview skills and constructive feedback in a low-stress environment from the panels help them in rectifying errors. It also helps students to reduce stress and anxiety about interviewing and boost their confidence. About the Mock Drive:Round 1: Group Discussion.Round 2: Interview Panel, consisting of technical and Verbal Staff, will ask questions to the students.Round 3: Feedback. The purpose of conducting the workshop:To let the students improve their communication.To hone the presentation skills of the students.To provide a learning platform for the students to understand the industry expectations.To inculcate the pragmatic approach amongst pupils regarding interview. DATE: 04/07/2018VENUE BLOCK: 34-213, 34-313 and 36-809, 909,709,609.Attachment

title: IELTS Training at Lovely Professional University : (6/14/2018)
body: Dear Student, School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to share the launch of IELTS (International English Language Testing System) Training for all the students across the university. About IELTS: IELTS is the world's most popular English test for work, study and migration. It is a test to analyse the English language skills of students who plan to pursue their higher studies abroad and provides a fair, accurate and relevant assessment of language skills, based on well-established standards, and covers the full range of proficiency levels, from a non-user to an expert user. Modules Offered: Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing Batch Details: A. Batch – I: Starters Program Code: 4S101, Course Code: ENGS021 Duration: 4 weeks/7 hours, Monday - Friday: 09:00am - 05:00pm Fee: Rs. 15000/- B. Batch – II: Movers Program Code: 4S202, Course Code: ENGS022 Duration: 8 weeks/5 hours Monday - Friday: 09:00am - 03:00pm Fee: Rs. 19000/- C.Batch – III: Fliers (for students/working professionals) Program Code: 4S301, Course Code: ENGS023 Duration: 12 weeks/2 hours Monday - Friday: 05:00pm - 07:00pm Fee: Rs. 15000/- Batch Starts: August 2018 Eligibility: Pass with XII standard Admission Procedure: 1. The Admission Form is attached herewith. 2. Fill the form, attach a photo and a copy of 10th & 12th Mark Sheets to the form. 3. Submit the duly filled form in Division of Admissions (Block 30-105) along with fee payment (Only cash payment will be accepted). 4. Get a new IELTS UMS ID and Password. 5. Submit a copy of payment receipt along with a copy of LPU ID and form with photo in Block 32-505. Note: Please fill in the complete and correct programme name. Happy Learning!!

title: Learn Chinese (Mandarin) Language - HSK Level 1 @ LPU : (6/5/2018)
body: Dear All, Department of Foreign Languages (DFL) is pleased to inform that the admissions for Certification Course in Chinese (Mandarin) Language has now begun. Courses Offered: Programme Name (Semester 1) Duration Course Code Certificate in Chinese (Mandarin) Language - HSK Leve1 60 hours CHIS101 Career Options: - Interpreter: It involves the conversion of conversation in Chinese to English and vice-versa. - Translator: The profile requires the candidate to convert written documents from Chinese to English and vice-versa. - IT and Automobile Companies: Many Chinese Companies and Indian Companies prefer candidates with Technical Knowledge along with Chinese Skills as most of their clients are China. - Research Analyst: When it comes to large companies that have competition in countries like China and other Mandarin-speaking nations, having Chinese language skills are a major plus when investigating information that may not be available in English. - Work in China: After learning the advanced level of Chinese, the opportunities are open for candidates to work in China. - Outbound Process: There are several BPOs which are dealing with Chinese Clients and they look for candidates who can provide them Language support. - Teaching: There are opportunities for those who want to add value by teaching Chinese in Schools, Colleges, Institution and Corporate Offices. Batch Timings: Tentative batch timings are as follows: - Weekdays batch timing: 05:00 PM – 07:00 PM (Mon, Tues & Wed) - Weekend batch: 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM (Saturdays and Sundays) Admission Details: Admission is on first come first serve basis from 6th June to 10th August2018. Session Details: The batches will commence tentatively as per the schedule below: - Weekend batches: 18th of August 2018 - Weekday batches: 20th of August 2018 Course Fee: The fee of each course is Rs. 4,500/- for LPU students & staff + the cost of the books (approx. Rs. 1,000/- to be purchased separately) and is not refundable. For others, the fee for each course is Rs. 5,000/- + the cost of the books (approx. Rs. 1,000/- to be purchased separately) and is not refundable. For more information contact: Mr. Saurav Sharma COD, Department of Foreign Languages Block 20 (Law Block), 202/1

title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (5/29/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. viii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council Scholarship for the session 2018-19-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180518/001) : (5/29/2018)
body: Sikh Human Development Foundation, USA (SHDF) and Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council (Regd.), New Delhi invite applications for SHDF scholarships from regular students studying in recognized colleges and Universities for Professional Degree/Diploma Courses like Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Medical, Nursing, Home Science, Architecture, Agriculture, Business Management, B.Ed., Journalism, C.A etc Eligibility Criteria for Fresh and Renewal:- 1. Minimum 60 % marks in previous two examinations. 2. Total Family Income from all sources should not exceed Rs. 1,80,000 per year. 3. Every student must have his/her valid email ID as all the communications will be done through email ID only. List of documents required for Fresh/ Renewal Applicants are mentioned below:- 1. Three recent photographs -Good quality colored passport size (Paste TWO photographs at appropriate place in the Application Form and ONE with your name on the backside of it in an envelope to be attached to the form). 2. Mark sheets of 10th Class Examination, Sr. Secondary Examination & later exam, if any (Self Attested) required in case of fresh applicant and DMC of last 2 semesters or 1st year required for Renewal. 3. No handwritten Receipts will be accepted. 5. Copy of Death certificate(s), if father/mother is not alive. 6. Proof of family income (both parents):- Must attach attested copy of latest Income Tax Return / Employer Certificate/Pension Certificate mentioning yearly income, original valid certificate from the Tehsildar or village Sarpanch (stating agriculture land’s acreage and annual income). For daily wage labourers, small shopkeepers (specify type of shop), self-employed persons (who have filed no income tax return) provide original affidavit, stating income from all sources as per the appropriate enclosed format Note for Renewal Applicants:- A) The student eligible for Renewal of Scholarship and whose professional course is going to be completed during current year or next year will have to attend at least one Seminar / Workshop for his/her improvement of Communication skills, Personality Development, Moral Science, Human Values and career Guidance during the year. title: HYPER LOCAL DESIGN COMPETITION : (5/24/2018)
body: Title:- HYPERLOCAL DESIGN COMPETITION About:- COMMUN Serves as a unit block for UNI in the field of Urban Design. It intends to break the fusion of traditional design barriers and methodologies by making it a platform for experimentation and conceptual exchange of ideas in urbanism, society, culture and ecology. It is a research initiative dedicated to provide opportunities for designers from all domains to explore ideas that go beyond the boundaries of the discipline and enrich our built environment; thereby opening up possibilities for promotion of urban design thought at a global level. Traffic congestion remains a major apprehension all around the world despite of progress in technological fields concerning public transportation and mixed-use developments. So is the case in commercial capital city of India, but what makes it different from other cities in the world is it’s confounding number of people using public modes to commute. The existing Suburban Railway system though caters to millions of Mumbaikars on a daily basis in a cost-efficient and convenient manner, the issues attached to it are worth worrying about - safety being one of the most prioritized aspects over those related to comfort and cost. With an increasing number of users every year, the trains get overcrowded more and more, leading to higher possibilities of deaths caused by falling off a moving train and stampede on-board and in the stations. Organizer: - Commun Link to Participate: - http://commun.xyz/hyperlocal.html#competition Deadline: - Registrations ends: 5th June 2018 Indian Students 40$ | Indian Professional 60$ | Other Students 100$ | Other Professional 120$ Eligibility:- 1.The awards are open to students and professionals of all disciplines. 2.Student level include individuals enrolled in a full time Bachelor’s/Undergraduate, Master’s/Undergraduate. Ph.D Students will be considered as a professional. 3. All work submitted shall be original, and participant shall have all the rights of the submitted content. 4. Students participating in the contest will require producing a certificate of bona-fide from their universities as a proof of enrollment in an academic program, during result declaration, failing which their entry will be canceled. 5.The competition is open to all nationalities around the world. 6.Team/Individual participation is permitted. A maximum of 5 people can participate in a team. title: Allotment of Residential Facilities During Summer : (5/23/2018)
body: This is for the information of all the students who seek residential facilities for PEP/ Placement Drives/ Scrutiny/ Backlog/ Viva/ Skill Development Classes/ Sports or Cultural Workshop/ Summer Term/ Dissertation Work/ Freshmen Induction/ Part Time Jobs/ Training may avail the same as per the guidelines in this notice as given : 1. The whole process of allotment will be carried through University Management System and student has to use his/ her login ID and Password to book their seats. 2. Important Dates : Interface starts on - 25th May'2018 at 02:00 PM onwards Interface will close on - 05th Jul.'2018 at 11:59 PM 3. In this booking process, the student has to select the date of stay, check the availability of seats and book the seats. Student can select single day or multiple days. 4. Stay is available in BH-4 ABC for Boys and GH-6 AB for Girls. Apartment facility will not be available. 5. Mode of Payment : Payment of Stay and Electricity charges shall be made through the below mentioned modes : (a) Scratch Cards : Available at Block-33 Basement – Anil Tuck Shop. (b) I Cash Card : Activated at Block-32, Basement Accounts Section, Window No.-3,4,5 Note :- (a) Scratch cards are only available of amount Rs 1000/- and 250/- only. (b) For Odd amount choose the option of I cash Card and for Even amount choose the option of Scratch card. 6. Summer Term Hostel Charges will be applicable as per the Annexure1. 7. Category-wise Information : (a) For PEP Students : (i) Eligible students have to pay stay charges as 50% of the seater-wise fee for the summer term hostel booking and electricity charges will be extra. (ii) Student have to pay charges in advance and update the information (I Cash card/ Scratch Card) in the interface to book the seat. (iii) Hostlers will have to stay in their presently allocated hostel room and book the seat through : UMS-> Residential and Vendor Services → Residential booking → PEP Hostel Booking. While Day scholars may book seat through, UMS Navigation → Residential and Vendor Services → Residential booking → Summer hostel booking and can stay in the summer hostel starting from 01st Jun.'2018. (b) For Admission Councellors or Interns in Division of Admissions : Student who are recruited as a student counseller in Div. of Admission will stay with the currently allocated hostel till 31st May'2018. They have to book seat again through summer hostel booking interface and also shift to their new allotted hostels on 01st Jun.'2018. (i) For eligible students stay charges will be Rs. 1000/-month and electricity charges will be extra. (ii) Student have to pay charges in advance and update the information (I Cash card/ Scratch Card) in the interface to book the seat for Boys in 4-Seater Non-AC and for Girls 3-Seater Non-AC. (iii) Students can book the hostel-seat through : UMS Navigation → Residential and Vendor Services → Residential booking → Summer hostel booking (c) For Summer Term Students : (i) List of Summer Term registered students will be provided by Division of Academic Affairs to Division of Residential Services. Those students only will be given the authorization to book summer term hostel. (ii) Student have to pay charges (Accommodation + Electricity) and update the information (I Cash card/ Scratch Card) in the interface to book the seat. (iii) Students can book the hostel-seat through : UMS Navigation → Residential and Vendor Services → Residential booking → Summer hostel booking (d) For Reappear/ Placement Drives/ Scrutiny/Backlog/ Viva/ Skill Development Classes/ Sports or Cultural Workshop/ Dissertation Work/ Freshmen Induction/ Training : (i) Such students have to visit Block-29 Room No-301 between 09 AM to 06 PM and show registration details. (ii) Then booking rights will be provided to those students who will furnish the registration details. (iii) Student have to pay charges (Accommodation + Electricity) and update the information (I Cash card/ Scratch Card) in the interface to book the seat. (iv) Students can book the hostel-seat through: UMS Navigation → Residential and Vendor Services → Residential booking → Summer hostel booking 8. Other important information : (a) Student will have to pay electricity charges during booking as per the Annexure-1. Damage charges will be charged at the time of No-dues to be processed at the time of vacating the hostel. (b) Group booking facility will not be available. (c) These charges are exclusive of Food Facility. Food charges have to be paid to mess contractors directly. (d) The students can stay in hostel during Summer Vacations till 10th Jul.'18 only. On 11th Jul.'18 they will have to move to their respective allocated hostel blocks for forthcoming session 2018-19. If any day scholar has booked the hostel facility for summer duration he/ she has to vacate the hostel on 11th Jul.'18. (e) Mess/ Canteen/ Departmental store of BH-4 and GH-6 will be operational. (f) If the student did not occupy their hostel seat or cancel a seat after partial stay, no refund of the paid amount shall be done. (g) Up-gradation or degradation of booked seater is not allowed hence students must select the seater preference very carefully.

title: Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council Scholarship for the session 2018-19-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180518/001) : (5/18/2018)
body: Sikh Human Development Foundation, USA (SHDF) and Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council (Regd.), New Delhi invite applications for SHDF scholarships from regular students studying in recognized colleges and Universities for Professional Degree/Diploma Courses like Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Medical, Nursing, Home Science, Architecture, Agriculture, Business Management, B.Ed., Journalism, C.A etc Eligibility Criteria for Fresh and Renewal:- 1. Minimum 60 % marks in previous two examinations. 2. Total Family Income from all sources should not exceed Rs. 1,80,000 per year. 3. Every student must have his/her valid email ID as all the communications will be done through email ID only. List of documents required for Fresh/ Renewal Applicants are mentioned below:- 1. Three recent photographs -Good quality colored passport size (Paste TWO photographs at appropriate place in the Application Form and ONE with your name on the backside of it in an envelope to be attached to the form). 2. Mark sheets of 10th Class Examination, Sr. Secondary Examination & later exam, if any (Self Attested) required in case of Fresh applicant and DMC of last 2 semesters or 1st year required for Renewal. 3. DMC /Attested copies of Gazette (for the Examinations passed during 2017-2018) of professional courses. 4. Fees receipts paid for the academic year 2018-19 (Self Attested). No handwritten Receipts will be accepted. 5. Copy of Death certificate(s), if father/mother is not alive. 6. Proof of family income (both parents):- Must attach attested copy of latest Income Tax Return / Employer Certificate/Pension Certificate mentioning yearly income, original valid certificate from the Tehsildar or village Sarpanch (stating agriculture land’s acreage and annual income). For daily wage labourers, small shopkeepers (specify type of shop), self-employed persons (who have filed no income tax return) provide original affidavit, stating income from all sources as per the appropriate enclosed format. Note for Renewal Applicants:- A) The student eligible for Renewal of Scholarship and whose professional course is going to be completed during current year or next year will have to attend at least one Seminar / Workshop for his/her improvement of Communication skills, Personality Development, Moral Science, Human Values and career Guidance during the year. B) Candidates will also be required to appear for Interview. This interview shall be based on the subject matter contained in the recommended book “Naitik Sikhya” (prescribed by Guru Gobind Singh Study Circle, Ludhiana), General Knowledge and about content of the course for which scholarship is to be paid. Application form and detailed instructions are available on Nishkam website www.nishkam.org. The last date for applying for this scholarship is 15th June 2018. The queries in connection with Nishkam Scholarship can be done on contact no. 011-28333842 and 28334477. The students have to submit the completely filled application form in SSIV Cell (Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No.-1. The verified scholarship application form must be collected from the SSIV Cell & sent to the Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council on the following address by Speed/ Registered Post or courier and marking, “SHDF Scholarship-2018” on the top of the envelope:- Nishkam Sikh Welfare Council (Regd.), Nishkam Bhawan, B-Block, Tilak Vihar, New Delhi – 110018 In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information & Verification (SSIV) Cell on all working days between 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Note: The Students can check the advertisement and Guidelines/Instructions/eligibility criteria for NEW and RENEWAL students in the attached file.

body: The interface for polling and registration of Engineering Minor (EM) and Discipline Minor (DM) for Autumn Term of session 2018-2019 will remain open from May 15, 2018 (05:30 PM) till May 25, 2018 (05:30 PM). Students can register for the same through UMS either inside the campus or from outside campus. Due to ongoing End Term Examination(ETE), the polling interface will remain deactive from 08:00AM to 05:00 PM everyday for all students on all polling days except on May 20, 2018 (Sunday). If student opted for some engineering minor and discipline minor, their courses will be fixed and no alteration is allowed. Please note that if a student does not participate in registration up to 5:30 PM on May 25, 2018, he/she will be allotted the Engineering Minor (EM) and Discipline Minor (DM) area/course in which seats are left vacant as per system logic and no request for allotting his/her preference will be entertained. In order to check whether Engineering Minor and Discipline Minor is applicable in the next term, a student can refer to the attached file “Applicable programs for EM and DM polling of Autumn Term 2018-19.xls” with this announcement. Important Note: 1. All the students are informed to carefully study the course write-ups for the Engineering Minor (available at the link: UMS Navigation ---> Learning Management System (LMS) ---> Engineering Minor Polling) in order to shortlist the area of Engineering Minor elective course they would like to select. 2. For Discipline Minor, the course write-ups available at link: UMS Navigation ---> Learning Management System (LMS) ---> Discipline Minor Polling This careful analysis will help in making a good choice of courses. For the Discipline Minor (DM), the option is to be submitted at link: UMS Navigation ---> Learning Management System (LMS)---> Discipline Minor Polling 3. title: Summer Training Program for Mechanical & Civil engineering students of 2nd year. : (5/10/2018)
body: Dear Students, Bluehawks Education Pvt. Ltd. is offering in-campus 45 hrs. summer training program for the designing enthusiast who are keen in becoming a productive designer and wants to making their own piece of work with effective designing skills in the Automobile and construction industry. COURSES OFFERED: MECHANICAL 1. Solid Works: Learning Outcomes · Designing product concepts using scanned 3D data, imported images, or simple sketches. · To create an electronic workflow for conception, design, prototyping and testing of your design. · How to keep all your design data and design intellectual property in multiple file formats and manage them in a safe, centralized place and also can access it later. · Get designation of a productive, innovative, and communicative designer/engineer, with an ability to work with people spanning different disciplines. 2. AutoCAD: Learning Outcomes · Know the symbol naming conventions; usage of multiple symbol libraries, hydraulic and P&ID symbols; generate PLC layout modules, insert PLC modules, and organize PLC database files. · learn to get components into your panel for layout; to generate and update customizable reports and use folders to organize drawings. · Able to generate bill of materials reporting and create PLC I/O drawings from spreadsheets. · Can do wire numbering and component tagging in circuits design. CIVIL 1. StaadPro: Learning Outcomes · know how to make object-oriented intuitive 2D/3D graphic model generation, pull down menus, floating toolbars, tool tip help, flexible zoom and multiple views · To generate graphics/text input · To achieve user-specified design parameters by customize design. · To design concrete beams/columns/slabs/footings as per all major international codes 2. AutoCAD Civil 3D: Learning Outcomes · know to use streamlined workflow for creating corridor models. · Gain mastery over tools for pressure network creation, sanitary and storm drainage systems, terrains models for grading, automated parcel layout tools. · Know to use tools for dynamic surface creation, streamline mapping and surveying workflows, and use point clouds to digitize as-built features. · How to do storm and sanitary analysis, geospatial analysis, and river analysis. Benefits: · Internationally accepted certificate. · Live Projects post training · Flexible batch timing for reappear and backlog students. · Placement assistance to top performers. · Certified and Experienced trainers. title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (5/8/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. viii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: A Career Counseling Workshop on Commercial Contract for students from Master of Business Administration (5/8/2018)
body: Knowledge, skills and abilities (KSAs) are three important aspects of one person’s career. The fine line between each aspect is very often confused and used interchangeably. And, the more the skills gap is growing, the more important these three aspects become. This is because we need to clearly understand whether it is knowledge, a skill or an ability that needs to be developed. Center for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a 2 days workshop in Excellence in drafting Commercial Contracts, to impart the next level of practical training, which will be led by, Mr. Bhumesh Verma who has a vast experience of delivering guest lectures in various reputed institutes. The 2 days of workshop will focus on:What are the ailments associated with legal drafting?What does a client expect?How can you add value?How do you protect your client’s interest?How should you work with templates and decide what to add, delete or edit?How to draft critical clauses?What strategy you should adopt for drafting/negotiating drafts? The purpose of conducting the workshop:To motivate and bring confidence amongst pupils to bring improvement in writing and negotiable skills. title: AP Janmabhoomi Project Outreach Internship : (5/5/2018)
body: Dear Student, School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to share with you an enriching internship opportunity for students with flagship program - A.P Janmabhoomi, which is aimed at digitizing 5000 government schools in the Sunrise state by 2018. About the Internship: Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include: 1. Work with Mandal-level officers, Gram Panchayats and higher officials of an assigned area toidentify potential NRIs who can contribute to the digital classroom initiative. 2. Connect with NRIs and promote the cause of AP Janmabhoomi among them. 3. Collaborate with school authorities and facilitate the digitization of schools through NRI funding. 4. Keep the Project Manager updated on the progress of given tasks daily. Eligibility: Undergraduate / Post Graduate students Skills Required: 1. A strong passion to serve the community 2. Good communication skills- comfortable with English and Telugu 3. Knowledge on MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. 4. Should be proactive and punctual. Duration: 5 weeks (Mid May - June) Stipend: Unpaid (Travel expenses subject to norms will be covered) Key Benefits: 1. A chance to hone their management and problem solving skills 2. Great opportunity for networking as the intern would be expected to work closely with various high level officials. 3. Mentored by management graduates from Top Management colleges of India 4. Certificate from the Govt. of A.P which would look great on the resume. 5. An immense learning experience on various aspects of marketing, communication and education sector. Selection Process:Interested students would have to go through a two-phase screening process. Stage 1: Application Shortlisting 1. The candidates are requested to fill their details and following questions in the Google form latest by 06/05/2018. Link: https://tinyurl.com/apsuminter After your successful registration on the above link, you will be directed to the website of AP Janmabhoomi Project Outreach Internship. Please complete the registration process by registering in the official Website. Stage 2: Telephonic/Skype Interview:The candidates whose have cleared Stage 1 have to appear for the telephonic interview. The details would be mailed to the selected candidates. For further details, please visit our website: http://www.apjanmabhoomi.org/ We would be happy to answer any queries at intern@apjanmabhoomi.org--

Students can register for the same through UMS either inside campus or from outside campus. Due to ongoing End Term Practical(ETP) examination in certain programs, the polling interface will remain deactive from 08:00AM to 05:00PM everyday for all students on all polling days except on May 06, 2018(Sunday). Please Check the following points: 1. For all Honors students the polling cum registration interface will be open at 5:30 PM on May 02, 2018. 2. For all other programmes the polling interface will be open at 5:30 PM on May 03, 2018 Please note that if a student does not participate in registration up to 5:30 PM on May 07, 2018, he/she will be allotted the course in which seats are left vacant as per system logic and no request for allotting his/her preference will be entertained. The detail of registration process has been attached with this announcement. In order to check whether OE (Open Elective) is applicable in the next term, a student can refer to the attached file “Applicable programs for OE polling of Autumn Term 2018-19.xls” with this announcement. Important Note: All the students are informed to carefully study the course write-ups (available at link: UMS Navigation -> Learning Management System (LMS) -> Open Elective Registration) in order to shortlist the course they would like to select. This careful analysis will help in making a good choice of courses.

title: Reminder! Enrollment into Career Services – Batch graduating in 2020 : (4/28/2018)
body: ALERT: Last 3 days for enrolling into Career Services without Compounding Fee!!! Alignment of career with role is regarded as one of the most critical roles of professional education. The university visualizes its role as a facilitator to bring about a radical change in the employability of its students. The comprehensive policy for Enrollment into Career Services is attached herewith for reference. Enrollment of students into University Career Services is now open for the batch graduating in 2020 and University Career Services of the University will be available only to students who chose to avail them. Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and international) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2020. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. D. and Certificate programs. Registration Process: Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: ** Process Step-1: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. ** Process Step-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. (At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface) Important Note: a) Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). b) During Process Step-2 registration, students will need to fill and confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. c) The student needs to pay the relevant PEP (Test fee) through online mode only just at Process step-2 of registration, as per the program selected during the career services registrations. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Registration Timelines: ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 without compounding (late) fee: 10th April 2018 to 30th April 2018 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs. 500: 1st May 2018 to 10th May 2018 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs.1000: 11th May 2018 to 31st May 2018 ** Last date for PEP fee payment is 31st May, 2018. Students are advised to carefully read the policy attached herewith before enrolling for university career services.

title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001 : (4/26/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. viii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

Typical job titles for CEH-certified professionals include penetration tester, network security specialist, ethical hacker, security consultant, site administrator and auditor. As well as this training training will introduce the students to an interactive environment where they will be shown how to scan, test, hack and secure their own systems. The lab’s intensive environment gives each student in-depth knowledge and practical experience with the current essential security systems. title: Career Services Registration re-opened for 2019 graduating batch students having CGPA less than 5.5 during Nov-Dec 2017 : (4/24/2018)
body: The registration interface for enrollment into Career Services has now been re-opened for the eligible students from 2019 graduating batch who were having CGPA less than 5.5 earlier during Career Services registration process in Nov-Dec 2017. Registration Timelines: ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 without compounding (late) fee: 24th April 2018 to 30th April 2018. Registration Process: Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: ** Process Step-1: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. ** Process Step-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. (At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment ONLINE as guided by the interface) Important Note: a) Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). b) During Process Step-2 registration, students will need to fill and confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. c) The student needs to pay the relevant PEP (Test fee) only through online mode at Process step-2 of registration, as per the program selected during the career services registrations. Convenience charges shall be applicable. d) Students are advised to carefully read the policy available in placement portal before enrolling for university career services.

title: Competitive Programming Pathway For 2nd Year CSE/IT Student's : (4/20/2018)
body: Dear Student, School of Computer Science and Engineering will be offering a separate pathway named “Placement oriented track of Competitive Programming for product based companies” to the students currently in second year of their study under CSE/IT programmes. Under this pathway, the following 03 courses based on competitive coding theme will be offered in the next two terms i.e. Term 5 and Term 6 besides the Engineering minor, Open Minor tracks and other regular courses. 1. COMPETITIVE CODING APPROACHES-TECHNIQUES 2. PRELUDE TO COMPETITIVE CODING 3. CODING PEARLS Only top 300 students will be registered for this pathway. The students will be selected on the basis of their academic scores and a diagnostic test. Following are the details of the shortlisting process: 1. The scores of the following courses from academics shall be considered : a. COMPUTER PROGRAMMING (CSE101) / (CSE108A) b. OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING (CSE202) c. DATA STRUCTURES AND ALGORITHMS (CSE205) d. PYTHON PROGRAMMING (INT213) e. PROGRAMMING IN JAVA (CSE310) 2. Each one of the above courses shall be considered out of 15 marks each which makes a total of 75 marks from academics. 3. A separate coding based diagnostic test of 25 marks shall be conducted on 29th April, 2018 on Hackerrank platform. The test will have 02 coding problems (One of 10 marks and the other of 15 marks) to be solved in 01 hour. 4. The combined score of academics and diagnostic test out of 100 shall be considered for shortlisting of students for the pathway. 5. Seating plan for this diagnostic test will be shared with students shortly through a separate UMS announcement. 6. The shortlisted students from next term onwards will have to continue with the above mentioned pathway only. 7. Some selective few students may also get shortlisted as wild card entries. 8. The number of courses for the students in the next semesters will remain same as for all the other students in 3rd year. These courses will replace some of the courses. For any queries regarding the same the students can contact their respective section HoDs.

body: All 2nd year CSE students are to undergo a mandatory training in summer (4-6weeks) Mentioned below is the procedure to be followed for training Category 1: Students having less than B grade in either C OR C++ Course code (CSE 101, CSE 202) will have to do their mandatory summer training in C, C++ respectively. Please note that their evaluation of summer training will be conducted only on the basis of C or C++ All these students will then have to write an Improvement exam and improve their grade to at least B in both these courses; else they might not be allowed to sit for Placements If a student has less than B grade in both C & C++, then they have to write exam and improve Grade in both of them. It is highly recommended that the students choose the training in accordance to the specialization they plan to take in the next semester (not mandatory) Process to follow: You are required to poll and provide your training option in Ums Navigation->Feedback and survey->Online Survey->2020 Batch Summer Training Please note student who require letter of reference from university. title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (4/13/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. viii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: Mandatory Summer Training for 2nd Year CSE Students(4-6weeks) : (4/11/2018)
body: All 2nd year CSE students are to undergo a mandatory training in summer (4-6weeks) Mentioned below is the procedure to be followed for training Category 1: Students having less than B grade in either C OR C++ Course code (CSE 101, CSE 202) will have to do their mandatory summer training in C, C++ respectively. Please note that their evaluation of summer training will be conducted only on the basis of C or C++ All these students will then have to write an Improvement exam and improve their grade to at least B in both these courses; else they might not be allowed to sit for Placements If a student has less than B grade in both C & C++, then they have to write exam and improve Grade in both of them. There are 2 ways in which the students can take this training 1. MOOCS. List of Approved MOOCS is also attached herewith (Highly Recommended) 2. An institute of your choice- The suggestive syllabus for this training is attached herewith Process to Follow: You are required to poll and provide your training option in Ums Navigation->Feedback and survey->Online Survey-> 2020 BATCH SUMMER TRAINING for C/C++( Less Grade then B) Category 2: All other students As discussed in meeting student can opt for either of three options given below 1. MOOCS 2. Reputed Organization 3. Institute List of technologies and approved online courses is also attached herewith. It is highly recommended that the students choose the training in accordance to the specialization they plan to take in the next semester (not mandatory) Process to follow: You are required to poll and provide your training option in Ums Navigation->Feedback and survey->Online Survey->2020 Batch Summer Training Please note student who require letter of reference from university. Hardcopy of reference letter will be provided for government institutes/ organizations only and for all other private institutes or organizations soft copy will be mailed to the concerned authority of the organization. You are required to provide details for Letter of Recommendation at this link: https://tinyurl.com/cseintern2018 This link will be open till 25th April 2018. You can collect your LOR within one week after submitting your response. No change will be allowed later on, so choose your option wisely. title: Student Enrollment into Career Services – Batch graduating in 2020 : (4/11/2018)
body: Alignment of career with role is regarded as one of the most critical roles of professional education. The university visualizes its role as a facilitator to bring about a radical change in the employability of its students. The comprehensive policy for Enrollment into Career Services is attached herewith for reference. Enrollment of students into University Career Services is now open for the batch graduating in 2020 and University Career Services of the University will be available only to students who chose to avail them. Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and international) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2020. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. D. and Certificate programs. Registration Process: Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: ** Process Step-1: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. ** Process Step-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. (At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface) Important Note: a) Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). b) During Process Step-2 registration, students will need to fill and confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. c) The student needs to pay the relevant PEP (Test fee) through online mode only just at Process step-2 of registration, as per the program selected during the career services registrations. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Registration Timelines: ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 without compounding (late) fee: 10th April 2018 to 30th April 2018 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs. 500: 1st May 2018 to 10th May 2018 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs.1000: 11th May 2018 to 31st May 2018 ** Last date for PEP fee payment is 31st May, 2018. Students are advised to carefully read the policy attached herewith before enrolling for university career services.

title: Student Enrollment into Career Services – Batch graduating in 2020 : (4/9/2018)
body: Alignment of career with role is regarded as one of the most critical roles of professional education. The university visualizes its role as a facilitator to bring about a radical change in the employability of its students. The comprehensive policy for Enrollment into Career Services is attached herewith for reference. Enrollment of students into University Career Services is now open for the batch graduating in 2020 and University Career Services of the University will be available only to students who chose to avail them. Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and international) of full-time regular programs (including Hons. dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2020. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. D. and Certificate programs. Registration Process: Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: ** Process Step-1: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. ** Process Step-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. (At this step itself, the students will be required to make PEP Fee payment online as it will be guided by the interface) Important Note: a) Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum CGPA of 5.5 (or equivalent, for batches admitted prior 2017) and minimum current CGPA of 5 (or equivalent, for admission batches 2017 onwards). b) During Process Step-2 registration, students will need to fill and confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. c) The student needs to pay the relevant PEP (Test fee) through online mode only just at Process step-2 of registration, as per the program selected during the career services registrations. Convenience charges shall be applicable. Registration Timelines: ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 without compounding (late) fee: 10th April 2018 to 30th April 2018 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs. 500: 1st May 2018 to 10th May 2018 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs.1000: 11th May 2018 to 31st May 2018 ** Last date for PEP fee payment is 31st May, 2018. Students are advised to carefully read the policy attached herewith before enrolling for university career services. In case of any queries, students may contact their respective school Training and Placement Coordinators (TPCs).

title: Summer Training on CCNA : (4/9/2018)
body: The CCNA v3 certification summer training includes both Interconnecting Cisco Networking Devices, Part 1 (ICND1) and Interconnecting Cisco Networking Devices, Part 2 (ICND2) courses merged into one. Participants in this CCNA course will learn to install, configure, operate, and manage basic IPv4 / IPv6 networks. This CCNA bootcamp on Routing & Switching course also imparts skills to configure a LAN switch and IP router, connect to WAN, and find security threats. After CCNA Routing & Switching (R&S) v3.0 course completion, participants will acquire key skills and knowledge to configure, operate, manage and troubleshoot a medium-sized enterprise network, including the ability to ensure security of the network. **This training will be providing you practices based on sample papers and cheat sheets simultaneously as well. Instructors :- NITIN UMESH (Asst Prof.), AWDHESH SHUKLA (Asst Prof.) Course Duration : 60 hours (covered between 26 May to 26 June) Course Fee : 3750/- Registration Link : https://shortto.com/speevent/

body: Division of Admission is recruiting students for Part Time Job as Admission Counselor. The Requirements are as follows: 1. title: Hear me speak: Let's Fight stage fear : (4/6/2018)
body: “The worst speech you ever gave will be far better than the one you never gave.” -Fred Miller Innumerable people have astounding ideas, the ones which are never shared with the world as the fear of public speaking never lets those people say those ideas out loud. Department of Verbal Ability under the aegis of School of Professional Enhancement presents a workshop “Hear me speak: Let’s fight stage fear”. The workshop aims to provide a fun therapy to remove, or at least reduce that fear to help those who experience nervousness while speaking publically, to be more confident. You will learn to: *Overcome stage fear/nervousness *Have a more confident body language *Be able to present your ideas in a fluent manner *Control stammering/ stuttering, forgetting what to say, when on stage *Enhancing self-expressions to look more presentable. Date: 11th April 2018 Time: 5:00pm -6:30 p.m Venue: BLock 25-304 Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/nostagefear Hurry Up and register, Limited Seats, so first come first serve. Resource Persons: Ms. Mitali Sareen Assistant Professor Dept. of Verbal Ability Email: mitali.22226@lpu.co.in Ms. Anantjot Kaur Assistant Professor Dept. of Verbal Ability Email: anantjot.21869@lpu.co.in

title: Programming input options for placement registered 2019 pass out students : (4/4/2018)
body: As per the previous communication through mail and my messages the following options for programming input were shared. The same information is shared here in detail. The details for the three options are as follows: Option 1: Data Structure Nanodegree from Udacity (DS&P): Students would register on the Udacity platform and study Data structure and programming nanodegree on their platform. They would be exempted from the SAP input and will be allowed to use the time for nanodegree. They would go to the same classes where they were going for SAP input on the same Time slots but attendance would be considered in the new course code of Nanodegree. Students will be evaluated by ETP(End Term Practical) Viva and presentation. Attendance will carry 5 marks and viva would carry 95 marks. Udacity is offering a 50% refund to students on completing the nano degree. Option 2: Dynamic Programming Input Shortlisted students who are selected for Dynamic Programming inputs have taken 1-week classes on Dynamic Programming. They would be exempted from the SAP input and be allowed to use the time for practicing dynamic programming. 1 week attendance shall be considered in the new course. After the training student will be allotted a course in place of SAP course where students will be given weekly tests, i.e. 4 tests in next 4 weeks on 14th, 21st,28th April & last in 1st week of May on Platforms like Hackerearth or Hackerank etc., the final grade will be evaluated on the basis of these tests. Marks of best 2 out of 4 tests would be considered for final grade. Attendance of these tests will also be counted towards final attendance. Every test will be of 90 minutes and will contain 3 coding questions. Being an evaluation only course in case a student is not able to clear he shall be awarded either pass grades from O to D or F/G grade only. No option for E grade. Attendance would carry 5 marks and CAs would carry 95 marks. Students need not attend the SAP classes and use the time for preparation & practice of Dynamic Programming. Option 3: 7-Day programming Input Shortlisted students who are selected for 7-Day Programming inputs have taken 1-week classes on Programming. They would be exempted from the SAP input and be allowed to use the time for practicing Programming. 1 week attendance shall be considered in the new course. After the training student will be allotted a course in place of SAP course where students will be given weekly tests, i.e. 4 tests in next 4 weeks on 14th, 21st,28th April & last in 1st week of May on Platforms like Hackerearth or Hackerank etc., the final grade will be evaluated on the basis of these tests. Marks of best 2 out of 4 tests would be considered for final grade.Attendance of these tests will also be counted towards final attendance. Every test will be of 120 minutes and will contain MCQs and coding questions. Being an evaluation only course in case a student is not able to clear he shall be awarded either pass grades from O to D or F/G grade only. No option for E grade. Attendance would carry 5 marks and CAs would carry 95 marks. Students need not attend the SAP classes and use the time for preparation & practice of Programming. For any clarification write to cse.tpc@lpu.co.in

body: Dear Students Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of the Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a Mock Drive for practising the practical aspects required in cracking the placement interview. Real-time demonstration of behavioural skills is the basic rationale behind the inclusion of Mock drives which includes group discussion as well as personal interviews and it is also one of the selection techniques in company placements. None of the other techniques tests the candidate’s managerial skills like communication skills, knowledge and ideas regarding a given subject, capability to co-ordinate and lead, etc. as well as a group discussion. The students will be provided with a platform to practice intonation with different aspects. The students will have to showcase their speaking skills amongst the participants, which will boost their confidence to speak correctly. The objective of conducting the Mock drive is to provide candidates with an opportunity to test out their GD and interview skills and constructive feedback in a low-stress environment from the panels helps them in rectifying errors. It also helps students to reduce stress and anxiety about interviewing and boosts their confidence. About the Mock Drive: Round 1: Group Discussion. Round 2: Interview Panel, consisting of technical and Verbal Staff, will ask questions to the students. Round 3: Feedback. The purpose of conducting the workshop: To let the students improve their communication. To hone the presentation skills of the students. To provide a learning platform for the students to understand the industry expectations. To inculcate the pragmatic approach amongst pupils regarding interviews. DATE: 04/04/2018 VENUE BLOCK: 34-213, 34-313 and 36-809, 909,709,609.Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: Scholarship for Journalism Students in “Thisis FINLAND foreign correspondents” Program : (3/21/2018)
body: Division of International Affairs brings the opportunity for Journalism students with little experience to attend the program in Finland from 6th of August – 24th of August 2018. This programme is available to young Journalists. The programme is a once in a lifetime opportunity for young journalists and social media influencers. The programme provides an excellent opportunity to learn more about Finland, Finnish society and the Finnish way of life. It includes briefings on various subjects, meetings with Finnish professionals and visits to business enterprises, cultural sites and institutions. Scholarship Description: Application Deadline: March 26, 2018 Study Subject: The Foreign Correspondents’ Programme starts on 6 August and ends on 24 August 2018. The programme is intensive and includes briefings on various subjects, meetings with Finnish professionals and visits to business enterprises, cultural sites and institutions. It also includes a weekend stay as the guest of a Finnish family. Scholarship Award: The scholarship covers the costs of travel to and from Finland, local travel in Helsinki, accommodation and the daily programme, including transportation and some meals. The programme does not cover medical insurance, per diem allowance or meals not listed as part of the programme. Scholarship can be taken in Helsinki, Finland Eligibility: · An aspiring journalist (graduate or student due to graduate soon) with some work experience in a media house (TV, print or web) or an influence in social media, for example, an accomplished blogger or vlogger; · Born between 1989 and 1998; · Able to work and communicate fluently in English; · Interested in learning new things, meeting people from different cultures and spending three weeks in a foreign country; Interested applicants have to send curriculum vitae with photo and an essay (600-800) words or link to a short video on internet emphasizing your interest in Finland. For Further information please contact Mr. Narinder Pal in Block 32-308 or email on supriya.22515@lpu.co.in and narinder.23030@lpu.co.in.
