title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS.(Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (3/20/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. viii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: Software Internship Opportunity at "Solar Energy Research Institute Of Singapore (SERIS), Singapore" : (3/19/2018)
body: Dear Students, There is an upcoming opportunity from one of our Alumni working at "Solar Energy Research Institute Of Singapore (SERIS), Singapore" as Project Leader. SERIS conducts research, development, testing and consulting on solar energy technologies and their integration into power systems and buildings. Their primary work focus has been leading the software development of “XSolar-Hetero, i.e. Web-based Photovoltaic Simulation Platform”. This software platform aims to (a) provide a platform for solar researchers to use established (and dynamically upload new) device/process/yield programs that post-process real or simulated various characterization measurements for a multitude of different solar architectures, and, (b) provide machine learning infrastructure for solar-focused data scientists. Links about: SERIS website: http://www.seris.nus.edu.sg/ Project website: https://xsolar-hetero.sg They are looking for upto two talented software interns to join us for six months as part of their bachelor's/master’s thesis. These positions are unpaid and They are flexible on joining dates. The primary focus of this internship will be to train/mentor students on the latest web technologies, Students interns can learn concepts such as DevOps Automation (docker/kubernetes/serverless), Design Patterns in Production (Software architecture to scale to hundreds of users and Node.js Data APIs and Test Driven Development) and Data Engineering workflows. Some essential skills, They are looking but not limited to: 1.Solid fundamentals such as Data structures and Algorithms is required. 2.Excellent knowledge of web backend concepts such as HTTP, Web-sockets, REST APIs and JSON is required. 3.Prior experience in Javascript (ECMAScript 2017, ES7) is required. 4.Familiar with NoSQL databases (document and key-value stores like MongoDB, Redis etc.) is a plus.Familiar with test-driven development frameworks (MochaJS, ChaiJS and Sinon JS) is a plus. 5.Interest in data engineering workflows is a plus. Interested students fitting above mentioned criteria can submit following details on the form link below: 1.Github/BitBucket/Gitlab profile or link to previous projects. 2.Latest CV 3.Upto one-page letter stating your motivation to join this internship. Application Form Link: https://goo.gl/forms/IHSUfk8QyHqThT9H3 (This link will require a Gmail account to login) Last date to share your details: March 22, 2018(Thursday), 4 pm. In case of any query visit Block 34-201A, Timings: 4:30 pm to 5:30 pm

title: Software Internship opportunity at "Solar Energy Research Institute Of Singapore (SERIS), Singapore" : (3/16/2018)
body: Dear Students, There is an upcoming opportunity from one of our Alumni working at "Solar Energy Research Institute Of Singapore (SERIS), Singapore" as Project Leader. SERIS conducts research, development, testing and consulting on solar energy technologies and their integration into power systems and buildings. Their primary work focus has been leading the software development of “XSolar-Hetero, i.e. Web-based Photovoltaic Simulation Platform”. This software platform aims to (a) provide a platform for solar researchers to use established (and dynamically upload new) device/process/yield programs that post-process real or simulated various characterisation measurements for a multitude of different solar architectures, and, (b) provide machine learning infrastructure for solar-focused data scientists. Links about: SERIS website: http://www.seris.nus.edu.sg/ Project website: https://xsolar-hetero.sg They are looking for upto two talented software interns to join us for six months as part of their bachelor's/master’s thesis. These positions are unpaid and They are flexible on joining dates. The primary focus of this internship will be to train/mentor students on the latest web technologies, Students interns can learn concepts such as DevOps Automation (docker/kubernetes/serverless), Design Patterns in Production (Software architecture to scale to hundreds of users and Node.js Data APIs and Test Driven Development) and Data Engineering workflows. Some essential skills, They are looking but not limited to: 1.Solid fundamentals such as Data structures and Algorithms is required. 2.Excellent knowledge of web backend concepts such as HTTP, Web-sockets, REST APIs and JSON is required. 3.Prior experience in Javascript (ECMAScript 2017, ES7) is required. 4.Familiar with NoSQL databases (document and key-value stores like MongoDB, Redis etc.) is a plus. 5.Familiar with test-driven development frameworks (MochaJS, ChaiJS and Sinon JS) is a plus. 6.Interest in data engineering workflows is a plus. Interested students fitting above mentioned criteria can submit following details on the form link below: 1.Github/BitBucket/Gitlab profile or link to previous projects. 2.Latest CV 3.Upto one-page letter stating your motivation to join this internship. Application Form Link: https://goo.gl/forms/IHSUfk8QyHqThT9H3 (This link will require a Gmail account to login) Last date to share your details: March 17, 2018(Saturday), 4 pm. In case of any query visit Block 34-201A, Timings: 10:30 am to 12:30 pm

title: A Career Counseling Session on Team Building for Students from Mittal School of Business (3/14/2018)
body: Dear Vertos! Center for Professional Enhancement is going to organize A Career Counseling Session on Team Building.In the coming time, team building is important. It enables employees to learn from others and develop new skills. Working in a team helps employees take on leadership roles and see their team members fulfill their responsibilities. Teamwork enables problem solving capabilities, strategizing and decision making skills. Teams are no longer evaluated on the basis of effort , they are evaluated on the basis of outcomes. In order to achieve maximum outcomes, inner team as well as intra team competitions prop up leading to conflict. Thus team building becomes critical to achieve outcomes. The workshop will help students to learn the following skills:Communicating and setting expectations.Various stages of Team formation.Understanding emotions.Effect of social media messaging on emotions.Team building activities. The purpose of conducting the workshop:Breaking the barrier.Promoting creativity.Relationship building.Learn how to overcome objections and excuses in a positive and influential manner. title: Live Project: Flipkart – FOS (Feet on the Street) : (3/8/2018)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to share a live project from FlipKart - Feet on Street. About the company: Flipkart is an electronic commerce company headquartered in Bengaluru, India. It was founded in October 2007 by Sachin Bansal and Binny Bansal and is one of the largest e-commerce sites in India. About the project: The SmartTree has partnered with Flipkart in the process of assisting and onboarding new sellers on the Flipkart platform. The interns will be assisting existing sellers as well as getting new sellers onboard on Flipkart.The project helps the students in gaining an insight into the e-commerce industry along with the process flow takes place at the backend on the seller’s side. Basic Responsibilities: - Get in touch with new sellers fulfilling the criteria who are not already selling on Flipkart - Obtain details required for registering on Flipkart from the seller - Obtain details of products which are to be listed on Flipkart and with the assistance of The SmartTree team onboard the seller - The stipend is issued once the seller is successfully on board. - THE STUDENTS DON’T HAVE TO MISS THEIR CLASSES, IT’S A WORK FROM HOME PROJECT! - The Internship can be started at any point, just please let me know that when you will be starting this Internship. - There is no Fixed timing, you can work as per your convenience. - No targets Registration - https://tinyurl.com/y7tn8esa One you register on the link, the link to register on company's website will be shown. Please register on that link as well.

title: Bihar Post Matric scholarship for SC/ST/ OBC students for the session 2017-18 is open for registration-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180214/002) : (3/7/2018)
body: Registration process for applying in Post Matric scholarship scheme Bihar for SC/ST/ OBC students has been started for the session 2017-18. The students can apply for this scholarship on the following link:- https://scholarships.gov.in/ The last date of applying for the scholarship for students is extended till 20.03.2018. The students have to select the below mentioned university details while applying for scholarship online on the NSP portal:- State – PUNJAB District – KAPURTHALA University Name – Lovely Professional University (AISHE CODE- U-0379). If Students selects the wrong university detail other than mentioned above then his/her case will not be forwarded online by the university and students will be responsible themselves. Annual income of the parent of the SC/ST should not exceed 2.5 lac per annum and BC /EBC student should not exceed Rs. 1 lac per annum from all sources. After submitting the application online on the scholarship portal, the students have to submit his/her print application form at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No.-1 along with the following self attested documents:- 1. Passport size photograph of student - 01. 2. Previous year Mark Sheets from Matric onwards (e.g. 10th , 12th , Graduation etc.) 3. Income Certificate (Recent salary certificate / Income certificate for the financial year 2017-18) 4. Caste Certificate. 5. Domicile Certificate. 6. Bank Passbook copy of student with IFSC code mentioned on it. 7. Photocopy of Aadhar Card. 8. Fee Receipts (Attested from accounts department.) 9. Minority Community Declaration (Format available at Block 32, Room No. 102, window no. 1). Uploading of all the documents on National Scholarship portal is mandatory, minimum file size to upload each documents is 200 kb. All the students have to provide the valid (latest) contact number of self, father, mother etc , along with the email ID (of student) for communication. In case , wrong information is provided, the students will be responsible for themselves. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on all working days between 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Note: 1. Student has to fill his/her name as mentioned on the Aadhar Card. 2. Guidelines for SC/ST 2017-18 attached for information. 3. Guidelines for OBC attached for Information.

title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (2/27/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis.In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. viii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar,State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: WIN iPADS through Anti-Piracy Film Making Competition : (2/19/2018)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to share an opportunity to win iPads during the events at the American Centre. Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) in collaboration with United States Embassy in India has launched the 1st Antipiracy Film making competition for students of Northern India. The main objective of this unique initiative is to promote Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) and to build a strong IP ecosystem in North India. The theme of the competition is to “Respect Copyrights, Steer Clear of Piracy”. The following are the criteria for participating in the competition:- 1. Films can be of live action, documentary, interviews, and animation. The content must be completely original and owned by the contestant. 2. The entry is limited to one per entrant. If additional entries are submitted only the first entry will be eligible. 3. The participant needs to fulfill the age limit (18-25 years) and Geographical limit. 4. Playing time of the film cannot be more than one minute. 5. The participant needs to submit the original document such as (Pan Card or Voter ID card) needs to get a photocopy of it. 6. The video should be clear in all aspects in pictures, lighting, sound etc. 7. Film which offers a solution for the piracy problem will get more marks. PRIZES FOR WINNERS- Top three winners will be given prizes iPads during the events at the American Centre. Please note there is no registration fees associated with this. title: Ghar Ghar Rozgar – Punjab Mega Job Fair 2018 : (2/17/2018)
body: Department of Employment Generation and Training, Government of Punjab is organizing its 2nd State Level Mega Job Fair 2018 - Ghar Ghar Rozgar in order to provide job opportunities and skill training opportunities to the passed-out as well as yet to pass-out students of any diploma, graduate or post-graduate program.This mega event is planned as per the following schedule across various locations in Punjab. Event Date: 20th Feb 2018 to 8th Mar 2018 Last Date to register: 18th Feb 2018 Registration Link: http://www.ghargharrozgar.punjab.gov.in/app/register List of Job Mela Events: http://www.ghargharrozgar.punjab.gov.in/site/page?title=Job+Mela (updated regularly) For more details, visit: http://www.ghargharrozgar.punjab.gov.in Registration Steps/FAQs: 1. For registration in Job Melas, candidate needs to first register as a Job Seeker on the above mentioned portal. 2. During registration, OTP will be forwarded to registered email-Id and Mobile No. of the candidate. In case of any delay in SMS OTP, candidate can use OTP received on email-id. 3. After successful registration, candidate needs to update his/her profile (educational qualification, skills, experience etc.) before participation/applying for the Job Mela/Jobs. 4. Candidate will be able to select the venue, date and the company as per his qualification and generate hall tickets for participating w.e.f. 15thFeb 2018. 5. Complete details of venue-wise Job Melas will be visible on portal in Job Fair 2018 w.e.f. 15th Feb 2018 for participation. 6. Each candidate can apply for maximum 3 employers in a day, along with max limit of 10 days in a month. 7. Job fair related queries can be addressed to 1800-419-0730 (toll free) or 01822-662537 or 78886-90013 to 78886-90020 or ghargharrozgar@punjab.gov.in Important Note: 1. All the final year students (placed or yet to be placed) are required to register for the event on the link mentioned above. 2. On the registration page: Non-Punjab students of LPU can register by selecting State: Punjab, District: Kapurthala, Pin:144411. 3. Only the registrations made till above mentioned deadline of 18th Feb 2018 will be considered. 4. Kindly spread the word around to the benefit of society.

title: HackerRank University CodeSprint Jan 2018 : (2/15/2018)
body: Join University CodeSprint, the ultimate university coding competition, and represent your school to prove how well students and graduates from your school can code! They want to learn which schools around the world train the best programmers. A lot of global university ranking reports use school reputation, the number of publications and citation published within a given year and other subjective ranking criteria. We want to learn which schools have the best programmers based on their skill. So, do you think our school has the best programmers and deserves global recognition? Join University CodeSprint and invite your friends to represent your school. University CodeSprint will have 3 leaderboards: Individual Leaderboard, School Leaderboard and Alumni Leaderboard. A School must have at least 10 students participating in University CodeSprint in order for the school to be listed on the School Leaderboard. School rank will be determined by the sum of the top 10 participant ranks of the represented school. title: Invitation to “Laurie Baker Centenary Workshop”. : (2/14/2018)
body: It is a matter of great pleasure for us that Architect Laurie Baker Centenary Workshop is being conducted at LSAD, LPU Campus on 15th, 16th 17th February 2018 in association with Re-Root an initiative of COSTFORD, Thrissur. About the Master Architect: Laurie Baker was an accomplished innovative designer and a cartoonist, artist. He served in the Second World War in the Friends Ambulance Unit and lived for four years in isolation in remote China taking care of lepers. After a meeting with Gandhiji he was convinced to come to India, initially as the chief architect of the Mission to Lepers building leper homes throughout India. He since lived in Pithoragarh in the foothills of the Himalayas building hospitals and schools and in the tribal areas of Vagamon in Kerala before finally settling down in the city of Trivandrum. His design portfolio includes a dance village, computer institutes, fishermen’s huts, chapels and churches, factories, schools, film studios, orphanages, tourist resorts, residences, technical institutes, earthquake and tsunami resistant houses, leprosy homes, a Literacy Village, hostels, slum dwellings improvement, an ornithology centre, government buildings, a blind children’s international school and a museum. In Kerala alone, he has built over 2000 buildings. He has also done pioneering work into earthquake and tsunami proof housing. About Re-Root: Re-root serves as an absolute platform to create a global community of architects and designers provided with an insight to propagate the philosophies of the Gandhi of Architecture: Laurence Wilfred (Laurie) Baker which long pre-empted modern concepts such as eco friendliness and sustainable architecture. Lecture: Thursday 15th February, 2018, 10am to 12 noon at 8B-400 Workshop: Thursday, Friday, Saturday15th, 16th and 17th February, 2018 Workshop Session-1: 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM and Session-2: 02:00 PM to 05:00 PM,Workshop Venue: Various Site Locations at LPU campus. All the faculty and staff members not having lectures/ examination duty during this time are invited to attend the same.

title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (2/10/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis.In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. viii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar,State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: LPU Transforming Education Awards ceremony held at Former President's Residence, New Delhi : (2/5/2018)
body: On 5th of September 2017 i.e. Teacher’s Day, LPU launched a project named “Transforming Education Awards” to honour teachers of various schools/ coaching centres for their endless efforts in shaping the future of their students. In this project, students of different schools and coaching institutes throughout India participated and gave credit to their teachers by uploading a video about their teacher. The response from the students, teachers, and schools was overwhelming with 3495 nominations, 6 lac+ votes and, 30 lac+ views. In the result declared by the Jury, 13 schools got teaching grant worth Rs. 1 Lac each and their teachers and students got awards of Rs. 25000 and Rs. 10000 respectively. In addition to the 13 schools, 76 more videos won teaching grant of Rs. 25000 for school, Rs. 10000 for the nominated teacher, and Rs. 2000 for the student. In Coaching Institute Category, 29 videos won Rs. 25000 as teaching grant for the institute, Rs. 10000 for the nominated teachers, and Rs. 2000 for the student. All the winners were felicitated by Sh. Pranab Mukherjee, Former President of India, in the award ceremony held at his residence 10, Rajaji Marg, New Delhi on 31st Jan 2018. On the same day, Sh. Pranab Mukherjee launched "Pranab Sir ki Paathshaala"- an initiative to stay connected with students, and took his very first class with LPU students. Both the project and the award ceremony were a huge success and were covered by almost all big media houses- Statesman, Hindustan Times, Amar Ujala, Dainik Jagran, Career 360, Delhi Times, Tribune, and many more. Attached is a press coverage and you can check the photographs of the ceremony through the following link : https://tinyurl.com/Award-Ceremony-LPU-31ST-JAN

title: Call for R&D Proposals : (2/5/2018)
body: Department of Science and Technology - Ministry of Science and Technology NRDMS-NSDI Division Invites R&D Project Proposals on “Spatial Data Infrastructures (SDI) for Urban Governance Applications” Category I - Testbed projects – Urban Governance testbed projects are required to be implemented for testing and demonstrating the utility of SDI concepts (or underlying data sets) in Smart City development to end users in a short time frame while focusing on the relevant and immediate GIS applications. R&D Teams implementing State SDI projects or similar scientific & technical groups in different State Government Agencies are expected to submit project proposals in this Category. A part of the proposed activities in the category could be implemented with the involvement of a suitable System Integrator/ Vendor to be identified through an EoI/ RFP process, in addition to the JRFs/ SRFs/ RAs etc. Category II - Deployment R&D – In these projects, some amount of development is required to be implemented and demonstrated through lab-based activities in technical institutions like IITs, Universities; Laboratories etc. to support the deployment of standards/ technologies required in Category I (e.g. CityGML testbed for Indian City Features). Activities are required to be implemented by R&D Teams with the help of JRFs/ SRFs/ RAs. Etc. Category III – High-end R&D - Projects are expected to be implemented with the help of only JRFs/ SRFs/ RAs etc. The recommended areas in this category are: Spatio-Temporal Data Modelling, Big Geospatial Data Analytics; High Performance Computing (HPC) for Smart City Applications; Autonomous Sensor Networks, Geo-Semantic Sensor Web, Semantic Interoperability, Seamless Outdoor/ Indoor Navigation, Building Information Model (BIM) & GIS interoperability, Point cloud to City GML, Internet of Things (IoT), Geospatial Data Security, Social Media Analytics, Interdependencies between Critical Infrastructures etc. Details of the terms and conditions prescribed proforma and other norms/ guidelines for submission of the proposals may be accessed/ submitted at the website http://onlinedst.gov.in. The last date for submission of the project proposal is 31 March 2018. For any queries regarding the above, may please contact or e-mail to Dr. Bhoop Singh, Head (NRDMS-NSDI), DST, New Delhi at 011-26523577/ 26590361/bhoopsingh@nic.in or Dr. Shubha Pandey, Sc. C, DST, New Delhi at 011-26590351/shubha.p@nic.in.

title: Learn Japanese Language @ LPU : (2/1/2018)
body: Dear All, Department of Foreign Languages (DFL) is pleased to inform that the admissions for Certification Course in Japanese Language has now begun. Courses Offered: Programme Name (Semester 1) Duration Course Code Certificate in Japanese Language N5 60 hours JAPS101 Career Options: - Interpreter: It involves the conversion of conversation in Japanese to English and vice-versa. - Translator: The profile requires the candidate to convert written documents from Japanese to English and vice-versa. - IT and Automobile Companies: Many Japanese Companies and Indian Companies prefer candidates with Technical Knowledge along with Japanese Skills as most of their clients are Japanese. - Work in Japan: After learning the advanced level of Japanese, the opportunities are open for candidates to work in Japan. Our Institute Provides assistance to candidates who want to study and work in Japan. - Outbound Process: There are several BPOs which are dealing with Japanese Clients and they look for candidates who can provide them Language support. - Teaching: There are opportunities for those who want to add value by teaching Japanese in Schools, Colleges, Institution and Corporate Offices. - Hospitality Industry: Candidates can also look for their career option in several Travel Companies and Hotels and Many more. Batch Timings: Tentative batch timings are as follows: Weekdays batch timing: 05:00 PM – 07:00 PM (Mon, Tues & Wed) Weekend batch: 09:00 AM to 12:00 Noon (Saturdays and Sundays) Admission Details: Admission is on first come first serve basis from 1st Feb to 7th Feb. title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (1/27/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis.In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. vii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar,State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: Google India Scholarships : (1/23/2018)
body: School of Professional Enhancement is delighted share a great opportunity. Earn a Developer Scholarship from Google! Google's Reskilling India Programme * Learn valuable skills to launch or advance your career as a mobile or web developer * Master world-class curriculum developed with experts from Google and Udacity * Join the rapidly growing community of mobile and web developers in cities and towns across India . How it Works To apply for a scholarship, you need to be at least 18 years old and live in India. You'll begin by choosing your learning path, either Web Developer or Android Developer. From there, once you're accepted, we'll place you in one of two tracks, depending on your existing skills and experience, either Beginner or Intermediate. After that, the learning begins! Finally, top students from each track will earn full scholarships to one of our Android or Web Development Nano degree programs. How to Apply The application is straightforward, and should take 10-15 minutes. There is a single application for all, whether you're interested in Mobile or Web, and whether you're a beginner or already have experience. title: A Soft Skill Event- Mock Drive for students from Lovely Faculty of Technology and Sciences (1/21/2018)
body: Dear Students Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a Mock Drive for practicing the practical aspects required in cracking the placement interview. Real time demonstration of behavioral skills is the basic rationale behind the inclusion of Mock drives which includes group discussion as well as personal interview and it is also one of the selection techniques in company placements. None of the other techniques test the candidate’s managerial skills like communication skills, knowledge and ideas regarding a given subject, capability to co-ordinate and lead, etc. as well as a group discussion. The students will be provided a platform to practice intonation with different aspects. The students will have to showcase their speaking skills amongst the participants, which will boost their confidence to speak correctly. The objective of conducting the Mock drive is to provide candidates with an opportunity to test out their GD and interview skills and constructive feedback in a low-stress environment from the panels help them in rectifying errors. It also helps students to reduce stress and anxiety about interviewing and boost their confidence. We probably might tell them that kid, nature has been destroyed too much by mankind so we don’t have oxygen as before and atmosphere is full of harmful gases that are made by human activities so we need to stay in doors to stay safe and alive. title: A career counselling Workshop on Hydraulic for students from School of Mechanical Engineering (1/12/2018)
body: Dear StudentsCentre for Professional Enhancement, Lovely Professional Enhancement is going to organize A career counseling Workshop on Hydraulic.Hydraulics, branch of science concerned with the practical applications of fluids, primary liquids, in motion. It is related to fluid mechanics which in large part provides its theoretical foundation. Hydraulics deals with such matters as the flow of liquids in pipes, rivers and channels and their confinement by dams and tanks. Some of its principles apply to gases, usually in cases in which variations in density are relatively small. Consequently, the scope of hydraulics extends to such mechanical devices as fans and gas turbines and to pneumatic control systems. The purpose of conducting the workshop is to help students to be able to move from a reactive career into something that is much more intentional and more proactive. The details of the workshop is as: S.noTopicContentTime1IntroductionIndustrial Hydraulics10:00am-10:30am2ConceptFluid Power Concepts10:30am- 1:00pm3ApplicationApplication of Hydraulic Technology2:00pm -4:00pm Details:Registration Link:https://tinyurl/worlshoponhydraulics CHIEF GUEST OF THE EVENT: Mr. Vimal Ojha, SOHA Technologies Pvt Ltd, presented the session DATE: 20th January 2018 VENUE: 56-504.Attachment

title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (1/8/2018)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. vii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar,State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: Marubeni India Meritorious Scholarship 2017-18 –reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/180108/001) : (1/8/2018)
body: Marubeni India Private Limited invites applications for Marubeni India Meritorious Scholarship 2017-18 from talented, meritorious and needy students for pursuing their higher education. Last date for applying the scholarship is 13.01.2018. Eligibility · Students who have scored more than 75% marks in their Board exams in Class 12 (academic session 2016-17) and continuing their higher education in any full-time Undergraduate /Professional /Technical Courses with state/UGC recognized Universities / Reputed Engineering, Management and other technical institutes situated in the State of Punjab (including Chandigarh) ONLY. · Students who are not availing any other scholarship (amount of which is INR 6,000 p.a. or more) · Students whose family income (from all sources) is not more than INR 200,000 p.a. Note: Children of employees of Marubeni, Buddy4Study and any Central/State government including Municipal corporation are not eligible to participate in the scholarship program. The applicants must submit the following documents while applying for the scholarship :- · Passport size photo · One age proof document (Acceptable documents: Birth certificate, First and last pages of a valid Indian passport, Driver’s license, Class 10 mark sheet with Date of Birth mentioned) · One identity proof (Acceptable documents: PAN Card, Voter Identity Card, Driver’s License, Aadhar Card, Class 10 mark sheet with photo) For more details students can check the weblink http://www.b4s.in/id/MIM2 Students have to provide the valid (latest) contact number of Self, Father, Mother etc , along with the email ID (of student) for communication. In case of any wrong information the student will be responsible. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on all working days between 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

title: WiFi Th!nkFest 2.0 : (1/8/2018)
body: BharatNet is a project of national importance established by Govt. of India, in 2017. The project is aimed at creating nationwide optical fiber network infrastructure accessible on a non-discriminatory basis, to provide on-demand, affordable broadband connectivity to more than 2.5 lakh Gram Panchayats. The objective is to facilitate the delivery of e-governance, e-health, e-education, e-banking, Internet and other services to the rural India. Phase 2 of the project, launched recently by the Govt of India, envisages setting up of WiFi hotspots in every Gram Panchayat, providing Internet connectivity to 6.5 lakh villages. Mojo Networks has the launched a "WiFi Think Fest 2.0". This time the focus is on Rural WiFi and its use cases. The usecase could be related to governance, learning, agriculture, healthcare and other means of socio-economic upliftment of people.Participants can submit their idea in the form of a document, slide-set or app. Any professional, undergraduate or graduate students of any stream can participate in the contest. Hosting Platform: Mojo Networks in association with BharatNet Category of Event: Hackathon(Idea submission based) Mode of Event Participation: Online followed by offline Nature of Event: Competition only with Prize Number of Rounds of this event: 2 Event Winner Prizes: 1st Prize:Google Pixel 2, 2nd Prize:Huawei Watch 2, 3rd Prize:Amazon Echo Plus. title: Online Logo and Tagline Making Competition : (1/2/2018)
body: Dear Students, The objective of the National Food Security Act, 2013 (NFSA) is to provide food and nutritional security in human life cycle approach, by ensuring access to adequate quantity of quality food at affordable prices to people to live a life with dignity and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. The Act is now being implemented pan-India and foodgrains, as per entitlement prescribed under the Act, which are uniform throughout the country, are being allocated by the Central Government to States/UTs. Therefore, in order to preserve the National character of this important initiative for food security and also to highlight the major role of Government of India in ensuring food security of the people, vis-à-vis a very miniscule additional benefit by some State Governments, a distinct logo with a catchy tagline. Last date of submission is 18th January, 2018 at 5:00PM. Eligibility Criteria: 1. The Contest is open to all Indians citizens. Registered Organizations under relevant Indian Laws are also eligible to participate. 2. The employees of Department of Food and Public Distribution and their family members are not eligible for appearing in the contest. Awards/ Prize • The winning entry of logo with tagline will be awarded a cash prize of Rs.25000/- only. The Department of Food and Public Distribution will however have the freedom to select logo from one entry and tagline from some other entry and in that case prize money will be divided equally between two entries. • Taxes, if any applicable, will be deducted at source. title: MyGov Initiative - It doesn’t get bigger than this. : (1/2/2018)
body: Dear All, Become an active stakeholder in the governance process. Not only in the formulation part of it but also in the implementation bit. The Government through the MyGov Portal provides you with the opportunity to partner the government in its policy implementation drive through the group based and individual tasks which are earmarked on this task. Take up the tasks and help the Government in taking its policy goals and implementation forward through your individual action. Successful completion of a task will enable citizens to earn credit points and a chance to share their ideas with the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India. About MyGov: MyGov is an innovative platform to build a partnership between Citizens and Government with the help of technology for growth and development of India. Through this platform, the Government aims to encourage Citizen Participation towards Good Governance by seeking their ideas, suggestions and grass roots level contribution. Citizens can participate in this unique initiative of nation building. For the very first time in the history of this country, citizens from across India will come together to share their expert thoughts, ideas and suggestions with the Government in areas related to various policies, programs, schemes etc. MyGov aims to empower citizens to work hand in hand with the Government. How to Register: Register on mygov.in to participate. You will be asked for personal details such as name, email id etc. You will also be required to mention the kind of skills you have & the issues on which you may like to provide inputs. Registration and sign up on MyGov can be done through your valid email ID and your 10-digit Mobile number. While logging in, either the registered mobile number or email id can be used. Every time you enter your Mobile Number or Email ID, a One Time Password (OTP) shall be sent to your email as well as mobile number registered with MyGov. You do not need to remember any password for logging in. Alternatively, you can Sign-in by using your email id and password as you maintain with MyGov. · Link to Website: https://innovate.mygov.in/ Latest Initiatives: * Data Protection in India : https://innovate.mygov.in/data-protection-in-india/ * International Design Competition : https://innovate.mygov.in/irsdc/ * Capture the flag (NITI Aayog) : https://innovate.mygov.in/niti-registration/ * Smart India Hackathon 2018 : https://innovate.mygov.in/sih2018/ Note: All students who are registering themselves in MyGov initiative are required to fill their details in the link given below: Link: https://tinyurl.com/MyGov-LPU For any query: Email: manish.19164@lpu.co.in

title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (12/30/2017)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. viii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com . In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­ (between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

body: Dear Students, A chance to bring your technological innovation or idea among VALEO for new ways to use cars and get chance to win prizes upto 2 lakh euros and many other wonderful opportunities with VALEO. About VALEO: Valeo is an automotive supplier and partner to automakers worldwide. As a technology company, they design innovative solutions for smart mobility, with a particular focus on intuitive driving and reducing CO2 emissions. The Group also provides and distributes spare parts for automakers and independent aftermarket operators. About VALEO Innovative challenge 2018: The aim of the competition is to reward an innovative project, whether it is a technological innovation or an idea for new ways to use cars. The participants will have to propose new solutions in one of the following categories: ·Vehicle electrification ·Autonomous vehicle ·Digital mobility The competition is open to final year students from all disciplines and to the teachers, one per team. Entrants must compete in teams made up of between two and a maximum of five people. Teams can take part to the challenge by presenting a relevant, innovative project in English by submitting: 1. Mp4 video pitch (maximum 3 minutes) that explains the project in a clear, simple and audible way, 2. Accompanied by 5 slides describing the composition of the team; the problem identified; the existing or known solutions; the proposed technical solution; the target market and the business model. · First Stage : Registration & Ideation: from Nov 15, 2017 till March 30th, 2018 · Second Stage : Project accelerations: From June 16, 2018 to September 28, 2018 · Third Stage: Final Pitch & Awards: October 12, 2018 Prizes: · For the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Teams! €200,000 to be shared! · 9 selected finalist teams will get chance to pitch their idea/project in Paris For registration and more information please visit website link given below: · Link to Website : https://valeoinnovationchallenge.valeo.com/en/challenges/innovationchallenge2018?lang=en Note: All students who are registering themselves in the competition are required to fill their details in the link given below: Link: https://tinyurl.com/VALEO-LPU For any query: Email: manish.19164@lpu.co.in

title: MyGov Initiative - It doesn’t get bigger than this. : (12/21/2017)
body: Dear All, Become an active stakeholder in the governance process. Not only in the formulation part of it but also in the implementation bit. The Government through the MyGov Portal provides you with the opportunity to partner the government in its policy implementation drive through the group based and individual tasks which are earmarked on this task. Take up the tasks and help the Government in taking its policy goals and implementation forward through your individual action. Successful completion of a task will enable citizens to earn credit points and a chance to share their ideas with the Hon'ble Prime Minister of India. About MyGov: MyGov is an innovative platform to build a partnership between Citizens and Government with the help of technology for growth and development of India. Through this platform, the Government aims to encourage Citizen Participation towards Good Governance by seeking their ideas, suggestions and grass roots level contribution. Citizens can participate in this unique initiative of nation building. For the very first time in the history of this country, citizens from across India will come together to share their expert thoughts, ideas and suggestions with the Government in areas related to various policies, programs, schemes etc. MyGov aims to empower citizens to work hand in hand with the Government. How to Register: Register on mygov.in to participate. You will be asked for personal details such as name, email id etc. You will also be required to mention the kind of skills you have & the issues on which you may like to provide inputs. Registration and sign up on MyGov can be done through your valid email ID and your 10-digit Mobile number. While logging in, either the registered mobile number or email id can be used. title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171218/001) : (12/18/2017)
body: The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 Conditions for Scholarship: i) Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. ii) Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. iii) Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. iv) Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. v) Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. vi) Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. vii) A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. vii) All scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ix) The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. For more information, the students can check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in or contact them on 01145803730, 45088638 , E-mail: nhfdctf@gmail.com In case of any problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

title: WiFi Th!nkFest 2.0 : (12/18/2017)
body: BharatNet is a project of national importance established by Govt. of India, in 2017. The project is aimed at creating nationwide optical fiber network infrastructure accessible on a non-discriminatory basis, to provide on-demand, affordable broadband connectivity to more than 2.5 lakh Gram Panchayats. The objective is to facilitate the delivery of e-governance, e-health, e-education, e-banking, Internet and other services to the rural India. Phase 2 of the project, launched recently by the Govt of India, envisages setting up of WiFi hotspots in every Gram Panchayat, providing Internet connectivity to 6.5 lakh villages. Mojo Networks has the launched a "WiFi Think Fest 2.0". This time the focus is on Rural WiFi and its use cases. The usecase could be related to governance, learning, agriculture, healthcare and other means of socio-economic upliftment of people. Participants can submit their idea in the form of a document, slide-set or app. Any professional, undergraduate or graduate students of any stream can participate in the contest. body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement with 18.H Consulting is going to conduct certification training on “AngularJS”. It’s an Opportunity for Computer Science and Engineering students to register themselves for this training.It would be an advance learning experience from the expert trainers with industry experience. About AngularJS: AngularJS (commonly referred to as "Angular.js" or "AngularJS 1.X") is a JavaScript-based open-source front-end web application framework mainly maintained by Google and by a community of individuals and corporations to address many of the challenges encountered in developing single-page applications. Details about training: Program Name: Angular JS Program Overview: In this program participants will learn about the fundamentals of AngularJS and build single page web applications with that framework. Program Duration: 5 days. Fee: 8000/- including taxes (A special discount of 20% on the total fee amount will be given to the first 20 registered students for both the batches.) Prerequisite Skills: HTML, JavaScript, AJAX Basics & jQuery Basics Who should attend:Those students who intend to work on Web applications in developing User Interface using MV* framework should attend this program. This will be useful for developing Single page web application using AngularJS. Registration: The training will be conducted in two batches. So students who wants to enroll themselves in the training can choose their preferred batch as per their ease. 1st Batch: 26th Dec – 31st Dec 2017 2nd Batch: 8th Jan – 12th Jan 2018 Registration link: https://tinyurl.com/AngularJS-LPU Registrations Start: 11th Dec 2017 at 11 AM. Note: Minimum requirement of the batch will be 50 students per batch. The dates said above are tentative dates and can be changed as per registrations in each batch.

body: Informatica, a NASDAQ listed company, is conducting “Informatica Code-a-thon Contest”, a programming focused challenge with great prizes ** First Prize: Macbook Air, ** Second Prize: iphone 7 and ** Third Prize: iPad mini ** Runnerup Prizes: Informatica branded merchandise for the next 5 top coders. ** Apart from abovesaid prizes students will be getting an opportunity to be assessed for an internship/full time position at Informatica offices in Bengaluru & Hyderabad. ** The contest starts on 9th Dec and ends on 17th Dec. Key skills required: ** Proficiency in C, C++ and Java. Test Structure ** A student will be required to take three questions in a maximum timeframe of 23 hours 59 minutes (1440 minutes). ** Coding TestQuestions:3 ** Time: 23 Hours 59 Minutes ** Max Score: 300 The link to the contest: https://www.techgig.com/challenge/informat Note: ** 4th Year students registered in placements are already locked for the said test on placement portal. ** 3rd Year students are also requested to register on the link provided and attempt the test. Rules ** Any participant can attempt the contest only 1 time. ** There will be no negative marking. ** Time duration is 1440 minutes. ** In case your session expires before finishing the test, you cannot re-take the test. ** Your test will resume from where you left off, and the total time will reduce by the duration of your previous attempt. ** Winners of the contest will be chosen solely on the discretion. ** Please ensure to update your profile and contact details.Please refrain from discussing strategy during the contest. ** All submissions are run through a plagiarism detector. Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and international) of full-time regular programs (including Hons., dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2019. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. D. and Certificate programs. Registration Process: Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: ** Process Step-1: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. ** Process Step-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Important Note: a) Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum 5.5 CGPA. b) During Process Step-2 registration, students will need to fill and confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. Registration Timelines: ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 without compounding (late) fee: 25-Nov-2017 to 10-Dec-2017 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs. 500: 11-Dec-2017 to 17-Dec-2017 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs. 2000: 18-Dec-2017 to 24-Dec-2017 Students are advised to carefully read the policy attached herewith before enrolling for university career services. title: Give simple possible solution to challenges and win cash prize upto 6 Lac. : (12/2/2017)
body: Dear Students, Even the simplest of ideas have the power to transform lives and impact the society in a positive way. So here’s your chance to participate in ‘Navachar’ by Bajaj and get chance to win cash prizes upto 6 Lac rupee. About Competition: In 2017, India realized its dream of becoming a ‘power-surplus’ nation.Despite this, about 60 million households in India have no access to electricity. Out of those who do, almost all find electricity supply intermittent and unreliable. What causes this paradox? How do we change this picture? Navachar, an innovation challenge by Bajaj Electricals Ltd, aims at finding answers. As the name suggests, it invites the brightest of minds to create innovative solutions to the pressing problems faced by India’s electricity sector. Faculty, staff & students are invited to register for the workshop at the following link: http://www.lpu.in/academics/faculty-development.php NOTE: Since there are limited seats selection will be on first come first served basis. title: Student Enrollment into Career Services – Batch graduating in 2019 : (11/24/2017)
body: Alignment of career with role is regarded as one of the most critical roles of professional education. The university visualizes its role as a facilitator to bring about a radical change in the employability of its students. The comprehensive policy for Enrollment into Career Services is attached herewith for reference. Enrollment of students into University Career Services is now open for the batch graduating in 2019 and University Career Services of the University will be available only to students who chose to avail them. Applicability: a) The policy is applicable to students (Indian and international) of full-time regular programs (including Hons., dual-degree and integrated) expected to graduate in 2019. b) The policy is not applicable to students enrolled in ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., PhD. and Certificate programs. Registration Process: Registration process is divided into 2 steps/phases: ** Process Step-1: Student Consent for placement registration. This step is mandatory for every student eligible for placement registration. Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration. ** Process Step-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. This step is mandatory only for those students who give the consent as YES to register for career services during Process Step-1. Pathway for registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Portal > Placement Process-2 Registration. Only after successful completion of this step, a student will be considered enrolled into Career Services. Important Note: a) Process Step-1 will be allowed only to students who will have current minimum 5.5 CGPA. b) During Process Step-2 registration, students will need to fill and confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. Registration Timelines: ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 without compounding (late) fee: 25-Nov-2017 to 10-Dec-2017 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs. 500: 11-Dec-2017 to 17-Dec-2017 ** Placement Registration Process-1 & Process-2 with compounding (late) fee of Rs. 2000: 18-Dec-2017 to 24-Dec-2017 Students are advised to carefully read the policy attached herewith before enrolling for university career services. In case of any queries, students can approach their respective school TPCs or Ms. Malika Verma (Block 32-305, DCS).

title: Great opportunity for LPU researchers to get a fellowship at Danish University : (11/24/2017)
body: Aarhus Institute of Advanced Studies (AIAS), Denmark along with financial help from European Union’s Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation Programme under the Marie Sklodowska-Curie grant agreement no 754513 announces up to 15 AIAS-COFOUND fellowships for the most talented researchers from around the world. Applicants can choose their research topic freely within all academic areas. The duration of a fellowship varies from 6 up to 36 months. Type of Fellowships: · AIAS-COFUND Junior Fellowships for postdoctoral researchers with a career of 2-10 years. Duration of Fellowship (12- 36 months.) · AIAS-COFUND Senior Fellowships for researchers with a career of +10 years. Duration of Fellowship (6-18 months.) Inclusions of Fellowship: Funding of travel, reasonable research expenses and competitive salary. Eligibility: Talented researchers with a PhD and a minimum of two years of fulltime postdoctoral research experience at the time of the application deadline. Applicants must comply with the following mobility demand: · Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activities (work etc.) for more than 12 months in Denmark in the 3 years immediately prior to the call deadline. Time spent as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention, compulsory national service and/or short stays such as holidays are not taken into account. Apply online at: www.efond.dk/aias. Important Link for requirements to the contents of the application: http://aias.au.dk/aias-fellowships/aias-cofund-fellowships/ Application Deadline: 24 January 2018 For further information contact at 32-308 or email at manu.22413@lpu.co.in

title: Registrations open for ‘Ignited Minds’ competition from School of Professional Enhancement. : (11/23/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to announce a self-improvement competition ‘Ignited Minds’. We at CLUB ILLUMINATI solely believe that having good speaking skills, oratory skills and spelling skills gives an added extra touch in our personality. So we hereby provide this platform to showcase your oratory and spelling skills. Interested Students can become a part of ‘Ignited Minds’ and prove their might as well as showcase their talents in this grant stage provided by CLUB ILLUMINATi. The competition is divided into two parts - 1. Spell-Bee - The first section would be the “Spell Bee” where a team will be of two members and a spelling will be asked. Spell Bee will comprise of two further rounds, in the first round spelling of a word will be asked to each team individually and will be awarded points based on their right answers. In second round, a spelling of a word will be asked randomly, whichever team buzzes the buzzer first, will get chance to speak the word and awarded points. 2. Extempore Speech - The second section “Extempore” will be based on speaking skills, where a participant will be assigned a topic on the spot and will get 3 minutes for thinking on the same and have to speak for maximum of 5 mins. After that the speaker need to face a questionnaire round, where any participant or audience can ask their question based on the topic. They will be awarded points based on their speaking skills and the answer the speaker gives, such as reversing paralysis, quantum computers, gene therapy, Botnets of things, reinforcement learning. Registration link: tinyurl.com/illuminatiimind No Registration fee Date: 25th November (Saturday) Last date for registration: 24th November Venue: Will be confirmed after registering Contact Details: Email: nagendrakansana@gmail.com, Phone: 9425124202, 9915130867

title: Globetrotter Fashion Week : (11/20/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement in collaboration with School of Hotel Management & Hospitality Activity Team - HAT is pleased to share with you an opportunity not only to learn about different cultures, but to become a part of them, experience them, witness their grandeur, and understand different people in our upcoming event - "Globetrotter Fashion Week". Ethnic wear is the epitome of all cultures, and It can teach you a lot about the region of it's origin. As the name suggests, the event would be a fashion show in which the participants will have to represent a particular region from anywhere around the globe by dressing up in that region's ethnic outfits. Participants are free to chose any country, any city or state according to their preferences. The show would consist of 3 rounds and the rules are as follows - Round 1 - In the first round of the event, the participants would have to walk on the ramp in their ethnic outfits and explain where the outfit originates from. 50 participants will qualify for the next round. Round 2 - With the 2nd round, the participants would have to find creative ways to carry themselves with the props that we'll provide. Top 10 participants will qualify for the last round. Round 3 - The last round would be a questionnaire round for the participants in which the participants will be asked questions regarding the outfit they chose. The participants will be judged on different criteria including Stage presence, appearance, technical correctness & proper justification for their choice of outfits and the overall quality. Prize: Top 3 candidate will be awarded with Trophies & Certificate. Eligibility: Students from all School/ University can participate in the event. Registration: Students interested can register them selves in the below mentioned link on or before 24th Nov. 2017 by 11:00 am. www.tinyurl.com/globetrotterfw For any Query Contact - Mr. Manmeet Singh (8847370323) & Mr. Jashandeep Singh Grover (9317107900)

title: Invitation to attend ISSWM- 2017 : (11/16/2017)
body: The School of Bioengineering and Biosciences (LFTS) in collaboration with McGill University - Canada is organizing an International Conference on ''Innovative Strategies for Sustainable Water Management (ISSWM-2017) on November 17-18, 2017 at Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium. The Conference has participants and speakers from different countries and their talk shall be themed around areas for discussion and paper presentation on Waste water management (treatment and reuse), Anthropogenic interference, Waste Water Microbiology, Waste Water Chemistry, Waste Water quality monitoring tools and techniques, Innovative technologies for minimizing waste water, Future waste water reclamation strategies and policies, Successful case studies on waste water management Etc. ISSWM-2017 offers a platform to amalgamate researchers, academicians, industrial personnel, entrepreneurs, NGOs and policy makers across the globe to share their research findings, ideas and experiences, success stories on the development of sustainable, efficient, cost effective and robust technologies to decontaminate water from source of pollution to point of use. During the conference, there is a special schedule session entitled “One day Ph.D. students’ Symposium on Science and Technology”, the main objective of which is to provide plenty of opportunity to research scholars to interact with international experts and benefit from their experiences. All students are invited to participate in ISSWM - 2017 and can have interaction with the speakers For any further information, please contact Dr. Rahul Singh (8054258749)
