title: AWS IoT App Challenge 2017 : (11/14/2017)
body: The competition is on! Build cool IoT apps that put IoT sensor data to work and make day-to-day life simpler for everyone. Enter your app into the AWS IoT App Challenge for a chance to win cash prizes, an Amazon Echo, AWS Credits, and more from a prize pool totaling $10,000. You’ll also have the opportunity to meet with AWS product team leaders and have your winning submission promoted by AWS. The Challenge Build an app that collects and processes sensor data to solve a particular user need, ranging from ordering fresh groceries or replacing printer cartridges to automating manufacturing plants and assembly lines. The app must use AWS IoT, Amazon Kinesis, or both to collect and process the data, then take actions in real-time. The Reward The rewards for the winning submissions include a total prize pool of $10,000, an Amazon Echo, AWS Credits, and more. You’ll also have the opportunity to meet with AWS product team leaders and have your winning submission promoted by AWS. Resources Download sample code(https://github.com/awslabs/aws-weathergen) and customize it to build your app. No need to start from scratch.Watch the AWS IoT App Challenge Kick Off (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jsNOR6b3EZE). We will walk you through developing a sample IoT app. Take advantage of additional resources(https://awsiot.devpost.com/details/resources) including links to data simulators, public data sets, and blog posts that guide you through building IoT applications. To avail participation benefits, submit your details to Training and Placement Cell on following link: "https://tinyurl.com/csestudentevent" after registering

title: Take your Business Online in 24 Hours : (11/8/2017)
body: Today’s digital world is competing at the global level. Digital World is also offering plenty of perks. It is need of the hour to get our business online to world very quickly. We just need to move from our seat and learn the various ways to earn from this huge pool. title: AWS IoT App Challenge Hackathon : (11/8/2017)
body: Application Requirements: Build an app that collects and processes sensor data to solve a particular user need, ranging from ordering fresh groceries or replacing printer cartridges to automating manufacturing plants and assembly lines. The app must use AWS IoT, or Amazon Kinesis, or both to collect and process the data, and take actions in real-time. What to Create: Makers must build a working software application using AWS IoT Platform and/or Amazon Kinesis. Functionality: The Application code must function as depicted in the video and/or expressed in any other materials submitted in connection with the Hackathon. New & Existing: Applications must be either newly created by the Maker or, if the Application existed prior to the Hackathon Submission Period, must have been updated to use Amazon IoT Platform and/or Amazon Kinesis during the Hackathon Submission Period. Testing: The Maker must make the Application available free of charge and without any restriction, for testing, evaluation and use by the Poster, Administrator and judges during the Hackathon and until the Judging Period ends.Makers must make their Application available for testing by: Including a link to the Application code on GitHub or BitBucket. Eligibility: The hackathon is open to individuals, and teams of eligible individuals. Hackathon Submission Period: before November 16, 2017(5:00 pm) Judging Period: November 27, 2017 (10:00am Pacific Time) – December 8, 2017 (5:00pm Pacific Time) Winners Announced: On or around December 15, 2017 (2:00pm Pacific Time) PRIZES:To be eligible for prizes, participants must build and submit an IoT app using AWS IoT or Amazon Kinesis or both. First Prize: US$5,000 USD, US$2,500 AWS Credits,30-minute virtual meeting with GM of Amazon Kinesis, Amazon Echo (up to 2 per team), Social media promotion by AWS blog, Promo video at reinvent. Second Prize: US$3,000 USD, US$1,000 AWS Credits, Amazon Echo (up to 2 per team), Social media promotion by AWS blog. Third Prize: US$2,000 US$500 AWS Credits, Amazon Echo (up to 2 per team), Social media promotion by AWS blog For More Details use website Link: http://AWSIoT.Devpost.com Note: Duty leaves will be provided to participating student, to avail submit details on following link: https://goo.gl/forms/L6kJHGQrTRnVgjgp2

Dr. Amar Prasad Reddy(Director -National Cyber Safety and Security Standards) 2. Raul Rodriguez (Criminal Intelligence Analyst ,Interpol,Spain) 3. title: Workshop on "Master - Mind And Self Teaming to Evolve & Rise" : (11/7/2017)
body: “Real Power Lies in the Power of the Mind” Our greatest tool to win every challenge in life is not what we acquire from outside, it is something that we all have it in us by birth. The only thing that stops us to unleash our full potential and open doors to unlimited possibilities is our connection with our own-self. This connection can be achieved with a special power and that is the “power of the mind.” When we and our mind consciously combine to form an alliance that is what makes us a “MASTER.” So, to be a master of your own life and destiny, under the aegis of School of Professional Enhancement, the Department of Soft Skills presents “MASTER- Mind And Self Teaming to Evolve & Rise,” a workshop which will help you unleash the potential to conquer all the challenges in life and become a better and balanced thinker. title: Call for Particpaton in National Entrepreneurship Conclave by Rectangle India Solutions and Services : (11/3/2017)
body: “It’s not about ideas. It’s about making ideas happen.” Do you have enough courage to be an entrepreneur and lead a start-up? Do you want to create chance for yourself ?Do you want to follow your dreams or some other's dreams? Do you want to know what it takes to be an entrepreneur? Do you want to live a life which some people only dream of ? Do you want to be the job creators and not the job seekers? To answer these Student Start-up Rectangle India under the aegis of Student Entrepreneurship Cell, Division of Student Welfare Presents National Entrepreneurship Conclave 2017 which is India’s 1st Start-up initiated Entrepreneurial Conclave. The agenda of this event “National Entrepreneurship Conclave” is to arise the thoughts of youth on Entrepreneurship and start-up ideas on Ed-Tech, Fin-Tech, Block Chain and Social Entrepreneurship. Hear from leaders who got success in their respective fields and won the heart of the society/surroundings with their restless efforts. Ground reality experiences of these leaders when joined together with energetic future thinkers by their Guest Talks/Panel Discussions, only one outcome is possible “The Change”. Highlight Events of the NEC-2k17:- 1) Start-up Showcase by 20+ start-up’s and 20+ Brands 2) Guest Talks by Start-Up Founders, Investors, Corporate 3) Panel Discussions on Ed-Tech, Fin-Tech,Block Chain and Social Entrepreneurship 4) B-Plan Presentation by Successful Entrepreneur 5) Networking with Investors, Start-up Founder’s, Corporate Dates of NEC-2k17:- 24th November, 2017(Start-up Showcase); 25th & 26th November,2017(Conclave) Venue:- Bal Dev Raj Mittal Uni-polis(Start-up Showcase) and Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium(Conclave) Student Benefit:- 1)To learn how to build your own Business Plan, how to pitch your Start-up idea to the investors and get funding for your Start-up, learn about Entrepreneurship from 20+ speakers with their Guests Talks and Panel Discussions. 2) Certificate of NEC-2K17 to all the Participants. 3) Conclave Kit consists of Notepad & pen,Id card, Coupons of Sponsors. 4)1000/-cash back coupon from Rectangle India can be used for future Trainings/Events in 4 years. Ticket Fee :- 499/- participant (LPU students) for 1st 1000 seats ; 599/- participant(LPU students) for 1000+ seats 599/-participant(Faculty);799/- participant(other college/university) Registration link: www.rectangleindia.com/nec2k17 For any query Contact: +91 8699895201, +91 9569604691 Visit us at:- Block-13(DSW),Room-206,Cabin-12 Note:-Student should register in the above link and confirm the entry pass by paying the amount at our help desks 13, 33 and respective hostels at Bh-1,Bh-2 and Bh-5

body: Have you ever wondered as a student that what is the real problem industry is facing? Do you think you can solve their problem? title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (10/31/2017)
body: Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Only the female mosquito transmits the dengue virus. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 metres from the breeding site. They do not breed in creeks, swamps, pools or other bodies of water. --Signs and symptoms The disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • fever for 3 to 7 days • intense headache and pain behind the eyes • muscle and joint pain • loss of appetite • vomiting and diarrhoea • skin rash • bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. --Prevention Since mosquito breeds on clear water please cover your all water containers • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus . • Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: Prevention from Dengue Fever : (10/28/2017)
body: Fever Dengue virus is transmitted by a bite from the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Only the female mosquito transmits the dengue virus. This mosquito is a daytime biter, both inside and outside homes, and is most active in the hours after sunrise and before sunset. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes breed inside and outside the home in containers holding water and rarely fly more than 200 metres from the breeding site. They do not breed in creeks, swamps, pools or other bodies of water. ---Signs and symptoms The disease has a sudden onset and symptoms may include: • fever for 3 to 7 days • intense headache and pain behind the eyes • muscle and joint pain • loss of appetite • vomiting and diarrhoea • skin rash • bleeding, usually from the nose or gums. Recovery is sometimes associated with prolonged fatigue and depression. Repeated episodes of dengue fever may result in excessive bleeding and shock but, with appropriate treatment, are rarely fatal. ----Prevention • There is no vaccine to prevent human infection by this virus. • Wear long, loose fitting, light coloured clothing, covering as much of the body as you can. Mosquitoes can bite through tight clothing like jeans. • Personal protection and the environmental management of mosquitoes are important in preventing illness. • When outdoors, apply insect repellent containing DEET (diethyl toluamide) or picaridin and always follow instructions on the label. • Place mosquito-proof mesh on doors and windows. • Cover your sleeping areas with mosquito nets. Aerosol knockdown or surface insect sprays can help control mosquitoes inside the home but always follow instructions on the label.

title: A career counseling Workshop on Statement of Purpose for students from School of Mechanical Engineering (10/26/2017)
body: Dear Students Department of Verbal Ability under the aegis of Center for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a A career counseling Workshop on Statement of Purpose, a session on how to write effectively in English language for attaining admission in reputed institutes. The workshop will intend to help students to learn the most important element of the admissions process. When applying to study at a university abroad, one of the most important pieces of a strong application is your Statement of Purpose (SOP). A Statement of Purpose is a short essay that highlights your educational background, achievements, and goals. It allows the admissions committee to peek into your background, almost a narrative to your entire application. In essence, a well-drafted statement of purpose could downplay certain weaknesses. The major objective of this session is to make students learn:the purpose of writing and organizing ideasTo learn effective techniques to monitor the effectiveness of writing.Role of Vocabulary in enhancing the art of writing. The students will be provided a platform to practice various writings with in the session which will be evaluated by the speaker. The purpose of conducting the workshop:To let the students improve their writing skills.To hone the presentation skills of the students. Registration Link:https://tinyurl/statementofpurposeworkshop RESOURCE PERSON: Ms Anudeep Bedi , Assistant Professor, Department of Verbal Ability, Centre for Professional Enhancement Lovely Professional University, Phagwara DATE: 28th October 2017VENUE: 56-505 Attachment

title: PREVENTION OF SKIN FUNGAL INFECTION : (10/23/2017)
body: Ringworm is a fungal skin infection that causes a red, circular, itchy rash. Take care of yourself to prevent this infection Do’s -Regular bathing, Body cleansing is must -Before wearing clothes, drying out yourself to prevent excess moisture -Wearing loose clothes -Laundering clothes of infected person in hot water and washing with anti-septic agent -Drying clothes in sunlight for at least 2 hours, -Wearing clothes after ironing them and placing them separately -Washing your hands with anti-septic and water frequently. -Keeping hair, nails and scalp clean -Wearing well ventilated shoes with cotton socks, not sharing comb and other utilities with other family members. -Eating healthy food which boost immunity, drinking 2-3 liters of water everyday

title: Financial Literacy through Investor Awareness Programme (I.A.P) : (10/14/2017)
body: Dear Student, School of Professional Enhancement with ValeurHR is conducting 'Financial Literacy through Investor Awareness Programme (I.A.P)' on 14th Oct 2017, Saturday. It’s an Opportunity for students and staff to attend this workshop. It would be an advance learning experience from the peoples of SEBI. There will be a limited seating in the session so audience will be shortlisted on first come first serve basis. Regarding IAP: ValeurHR E-Solutions Private Limited, want to impart Financial Literacy through Investor Awareness Programme (I.A.P) for your team which is an approved financial literacy program being driven by Securities and Exchange Board of India, S.E.B.I, so that it helps the people take more effective investment decisions (retirement planning, child education & marriage planning, tax saving options, tax planning, and all sorts of investment options) enabling them to create wealth for a healthy living. Life expectancy has increased over the years and coupled with the rising costs of living, longevity poses opportunities and risks. Today’s youth will need to manage their finances responsibly and wisely in order to achieve financial security and a high standard of living in their golden years. This is a 45-60 minutes program and no Professional fee will be charged to your organization for this Investor Awareness Program. Their team focuses on only spreading awareness and does not sell any financial product available in the market. As a team of facilitators and trainers, they are equipped with financial knowledge and the basic understanding of efficient investment decisions. The expected outcome of the Investor Awareness Program (I.A.P) is an enhanced level of financial literacy for an increased appetite to save and invest wisely. The participant shall learn... 1. How does a savings account and fixed deposits give us return on our money? 2. How is mutual fund an efficient investment option from the return and taxation point of view? 3. How does inflation impact our investments? What is deflation? 4. The basic difference between investment and savings. Date of Session: 14th Oct 2017 (Saturday) Timings: 4:00 P.M – 5:00 PM Venue: Will be shared with registered audience. title: Scholarship Opportunity in Hong Kong for PhD students : (10/13/2017)
body: Division of International Affairs-LPU brings you another amazing opportunity to do your PhD in Hong Kong.The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) aims at attracting the best and brightest students in the world to pursue their PhD studies in Hong Kong’s universities. Eligibility Candidates who are seeking admission as new full time PhD students in the following eight universities, irrespective of their country of origin, prior work experience and ethnic background, should be eligible to apply. *City University of Hong Kong *Hong Kong Baptist University *Lingnan University *The Chinese University of Hong Kong *The Education University of Hong Kong *The Hong Kong Polytechnic University *The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology *The University of Hong Kong Applicants should demonstrate outstanding qualities of academic performance, research ability / potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership abilities.Fellowship Award The Fellowship provides an annual stipend of HK$240,000 (approximately US$30,000) and a conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$10,000 (approximately US$1,300) per year to each awardee for a period of up to three years. More than 230 PhD Fellowships will be awarded in the 2018/19 academic year*. For awardees who need more than three years to complete their PhD studies, additional support may be provided by the chosen universities. For details, please contact the universities concerned directly. * Universities in Hong Kong normally start their academic year in September. Selection Panel Shortlisted applications, subject to their areas of studies, will be reviewed by one of the following two Selection Panels comprising experts in the relevant board areas: *Science, Medicine, Engineering and Technology *Humanities, Social Science and Business Studies Selection Criteria While candidates’ academic excellence is of primary consideration, the Selection Panels will take into account factors as follows: *Academic excellence; *Research ability and potential; *Communication and interpersonal skills; and *Leadership abilities. How to Apply: Eligible candidates should first make an Initial Application online through the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme Electronic System (HKPFSES) to obtain an HKPFS Reference Number by 1 December 2017 at Hong Kong Time 12:00:00 before submitting applications for PhD admission to their desired universities. Applicants may choose up to two programmes / departments at one or two universities for PhD study under HKPFS 2018/19. They should comply with the admission requirements of their selected universities and programmes. As the deadlines for applications to some of the universities may immediately follow that of the Initial Application, candidates should submit initial applications as early as possible to ensure that they have sufficient time to submit applications to universities. Link-> https://cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs/index.html Download -> find the attahced file Apply Now Link-> https://cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs/apply.html For any queries contact Mr. Manu Aggarwal on 9780036427, Block 32-308 from 9AM– 5PM or mail us @ international@lpu.co.in or manu.22413@lpu.co.in

title: Amazing Opportunity in USA for students : (10/10/2017)
body: Division of International Affairs-LPU brings you another amazing opportunity to pursue your short term research during summers in the USA. The Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Govt. of India, Indo-US Science and Technology Forum (IUSSTF) and WINStep Forward are partnering to support the prestigious Khorana Program for Scholars named in honor of Dr. Har Gobind Khorana. The Khorana Program will provide opportunities to Indian students to undertake research at University of Wisconsin-Madison (UW) and partner universities in summer 2018 for a period of 10 weeks. A list of UW partner universities is available http://www.winstepforward.org Scholarship includes: Stipend Airfare Health Insurance Application Guideline: *Pre-final year (2/3rd Year) students enrolled in B.Tech, M.Tech, B.Sc, M.Sc., in Biotechnology and allied areas (including agricultural, food, health and biomedical sciences) are eligible to apply. Final Year students and Ph.D. students are NOT eligible to apply *The applicant should have: • Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 8.0 or higher OR • Percentage: 80% and higher. *Only those candidates (preferably pre-final year) who shall be completing their degree program on or after May 2019 are eligible to apply. *Candidates are encouraged to fill out the online application and upload scanned copies of latest mark sheet/transcript, No-Objection Certificate & 2 Letters of Recommendation (Recommendation letter could be taken from HOD/HOS, please visit International Affairs of LPU in block 32,308 in case you face issue with this). Supporting documents should be provided strictly according to the check-list mentioned in the application form. Please DO NOT attach Class X/Class XII mark sheets. *Recommendation letters can be sent along with the application form or if referees wish to give a sealed one, they may send it directly to scholar@indousstf.org with Applicant’s full name in the subject line. *Hard copies of the application form/supporting documents are not required. *If you do not have a passport and have applied for it, choose “Applied for” in the passport details section of the Application form. *Applications in subject-fields other than those specified in the advertisement will not be considered. Program dates: May – July 2018 Submission Deadline: 30 November 2017 How to Apply-> http://49.50.81.218/Program_Details.aspx?ProgramFor=1 Application Guideline-> http://iusstf.org/cms/newsimages/file/khorana/2018_Application_guidelines_Revised.pdf

title: NATIONAL HANDICAPPED FINANCE AND DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NHFDC) SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME - FOR 2500 DIFFERENTLY ABLED STUDENTS-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/171008/001) : (10/8/2017)
body: Dear Students, The National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) is implementing the scheme of Scholarship Trust Fund for and on behalf of Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India for the students with disabilities. Under these schemes, 2500 new scholarships are provided every year for pursuing Degree and Post Graduate level professional or technical courses. Last date to apply for the scholarship is 30.06.2018 1. Objective: 1.1 The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to the differently-abled students to enable them to pursue professional or technical courses from recognized institutes and get employed/self-employed. 1.2 Differently-abled students face several barriers physical, financial, psychological,mental in pursuing studies and living with dignity. At times such students are deprived of harnessing their latent skills and thereby miss the opportunity to earn their livelihood and find a dignified place for themselves in the society. This scheme envisages encouraging differently-abled students by providing scholarships and other assistance to pursue professional or technical courses and various skill development courses for their empowerment. 2. Number of Scholarships: 2.1 To start with every year 2500 scholarships will be provided to the differently-abled students throughout the country. 30% scholarships will be reserved for girls, which will be transferable to male students in case of non-availability of female candidates. 3. Scope: 3.1 These scholarships will be available for studies in India, for all differently-abled students who are covered under the Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunity, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995 and the National Trust for the Welfare of Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities Act, 1999. Only Indian Nationals will be eligible for scholarships. 4. Conditions for Scholarship: · Financial assistance will be given to pursue degree and/or post graduate level technical and professional courses from a recognized institution. Maintenance, book/stationary allowance and grant for purchase of assistive devices will be credited to the student's account. Non-refundable fees shall be reimbursed to the student on production of proof of deposit of fees or will be paid directly to the Institute under intimation to the student. · Scholarship will be awarded for only one course at a time. · Students who get admission to a college to pursue technical/professional courses, on the basis of a competitive examination will be eligible for the scholarship without any consideration of percentage of marks at higher secondary/graduation level. · Students who get admission in technical/professional courses without facing any competitive examination will also be eligible for scholarship. However, such students should have not less than 50% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. Selection of these students will be done strictly on merit basis. In case of female students should have not less than 45% marks at higher secondary/graduation level. · Students who pursue their education through correspondence would also be eligible for the scholarship. · Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be subject to successful completion of the course during the preceding year. However, grace period shall be admissible for Girl Students and Students failing in category C-4 is of two years and for all other categories is for one year w.e.f. the academic year 2014-15. · A candidate who is awarded scholarship for one course, after its completion will be eligible for another course too. However, the awardees will not be eligible for a similar or equivalent course. · A scholarship holder under this Scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. · The annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 3.00 lakh from all sources. However, preference shall be given to economically weaker students. . For more information, the students can read the enclosed advertisement and check the official website of NHFDC i.e. www.nhfdc.nic.in . In case of any confusion / problem in applying for NHFDC SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar,State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­(between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM).

body: The students of Jharkhand state can apply on Jharkhand scholarship portal from 30th August 2017 through website link http://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in for Post Matric Scholarship scheme to SC/ST and OBC students for the session 2017-18. The last date for applying for this scholarship has been extended till 30th October 2017. Domicile certificate (as per the online record available in the website). 8. Bank Passbook copy. 9. Photocopy of Aadhar Card. (Aadhar Cardmust belinkedwith bank ) 10. Fee Receipts (to be attested from accounts department at Block No.32, Room No. 103, Window No. 5). Students have to upload all the above mentioned documents while applying online on the scholarship portal in jpeg/jpg (The size of the documents should not exceed 150kb). Note:- 1. In case of any mistake or wrong information found the student application will be rejected. 2. The scholarship form will be rejected if submitted more than once. 3. Seeding of Aadhar card with Bank account is mandatory otherwise scholarship will not be released by the Jharkhand state govt. 5. title: Change of Programme for Freshmen 2017 Students.(Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/171003/001) : (10/4/2017)
body: 1. This is for the information of all Freshmen 2017 Students that they can apply for Change of Programme as per the attached Guidelines and Timelines. 2. The students should read the guidelines thoroughly before applying. The Application Form can be downloaded from attachment of Formats and must be submitted (i.e. Annexure-1 and Annexure-2 complete in all respects) at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32, 102(window no.2) as per attached timelines. No applications will be entertained after that. 3. A student may download the form and undertaking and fill it up in his/her own handwriting in CAPITAL LETTERS, get it signed from the parents, scan it and e-mail it to academic.aac@lpu.co.in. The email should be with subject “Change of Programme for Freshmen 2017 Students -Registration No-” 4. In the ‘Without Compounding Fee’ phase, immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rs.1,000/- will be debited to the account of the student as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee. The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32 ,102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rs.1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee to the Department of Accounts. 5. In the ‘With Compounding Fee’ phase, immediately on the receipt of the e-mai,the compounding fee applicable as per timeline will be debited to the account of the student as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee. The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32,102(window no.2) after payment of the compounding fee applicable as per as per timeline will be debited to the account of the student Non Refundable Application Processing Fee to the Department of Accounts. 6. All students whose Change of Programme who application is approved must pay the ‘Change of Programme Fee’ as per timelines. Failing to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for their Change of Programme will stand cancelled and they shall continue in their current programme. The ‘Change of Programme’ Fee must be paid in person and no facility of online payment will be available. Students must plan their travel arrangements well in advance for this. 7. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old programme after approval of Change of Programme request or after paying the ‘Change of Programme Fee’.Students must read the enclosed ‘Guidelines for Change of Programme’ carefully before they apply for change of programme. In case of any query, kindly report to DAA window located at Block 32-102(Window No.2).

title: To apply for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab for the session 2017-18 (Fresh & Renewal of scholarship)-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/170929/002) : (9/29/2017)
body: Dear Students, The Punjab Government has announced Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Central Government for SC & OBC category students of Punjab for the session 2017-18. The Punjab Govt. Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship Portal has been started w.e.f. 29-Sep.2017. All the students who have submitted their documents for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Punjab are hereby informed to apply online for the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for the session 2017-18 by creating their login id & password in Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship. For old students who have applied last year for this scholarship, the students have to use their old user login id & password for applying for the scholarship on the Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship Portal. The user login id & password (renewal cases) will be sent to you in your my messages in UMS. In this scholarship portal you have to fill your complete information as mentioned in step 1, step 2 & step 3. The link for opening the Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship Portal is as under:- Link: - www.punjabscholarships.gov.in Step 1: For creating login id & password:- The students are advised to fill the following information in the Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship Portal as per the class 10th certificate / Adhaar Card and certificates / documents issued by the Govt.:- 1. Student’s Name 2. Father’s Name 3. Mother’s Name 4. Gender 5. Date of Birth 6. Religion 7. Category 8. Adhaar Card No. 9. Student’s Mobile No. 10. Student’s Email Address 11. Address with Pin Code 12. Parent’s Adhaar Card No. Step 2: For entering University details, Bank details, Course Details etc.:- The students are advised to click at Apply for Scholarship tab to fill the following details:- A. Institute / University Details (a) State - Punjab (b) District - Kapurthala (c) Tehsil - Phagwara (d) Institute /University - Lovely Professional University B. Scheme Related Detail (a) Academic Year – 2017-18 (b) Scheme – Post Matric Scholarship SC/OBC C. Application Related Detail (a) Course (b) Branch (c) Course Year – 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/etc. (d) Admission Date for Academic Year 2017-18 – 01/08/2017 (e) Enrollment Date – 01/08/2017 (f) University Registration / Enrollment Number (g) Special Category D. Details of last exam in which student appeared. (a) Hall Ticket/Admit Card No. - Qualifying Reg./Roll No. (b) Year of Exam – Last Qualifying Passing Year (c) Attendance (%) - Current Term Attendance % age (d) Marks in Percentage (%) Obtained – Last Qualifying % age (e) Promoted to Current session nor not – Yes (For new student’s percentage of qualifying examination & for renewal student’s percentage of previous year) E. 10th Class Passing Details (a) Select Board (b) Passing Year (c) 10th Class Roll Number F. Eligibility Related information (a) Govt. /Institute Recognized Hostel? (Hostler/Day scholar) (b) Caste Certificate No. – Mentioned on Caste Certificate (c) Caste Certificate Date – (dd/mm/yyyy) (d) Caste Certificate Issuing Authority - Tehsildar (e) Family Annual Income – Written on Income Affidavit (e) Re Enter Family Annual Income - Written on Income Affidavit G. Bank Account Details for Electronic Transfer of Funds (a) Enter IFSC Code (b) Bank Account Number Step 3: For uploading the compulsory documents on Portal: (a) Caste Certificate (b) Income Affidavit from Student Side (c) Adhaar Card Copy (d) Bank Passbook Copy (e) Matric Certificate (f) Passport Size Recent Photograph Students are required to fill the adhaar card number of father & mother in the following tab as given below: Edit Mobile No. / Email Address / Adhaar Number (Wherever applicable on the Portal) The complete process for filling step 1, step 2 & step 3 is enclosed for your reference as PDF file. Moreover, FAQ’s are also enclosed for clarification & submitting the online application form on Dr. Ambedkar Scholarship Portal. After completing the above process, the students have to submit the duly signed print application form, new Income Affidavit & Undertaking to be signed by the student (formats enclosed) in Block No.32, Room No. 101 on or before 15-Oct-2017 along with pending documents (if any). Moreover, user login id & password should be mentioned on the back side of the print application & this password should not be changed by the students. If any student has not applied for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab in the sessions and would like to apply for this scholarship in the session 2017-18 as a fresh candidate, such students can also apply for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab subject to satisfying the above conditions. For more details, the students can contact in 32-101 or 32-102 (Window No.01). If any student fail to produce the desired documents for the renewal of Post Matric Scholarship for the academic year 2017-18 then their case will not be processed and the student will not be eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab. All the queries related with Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab will be handled in 32-101. In case of any confusion / problem in applying for Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102­ (between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM). Note:- Reporting schedule to visit SSIV Cell will be sent through UMS in your my messages box.

title: PREVENTION OF FUNGAL INFECTION : (9/26/2017)
body: Ringworm is a fungal skin infection that causes a red, circular, itchy rash. Take care of yourself to prevent this infection Do’s -Regular bathing, Body cleansing is must -Before wearing clothes, drying out yourself to prevent excess moisture -Wearing loose clothes -Laundering clothes of infected person in hot water and washing with anti-septic agent -Drying clothes in sunlight for at least 2 hours, -Wearing clothes after ironing them and placing them separately -Washing your hands with anti-septic and water frequently. -Keeping hair, nails and scalp clean -Wearing well ventilated shoes with cotton socks, not sharing comb and other utilities with other family members. -Eating healthy food which boost immunity, drinking 2-3 liters of water everyday

title: Amazing Opportunity in USA for students : (9/22/2017)
body: Division of International Affairs-LPU brings you another amazing opportunity to pursue your studies in the USA. The Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Govt. of India, Indo-US Science and Technology Forum (IUSSTF) and WINStep Forward are partnering to support the prestigious Khorana Program for Scholars named in honor of Dr. Har Gobind Khorana, who won the Nobel Prize in 1968 for his work at the interface of Chemistry and Biology while a member of the UW faculty. The Khorana Program will provide opportunities to Indian students to undertake research at University of Wisconsin-Madison (UW) and partner universities in Summer 2018 for a period of 10 weeks. A list of UW partner universities is available http://www.winstepforward.org Scholarship includes: Stipend Airfare Health Insurance Eligibility Details B.Tech, M.Tech and B.Sc./M.Sc. students currently enrolled in recognized institutions of higher education in India in Biotechnology and allied areas are eligible to apply. Students pursuing Ph.D/Final year students are not eligible to apply Application Guideline: *Pre-final year candidates enrolled in B.Tech, M.Tech, B.Sc, M.Sc., MBBS in Biotechnology and allied areas (including agricultural, food, health and biomedical sciences) are eligible to apply. Final Year students and Ph.D. students are NOT eligible to apply *The applicant should have: • Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) of 8.0 or higher OR • Percentage: 80% and higher. *Only those candidates (preferably pre-final year) who shall be completing their degree program on or after May 2019 are eligible to apply. *Candidates are encouraged to fill out the online application and upload scanned copies of latest marksheet/transcript, No-Objection Certificate & 2 Letters of *Recommendation. Supporting documents should be provided strictly according to the check-list mentioned in the application form. Please DO NOT attach Class X/Class XII marksheets. *Recommendation letters can be sent along with the application form or if referees wish to give a sealed one, they may send it directly to scholar@indousstf.org with Applicant’s full name in the subject line. *Hard copies of the application form/supporting documents are not required. *If you do not have a passport and have applied for it, choose “Applied for” in the passport details section of the Application form. *Applications in subject-fields other than those specified in the advertisement will not be considered. Program dates: May – July 2018 Submission Deadline: 30 November 2017 How to Apply-> http://49.50.81.218/Program_Details.aspx?ProgramFor=1 Application Guideline ->http://iusstf.org/cms/newsimages/file/khorana/2018_Application_guidelines_Revised.pdf Download Brochure-> Download attached file

title: Scholarship Opportunity in Hong Kong for PhD students : (9/22/2017)
body: Division of International Affairs-LPU brings you another amazing opportunity to do your PhD in Hong Kong.The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) aims at attracting the best and brightest students in the world to pursue their PhD studies in Hong Kong’s universities. Eligibility Candidates who are seeking admission as new full-time PhD students in the following eight universities, irrespective of their country of origin, prior work experience, and ethnic background, should be eligible to apply. *City University of Hong Kong *Hong Kong Baptist University *Lingnan University *The Chinese University of Hong Kong *The Education University of Hong Kong *The Hong Kong Polytechnic University *The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology *The University of Hong Kong Applicants should demonstrate outstanding qualities of academic performance, research ability/potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership abilities. Fellowship Award The Fellowship provides an annual stipend of HK$240,000 (approximately US$30,000) and a conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$10,000 (approximately US$1,300) per year to each awardee for a period of up to three years. More than 230 PhD Fellowships will be awarded in the 2018/19 academic year*. For awardees who need more than three years to complete their PhD studies, additional support may be provided by the chosen universities. For details, please contact the universities concerned directly.* Universities in Hong Kong normally start their academic year in September. Selection Panel Shortlisted applications, subject to their areas of studies, will be reviewed by one of the following two Selection Panels comprising experts in the relevant board areas: *Science, Medicine, Engineering and Technology *Humanities, Social Science and Business Studies Selection Criteria While candidates’ academic excellence is of primary consideration, the Selection Panels will take into account factors as follows: *Academic excellence; *Research ability and potential; *Communication and interpersonal skills; and *Leadership abilities. How to Apply: Eligible candidates should first make an Initial Application online through the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme Electronic System (HKPFSES) to obtain an HKPFS Reference Number by 1 December 2017 at Hong Kong Time 12:00:00 before submitting applications for PhD admission to their desired universities. Applicants may choose up to two programmes/departments at one or two universities for PhD study under HKPFS 2018/19. They should comply with the admission requirements of their selected universities and programmes. As the deadlines for applications to some of the universities may immediately follow that of the Initial Application, candidates should submit initial applications as early as possible to ensure that they have sufficient time to submit applications to universities. Link-> https://cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs/index.html Download -> find the attached file Apply Now Link-> https://cerg1.ugc.edu.hk/hkpfs/apply.html

title: Competitive programming: Skill in need for CSE : (9/19/2017)
body: Competitive programming is a mind sport for programmers and there are various platforms available to practice and participate in code challenges. Few direct benefits that practicing competitive programming brings to your kitty are: 1. Practicing and Participating on competitive programming/hackathons brings you rewards in terms of prizes, internships and sometime hiring on packages more than 10 lakh. 2. For Higher studies, various universities value your competitive programming skill and makes you eligible to add weightage points to your admission application. 3. With-in Lovely Professional University you will be entitled to apply for various academic benefits.More details can be read on following link: https://tinyurl.com/LPUCompetitionPolicy The skill that you master while practicing competitive programming are: 1. Better learning of core concepts of algorithms such as analysis of algorithms, finding/developing the right algorithm for.solving specific problem. This also improves the ability to learn new algorithms. 2. The better understanding of Data structure and where to use them. 3. The better understanding of applications of basic mathematics concepts in solving the simple/complex problem. 4. Improve problem-solving and code writing skills and improved creativity in building the right and optimized solution. 5. Debugging and understanding who the compilers and execution engines work for a programming language etc.. 6. Train to perform better in pressure situations, e.g., interviews. A post containing detailed resources regarding practicing competitive programming is available on following link: https://goo.gl/hsJuoz
uploaded_by: Office of HOD School of Professional Enhancement *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

title: Switch - Be on both the sides | Event for School of Mechanical, Civil and Polytechnic : (9/18/2017)
body: Dear All, School of Professional Enhancement is privileged to share with you all that club C’will is going to organize its very first event for the semester ‘Switch- Be on both the sides’ on 23rd of September in Block-56A-502 at 10:30 AM. The event compromises of three activities: 1. Switch: A participant shall be given any random topic and instantly has to speak, “for or against” the topic. In the duration of 5 minutes whenever the judge commands ‘switch’, the speaker will have to toggle between ‘for’ and ‘against’ multiple times thereby contradicting the previous statements. (Open to participants only). 2. Spell-Bee: Participants will have to spell a word after listening to it. (Open to audience also). 3. Wordsworth: A big word shall be displayed on the screen, one at one time. Participants have 60 seconds to write as many small words from the one big word as possible in those 60 seconds. Repeat for at least 3 rounds. The one with the highest word count of legitimate words (with letters only from the one big word) wins! (open to audience also). Winners will be awarded Trophies and certificates. For registration copy and paste the URL: http://tinyurl.com/Switch-win For further information feel free to Contact: Facilitator: Rayees Rashid- 7307843374 President: Mr. Ayush- 7986792977

title: Call for Papers: Replication and Reproducibility in Psychological Bulletin Journal : (9/16/2017)
body: The primary mission of Psychological Bulletin is to contribute a cohesive, authoritative, theory-based, and complete synthesis of scientific evidence in the field of psychology. The editorial team is currently interested in the contribution of meta-analysis and systematic reviews to answering questions about the replication and reproducibility of psychological findings. This call is designed to encourage authors to consider the degree to which multi-study primary research papers, systematic replications efforts (e.g., Open Science Framework and Many Labs Replications), and meta-analysis can contribute to substantial psychological knowledge. The editors of Psychological Bulletin announce interest in publishing Replication and Reproducibility: Questions Asked and Answered via Research Synthesis.Papers may be published as a special issue or as a series of special sections. Manuscripts will be evaluated and may be published as they come in but must be submitted by December 29, 2017 for consideration for the special sections/issue. We invite authors to submit single papers that address a clearly defined question related to replication and reproducibility of psychological findings using systematic-review or meta-analytic perspectives. Purely methodological papers, such as tests or criticisms of particular approaches, or commentaries on replication and reproducibility, are not appropriate for Psychological Bulletin. Primary-level research reports are also outside of the interest domain of Psychological Bulletin. Examples of possible manuscripts include but are not limited to - meta-analyzing replication efforts - comparing evidence from different replication methods - synthesizing models of replication determinants - meta-analyzing predictors of questionable research practices and retraction - comparing methods to gauge publication bias For guidance in proposing a submission, interested authors may contact the Editor, Dolores Albarracín, or Associate Editor, Blair T. Johnson. Alternatively, authors are free to submit unsolicited manuscripts and should indicate that the submission targets this call in the cover letter. For more Information visit: http://www.apa.org/pubs/journals/bul/call-for-papers-replication.aspx

body: “The plain fact is that Planet doesn’t need more “Successful” people. But it does desperately need more peacemakers, healers, restorers and lovers of every shape and form. It needs people who live “WELL” in their places. It needs people of moral courage willing to join the fight to make the world habitable and humane.” Do you care enough to heal some of the damages we have done during evolution? body: Dear Aspirants, Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled a renowned exam named CoCubes (Pre Assess-2) for 2018 batch placement registered students(Engineering/MCA) on 10th Sep , 2017. A good Score in CoCubes will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So come prepared and attempt the exam with full enthusiasm. Why CoCubes Exam is important: · CoCubes is an industry renowned testing platform. · Most of the companies use CoCubes as their testing platform during placement drives. · CoCubes is India’s largest assessment and hiring platform. · CoCubes helps us in gauging your current performance levels which will be utilized to design customized training inputs for the students. You can know more about CoCubes at: www.cocubes.com Important Instructions: 1. It is mandatory for all the students. 2. Total duration of the exam is 240 minutes approx. containing different modules. You must attempt every module. In case you miss any module your exam will not be considered as completed and will not be evaluated for the final result. 3. You can attempt any module at any time within the given time span (9 AM, to 11 PM). 4. Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will help you to get shortlisted for upcoming placement drives. 5. Score of this exam will also be considered for shortlisting students for special training and companies therefore students should attempt this seriously. 6. Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not take this exam, hence attempt the test with full spirit. 7. No Duty Leave will be provided for test attempts. 8. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Therefore, don’t use any unfair means during exam. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. 9. Passkey/Activation Key of exam will be shared with you through UMS my messages on the exam day itself (one hour prior to the exam). Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: Jharkhand Post Matric Scholarship scheme to SC/ST and OBC students for the session 2017-18-reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/170901/001) : (9/1/2017)
body: The students of Jharkhand state can apply on Jharkhand scholarship portal from 30th August 2017 through website link http://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in for Post Matric Scholarship scheme to SC/ST and OBC students for the session 2017-18. The last date for applying for this scholarship is 30th September 2017. Annual income of the parent of the SC/ST students should not exceed Rs. 2.5 lac per annumand for OBC students should not exceed 1 lac per annum from all sources. After submitting the online application on the scholarship portal, the students have to submit his/her print application form at Block No. 32, Room No. 102, Window No.-1 along with the following self-attested documents:- 1. Print Application Form. 2. Passport Photograph of student (One). 3. Bonafide Certificate with Fee Structure. 4. Previous year Marksheet (Matric onwards). 5. Income certificate (as per the online record available in the website). 6. Caste certificate (as per the online record available in the website). 7. Domicile certificate (as per the online record available in the website). 8. Bank Passbook copy. 9. Photocopy of Aadhar Card. (Aadhar Cardmust belinkedwith bank ) 10. Fee Receipts (to be attested from accounts department at Block No.32, Room No. 103, Window No. 5). Students have to upload all the above mentioned documents while applying online on the scholarship portal in jpeg/jpg (The size of the documents should not exceed 150kb). Note:- 1. Before submitting the application on Jharkhand scholarship portal students have to recheck the application very carefully. In case of any mistake or wrong information found the student application will be rejected. 2. The scholarship form will be rejected if submitted more than once. 3. After the due dates no student will be able to apply for the scholarship. 4. Seeding of Aadhar card with Bank account is mandatory otherwise scholarship will not be released by the Jharkhand state govt. 5. Scholarship holder under this scheme will not avail any other scholarship / stipend for pursuing the same course from any other government agencies/department. 6. Student should be regular in attendance and must maintain 75% attendance in each semester. For more details students can also check the enclosed Advertisement / Timelines published by Jharkhand Government on http://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in. If students are facing any problem in applying for the scholarship then they can contact Jharkhand Scholarship Cell on 07258010024, 04023120591, 040-23120592, 040-23120593 or on email kalyanhelp@gmail.com. In case of any other querythe students can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell on all working days between 02:00 PM to 4:00 PM.

title: Opportunity to join and be a part of The Wipro Earthian Program : (8/29/2017)
body: Dear Students, Long queues for water, crowded buses that don't come on time or haggling with auto rickshaw drivers, all this, while negotiating stinking mounds of garbage and pothole-ridden roads - this is the reality of our cities today. Is there a way out? School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to share with you an opportunity to associate with Wipro, The Wipro Earthian!! The Wipro earthian program is meant to be an immersive experience for students, to bring the idea of sustainability to life. It welcomes and encourages students from all disciplines. It will help you gain a deeper understanding of urban sustainability challenges in your area or neighbourhood. The project will involve a combination of research and field reporting. The submission should identify a key problem, and highlight the role of different stakeholders - government agencies, citizens and private agencies involved. Students can also explore how environment, economics and people are interconnected in the context of the selected issue. The report should be based on current research that looks at these linkages. The context is India and city centric. Themes: Urban Mobility/Water/Waste Word limit for the essay: 1500-3000 words (Must include photographs) Requirement from the Students in this programme: Get to know your neighbourhood (this could be a part of the city, town, residential layout or even your own college campus). 1. Identify a key problem area. Who are the stakeholders? 2. What is the historical background or context of the issue?\ 3. How are citizens responding and coping with it? 4. What are the existing government programmes (decision making, budgets, implementation) related to the issue? Any budgets allocated to solve them? 5. Are citizens involved in decision making? 6. Are there any civil society organisations or corporates involved? 7. What are the economic, social and environmental impact of these problems? 8. Who are the key individuals or organisations working to solve such problems? How successful have they been? What are the learnings from those initiatives? 9. What else can be done to improve the situation To register, Step 1: Click on the link, https://tinyurl.com/ybajhejl HOW to Participate (Steps) : 1. Form a team with a minimum of TWO students and maximum of FOUR. 2. Remember the team members should all be from the same college or educational institution. 3. Pick one of the topics (Urban Mobility/Water/Waste) that you’d like to explore in this project. 4. Register on Wipro’s website, http://wipro.org/earthian/colleges.php Show the best of your creative, analytical, systemic and communication capabilities - it will be a highly enriching learning experience!

title: Internship/Placement Opportunities at Techgig.com : (8/24/2017)
body: Techgig (A part of Times Internet Limited) is organizing a 'Virtual Campus League', it is India’s biggest national level coding contest designed to identify the best programmers and tech enthusiast Students across India. Best performers of test will get shortlisted for Internship and Job offers,specifically for third and fourth year students Registration Link: https://www.techgig.com/virtualcampus/ To attempt and prepare for this test you have to follow following steps: (a) Register on the mentioned link: https://www.techgig.com/virtualcampus (in case you have not registered on the portal) (b) On your dashboard, you will find three tabs Aptitude, Code and Practice, There is 10 paper available in practice tab and You are instructed to attempt atleast 3-4 test before you sit for the final test on Aptitude and Code test. Practice papers will help you to prepare yourself for the final exam. title: Prevention From swine Flu : (8/24/2017)
body: Swine influenza, is an infection caused by any one of several types of swine influenza viruses.(H1N1) It is highly contagious, spreading quickly from person to person. Most symptoms are the same as seasonal flu. They can include: cough. fever. sore throat. stuffy or runny nose. body aches. headache. chills. fatigue. Below are a few tips to steer clear of swine flu, apart from vaccination: Wash hands: Wash your hands often in hot soapy water. Also avoid touching your nose, eyes and mouth. Avoid contact: Stay home if you are sick. And if you have to be around someone who is sick, avoid physical contact and try to stay a few feet away from them. Because the virus can spread when particles are dispersed into the air through a cough or sneeze. Therefore, cover your nose and mouth with a tissue when coughing or sneezing. Sleep: Get enough sleep of 8 hours every night to keep your immune system strong and ready to fight infection. Drink water: Keep your body hydrated by drinking water of about 8-10 glasses daily. Eat whole grains, fresh fruits and vegetables and other vitamin-rich foods to keep your body strong and nourished. Avoid fatty foods as these can slow your metabolism and weaken your immune system. In case of any queries, please contact Dr N K Gupta, 9878426871

body: Dear Student To gauge your preparedness and help you with the type of questions, School of Professional Enhancement is are arranging a Preparatory Test for BOSCH tomorrow (22-Aug-2017). This test will also help us in ranking you for upcoming drives. Other components of Bosch test would be ELQ & Domain for which regular tests are uploaded on OAS platform.Take those tests regularly as well. About the Test : Automata: Automata is the world's smartest coding test to find the most appropriate software engineer for a position. Automata goes beyond the simplistic test case criterion using its patent pending technology. Based on semantic analysis of the program and use of machine learning, Automata grades a program on how close a program’s implementation logic is to a possible correct solution. Our machine learning algorithm score matches an expert score by a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.85 on average (where test cased based score just matches 0.6) – this means our automated engine grades as well as an expert interviewer would do. It can detect programs which are low on test case score, but are semantically very similar to a correct implementation, thus capturing the thought process of the candidate. Automata finds how efficient is the solution in terms of time complexity and code maintainability. It is 75 minutes long where a candidate is asked to write 2 pieces of code. To Read More: http://www.aspiringminds.com/technology/automata Find enclosed Seating Plan and Sample Question Paper . Note: Mobile phones will not be allowed

A good Score in these exams will also give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. About AMCAT: AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates on the basis of their core skills which include reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Aspiring Minds conducts the AMCAT exam for engineering freshers who apply for IT jobs. The objective of the AMCAT exam is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information, you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com. Important pointers: Above mentioned exam is mandatory to attempt for every student as per the lists attached. AMCAT Benchmarkingexam timings will be shared through “UMS-My Message” one day prior to the test. For AMCAT Benchmarking instructions kindly visit at: https://tinyurl.com/AMCATinstructions Duty Leaves will not be providedfor all the exams for the time of test attempt. PEP policy for the Assessment attempt will be applicable and hence it is advised to appear in these exams with full spirit. Examcredentials will be shared on the exam day itself through UMS My messages. Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: HAL Recruitment 2017 : (8/19/2017)
body: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has certain openings for the recruitment of Apprentice (Graduate & Diploma Engineer) in various disciplines. Eligible candidates may apply online on or before 22-08-2017. Other details like educational qualification, selection process & how to apply are given below: Name of the Posts: 1. Apprentice (Graduate Engineers) 2. Apprentice (Diploma Technicians) Educational Qualification: Candidates should possess Degree/ Diploma in Engineering (Aeronautical/ Aerospace, Chemical, Civil, Computer, Computer Science & Technology, Computer Science & Engineering/ Information Science & Engineering / Information Technology, Mechanical, Metallurgy, Industrial, Material Science Engineering/ Foundry Technology) from a recognized University/ Board in India. Selection Process: Candidates will be selected based on merit, medical examination. How to Apply:Eligible candidates may apply online through the web portal 115.254.50.170/tti on or before 22-08-2017. Eligibility Criteria: i. Candidate should posses degree in Engineering in the above mentioned branches \ Provisional Degree Certificate from a recognized university in India (The Candidate must be Citizen of India). ii. Candidates who have completed Three Years (3-Years) after obtaining degree certificate are not eligible. iii. Candidates who have already registered /undergone /undergoing for Apprenticeship Training under the Apprenticeship Act elsewhere are not eligible. iv. Candidates with work experience of one or more years are not eligible. Last Date to Apply Online: 22-08-2017. Selection Process: i. A common merit list will be prepared for each core branch, based on the marks scored in the qualifying examination and candidates will be selected for the apprentice training from the merit list. ii. Reservation will be applicable as per apprenticeship act. iii. Shortlisted candidates shall undergo medical examination and have to be declared medically fit by Govt. Medical officer not below the rank of an assistant Surgeon (Gazetted). iv. Medically fit candidate must obtain police clearance certificate from the commissioner / superintendent of police of their locality from the place where the candidate resides and join the training within the stipulated time.

title: BOOT CAMP AND BASE CAMP ON PYTHON 3.x.0 FOR FRESHMEN 2017 : (8/11/2017)
body: Python is becoming the most prevailing and most traded programming language in the present times. It is proven to be most scientific and most effective tool for solving problems, crafting data dredging frameworks and building simple to complex elucidations for any discipline ranging from Commerce to Technology to Management et. al. It is proposed to have two fold sessions for learning Python: Boot camp followed by Base Camp. Boot Camp: One hour per day for two weeks [12hours] for basic introduction of Python. This would be sit-and-soak on Python and will cover up the platforms and ways to begin coding in Python and would let the learners script basic programs using various IDEs and consoles for various data types with introduction to the file handling in Python Base Camp: One hour per day for three weeks [18hours] statistical data analysis is using numPy, scientific analysis using sciPy and data plotting using Pylab. This would prepare them to script full solutions through explorations. Modus Operandi: · Students need to register at the link http://tinyurl.com/lpuPYTHONsessionsfreshmen2017. First 100 aspirants would be taken in.All freshmen irrespective of discipline and program of study are eligible for this Workshop. Last date for registration will be 16th August 2017, 1700 hours. · Session would happen in evening from 1715-1815 hours without hampering regular academics. Complete details of the workshop are in the attachment. · No fee would be charged from the participants as this workshop is to initiate awareness of Python and to build a culture of scripting since the very first year. · One would have to qualify the Boot Camp to participate in Base Camp. · Delivery would be done by Dr. Lovi Raj Gupta with co-instructors Ms Parampreet Kaur and Mr. Rajeev Patial. Boot Camp Timeline: 21st August 2017 – 2nd September 2017. Base Camp Timeline: Post Mid Term.(Dates will be shared with qualified candidates of Boot Camp) In case of any query, please contact at 8146585741.

title: Write A thon : (8/11/2017)
body: On the occasion of National Sports Day on August 29, IP4kids a CSR initiative, is organizing ‘Write-a-thon’, an annual essay writing competition to give young students an opportunity to understand the role played by intellectual property rights in sports. The winners in the college category will be given an opportunity for a paid Internship at the Firm, and other exciting prizes sponsored by Boltt Sports Technologies. Themes of the Essay – Young minds are encouraged to focus on the theme of “IP in the field of Sports”, for their essays and hence may contemplate writing on topics related to Intellectual Property, Innovation, Broadcasting, Licenses and sponsorships, merchandising, etc. Some of the suggested topics are: · Importance of Innovation as a Business Tool in the World of Sport· Ambush Marketing surrounding major Sporting Events· Personality Rights in the Sporting World· Olympic Emblem as a symbol of sporting inspiration· Broadcasting & Media Rights in Sport· The issue of counterfeiting in the world of sports. The aim of this competition is to give young students an opportunity to understand the role played by intellectual property rights in sports and further details about the competition including the submission guidelines can be found on the IP4kids website over here. http://www.ip4kids.in/current-issues/write-thon-first-essay-writing-competition/ For guidance and help the students can contact Dr. Runjhun tandon in DRD 38-201 or 9888160523.

title: Windows Azure Training for MCSA or MCP certification : (8/10/2017)
body: The IT industry is getting specific with job roles every day from an IT Manager to Software Developer to Specialized technology developers and this customization is growing day by day. We are standing with opportunities like never before in which everyone can leverage their skills to compete. BOSCH is looking for Windows Azure developers who have MCSA or MCP certification in Cloud platform, we are committed and ready to offer you training and get you certified for the same. The opportunity will be extended only to a few students who have throughout 65% and are from CSE/IT/ECE 2018 pass-out batch. This would be a very specific training and will be followed by certification exam for MCP. The package of the students who will be hired as Azure Developers will be higher than that of the other job roles offered by BOSCH. The cost for the training from authorized Microsoft partner would be Rs. 15000 which includes the following: Training on cloud and Azure (Training duration- 50 hours): 1. Concepts of cloud computing. 2. Introduction to different cloud platform. 3. Configuring Azure platform. 4. Developing app for the cloud using Asp.net, with Visual studio. 5. Preparation for exams. 6. The cost for one exam of MCP. As a special gesture by the university 50% cost of the training will be borne by university and student will have to bear only 50% cost. The effective cost for the student for training including MCP test will be Approx Rs. 7500. The fees will be made due in the account of the student and will be given sufficient time pay the same. After giving one exam for the MCAS you will be awarded MCP and if you attempt the second and clear that also then you will be awarded MCAS : Cloud Platform Certification. After you have cleared one exam the companies will evaluate you for job roles specific to cloud. As cloud is the next benchmark that every company is trying to align itself with; the scope and advantage of the certification would be immense at the time of placement. Dates for the training will be 16-Aug-2017 to 24-Aug-17 and the MCP exam will be on 26-Aug-17. The last date to apply for the training is 11-Aug-2017. Training Registration Link: https://tinyurl.com/aug-azure-training

title: A language lab Workshop on Tone- Tonic Intonation for students from School of Electrical and Electronics Engineering (8/9/2017)
body: Dear Students Department of Verbal Ability under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a Workshop on Tone- Tonic Intonation, a session on how to variate tone in English language for budding professionals. The workshop will intend to help students to equip them with a clear understanding of speaking as a functional process, thereby contributing to their preparedness to face the industry and competitive world. The focus of the workshop will be to convey the message effectively. The major objective of this session would be to learn how to speak in the most effective way by variating tone and giving required stress while speaking. The students will be provided a platform to practice intonation with different aspects. The students will have to showcase their speaking skills amongst the participants, which will boost their confidence to speak correctly. About the Workshop:Round 1: Introduction What is tone?, Differentiate High and low pitch, why to variate? how to variate?Round 2: Why, where and how to put stress?Round 3: Interaction Session , Speak in an articulate manner. The purpose of conducting the workshop:To let the students improve their intonation while communicating.To hone the presentation skills of the students.To provide a learning platform for the students to understand the industry expectations. title: A career counselling session on promoting start-ups by Dr. Chandan Chowdhury (7/27/2017)
body: Dear StudentsCentre for Professional Enhancement, Lovely Professional University is going to organize a career counselling session on promoting start-ups by Dr. Chandan Chowdhury.When it comes to start-ups, a general perception is that it needs to be in a developed country where all the resources are available. In truth, that misses the point: start-ups can begin anywhere, and its often the countries with the greatest needs that present the biggest opportunities. Startups are at home in underdeveloped countries, nations in conflict, and those countries new to entrepreneurship. Each of these environments offer untapped problems which startups can take advantage of not just to make a profit, but also to make an impact.Registration link:https://tinyurl/startupworkshoplpuResource Person: Dr. Chandan Chowdhury, Industry Expert.Date: 31st July, 2017Venue: Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium Attachment

This meal plan is available for both the South Indian and Standard food. Food fee applicable – Rs 30,500/- only. Meal plan details :PLAN-B (Skip meal plan) This plan is best suited for students who generally skip meals in the mess and like to eat outside occasionally as per their taste .Students who opt for this meal plan have an option to skip four meals (i.e. two lunches and two dinners) in a week. Students availing this meal plan will be charged Rs 4000/- less than the regular plan. This meal plan is available for both the South Indian and Standard food. Food fee applicable – Rs 26,500/- only. Note: Students who have already availed the mess facility can also switch to the new “Skip meal plan”and the difference of the food fee amount will be adjusted in your fee account. Students have the option to skip meals on any one of these weekday options. OPTION-1 : MONDAY AND WEDNESDAY OPTION-2 : TUESDAY AND THURSDAY OPTION-3 : WEDNESDAY AND FRIDAY Students can avail any one of these meal plans (on first come first serve basis) at the time of availing the food facility by using the below mentioned UMS link. title: Be Our Guest event for students from School of Fashion Designing (7/25/2017)
body: Dear Students The mind can be a chaotic place. It can feel like you are chasing one thought or feeling after another like a dog chasing every car he sees. Traditional ways of outlining your thoughts and feelings are often too linear and do not encompass what is going on. More creative ways like journaling, mind-mapping, and even drawing let you release the contents of your mind without restrictions. When you do not judge yourself and let your thoughts and feelings run free, you will get more clarity on them. The process of putting them out in a creative way makes them more real and solid. Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize an event Be Our Guest. The event will be focused on making students confident and industry ready. It will be held in 2 parts: About the event:Round 1: Group Discussion.Round 2: Extempore. title: MCM &PMS Scholarship for Minorities students, Scholarship for Students with Disability etc. scholarship schemes started on National Scholarship Portal for session 2017-18 -reg. (LPU/DOE/IC/170605/001) : (7/10/2017)
body: Fresh Students: Registration process for Post Matric Scholarship (PMS- Minorities), Merit Cum Mean (MCM – Minorities), Scholarship for Students with Disability etc. scholarship schemes has been started with effect from 03-06-2017 on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2017- 18 . The link for applying for the scholarship is as under: Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Documents required for uploading on NSP scholarship portal are mentioned below:- 1. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Diploma DMC, Graduation DMC etc.) 2. Fee Receipts (Duly stamped from accounts department). 3. Bonafide Certificate (In case of Umbrella scholarship scheme) 4. Minority Community Declaration (Format enclosed for printout). 5. The latest Income Certificate (Issued by the designated State/UT authority not older than 6 months from the issue date). 6. Aadhaar Card of student (linked with bank account). 7. Bank Passbook Copy (linked with Aadhar Card). 8. Domicile / Residence Certificate 9. Recent Passport Size Photo (1) All the eligible students have to submit the above mentioned documents in SSIV Cell, Block No. 32 Room No. 102,Window No. 1 before the last date as mentioned on the scholarship portal. Renewal Students: Students whose scholarship cases are sanctioned for the session 2016-17 and who have received the scholarship amount in his/her bank account have to register again for scholarship for the session 2017-18 as renewal case. Also the students have to submit the copy of scholarship received proof i.e.bank account statement While entering the university detail student have to select State – PUNJAB, District – KAPURTHALA, University name – Lovely Professional University (AISHE CODE- U-0379). If the students selects the wrong university name other then mentioned above then his/her case will not be forwarded online by the university and students will be responsible themselves for the rejection of the scholarship case. Students must provide valid contact details and email IDs for communication. In case of wrong information provided by the students, then we will not be able to communicate with students and the student will be responsible for the rejection of online scholarship application. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell in Block No.32, Room No.102 between 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM (on working days). Note: The Studentscan check the complete eligibility for the scholarship scheme andother instructions in the attached file.
