title: MCM &PMS Scholarship for Minorities students, Scholarship for Students with Disability etc. scholarship schemes started on National Scholarship Portal for session 2017-18 -reg. (Ref. No. LPU/DOE/IC/170605/001) : (6/29/2017)
body: Fresh Students: Registration process for Post Matric Scholarship (PMS- Minorities), Merit Cum Mean (MCM – Minorities), Scholarship for Students with Disability etc. scholarship schemes has been started with effect from 03-06-2017 on National Scholarship Portal for the session 2017- 18 . The link for applying for the scholarship is as under: Link: http://www.scholarships.gov.in Documents required for uploading on NSP scholarship portal are mentioned below:- 1. Academic details 10th onwards (e.g. 10th DMC, 12th DMC, Diploma DMC, Graduation DMC etc.) 2. Fee Receipts (Duly stamped from accounts department). 3. Bonafide Certificate (In case of Umbrella scholarship scheme) 4. Minority Community Declaration (Format enclosed for printout). 5. The latest Income Certificate (Issued by the designated State/UT authority not older than 6 months from the issue date). 6. Aadhaar Card of student (linked with bank account). 7. Bank Passbook Copy (linked with Aadhar Card). 8. Domicile / Residence Certificate 9. Recent Passport Size Photo (1) All the eligible students have to submit the above mentioned documents in SSIV Cell, Block No. 32 Room No. 102,Window No. 1 before the last date as mentioned on the scholarship portal. Renewal Students: Students whose scholarship cases are sanctioned for the session 2016-17 and who have received the scholarship amount in his/her bank account have to register again for scholarship for the session 2017-18 as renewal case. Also the students have to submit the copy of scholarship received proof i.e.bank account statement While entering the university detail student have to select State – PUNJAB, District – KAPURTHALA, University name – Lovely Professional University (AISHE CODE- U-0379). If the students selects the wrong university name other then mentioned above then his/her case will not be forwarded online by the university and students will be responsible themselves for the rejection of the scholarship case. Students must provide valid contact details and email IDs for communication. In case of wrong information provided by the students, then we will not be able to communicate with students and the student will be responsible for the rejection of online scholarship application. In case of any query, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Assistant Registrar, SSIV Cell in Block No.32, Room No.102 between 10.00 AM to 4.00 PM (on working days). Note: The Students can check the complete eligibility for the scholarship scheme and other instructions in the attached file.

body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to share an opportunity to be a Change Maker to a society through Jagriti Yatra. Jagriti Yatra is a 15-day long, national train journey that will take you 8000 kilometers across the length and breadth of India, to understand and build the India of smaller towns and villages through enterprise. The vision of Jagriti is 'building India through enterprise'. It aims to inspire the young Indians living in the middle of the Indian demographic diamond to lead development by taking to enterprise, thus unleashing a movement of Enterprise-led-development. title: Updated notice - Microsoft Azure Training at LPU campus commencing from 23rd June 2017 now : (6/8/2017)
body: Dear Aspirants The IT industry is getting specific with job roles every day from an IT Manager to Software Developer to Specialized technology developers and this customization is growing day by day. Now on the same lines, we would like to extend to you all a similar opportunity in which companies are ready to hire people with specific skill sets at the dream packages. One of such opportunity has come up early for you all. A reputed IT company is looking for Windows Azure developers who have Microsoft Certified Application Specialist (MCAS) you will be awarded Microsoft Certified Professional(MCP) certification in Cloud platform, we are committed and ready to offer you training and get you certified for the same at a subsidized cost. The opportunity will be extended to a few students only and this would be a very specific training and will be followed by certification exam for MCP. The cost for the training from authorized Microsoft partner would be Rs. 15000 ( The cost of this training including certificate is 25000-30000 in the market) which includes the following: Training on cloud and Azure (Intermediate to Advanced) 1. Concepts of cloud computing. 2. Introduction to a different cloud platform. 3. Configuring Azure platform. 4. Developing applications for the cloud using Asp.net, with Visual Studio. 5. Project work. 6. Preparation for exams. Training Duration- 50 hours ( 9 days ) The cost for one exam of MCP will be Rs. 2795 including taxes which is included in the above-mentioned cost. After taking one exam for the Microsoft Certified Application Specialist (MCAS) you will be awarded Microsoft Certified Professional(MCP) and if you attempt the second and clear that also then you will be awarded Microsoft Certified Application Specialist: Cloud Platform Certification. After you have cleared one exam the companies will evaluate you for job roles specific to cloud. As the cloud is the next benchmark that every company is trying to align itself with the scope and advantage of the certification would be immense at the time of placement. Interested students must write to professional_enhancement@lpu.co.in by writing "Azure Registration" in the subject along with their registration number. The student will be automatically registered and the fees would be made "due" in their accounts. Students can pay Rs15000/- by Aug'2017. Classes would commence from 23rd June '2017. Registrations only on First come First serve basis. To read more about the certification, click on the following link: https://www.microsoft.com/en-in/learning/mcsd-azure-architect-certification.aspx

body: Students who seek residential facilities for Re-appear exams/Summer Term/Training/ skill development classes/freshmen induction volunteer/sports and cultural activities / Admission Counsellor (Part time jobs) etc. may avail the same as per the guidelines circulated in this notice. The whole process of allotment will be carried through University Management System and student has to use his/her login Id and password to book their seats. Interface starts on - 29th May’17 (Start at 2:00 PM onwards) Interface Closed on 24th July’17 (End at 11:59 PM) The allotment of hostel for these activities will be available from 1st June 2017 onwards however the booking will start from 29th May’17. For booking hostels interface has been activated in UMS at link: UMS Navigation → Residential booking → Summer Hostel Booking In this booking process, the student has to select the date of stay, check the availability of seats and book the seat. Student can select single day or multiple days. Mode of Payment: Payment of stay and electricity charges shall be done through the below mentioned modes:- 1. Scratch cards ( Available at block 33 basement Anil Kumar tuckshop, BH-2 Chopra Mobile, GH-5 Departmental Store) 2. Scholar Card ( Block 32, basement accounts section, window no. 3, 4 & 5). Other Important Instructions:- • Student will have to pay electricity charges in advance during booking as per the Annexure- I. Damage charges will be charged at the time of No dues to be processed at the time of vacating the hostel. • Group booking facility will not be available. • These charges are exclusive of food facility. Food charges will have to be paid to the Mess Contractor directly. • The students can stay in hostel during summer vacation till 24th July, 2017 only. On 25th July 2017, they will have to move to their respective allocated hostel blocks for forthcoming session 2017-18. If any day scholar has booked the hostel facility for summer duration he/she will also have to vacate the hostel on 25th July 2017. • If the student did not occupy their hostel seat or cancel a seat after partial stay, no refund of the paid amount shall be done. • Students who are recruited as a student counselor in Division of Admission will stay with the currently allocated hostel till two days after the last date of examination. After this duration they will be charged on day to day basis (As per subsidized rates) according to their allocated seater including electricity. They will get the no dues clearance on 31st May 2017. Simultaneously they have to book their hostel seat again through summer vacation hostel booking interface and also shift to their new allotted hostels after 31st May 2017. • Up-gradation or degradation of booked seater is not allowed hence students must select the seater preference very carefully.

title: Women Transforming India, 2017 Breaking the Glass Ceiling, an online contest initiated by NITI Aayog, Government of India. : (5/17/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to share with you all the initiative taken by NITI Aayog, Government of India. We all are aware of the fact that the theme for International Women’s Day, 8th March 2017, focuses on “Women in the Changing World of Work: Planet 50-50 by 2030”. This advances the Government of India’s commitment to ensure Gender Parity in India, with special focus on women’s economic empowerment. Achieving gender equality and empowerment of all women and girls, rests upon unlocking the full potential of women in the world of work. In 2016, NITI Aayog, in partnership with the United Nations India and MyGov, launched the first-ever Women Transforming India, an online contest to recognize powerful women of India’s workforce, who are influencing positive change in their communities and furthering the Government of India’s mission of inclusive economic growth. This year, NITI Aayog would award inspiring women from across India through entries in two categories: 1. Short video and photo contest on Women Breaking Gender Stereotypes: This can be a homemade video shot on the mobile phone. Both photos and videos are to be accompanied with a short caption (not over 50 words) encapsulating the story of the woman. 2. Written entries of women in the workforce, across sectors, irrespective of their educational qualifications. Stories of women working in non-traditional occupations and women who are working to empower other women, their neighbourhoods/society in anyway will be encouraged. (Stories should not exceed 500 words.) To register, click on the following link: http://tinyurl.com/mlm4vha The opportunity lies in the fact that the last date for submission of entries has been extended till 1st June, 2017. For further instructions, thoroughly read the Attachment, Instructions For terms and conditions, please go through the Attachments, MyGov Women Transforming India TnC

title: Summer Industrial Training by Society of Hydraulic & Automation (SOHA) on Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manfacturing : (5/8/2017)
body: Dear Student, School of Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Society of Hydraulic & Automation (SOHA) is conducting Summer Industrial Training on Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing for the students of School of Mechanical Engineering & School of Polytechnic (Mechanical). Organization Profile: SOHA (Society of Hydraulic and Automation Technologies) is a group of industry in which there’s more than 25 companies related to Hydraulic Technologies, Pneumatic Technologies, Automobiles, Automation Technologies are associated and working for increasing the job employability and working for make in India by providing the Industrial Skill. Target Audience: Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing students of Mechanical Engineering 2nd & 3rd Year & Polytechnic Mechanical 2nd Year. Module Overview: Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing is a complete practical oriented program. Where, students will go through the basics of Automobile, Chassis design, Suspension unit, Breaking Unit, Transmission System, Differentials, IC Engine & session on designing the machine parts, parts of Engine & Car along with the aerodynamics of Vehicle. Students will manufacture a vehicle with in the campus itself from the scratch. Proposed Training Date: Batch – I: 24th May to 12th June 2017 ( B.Tech & Diploma 2nd Year Student) Batch - II: 13th June to 2nd July 2017 ( B.Tech 3rd Year Students) Duration: Duration of the Industrial Training is 20 Day/160 hrs. Venue: All these programs will be conducted at LPU Pedagogy: The program involves 80% practical and 20% theory Training Fees for the Module: Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing is Rs. 6000/- Registration Process: Interested students can register themselves in the below mentioned link on or before 15th May 2017 http://tinyurl.com/IndustrialTraining-SOHA Important Note: - Nominal Charges for the Hostel Accommodation if students enroll for the Training module - Training will be considered equivalent to Summer Internship Training as per Academic Curriculum - The fees for the registered students for the training will be directly debited to their respective LPU account. title: Summer Industrial Training by Society of Hydraulic & Automation (SOHA) : (4/24/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Society of Hydraulic & Automation (SOHA) is conducting Summer Industrial Training on Hydraulic Machine Manufacturing, Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing & Structure Design for the students of School of Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering & School of Polytechnic. Organization Profile: SOHA (Society of Hydraulic and Automation Technologies) is a group of industry in which there’s more than 25 companies related to Hydraulic Technologies, Pneumatic Technologies, Automobiles, Automation Technologies are associated and working for increasing the job employability and working for make in India by providing the Industrial Skill. Target Audience: · For Hydraulic Machine Manufacturing students of Mechanical Engineering 2nd & 3rd Year. · For Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing students of Mechanical Engineering 2nd & 3rd Year & Polytechnic Mechanical 2nd Year · For Structure Design students of Civil Engineering 3rd year & Polytechnic 2nd Year. Module Overview: 1) Industrial Hydraulic Manufacturing: Industrial Hydraulic system & Machine manufacturing is a complete job oriented Program. In India there are more than One Thousand companies that want complete trained engineer on the hydraulic Technology. But this kind of system training is not available at college level and the cost of this kind of training is very costly (More than 1 Lakh). In this Summer Industrial Internship Program students will learn the complete Industrial Work of Hydraulic Technology & their development process under the guidance of industrial experts. 2) Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing: Is a complete practical oriented program. Were, students will go through the basics of Automobile, Chassis design, Suspension unit, Breaking Unit, Transmission System, Differentials, IC Engine & session on designing the machine parts, parts of Engine & Car along with the aerodynamics of Vehicle. Students will manufacture a vehicle with in the campus itself from the scratch. 3) Structure Design: Structural engineering is mainly a sub-division of civil engineering in which structural engineers are trained to understand, predict, and calculate the stability, strength and rigidity of built structures for buildings and non-building structures, to develop designs and integrate their design with that of other designers, and to supervise construction of projects on site. Proposed Training Date: Batch – I: 24th May to 12th June 2017 ( B.Tech & Diploma 2nd Year Student) Batch - II: 13th June to 2nd July 2017 ( B.Tech 3rd Year Students) Batch – III: 15th July to 3rd August 2017 (B.Tech 3rd Year Students with Backlog) Duration: Duration of the Industrial Training is 20 Day/160 hrs. Venue: All these programs will be conducted at LPU Pedagogy: The program involves 80% practical and 20% theory Training Fees for the Module: · Industrial Hydraulic Manufacturing: Rs. 7000/- · Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing: Rs. 6000/- · Structure Design: Rs.5500/- Registration Process: Interested students can register themselves in the below mentioned link on or before 29th April 2017 http://tinyurl.com/IndustrialTraining-SOHA Important Note: - Nominal Charges for the Hostel Accommodation if students enroll for the Training module - Training will be considered equivalent to Summer Internship Training as per Academic Curriculum - The fees for the registered students for the training will be directly debited to their respective LPU account. Please find attached herewith, the details of module offered for your reference. In case of any queries feel free to reach: Mr. Sukhvinder Singh: - 99150-20407 Mr. Jitendra:- 79798-42569

title: Summer Industrial Training by Society of Hydraulic & Automation (SOHA) : (4/19/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Society of Hydraulic & Automation (SOHA) is conducting Summer Industrial Training on Hydraulic Machine Manufacturing, Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing & Structure Design for the students of School of Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering & School of Polytechnic. Organization Profile: SOHA (Society of Hydraulic and Automation Technologies) is a group of industry in which there’s more than 25 companies related to Hydraulic Technologies, Pneumatic Technologies, Automobiles, Automation Technologies are associated and working for increasing the job employability and working for make in India by providing the Industrial Skill. Target Audience: · For Hydraulic Machine Manufacturing students of Mechanical Engineering 2nd & 3rd Year. · For Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing students of Mechanical Engineering 2nd & 3rd Year & Polytechnic Mechanical 2nd Year · For Structure Design students of Civil Engineering 3rd year & Polytechnic 2nd Year. Module Overview: 1) Industrial Hydraulic Manufacturing: Industrial Hydraulic system & Machine manufacturing is a complete job oriented Program. In India there are more than One Thousand companies that want complete trained engineer on the hydraulic Technology. But this kind of system training is not available at college level and the cost of this kind of training is very costly (More than 1 Lakh). In this Summer Industrial Internship Program students will learn the complete Industrial Work of Hydraulic Technology & their development process under the guidance of industrial experts. 2) Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing: Is a complete practical oriented program. Were, students will go through the basics of Automobile, Chassis design, Suspension unit, Breaking Unit, Transmission System, Differentials, IC Engine & session on designing the machine parts, parts of Engine & Car along with the aerodynamics of Vehicle. Students will manufacture a vehicle with in the campus itself from the scratch. 3) Structure Design: Structural engineering is mainly a sub-division of civil engineering in which structural engineers are trained to understand, predict, and calculate the stability, strength and rigidity of built structures for buildings and non-building structures, to develop designs and integrate their design with that of other designers, and to supervise construction of projects on site. Proposed Training Date: Batch – I: 24th May to 12th June 2017 ( B.Tech & Diploma 2nd Year Student) Batch - II: 13th June to 2nd July 2017 ( B.Tech 3rd Year Students) Batch – III: 15th July to 3rd August 2017 (B.Tech 3rd Year Students with Backlog) Duration: Duration of the Industrial Training is 20 Day/160 hrs. Venue: All these programs will be conducted at LPU Pedagogy: The program involves 80% practical and 20% theory Training Fees for the Module: · Industrial Hydraulic Manufacturing: Rs. 7000/- · Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing: Rs. 6000/- · Structure Design: Rs.5500/- Registration Process: Interested students can register themselves in the below mentioned link on or before 22nd April 2017 http://tinyurl.com/IndustrialTraining-SOHA Important Note: - Nominal Charges for the Hostel Accommodation if students enroll for the Training module - Training willbe considered equivalent to Summer Internship Training as per Academic Curriculum - The fees for the registered students for the training will be directly debited to their respective LPU account. Please find attached herewith, the details of module offered for your reference. In case of any queries feel free to reach: Mr. Sukhvinder Singh: - 99150-20407 Mr. Jitendra:- 79798-42569

WHAT IS INK? INK is India’s foremost platform for the exchange of cutting-edge ideas and inspiring stories. Known for the annual INK Conference, INK Asia, INK Salons, and programs such as INK Fellows, we are a community that accelerates the journeys of game changers. WHAT IS THE INK MAKERS PROGRAM? - INK Makers is a celebration of invention and innovation in every possible aspect of daily life. - With the INK Makers Program we aim to introduce the maker culture to undergraduate students and mentor them to turn their ideas into tangible products and concepts. - This is to create a cultural shift in the minds of the students and the educators. This culture will inculcate self-sufficiency, entrepreneurship and foster innovation and disruptive thinking among students. - We are inspired by the current wave of the "Make in India" movement, and aim to identify and nurture these "Makers" across India. title: Summer Industrial Training by Society of Hydraulic & Automation (SOHA) at LPU : (4/15/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Society of Hydraulic & Automation (SOHA) is conducting Summer Industrial Training on Hydraulic Machine Manufacturing, Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing & Structure Design for the students of School of Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering & School of Polytechnic. Organization Profile: SOHA (Society of Hydraulic and Automation Technologies) is a group of industry in which there’s more than 25 companies related to Hydraulic Technologies, Pneumatic Technologies, Automobiles, Automation Technologies are associated and working for increasing the job employability and working for make in India by providing the Industrial Skill. Target Audience: · For Hydraulic Machine Manufacturing students of Mechanical Engineering 2nd & 3rd Year. · For Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing students of Mechanical Engineering 2nd & 3rd Year & Polytechnic Mechanical 2nd Year · For Structure Design students of Civil Engineering 3rd year & Polytechnic 2nd Year. Module Overview: 1) Industrial Hydraulic Manufacturing: Industrial Hydraulic system & Machine manufacturing is a complete job oriented Program. In India there are more than One Thousand companies that want complete trained engineer on the hydraulic Technology. But this kind of system training is not available at college level and the cost of this kind of training is very costly (More than 1 Lakh). In this Summer Industrial Internship Program students will learn the complete Industrial Work of Hydraulic Technology & their development process under the guidance of industrial experts. 2) Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing: Is a complete practical oriented program. Were, students will go through the basics of Automobile, Chassis design, Suspension unit, Breaking Unit, Transmission System, Differentials, IC Engine & session on designing the machine parts, parts of Engine & Car along with the aerodynamics of Vehicle. Students will manufacture a vehicle with in the campus itself from the scratch. 3) Structure Design: Structural engineering is mainly a sub-division of civil engineering in which structural engineers are trained to understand, predict, and calculate the stability, strength and rigidity of built structures for buildings and non-building structures, to develop designs and integrate their design with that of other designers, and to supervise construction of projects on site. Proposed Training Date: Batch – I: 24th May to 12th June 2017 ( B.Tech & Diploma 2nd Year Student) Batch - II: 13th June to 2nd July 2017 ( B.Tech 3rd Year Students) Batch – III: 5th July to 24th July 2017 (B.Tech 3rd Year Students with Backlog) Duration: Duration of the Industrial Training is 20 Day/160 hrs. Venue: All these programs will be conducted at LPU Pedagogy: The program involves 80% practical and 20% theory Training Fees for the Module: · Industrial Hydraulic Manufacturing: Rs. 7000/- · Vehicle Dynamic, Designing & Manufacturing: Rs. 6000/- · Structure Design: Rs.5500/- Registration Process: Interested students can register themselves in the below mentioned link on or before 22nd April 2017 http://tinyurl.com/IndustrialTraining-SOHA Important Note: - Nominal Charges for the Hostel Accommodation if students enroll for the Training module - Training willbe considered equivalent to Summer Internship Training as per Academic Curriculum - The fees for the registered students for the training will be directly debited to their respective LPU account. Please find attached herewith, the details of module offered for your reference. In case of any queries feel free to reach: Mr. Sukhvinder Singh: - 99150-20407 Mr. Jitendra:- 79798-42569

title: Internship Scheme : (4/14/2017)
body: The Internship scheme has been introduced by the University to offer Internships to the students in various School and Divisions of the University, at par with the internships being offered by any corporate. The purpose of internship is to acquaint the students with the practices followed in the industry and at the same time give them an opportunity to do research on some relevant topics in their area of specialization. 1. To undertake a meaningful project. 2. To work hard and show initiative to win confidence of the supervisor. 3. Work hard and professionally to get PPO (Pre-Placement Offer). 4. Aim at maximizing learning. 5. Building relations with peers to thoroughly understand the strengths and weaknesses of system’s policies and procedures. 6. Understand systems, procedures and policies of the organization. 7. Identify problems areas and see, if, you can make suggestions. 8. Try to relate the practice to theory and find out reasons for difference between theory and practice. The Internships shall be open to the students of LPU as well as to the students of other Institutions/Universities. Types of Internships: · Internships which are part of course requirements. · Internships which are not part of the course requirements, but the students can opt for these Internships for knowledge/skill up gradations. Category: Internships can be offered in the following forms: · Internship which involves the students to be part of a Division of the University and get practical exposure to the learning they acquire in their curriculum. This internship may be offered free of cost or payment of fee by the intern. · Internships which involve some specific short term programmes being offered by the Schools/Divisions. Such internship shall be offered on fee basis. Details of the Internship Scheme and the internship available in the university shall be announced shortly.

body: This is for the information of all continuing students that they can apply for Change of Programme as per the attached Guidelines and Timelines. All the students who have submitted their wish to change the higher degree under “Taking Option for Continuation and Discontinuation of higher degree” have to submit the signed applications as per timelines. The students should read the guidelines thoroughly before applying. The Application Form can be downloaded from attachment of Formats and must be submitted (i.e. Annexure-1 and Annexure-2 complete in all respects) at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32, 102(window no.2) as per attached timelines. No applications will be entertained after that. A student may download the form and undertaking and fill it up in his/her own handwriting in CAPITAL LETTERS, get it signed from the parents, scan it and e-mail it to academic.aac@lpu.co.in. The email should be with subject “Change of Programme for Continuing Students-Registration No-” In the ‘Without Compounding Fee’ phase, immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rs.1,000/- will be debited to the account of the student as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee. The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32 ,102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rs.1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee to the Department of Accounts. In the ‘With Compounding Fee’ phase, immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rs. 3,000/- (upto 18th July, 2017) and Rs. 4000/-(upto 1st August, 2017) will be debited to the account of the student as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee. The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32,102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rs. 3,000/- (upto 18th July, 2017) and Rs.4000/-(upto 1st August, 2017) as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee to the Department of Accounts. All students whose Change of Programme who application is approved must pay the ‘Change of Programme Fee’ as per timelines. Failing to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for their Change of Programme will stand cancelled and they shall continue in their current programme. The ‘Change of Programme’ Fee must be paid in person and no facility of online payment will be available. Students must plan their travel arrangements well in advance for this. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old programme after approval of Change of Programme request or after paying the ‘Change of Programme Fee’.Students must read the enclosed ‘Guidelines for Change of Programme’ carefully before they apply for change of programme. In case of any query, kindly report to DAA Window (Block 32-102).

body: “To any entrepreneur: if you want to do it, do it now. If you don’t, you’re going to regret it.” Entrepreneurship is the millennial thing to do. title: ‘BOL BACHCHAN' – Make a Story to attain Glory : (4/6/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Nayi Disha Club of Mittal School of Business are going organize an event ‘BOL BACHCHAN' – Make a Story to attain Glory , which aims at enhancing the communication skills, confidence and creative skills because in the corporate world creativity matters and confidence makes one different from others. Target Audience: The target audience for the competition will be students from all schools of LPU. About the event: Students have to register in a team of two members in the below mentioned link on or before 10th April 2017. The event will consist of two rounds: Round - 1: - Every team has to create a story by clicking photographs in LPU (within the Campus) or outside the campus. Pictures should be original and should not have been downloaded from internet. Students have to submit these pictures in the form of PPT . The pictures may be in form of Collage or Single photograph on each slide. They can choose any theme to create their story & each story should have some message. The teams have to mail their PPTS on or before 12th April ’17 by 1700 hours at msobatom@gmail.com. Round - 2: - Selected teams will be given an opportunity to present their story verbally with photographs projected on the screen.. The story should be equally divided amongst the team members. Each team will be given 3-5 minutes to present their story. No story should exceed 5 minutes time. Time limits will be strictly enforced. Good speakers will be identified during this event and they will get a chance to be auditioned for the next video of Gyan Express - Youtube Channel. Venue, Date & Time: Block - 14- 101L, 15th April ’17 from 9:30 AM In Case of any queries free feel to reach: Ms.Sameena: +917027037860 (President – Nayi Disha) Mr.Chirag: +918968842187 (Vice President – Nayi Disha)

title: Opportunity to participate in India's biggest ‘Make-a-thon’ and Interaction Session with HOF - LFTS : (3/30/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Division of Career Services is pleased to share with you an opportunity to participate in India’s biggest ‘Make-a-thon’ by INK MAKERS. A Special Session will be conducted for students registered in the event with Dr. Lovi Raj Gupta, HOF-LFTS in order to guide & motivate the students to excel in India's biggest 'Make-a-thon'. WHAT IS INK? INK is India’s foremost platform for the exchange of cutting-edge ideas and inspiring stories. Known for the annual INK Conference, INK Asia, INK Salons, and programs such as INK Fellows, we are a community that accelerates the journeys of game changers. WHAT IS THE INK MAKERS PROGRAM? ? INK Makers is a celebration of invention and innovation in every possible aspect of daily life. ? With the INK Makers Program we aim to introduce the maker culture to undergraduate students and mentor them to turn their ideas into tangible products and concepts. ? This is to create a cultural shift in the minds of the students and the educators. This culture will inculcate self-sufficiency, entrepreneurship and foster innovation and disruptive thinking among students. ? We are inspired by the current wave of the "Make in India" movement, and aim to identify and nurture these "Makers" across India. This is an excellent platform for students to build innovative projects during ‘Make-a-thons’. And students will get industry support, Mentorship and monetary support for bringing a project to life. Interested students can register themselves in the below mentioned link on or before 3rd April 2017 http://tinyurl.com/ls4kzso For any clarification feel free to reach : Mr. Nitin Vij ( 7508183830).

title: Event: ENVISAGE- Treading to Staging : (3/24/2017)
body: Escaping from stage fear and low confidence requires a simple march to the stage of vision and exhibition of the basic realm of life to spectators. Department of Verbal Ability-I, School of Professional Enhancement is providing a platform to the students with an objective to enhance intellect, creativity, innovation, communication, peer learning. Envisage: From Treading to Staging: Curtains will be raised on 1st April at 10:00AM, Venue- SBRM Auditorium, all are invited to attend. Plays from different eras written by renowned playwrights will be staged · Passion Poison Petrifaction Passion, Poison, and Petrifaction is a short play by George Bernard Shaw. It is a comic mock-melodrama, written to raise funds for charity. It has been revived occasionally, in tandem with other short works by Shaw and by other playwrights. Election Troll The script is written by students. This is a comic play in which political scenario of a country is ridiculed through an illiterate politician. · A Mars Away The script of the play is written by students. The story revolves around a group of aliens wherein their leader persuades them to go back to Mars. · Super Dead Man It is a comic-play penned-down by D. M. Larson. The setting of the plot is pastoral atmosphere of eighteenth century. It contains seven varies characters. · Brad Pitt is stalking Me The play is an adaptation of the play Angelina Jolie is Stalking Me by Stephanie Alison Walker. The entire comedy takes place at a bus stop on a bench. Mysterious Death Lianne Gill has composed this play. This play is a nice period piece for two older and two younger women with a small male part. It was staged as part of the Franklin Players Festival in 2011. · Game of Life It is a one act comedy written by Christopher M. Connors. The entire act takes place at a bus stop on a bench. This play discusses the fundamental concepts of life, job and marriage through its main character Milton. · Amorica The play Amorica is penned-down by Nick Zagone which comes in the genre of Brechtian anti-capitalist play which was at its height during Nazi rule in Germany. · The Waiting Room It is a wonderful, weird and wild play written by D. M. Larson based upon a conversation among three youngsters. It describes the school days and deals with the youngsters who are seeking to be freed from the waiting room of the railway station. The Dictionary Salesman The script presents a comic approach to a realist atmosphere revolving around poverty, illiteracy and materialism. · Sara Wants the Moon Composed by A. Giovanni Affinito, describes the situation of a girl who seeks a specific thing in her life. In the end, she obtains it as well. Mr. Affinito is a member of the Dramatists Guild of America and resides on the Connecticut coast in West Haven. All Sarah wants is to shine in her current role as an abandoned wife found grieving in the moonlight in a forest glade. · What Goes Around, Comes Around This play is based on the true event where King Jay Singh, the king of Alwar was insulted in London, UK by the owner of Rolls Royce. In order to take revenge, he made the Rolls Royce a garbage carrier, due to which in India Rolls Royce selling was affected. The entire story revolves around the King.

title: Contributing towards Earth Hour on 25th March, 2017 : (3/23/2017)
body: Dear Students, As we all are aware of the fact that Earth Hour falls on 25th March every year. It is a worldwide movement for the planet organized by the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF). Since its start in 2007, this event is held worldwide annually encouraging individuals, communities, households and businesses to turn off their non-essential lights for one hour, from 8:30 to 9:30 p.m on 25th March 2017 (Saturday) as a symbol for their commitment to the planet. Today, Earth Hour engages a massive mainstream community on a broad range of environmental issues. This one hour event continues to remain the key drier of the now larger movements. School of Professional Enhancement (SPE) intend to do a small contribution towards the same and is requesting all its staff and students to actively participate in the same. This will mark a small contribution towards environment and saving energy. Hence, we are inviting photographs from students across the university which serves as an evidence of their contribution through the pictures captured by them. The best photograph will be awarded. Ideas could range from switching off the lights for one hour to hosting a candle-lit dinner. Interested students can email their entries at spe2@lpu.co.in, stating your Name, Registration No., Programme, Contact No., and Name of your School.

title: European Film Festival : (3/15/2017)
body: Department of Foreign Languages is pleased to announce the screening of three popular movies in three European Languages through European Film Festival on 25th of March, 2017 in Baldev Raj Mittal Auditorium. Registration is mandatory. Movies French: Les Choristes (09.15 AM – 11.30 AM) The 2004 French drama film is set in 1948, where a professor of music, Clement Mathieu, becomes the supervisor at a boarding school for the rehabilitation for minors. What he discovers disconcerts him -- the current situation is repressive. Through the power of song, Clement tries to transform the students. German: Goodbye Lenin! (12.30 PM – 02.30 PM) Good Bye Lenin hailed as the Best European Film at the 2003 Berlin Film Festival, Goodbye Lenin is set in East Germany around the time of the collapse of the Berlin Wall. The film provides a fleeting glimpse into one of the major events in modern European history, touching many important political and social issues. East Germany, the year 1989: A young man protests against the regime. His mother watches the police arresting him and suffers a heart attack and falls into a coma. Some months later, the GDR "German Democratic Republic" does not exist anymore and the mother awakes. Since she has to avoid every excitement, the son tries to set up the GDR again for her in their flat. Spanish: Volver (03:00 PM- 05:00 PM) Volver meaning “to come back” is a 2006 Spanish film written and directed by Pedro Almodóvar. Headed by actress Penélope Cruz, the film revolves around the story of a working-class woman Raimunda forced to go to great lengths to protect her 14-year-old daughter Paula and her mother Irene who comes back from the dead to tie up the loose ends with her. Everyone is cordially invited for this programme. Registration of students is mandatory: For registration please fill in the registration form on: https://tinyurl.com/zj25vdn Last date of registration is 23rd March by evening 05:00 PM

title: Dept. of Foreign Language presents European Film Festival : (3/10/2017)
body: Films are stories which narrate experiences of mankind and a film festival aims to celebrate our stories. On this note, the Department of Foreign Languages is glad to announce the screening of three popular movies in three European Languages on 25th of March, 2017 in Baldevraj Mittal Auditorium. Movies: 1. French: Les Choristes (09.15 AM – 11.30 AM): The 2004 French drama film is set in 1948, where a professor of music, Clement Mathieu, becomes the supervisor at a boarding school for the rehabilitation for minors. What he discovers disconcerts him -- the current situation is repressive. Through the power of song, Clement tries to transform the students. 2. German: Goodbye Lenin! (12.30 PM – 02.30 PM): Good Bye Lenin hailed as the Best European Film at the 2003 Berlin Film Festival, Goodbye Lenin is set in East Germany around the time of the collapse of the Berlin Wall. The film provides a fleeting glimpse into one of the major events in modern European history, touching many important political and social issues. East Germany, the year 1989: A young man protests against the regime. His mother watches the police arresting him and suffers a heart attack and falls into a coma. Some months later, the GDR "German Democratic Republic" does not exist anymore and the mother awakes. Since she has to avoid every excitement, the son tries to set up the GDR again for her in their flat. 3. Spanish: Volver (03:00 PM- 05:00 PM): Volver meaning “to come back” is a 2006 Spanish film written and directed by Pedro Almodóvar. Headed by actress Penélope Cruz, the film revolves around the story of a working-class woman Raimunda forced to go to great lengths to protect her 14-year-old daughter Paula and her mother Irene who comes back from the dead to tie up the loose ends with her. Everyone is cordially invited for this programme. Registration of students is mandatory. For registration please fill in the registration form on: https://tinyurl.com/zj25vdn Last date of registration is 23rd March by evening 05:00 PM

title: TATA Crucibles - The Campus Quiz 2017 : (3/9/2017)
body: Lovely Professional University Presents The famous TATA Crucible - The Campus Quiz 2017 'Tata Crucible - The Business Quiz' seeks to bring together sharpest young corporate minds in India to take on the heat of the toughest business quiz in India. Youth is a key audience cluster which the Tata Group is focusing its communication at and Tata Crucible is one of the key initiatives towards this engagement. The Event details are as follows : Date : 16-March-2016 Venue : Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium Event Schedule : Prelim : 01.30 PM to 02.30 PM Final : 04.00 PM to 05.00 PM Registration Verification Desk : 11:00 AM Onwards (Mandatory for both Online & offline candidates) It’s a great opportunity for LPU students to participate in this National Level Quiz Show. Seats are limited & will be on First Come First Serve, so kindly register yourselves to the following link. www.tatacrucible.com Note : 1. On the spot registration will be entertained from 11:00 AM to 12:30 PM on 16th - March,2017. 2. The student will be allowed to enter into the Auditorium only after the verification process at Registration Verification Desk. 3. Also register on following link http://tinyurl.com/tatacrucible2017LPU to get duty leaves. 4. Entry to the Auditorium starts from sharp 12:00 PM to 01:00 PM through Turnstile gates. 5. Duty Leaves will be given to the students only from 12:00 AM to 05:00 PM. Important Instructions regarding attendance: 1. Attendance of the registered students in an event will be through online mode i.e. through turnstile gates only. 2. Entry & Exit, to & from the Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium respectively will be through only Turnstile Gates only. 3. Duty Leaves will be given to only those students who have marked/punched their ID card on Turnstile Gates during Entry & Exit from the auditorium. 4. When a student punch his/her Id card on turnstile gate, A) A green light signal means that the Id-Card is authorized/activated. B) A red light signal means the card is unauthorized/not activated. 5. If in-case, the Student Id Card is not working/activated/authorized during punching his/her attendance through turnstile gates, they are requested to mark their attendance OFFLINE, by signing on the attendance sheet at Student’s Help Desk. 6. Eg: If duty leaves timings are 12:00 PM to 05:00 PM, then a student must punch his ID card not late then 12:45 PM and must exit from the auditorium only after 05:00 PM. 7. Student will be sole responsible for his duty leave, if/she has not marked his Id card on turnstile gate.

body: Lovely Professional University Presents The famous TATA Crucible - The Campus Quiz 2017 'Tata Crucible - The Business Quiz' seeks to bring together sharpest young corporate minds in India to take on the heat of the toughest business quiz in India. Youth is a key audience cluster which the Tata Group is focusing its communication at and Tata Crucible is one of the key initiatives towards this engagement. The Event details are as follows : Date : 16-March-2016 Venue : Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium Event Schedule : Prelim : 01.30 PM to 02.30 PM Final : 04.00 PM to 05.00 PM Registration Verificiation Desk : 11:00 AM Onwards (Mandatory for both Online & offline candidates) It’s a great opportunity for LPU students to participate in this National Level Quiz Show. Seats are limited & will be on First Come First Serve, so kindly register yourselves to the following link. www.tatacrucible.com Note : 1. On the spot registration will be entertained from 11:00 AM to 12:30 PM on 16th - March,2017. 2. The student will be allowed to enter into the Auditorium only after the verification process at Registration Verification Desk. 3. Also register on following link http://tinyurl.com/tatacrucible2017LPU to get duty leaves. 4. Entry to the Auditorium starts from sharp 12:00 PM to 01:00 PM through Turnstile gates. 5. Duty Leaves will be given to the students only from 12:00 AM to 05:00 PM. Important Instructions regarding attendance: 1. Attendance of the registered students in an event will be through online mode i.e. through turnstile gates only. 2. Entry & Exit, to & from the Shanti Devi Mittal Auditorium respectively will be through only Turnstile Gates only. 3. Duty Leaves will be given to only those students who have marked/punched their ID card on Turnstile Gates during Entry & Exit from the auditorium. 4. When a student punch his/her Id card on turnstile gate, A) A green light signal means that the Id-Card is authorized/activated. B) A red light signal means the card is unauthorized/not activated. 5. If in-case, the Student Id Card is not working/activated/authorized during punching his/her attendance through turnstile gates, they are requested to mark their attendance OFFLINE, by signing on the attendance sheet at Student’s Help Desk. 6. Eg: If duty leaves timings are 12:00 PM to 05:00 PM, then a student must punch his ID card not late then 12:45 PM and must exit from the auditorium only after 05:00 PM. 7. Student will be sole responsible for his duty leave, if/she has not marked his Id card on turnstile gate.

title: Registrations Open for Alibaba - Online GET Program : (3/3/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement pleased to share with you Alibaba - Online GET Program. About Alibaba: Launched in 1999, Alibaba.com is the leading platform for global wholesale trade. They serve millions of buyers and suppliers around the world. Alibaba.com brings hundreds of millions of products in over 40 different major categories, including consumer electronics, machinery and apparel. Buyers for these products are located in 190+ countries and regions, and exchange hundreds of thousands of messages with suppliers on the platform each day. Target Audience: The target audience for the same is all Final and Pre Final Year students. About Alibaba - Online GET Program This is a self paced online learning program hosted on the Alibaba platform. This program aims at providing an opportunity for students to engage in a 30 hours online training program to lead them on an informative and practically designed journey through Cross Border Trade, B2B Ecommerce, Digital skills for success, Practical Learning on Marketplaces. The Online GET program will provide Basic understanding of E-commerce to ride on the new digital wave of E-commerce. Introductions and hands on assignments of various key features of the platform. Coverage of trade facilitation services like trade finance, logistics, freights forwarding, credits & inspections to help online trade efficiently. Horizontal coverage of trade related knowledge for an understanding of the nuances of global trade and E-commerce. On completion the students will take an online test for the certification by Alibaba. Students of all programs are eligible to participate and get certified. The program ideally should be completed in 2 weeks. The certificate is globally valid and is valid in all countries w.r.t. the Alibaba platform. Once certified the students will be given an opportunity to interact with Industries to explore employment or entrepreneurship opportunities who use the Alibaba platform for global trade. Interested students can register themselves in the below mention link on or before 10th March 2017: http://tinyurl.com/hgmsj4d For details, please contact Mr. Saumyajit Ganguly (Contact: 9915020423)

title: Registrations Open for Alibaba - Dream Trip Program : (3/3/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement pleased to share with you Alibaba - Dream Trip Program, where students get an opportunity to visit Alibaba Head Office in Guangzhou, China. Target Audience: The target audience for the same is all Final and Pre Final Year students. About Alibaba Launched in 1999, Alibaba.com is the leading platform for global wholesale trade. They serve millions of buyers and suppliers around the world. Alibaba.com brings hundreds of millions of products in over 40 different major categories, including consumer electronics, machinery and apparel. Buyers for these products are located in 190+ countries and regions, and exchange hundreds of thousands of messages with suppliers on the platform each day. Alibaba Dream Trip Program Dream Trip is a 4-day engagement at Alibaba’s global HQ in Hangzhou, PRC which leads students to explore Alibaba, witness E-commerce growth and communicate with successful e-businessmen. This is a self-sponsored program. LPU will be one of the first institutions in India to collaborate with Alibaba for the dream trip program and we may have the privilege of being the first team from India to visit Alibaba headquarters to interact and learn in depth the nuance of E-Commerce with global examples. The Schedule of the program is as below: Day one • Pick up and Check-in • Opening Ceremony Day Two • Binjiang Campus Visit • Lecture of Alibaba culture • Successful company Visit and Successful businessman communication • Brainstorm of E-business Day Three • Xixi Campus Visit • E-business & E-wtp Introduction • Successful company Visit and Successful business people communication • Taiji Zen house Visit and Taiji exercise • West Lake Visit Day Four • Alibaba.com Introduction • One-on-one consultant and Dismissing The tentative cost of the program will be around INR 1,29,300/-, which will be borne by student and the breakup of the same is as below: · To and Fro Air Tickets (Delhi to Guangzhou): INR 55,000/- (At Actuals) · Visa Charges (Tourist visa): INR 7000/- (At Actuals) · Facilitation Charges: USD 1000/- by Alibaba Vendor that include Airport Pickup & Drop, Local Transport, Stay, Food & Local Site seeing as mentioned in schedule as per Actual dollar Value (Rs 67000/-) (Maximum batch size is of 40 students) The main objectives of the Dream Trip are: Visit Alibaba campuses; Watch what Alibaba people do; Feel Alibaba culture and spirit; Learn Alibaba management; Witness the development of internet tech; understand how Alipay build an online bank, help consumers to go out without cash; Rural Tabaco help farmers enjoy the same facility as citizen and sell out their products online; Logistics involved in global trade; How Students open Online shops, get millions revenue per year. Interested students can registered themselves in the below mentioned link on or before 15th March, 2017: http://tinyurl.com/gu8524m In case of any queries feel free to reach: Mr. Saumyajit Ganguly - 9915020423

title: Scholarship Opportunity in Europe : (3/1/2017)
body: Division of International Affairs-LPU brings you another amazing opportunity study on complete Scholarship in Europe. Government of the Republic of Malta has announced three scholarships for students from developing nations in postgraduation studies in Climate Action at the University of Malta, Europe commencing in October 2017. The scholarship would cover full tuition fee, monthly subsistence allowance, return airfare, health insurance and visa charges. The interested students can visit the following web link for detailed information on the scholarships and eligibility criteria: http://www.um.edu.mt/newspoint/noticeboard/opportunities/2017/02/scholarshipsinclimateaction The aim of these scholarships donated by the government of Malta will serve to complement other national climate action projects and provide the opportunity to educate academically and train professionally, young people from developing countries on how to manage mitigation, adaptation and governance of climate change. Applicants need to submit their application online and provide copies of their academic qualifications and all other requested documentation to the University of Malta by the 5th May 2017. Information is available at: http://www.um.edu.mt/registrar/prospective/admissions For any queries contact Mr. Sidharath Sharma 9780036427, Block 32-308 from 9AM– 5PM.

title: CoCubes (Pre assess -1) Exam for (Engineering/MCA) placement registered students graduating in 2018. (2/28/2017)
body: Dear Aspirants, Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled a renowned exam named CoCubes (Pre Assess-1) for 2018 batch placement registered students(Engineering/MCA) on 28th Feb 2017. A good Score in CoCubes will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So come prepared and attempt the exam with full enthusiasm. Why CoCubes Exam is important: CoCubes is an industry renowned testing platform. Most of the companies use CoCubes as their testing platform during placement drives. CoCubes is India’s largest assessment and hiring platform. CoCubes helps us in gauging your current performance levels which will be utilized to design customized training inputs for the students. You can know more about CoCubes at: www.cocubes.com Important Instructions: It is mandatory for all the students. Total duration of the exam is 240 minutes approx. containing different modules. You must attempt every module. In case you miss any module your exam will not be considered completed and will not be evaluated for the final result. You can attempt any module at any time within the given time span (9 AM, to 11 PM). Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will help you to get shortlisted for upcoming placement drives. Score of this exam will also be considered for shortlisting students for special training and companies therefore students should attempt this seriously. Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not take this exam, hence attempt the test with full spirit. No Duty Leave will be provided for test attempts. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Therefore, don’t use any unfair means during exam. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. Passkey/Activation Key of exam will be shared with you through UMS my messages on the exam day itself (one hour prior to the exam). Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: ‘Euthanasia- An Indian Perspective’ - Panel Discussion Competition in Mittal School of Business : (2/17/2017)
body: Dear Students, We are pleased to share with you that School of Professional Enhancement in collaboration with Mittal School of Business is organizing ‘Euthanasia- An Indian Perspective’ - Panel Discussion Competition in Mittal School of Business. Panel Discussion is one of those competitions which will help students to improve their communication skills, analytical thinking and confidence level. Target Audience: The target audience for the competition is students from BBA and MBA who study Business Ethics as a course. Event Details: Registered Students will participate in team of five. The teams will be one from each section. The event will consist of Two Rounds: 1st Round Prelim:- In the first round each team will be given 4 minutes to give their views on the topic. All team members have to participate while giving the views. They will judge on the basis of relevance of content and level of preparation on the topic. Top 5 teams will move to the second round. 2nd Round Finale: - Top 5 teams will participate in the second round. Each team will be asked questions by the other 4 teams based on the points given by that team in the first round. Each team is allowed to ask only one question, so each team will be asked 4 questions followed by question asked by judge and the team will be evaluated on the basis of their responses as per the parameters mentioned in the judgment sheet. Questions can be asked about the facts related to Euthanasia as well as opinion based questions can also be asked. Prize: In order to reward participants for their success and efforts, it is proposed to encourage the winners with Prize and Certificates. Event Date, Venue & Time: Date: 23rd Feb, 2017 Venue: Room – 14 - 101L Time: - 3:00 – 5:00 pm Interested students can register them self in the below mentioned link: http://tinyurl.com/zetkrpz

title: Daily World Chandigarh Marathon 2017 : (2/16/2017)
body: The first edition of the Chandigarh –Mohali Marathon, in association with Lovely Professional University & Chandigarh Administration for conservation of the Environment & Digital India is scheduled as per following details. Marathon Date : 09th – April – 2017 Venue & Timings will be intimated to the registered participants through emails/texts. The event will be hosted every year on the second Sunday of April. The event will be attended by prominent politicians, senior bureaucrats & distinguished personalities/celebrities. Some of the highlights of the Marathon 2017: • 10,000 participants from all across India and overseas are expected to take part in this mega event which will be the first International level full Marathon event of the region. • Besides the Full Marathon, the event will include the Half Marathon and 5 Km fun runs for different age categories. • Hon'ble Governor of Punjab will be the Chief Guest and the event will be attended and promoted by a galaxy of distinguished personalities. • The event is supported by the District Administrations of Chandigarh (UT) and Mohali (Punjab) which are fully involved in its organization. • Extensive support by national and International institutions and brands and more than 2,000 volunteers will make this one of the most successful and historic community events ever in Chandigarh/ Mohali. • Besides promoting health and fitness through running, the event will involve mass plantation of saplings as also free distribution of plants to the participants and spectators. • Being an International level event in the region, the Marathon will be a mega hit with all classes and categories of individuals, Clubs, NGO’s, Corporate houses, schools, universities and college students etc who will all be involved in its planning and implementation. Benefits to the participants. - Medals to all finishers - T-Shirts will be provided to the participants - Goodies & Certificates will be given to the participants - Refreshments will be given to the participants - Vintage Car & Harley Davidson Motorbike Show - Zumba, Bhangra & Unlimited fun So, Interested students are requested to register themselves to the following links and grab this opportunity. https://in.bookmyshow.com/sports/marathon/chandigarh-mohali-run & www.dailyworldmarathon.com For any queries contact @9914088899

title: Daily World Chandigarh Marathon 2017 : (2/14/2017)
body: The first edition of the Chandigarh –Mohali Marathon, in association with Lovely Professional University & Chandigarh Administration for conservation of the Environment & Digital India is scheduled as per following details. Marathon Date : 09th – April – 2017 Venue & Timings will be intimated to the registered participants through emails/texts. The event will be hosted every year on the second Sunday of April. The event will be attended by prominent politicians, senior bureaucrats & distinguished personalities/celebrities. Some of the highlights of the Marathon 2017: • 10,000 participants from all across India and overseas are expected to take part in this mega event which will be the first International level full Marathon event of the region. • Besides the Full Marathon, the event will include the Half Marathon and 5 Km fun runs for different age categories. • Hon'ble Governor of Punjab will be the Chief Guest and the event will be attended and promoted by a galaxy of distinguished personalities. • The event is supported by the District Administrations of Chandigarh (UT) and Mohali (Punjab) which are fully involved in its organization. • Extensive support by national and International institutions and brands and more than 2,000 volunteers will make this one of the most successful and historic community events ever in Chandigarh/ Mohali. • Besides promoting health and fitness through running, the event will involve mass plantation of saplings as also free distribution of plants to the participants and spectators. • Being an International level event in the region, the Marathon will be a mega hit with all classes and categories of individuals, Clubs, NGO’s, Corporate houses, schools, universities and college students etc who will all be involved in its planning and implementation. Benefits to the participants. - Medals to all finishers - T-Shirts will be provided to the participants - Goodies & Certificates will be given to the participants - Refreshments will be given to the participants - Vintage Car & Harley Davidson Motorbike Show - Zumba, Bhangra & Unlimited fun So, Interested students are requested to register themselves to the following links and grab this opportunity. https://in.bookmyshow.com/sports/marathon/chandigarh-mohali-run & www.dailyworldmarathon.com You can visit Help Desk near Block 13, which will be operational from 15th – February -2017 onwards.

body: Dear Students, We are pleased to announce that CampK12 is offering a Digital Marketing LIVE Project Opportunity for LPU Students. Kindly find below the details of the same. CAMP K12 is a leading tech start-up which pioneers App Development and Coding for school students in India. Camp K12 has started its popular 'Digital Marketing Internship' across different cities. In this project, you will have to complete 4 tasks- challenging and interesting, and if you outperform, win a chance to earn a FULL-TIME INTERNSHIP with the start-up that pioneers the concept of App Development & Coding for school students, pan India. Grab this opportunity of experiencing how the actual 'Marketing & Strategising' works in the corporate world. Live exciting and result oriented life of a marketer for exactly 15 days! The project shall include some basic digital media promotion tasks and will move on to strategy making, experimenting and digital marketing-planning activities. Every round shall be evaluated on the basis of 'Effort Points' gained and your certificates shall include your performance ratings as well. The project also opens gates for promotion to higher levels for outstanding performers in subsequent project across different cities. The students will get to work in teams with people from diverse backgrounds. 4) The students shall be awarded a recognized certificate on successful completion of the project and shall also be given performance based ranking. 5) Students from all years and courses can participate. It is No Way restricted to just management students. 6) The Students can apply for Team Leader or Team member role. 7) The best performing students shall be provided a Full Time Internship opportunity with the company, which they can join as per the curriculum schedule of the college. title: "YouthZest-Write Here, Right Now" competition for School of Mechanical and Civil Engineering. : (2/7/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement is organizing "YouthZest-Write Here, Right Now" competition for School of Mechanical and Civil Engineering. YouthZest aims to provide platform for students to hone their public speaking skills along with other skills like creativity, psychology, attitude, writing skills, problem solving, critical thinking, spontaneity and analytical skills. Target Audience: The target audience for the competition will be students from School of Mechanical and Civil Engineering B.Tech and M.Tech (all year students). Event Details: The event will consist of three rounds; Round – 1: I see I observe Round – 2: I listen I answer Round – 3: I speak I conquer Details about the event: Students will participate in teams with three participants per team. Registration: There will be online registration through the event url: https://tinyurl.com/glteu8y The event will be conducted in a relay of three rounds in which each participant will represent the team individually. First round: I see I observe: (First participant of the team will participate) It will be a picture perception round in which a picture will be flashed to the participants for 30 seconds and they will write a story as perceived from the picture in 10 minutes followed by 5 minute presentation of the story in front of the audience. Participants will be judged on communication skills, structuring of the content, creativity and platform skills. Second Round: I listen I answer: (Second participant of the team will participate) It will be a question and answer round in which the participants will be called on the stage individually and will be asked a question related to a problem by the jury member. The team can discuss about the problem in team but only one participant will come on the stage and answer. Teams will get 5 minutes to discuss and 2 minutes to answer. Participants will be judged on team dynamics, problem solving, critical thinking and confidence. Third Round: I speak I conquer: (Third participant of the team will participate) This will be an extempore round in which participants will be given topics on the spot. They will be given one minute to think on the topic and 2 minutes to speak. Participants will be judged on content, communication skills, platform skills and spontaneity and confidence.

title: AMCAT diagnostic exam on 11 Feb 2017 for placement registered students passing out in 2018. (2/6/2017)
body: Dear Aspirants, This is to inform you that the Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled your AMCAT diagnostic exam on 11thFeb, 2017 for placement registered students passing out in 2018. A good score in AMCAT will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So consider it very important as this is your first step towards a great career ahead. About AMCAT: AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates based on their core skills which include reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Aspiring Minds conducts the AMCAT exam for engineering freshers who apply for IT jobs. The objective of the AMCAT exam is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information, you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com. Key Pointers AMCAT exam is mandatory for all students (as per the attached list). Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not appear in this exam, hence attempting it with full spirit. AMCAT exam timings will be shared through “UMS-My Message” one day before the test. Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will be helpful for you to get shortlisted in the upcoming drives. Hence participate in this exam with full enthusiasm. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. Duty leave will be provided for attempting the exam. So attempt accordingly. Login Credentials for the exam will be shared with you through UMS my messages on the day of the exam. Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

Our Aim: To emerge the innate values of each individual and reflect healthy, wealthy, happy, disciplined and dignified life. This is a Spiritual Revolution. The organization basically is a Link between Lovely Professional University and Brahma Kumaris World Spiritual University. body: Dear Students Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is organizing a workshop on Anger Management to provide education about the physiological, cognitive, and behavioral components of anger and facilitates the application of these newly acquired skills. Anger is a completely normal, usually healthy, human emotion. title: 'Master Stroke' - Case Study Competition for Mittal School of Business : (1/17/2017)
body: Dear Students, School of Professional Enhancement is pleased to announce the launch of 'Master Stroke' - Case Study Competition for Mittal School of Business. Through this competition, participants will strive to develop the best solution to a Business Related Case Study within an allocated time frame, typically with teams of four individuals pitted against each other in a head-to-head or broader relative ranking. Eligible Participant: The eligible participant for the competition will be students from Mittal School of Business - MBA, BBA, B.Com & M.Com (all year students). Event Details: All the interested students are requested to register themselves in a Team of 4 members on or before 21st January 2017 by 1700 Hours. Case study will be released on 21st January 2017 at 1700 Hours which will be shared to registered teams through email. At this point, teams will have three days to prepare and submit their proposals in PPT Format. The event will consist of two Rounds; Round – 1 (Premils): Case Solution Submission Round – 2 (Final): Final Event & Presentation - Proposal Submission & Expert Review (24th January 2017): All teams have to submit their proposal on or before 24th January 2017 by 1700 hours for review. Team proposals will be reviewed by a panel of experts. The Top 8 Teams will then be chosen to participate in the final event on 28th January 2017. - Final Event & Presentation (28th January 2017): The final event will be held on 28th January 2017. The Top 8 Teams will present their solution. Each team will be given 15 minutes to present, followed by a maximum 15 minutes of questions and answers round. Time limits will be strictly enforced. Prizes: In order to reward participants for their success and efforts, it is proposed to encourage the winners with Gift/Consolation prize and Certificates. Registration: Interested Students can register themselves by clicking on the link: http://tinyurl.com/hxblxt9 Kindly find attached herewith, the poster of 'Master Stroke' - Case Study Competition.

title: A Soft Skill Event- Mock Drive for students from Lovely Faculty of Technology and Sciences (1/11/2017)
body: Dear Students Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a Mock Drive for practicing the practical aspects required in cracking the placement interview. Real time demonstration of behavioral skills is the basic rationale behind the inclusion of Mock drives which includes group discussion as well as personal interview and it is also one of the selection techniques in company placements. The students will be provided a platform to practice intonation with different aspects. The students will have to showcase their speaking skills amongst the participants, which will boost their confidence to speak correctly. About the Mock Drive:Round 1: Group Discussion.Round 2: Interview Panel, consisting of technical and Verbal Staff, will ask questions to the students.Round 3: Feedback. The purpose of conducting the Mock Drive:To let the students improve their communication.To hone the presentation skills of the students.To provide a learning platform for the students to understand the industry expectations. DATE: 14 January 2017 VENUE BLOCK: 33-506,507,508Attachment

body: We are proud to announce that LPU has bagged Overall Championship Trophy in 32nd AIU Inter Universities North Zone Youth Festival held at Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur, U.P from 2nd to 6th January 2017. The contingent of LPU gave a remarkable competition to 30 universities of North India in categories of Music, Dance, Fine Arts, Theater and Literary and secured the Overall Championship position 2nd time in the row. title: 5G - Fifth Generation ---- Call for papers for special Issue : (12/22/2016)
body: The past two decades have witnessed phenomenal progress in wireless access to the Internet and telecommunication services from mobile devices, ranging from smartphones to laptops to specialized devices. Cellular network operators in several countries have deployed fourth-generation long-term evolution (4G LTE) radio technologies to keep up with the demand from the market, especially for video and social media services. Long-term plans are under way for cellular networks to continue to evolve and grow in performance, flexibility, quality of experience, and energy efficiency. The fifth generation — 5G — is the umbrella term for the next generation of cellular network technologies to be deployed in the 2020 time frame. The 5G umbrella includes advances on several different fronts, all of which are required for vendors and mobile network operators to meet market demands with cost-effective deployments. Radio access technologies are a critical foundation for mobile services, and are often a constraining factor, as users now expect mobile services to fully match wired services. In addition to enhancing existing services, 5G is expected to enable new demanding services, such as virtual reality and remotely controlled machines. Compared to 4G, the targets for 5G radio performance include higher user rates, stringent end-to-end latency, higher spectral efficiency, and greater user density, as well as a much larger number of end users. Use of advanced radio techniques — such as advanced multiple input, multiple output (MIMO) — is envisioned to support these requirements. This special issue will provide a comprehensive and timely update of 5G radio and network technologies. We seek papers from industry and academia to address these themes. Of particular interest are review and tutorial articles that summarize the subject area, and provide guidance to network and service researchers and planners so that they can anticipate the impact of 5G on networks and envision new mobile services. Relevant topics include: 1. Innovations in 5G radio technologies;innovations in 5G network architectures 2. new mobile services and use cases in 5G 3. IoT’s impact on 5G;multi-radio access technology for 5G 4. Network function virtualization (NFV) for 5G 5. SDN’s role in 5G networks;network slicing architectures for 5G 6. mobile edge computing in 5G 7. security architecture solutions for 5G 8. geographical variation in 5G deployment models. Important Dates: Final submissions due: 12 January 2017 Publication issue: September/October 2017 For more information visit: https://www.computer.org/web/computingnow/iccfp5

title: ICS-HYI Fellowship for China Studies 2017: CALL FOR APPLICATIONS : (12/19/2016)
body: Since 2013, the Institute of Chinese Studies (ICS), Delhi, and the Harvard-Yenching Institute (HYI), US, have been successfully running a programme to support doctoral research in Chinese Studies in India. Recognising the need for building long-term capacity in this field in India and attaining world-class standards, the ICS-HYI Fellowship seeks to support the most promising emerging scholars of China in India to conduct research and hone their academic and linguistic skills over a multi-year period in India, China and the US (Harvard-Yenching Institute). Three batches of the ICS-HYI Fellows are currently active and in various stages of their PhD programmes in the three different countries. The fellowship supports young social scientists registered for their PhD in Indian universities for a period of 1-2 years in India, until they acquire sufficient competence in the Chinese language to proceed to China. Thereafter, the fellows proceed to a selected university in China, where, after completion of an academic year, move on to the Harvard-Yenching Institute for one more academic year. Following this, the fellows return to their parent university in India to submit their thesis. For this fifth and final year of their doctoral programme as well, the fellowship financially supports the scholar in India. On completion of their doctoral thesis, the fellows are required to work and apply their skills and knowledge of China in India, at universities or think tanks, for a minimum period of two years. Through this entire programme, the ICS-HYI fellowship is making a serious effort to ensure that India can look forward to having a corpus of young, motivated and highly qualified scholars of China, who can produce first-rate scholarship, enter our teaching programmes, and influence the public discourse on China.The ICS would be happy to address any queries in this regard at your convenience. Please find attached the Fellowship advertisement for details pertaining to eligibility, conditions, application procedure and important dates. You can also find the same here: http://www.icsin.org/ics-hyi-fellowship-for-china-studies-call-for-applications/
