AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test is an Employability assessment test to assess the Aptitude, Reasoning and Technical Skills of students and new graduates. AMCAT is a statistical assessment platform to provide the skill measurements for each student who takes up the test. This will show how polished your Analytical,Verbal and Technical skills are. Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out, So Delve into your bags and take out your magic pen and start preparing for the Test to increase your competence. Timings: 1:00pm - 2:00pm (for those students whose exam is in morning shift) 4.:30pm - 5:30pm (for those students whose exam is in evening shift) Remember that marks in such tests act as an indicator to decide the type of inputs a particular student gets and attending the session will give you a major insight on how to attempt this test. AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test is an Employability assessment test to assess the Aptitude, Reasoning and Technical Skills of students and new graduates. AMCAT is a statistical assessment platform to provide the skill measurements for each student who takes up the test. This will show how polished your Analytical,Verbal and Technical skills are. Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out, So Delve into your bags and take out your magic pen and start preparing for the Test to increase your competence. Remember Recipe for success is to Study while others are sleeping, work while others are loafing, prepare while others are playing and dream while others are wishing. Timings: 1:00pm - 2:00pm (for those students whose exam is in morning shift) 4.:30pm - 5:30pm (for those students whose exam is in evening shift) Remember that marks in such tests act as an indicator to decide the type of inputs a particular student gets and attending the session will give you a major insight on how to attempt this test. title: Indian Air Force Recruitment through Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT) : (12/8/2016)
body: Indian Air Force invites enterprising & adventurous Indian citizens (men and women) to join the Indian Air Force as Commissioned Officers in Flying, Ground duty (technical) and Ground duty (non-technical) branches. Online applications are invited for the courses commencing in January 2018 for grant of Short Service Commission (SSC) in Flying Branch and Permanent Commission (PC) / Short Service Commission (SSC) in Ground Duty (Technical) and Ground Duty (Non-technical) Branches. ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS ** Age – 20 to 24 years as on 01 Jan 2018 i.e. Born between 02 Jan 1994 to 01 Jan 1998; both dates inclusive. Upper age limit for Candidates holding valid and current Commercial Pilot Licence issued by DGCA (India) is relaxable upto 26 years i.e. Born between 02 Jan 1992 to 01 Jan 1998 (Both dates inclusive). ** Educational Qualifications: Graduates (3 year degree), B.E/B.Tech, MBA, MCA, MA, M.Sc. candidates with minimum aggregate score varying by designation as mentioned in attached file. ** Candidates appearing in final year/semester examinations may apply for all courses commencing in January 2018 provided they fulfil the conditions mentioned in attached file. COST TO COMPANY (CTC) On successful completion of Training, newly commissioned Flying officers would be entitled to approximate gross monthly emoluments in different branches including Transport Allowance of major cities as follows: ** Flying branch: Rs 82,050/- plus additional benefits/privileges ** Ground Duty (Tech) branch: Rs 71,550/- plus additional benefits/privileges ** Ground Duty (Non-tech) branch: Rs 68,550/- plus additional benefits/privileges SELECTION PROCEDURE **All applicants whose applications are submitted by due date will be called for AFCAT and Engineering Knowledge Test (EKT). **Candidates who are short-listed on the basis of AFCAT/EKT will be called for further testing at one of the Air Force Selection Boards (AFSBs), The testing would consist of different stages. Stage-I: Test consisting of Intelligence Test along with other tests will be conducted on the first day. Stage-II. Testing consisting of Psychological, Group Tests and Interview will be conducted on subsequent days (Five Days). For Flying Branch: Computerized Pilot Selection System (CPSS) would be administered to eligible candidates. This is once in a lifetime test. Candidates who have failed the (CPSS)/PABT in an earlier attempt or a Flight Cadet suspended from flying training at Air Force Academy will not be eligible to apply. HOW TO APPLY ** Candidates are to fill in ‘e-application' (Online) at IAF website www.careerairforce.nic.in and follow the instructions. ** LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPLICATION – 29 Dec 2016 ** Students who submit their applications must also fill their details at http://tinyurl.com/navy-airforce-2017 for university record and duty leave pre-requisite. For more details refer the attached file.

title: Indian Navy Recruitment through Naval Armament Inspection (NAI) Entry Scheme : (12/8/2016)
body: Applications are invited from unmarried male Indian citizens for grant of Permanent Commission (PC) in Naval Armament Inspection (NAI) entry in the Indian Navy for course commencing Jun 2017 at the Indian Naval Academy (INA), Ezhimala, Kerala. ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS ** Age – 19½ - 25 years, born between 02 Jul 1992 and 01 Jan 1998; both dates inclusive. ** Educational Qualifications: Candidates should have passed BE/B.Tech degree or in the final year of Engineering Course in any one stream i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Production, Instrumentation, IT, Chemical Metallurgy and Aerospace Engineering with minimum 60% aggregate marks till V semester (and also overall at completion of degree in June 2017). ** Only one application is to be filled by a candidate. COST TO COMPANY (CTC) The CTC for a sub Lieutenant would be approximately Rs. 87,600 to 90,000/- (incl. Basic Pay, DA, Grade Pay, Military Service Pay, Flying Allowance, House Rent Allowance and Transport allowance) plus additional facilities/privileges. SELECTION PROCEDURE ** Candidates will be issued call up for Service Selection Board (SSB) interviews based on their performance in educational qualification. ** SSB interviews for short-listed candidates will be scheduled from Dec 16 to Mar 17. ** The total duration of SSB interviews is five days consisting of stage I (Day one) and stage II (Four days). Stage I Tests, consist of Intelligence Tests, Picture Perception and Group Discussion Tests. Candidates who fail to qualify in Stage I will be sent back on the same day from SSB Centre. Stage II Tests consists of Psychological Tests, Group Task Tests and Interview. Successful candidates will undergo medicals examination (approx 3-5 days). HOW TO APPLY ** Candidates are to fill in ‘e-application' (Online) at www.joinindiannavy.gov.in and follow the procedure as mentioned in attached file. ** LAST DATE FOR ONLINE APPLICATION – 09 Dec 2016 ** LAST DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF APPLICATION – 19 Dec 2016 ** Students who submit their applications must also fill their details at http://tinyurl.com/navy-airforce-2017 for university record and duty leave pre-requisite. For more details refer the attached file.

title: Opportunity for Internship & Project in Digital Marketing : (12/7/2016)
body: Dear Students, We are pleased to announce that CampK12 is offering a Digital Marketing project opportunity for you. Kindly find below the details of the same. CAMP K12 is a leading ed-tech start-up which pioneers App Development and Coding for school students in India. Camp K12 has started its popular 'Digital Marketing Internship' across different cities. In this project, you will have to complete 3 tasks- challenging and interesting, and if you outperform, win a chance to earn a FULL-TIME INTERNSHIP with the start-up that pioneers the concept of App Development & Coding for school students, pan India. Grab this opportunity of experiencing how the actual 'Marketing & Strategising' works in the corporate world. Live exciting and result oriented life of a marketer for exactly 15 days! The project shall include some basic digital media promotion tasks and will move on to strategy making, experimenting and digital marketing-planning activities. Every round shall be evaluated on the basis of 'Effort Points' gained and your certificates shall include your performance ratings as well. The project also opens gates for promotion to higher levels for outstanding performers in subsequent project across different cities. PROJECT OUTLINE 1) The project shall help students learn the nuances of Digital Marketing and how does a company use digital marketing platforms. 2) It is a virtual project i.e. The Students Can Work remotely from their current locations. 3) It is a pan India project wherein students from different colleges across the country shall be participating. The students will get to work in teams with people from diverse backgrounds. 4) The students shall be awarded a recognized certificate on successful completion of the project and shall also be given performance based ranking. 5) Students from all years and courses can participate. It is No Way restricted to just management students. 6) The Students can apply for Team Leader or Team member role. 7) The best performing students shall be provided a Full Time Internship opportunity with the company, which they can join as per the curriculum schedule of the college. Visit these links for more: info.campk12.com facebook.com/campk12youtube.com/c/campk12 Application Deadline : Dec 9th 2016 The dates for the internship are Dec 15th - Dec 30th '16 (tentative) APPLY HERE: http://bit.ly/2eFbt8f For any queries, please write to Mr. Sukhvinder Singh at sukhvinder.20179@lpu.co.in DISCLAIMER: THIS VIRTUAL PROJECT REQUIRES 2 HOURS OF WORK EVERYDAY ON AN AVERAGE FOR 15 DAYS. title: The RBI policy Challenge - 2017 (A national level competition for under graduate/post graduate students) : (12/3/2016)
body: The RBI policy Challenge is a three tier competition which test essay writing, problem solving and presentation skills of the students. The RBI Policy challenge -2017 will be conducted as per the following methodology 1. Regional Round: This would involve writing an essay on a given topic by students in group of 3 or 4 guided by faculty advisor. Details regarding the topic, maximum word limit, assessment criteria, last date for receipt of entries etc are enclosed. Team writing the best essay , as assessed by expert(s), would advance to the Zonal Round. 2. Zonal Round (on 31st January 2017): A real-life problem based on a monetary/economic issue to be handed over to all the teams in advance and they will be expected to make a presentation of the 15 minutes on their approach to the problem before a panel of experts. Best team from every zone would advance to the national round. 3. National Round: A monetary policy related topic would be assigned to all the teams in the forenoon and they would be required to make a 15 minutes presentation in the afternoon before an eminent panel. Each team will also be fielding questions. Students are requested to participate in this national level competition.

title: Instruction for the Diagnostic test for BIO/AGRI/MCA/Mech/Civil-2018 batch scheduled at 3:00PM : (11/29/2016)
body: Dear Students Follow the following procedure to go through the online assessment test scheduled at 3:00 PM: 1. Enter the URL https://lputest.eyardstick.com/exam in google chrome browser. After entering the URL, the System Compatibility Check Screen appears. 2. Click on Click to login. 3. Fill your working Email ID and Secure Key for students of (BIOTECH/AGRI/MCA- 6xyxmhc), for (Mechanical- 8wyjeqd) and for ( Civil- 2icroai) then click on Log in. 4. Fill the Basic Information (Mandatory), and the Educational Details. Ensure that all the fields are filled appropriately. 5. Click on Save and Proceed to exam. This test is mandatory for students who are going to pass out and registered for the placements, Must Attempt the written ability module. Notes: 1. Do not press ‘Backspace’ or Refresh the screen during the exam. 2. Do not try to open any other window(s) or navigate away from the test screen, as you will be blocked by the system automatically. 3. In case of any internet disconnection (if the Red dialogue box appears), wait for a few seconds to get the connectivity restored (a green dialogue box will appear) and then proceed. If the same doesn’t appear even after 60 seconds, contact the system admin for assistance. Your timer will resume from the last point. 4. In case of any power / system failure or shutdown, re login within 10 mins, you will resume the test from the same point where you left and no time will be lapsed in the process. Post the same, you will not be able to continue the test. 5. Before proceeding to the next section, ensure that you have attempted all the questions of the current section as you won’t be able to come back to the previous section once exited.

Being established in the year 1949, Dr.Lal PathLabs is now the largest and most respected diagnostic service provider in the country. Dr. Lal Path Labs is India’s highest accredited laboratory, with accreditation from College of American Pathologists (CAP), National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL), Ministry of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and ISO 9001:2000 certification. Being listed in BSE,/NSE we have successfully launched of our IPO in December, 2015 and currently having a turnover of 800 corers per annum. The company has more than 170 Labs and over 2000 centers across India and serves over 12 million customers every year through our widest test menu and panels in the disciplines of Molecular Diagnostics, Biophysics, Flow Cytometry, Immunophenotying, Cytogenetic, Endocrinology, Genetics, Nutrition and Metabolism, Oncology, Toxicology, Immunohistochemistry, Infectious diseases, Biochemistry, Hematology, Histopathology and Cytology. Having a team of over 3000+ dedicated employees across India we strongly believe in hiring and retaining high quality manpower and nurturing them with employee friendly, positive and world class work environment. DESIGNATION: 1) Lab Analyst 2). Executive Trainee – Sales Refer attached file for the detailed job profile. title: Registration Open - Joint campus Placement drive by Amazon India for 2017 passing-out batch : (11/24/2016)
body: Lovely Professional University is going to conduct a joint campus placement drive by Amazon Development Centre India for all the students pursuing any Bachelor's / Master's degree programme and passing out in 2017. The drive is also open for the following students of LPU provided they meet the eligibility criteria stated below: a) Students who are debarred from placement services. b) Students who did not register for university placement services. ABOUT AMAZON: Amazon.com hires the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers. A Fortune 100 company based in Seattle, Washington, Amazon is the global leader in e-commerce. Amazon offers everything from books and electronics to apparel and diamond jewelry. Amazon operates sites in Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Netherlands, Spain, United Kingdom and United States, and maintain dozens of fulfillment centers around the world which encompass more than 26 million square feet. Amazon teams in India work on complex business challenges to innovate and create efficient solutions that enable various Amazon businesses, including Amazon websites across the world as well as support Payments, Transportation, and Digital products and services like the Kindle family of tablets, e-readers and the store. DESIGNATION: 1) Transaction Risk Investigator 2) Seller Support Associate Refer attached file for the detailed job profile. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: 1) Any graduate/post-graduate student passing out in 2017. 2) No standing reappears/backlogs allowed at the time of placement drive. SALARY PACKAGE: Rs. 3.54 / Rs. 3.65 LPA plus extra benefits. DRIVE DATE for LPU students: December 02, 2016. REPORTING TIME: 09:00 AM DRIVE VENUE: Block 32 SELECTION PROCESS: 1) Pre-placement Talk 2) Online Test (aptitude) 3) Voice and Accent Round 4) Technical cum HR Interview REGISTRATION PROCESS: Eligible students interested for the drive can register at the following link latest by 29th November 2016: https://lpu.typeform.com/to/ZG43nA Students registered for placements must register on Placement portal instead of this link. IMPORTANT NOTE 1) Students should carry 2 passport size photographs, 2 copies of updated CV & academic certificates. Soft copy of CVs must be in present with students in their respective mailbox. 2) Students must dress-up in formals. 3) Seating plan for the online test will be announced separately through UMS. 4) For any query, contact with your respective TPCs. 5) The drive may also spill over to 3rd and 4th December 2016.

title: Invitation for International Conference on “Recent Advances in fundamental and Applied Science” (RFAS-2016) on 25th and 26th November : (11/21/2016)
body: It gives us immense pleasure to share that the School of chemical Engineering & Physical Sciences is hosting an International Conference entitled “Recent Advances in fundamental and Applied Science”, with the objective of exploring cutting edge research and paradigm changing discoveries in fundamental and applied sciences. The conference will be held on 25-26th Nov, 2016 at the LPU campus. We would like to extend a warm invitation to all Faculty and Students of LPU for this conference as there is a great opportunity for all of us to learn, collaborate and explore our multidisciplinary research. Following research areas will be covered during the conference where all of us will get an opportunity to discuss, debate and learn from renowned people of Industry and academia across the globe. Thrust Areas: Chemistry: Catalysis, Co-ordination & Supramolecular Chemistry, Bio-inorganic, Bio-organic & Bio-Physical Chemistry, Synthetic Organic Chemistry, Material Science, Natural Product and Green chemistry, Polymer Sciences, Theoretical Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Thermodynamics, Surfactants and Solution Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry Physics: Astrophysics, Condensed Matter Physics, Acoustics, Laser Plasma Interaction, Nanotechnology, Radiation Physics, Electronics, Photonics, Biophysics Mathematics: Analysis and Algebra, Operations Research, Mathematical modeling, Fluid Dynamics and Solid Mechanics, Numerical analysis, Mathematical Tools and Techniques, Fuzzy set and Its Application, Geometry and Topology, Discrete Mathematics Key Note Speakers: Prof. Yuanhua Lin - Dean, School of Material Science and Engineering, Southwest Petroleum University, China. body: Dear Students We are pleased to inform you that School of Professional Enhancement-I is organizing an event 'The Engineer's Voice'. The event is open for all the students of Engineering/B.Tech (all streams/1st-4th year students). title: Revised Placement Registration Deadlines -2018 Passing Out Batch : (11/16/2016)
body: Students Enrolment for University Placement Services is now open for the batch passing out in 2018. The policy is applicable to all the students passing out in 2018 except for ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., Ph.D. programs & International students. All students who are planning to "EXIT" option from dual-degree program shall also exercise this placement registration process. Placement Registration Process is divided into 2 steps: ** Process-1: Student Consent for placement registration ** Process-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. Process-1 Details: a) Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration b) Select the option “YES” if student agrees to register for Placements. Further, student will have to select the correct program category/discipline with which he/she is going to pass out in 2018. c) Select the option “NO” if the student does not want to avail University placement services. In this case, student will have to specify three reasons for not accepting university placement services. d) Click on Submit to complete Process-1. Only those students will be directed to Process-2, who gave their consent in Process-1. Process-2 Details: e) Student who accepts the placement policy during Process-1, will be automatically directed to Placement Portal for Process-2 (for updating student profile). However the student can also access the same from Placement portal (ums.lpu.in/placements) > Login using UMS username/password > Placement Process-2 registration (or follow the same placement registration link mentioned under Process-1) f) During Process-2, students will need to fill/confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. g) After marking all details as correct, click on submit to complete placement registration . h) The PEP fee will be made due in students’ account which the student can pay under the head PEP (Test) Fee along with their next term fee. i) Student will be further redirected to Skill Set interface where he/she can fill their skill-set details. Important Timelines: Activity Start Date End Date Placement Registration Process-1 & II: 26th Oct 2016 15th Nov 2016 Placement Registration Process-1 & II 16th Nov 2016 30th Nov 2016 with Compounding Fee Rs. 500 Placement Registration Process-1 & II 1st Dec 2016 31st Dec 2016 with Compounding Fee Rs. 2,000: Last date for paying PEP (Test) Fee: 24th December 2016 (in Cash / Online mode) Students are advised to carefully read the placement policy attached herewith before enrolling for university placement services. Students can visit their respective School Placement Office and contact their Training and Placement Coordinators for queries.

title: science communication competition -- FameLab : (11/13/2016)
body: FameLab is one of the biggest science communication competitions in the world! If you think you can explain a scientific concept in just three minutes, and are interested in developing your presentation and communication skills, FameLab is for you!Communicating science to a lay audience is a growing priority for researchers worldwide. Indeed, the involvement of public audiences in designing research pathways has huge benefits in achieving successful outcomes and is increasingly recognised as a very important aspect of research agendas. FameLab helps STEM workers acquire valuable skills to communicate their work accessibly and attractively to a non-scientific audience. The competition offers contestants training masterclasses, which focus on presentation and communication skills and aim to empower individual scientists and researchers in speaking about their work. What's more? If you’re chosen as the winner of FameLab India, you could find yourself travelling to the Cheltenham Science Festival in the UK to represent India at the FameLab International grand final! Eligibility Criteria: Anyone between the age of 20 and 40 years as of 1 June 2016, who is:A student of science, mathematics or engineering A scientist or researcher A lecturer in science, mathematics and engineering subjects Applying science, mathematics and engineering in Industry or Government We cannot accept: Press of PR officers even for science-related organisations Artists who work on science-related themes Performers whose shows are about science or engineering Science centre staff who work exclusively or mainly in public Journalists and broadcasters Non-specialist school teachers For more information visit: https://www.britishcouncil.in/programmes/higher-education/famelab

title: RedHAT Academy Program : (11/11/2016)
body: REDHAT ACADEMY PROGRAM We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with RedHat Academy has setup a RedHat center of excellence. It’s a Great Opportunity for the students of LPU to avail benefit through the training program provided by the RedHatexperts.ICT Skills and knowledge open a world of possibilities for students looking to gain a competitive edge. This training program will help students in a wide range of RedHat Linux career today and in future. Advantage of pursuing training in RedHat Center of Excellence: 1) Discount in RHCSA certification. 2) The course material, instruction manuals, tests, assessments, slides, notes, quizzes would be provided by the RedHat Academy either in printed or electronic format. 3) RedHat performance based certification exam. 4) Once the candidates are RHCSA certified either they can chose to upgrade to RHCE or to CL210 path. 5) 1 day training will be on “How to excel in RedHat Certification”. 6) Learning Services and support services provided as part of the Program. 7) Deliverables by RedHat includes RedHat Enterprise Linux, JBoss Enterprise Middleware and other software programs branded by Red Hat. 8) Student of any year any stream can join the training program. Why Red Hat Certification through LPU? Red hat is now officially iin partnership with LPU to roll out this program Only cost of exam fee is around INR15000 to INR20000 in market for single attempt excluding training. In comparison of market the training cost of 72 hours training is in between 12000 to 15000 in the market costing all around INR 27000 to INR 35000 together. Whereas we are providing this training at INR 22000 including service tax fee which is INR 25,300. Red hat official trainers will give the training for this program Program detail: 1) Duration of Training: 72 hours + 8 hours input on Certification preparation. 2) Date of Training: · Start date: After End term Examinations Classes will be conducted on weekends only. No classes will be conducted in between national holidays and University examinations. 3) Training Covers: RHCSA: Online Content, Training & Certification. 4) Cost/Candidate for Training & Certification: Rs. 22,000/-plus Service Tax i.e. = Rs25, 300/- 5) Training Timings: Days Shifts Session I Break Session II Saturday and Sunday 09:00am to 01:00pm Lunch 02:00pm to 06:00pm Payment Process: 1) An initial amount of Rs 5,300/- need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees head for “RedHat Linux” as registration fee. 2) Rest fee shall be paid before 31st March 2017. 3) No certification will be provided in case of non submission and late fee submission. 4) Once a student is registered in this program he or she is entitled to pay the full fee even if he/she quits in between the program. 5) Registration fee is non-refundable. 6) Registration dates: · Opening Date: 19th Oct 2016 · Closing Date: 30th Nov 2016. title: Change of Programme for FRESHMEN students i.e. students of batch 2016 (Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/161110/002) : (11/10/2016)
body: It is for the information of all freshmen students (i.e. students of batch 2016) that they can apply for Change of Programme as per attached Guidelines and time lines. For the continuing students, Change of Programme will be offered in the Spring Term of 2016-17. The students should read the guidelines thoroughly before applying. The Application Form can be downloaded from the attachment of Formats and must be submitted (i.e. Annexure-1 and Annexure-2 complete in all respects) at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32- 102(window no.2) latest by 05:00 PM on November 30th, 2016 (without compounding fee) and by December 12th, 2016 (with compounding fee). No applications will be entertained after that. A student may also download the form and undertaking and fill it up in his/her own handwriting in CAPITAL LETTERS, get it signed from the parents, scan it and e-mail it to academic.aac@lpu.co.in. The email should be with subject “Change of Programme for Freshmen Students-Registration No-” In the ‘Without Compounding Fee’, immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rupees 1,000/- will be debited to the account of the student as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee. The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32 -102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rupees 1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee to the Department of Accounts. In the ‘With Compounding Fee’, immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rupees 3,000/- will be debited to the account of the student (i.e. Rupees 1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee and Rupees 2,000/- as Compounding Fee). The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32 ,102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rupees 3,000/- (i.e. Rupees 1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee and Rupees 2,000/- as Compounding Fee) to the Department of Accounts. All students whose Change of Programme application is approved must pay the ‘Change of Programme Fee’ by December 24th, 2016. Failing to pay the fee in above timeline the approval for their Change of Programme will stand cancelled and they shall continue in their current programme. The ‘Change of Programme’ Fee must be paid in person and no facility of online payment will be available. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old programme after approval of Change of Programme request or after paying the ‘Change of Programme Fee’. Students must read the enclosed ‘Guidelines for Change of Programme’ carefully before they apply for change of programme. In case of any query, kindly report to DAA window located at Block 32-102(Window No.2).

title: Counseling and Psychological Support System - CAPSS : (11/9/2016)
body: LPU is offering Confidential and Free Psychological Counseling support to all, in which a special assistance is provided to the individuals in dealing with their behavioral issues/concerns that may affect them negatively. By offering a wide range of counseling services in a friendly environment, we strive to help all, in achieving their academic, personal and relational goals. One may desire to have an empathetic support and genuine feedback for a difficult situation, learn useful self-management skills, improve social relationships, or resolve new or long-standing problematic situations. We are here to provide you all this and much more... CERTAIN SIGNS TO WATCH OUT FOR, WHERE YOU MAY NEED CAPSS SERVICES - Feeling extremely homesick. - Not able to manage with your work load and time. - Feeling lonely and sad. - Experiencing problems in relationships - Unprovoked anger and hostility. - Feelings of inferiority. - Feeling helpless or hopeless. - Despite best efforts unable to adjust. - Feeling stressed up most of the time. - Deterioration in quality of work. - Often feels shy and self-conscious. - Feeling no sense of belonging. - Thoughts about harming your own self or others. - Lack of concentration and confidence. - Excessive fatigue and sleep disturbances. - Experiencing constant anxiety, irritability or fearfulness. - Lack of communication skills. - Don't have any life goals or aims. - Lack of self-control, etc...... It is normal if you have any of the above mentioned signs. We all go through such phases of life where we don't feel equipped enough to help ourselves on our own. In such cases “IT IS OK TO SEEK HELP.” Services Offered: Individual Counseling, Group Counseling, Psychological Testing, and Psychiatric/clinical help. For Psychological Counseling sessions you may visit 1. Khushpinder Sharma Counseling Psychologist Cabin No. 11 (9am-5pm) Contact No: 9815181252

title: Student Enrolment for Placement Services – Batch passing out in 2018 (Registration Deadlines Revised) : (11/7/2016)
body: Students Enrolment for University Placement Services is now open for the batch passing out in 2018. The policy is applicable to all the students passing out in 2018 except for ODL, Part-time, M.Phil., Ph.D. programs & International students. All students who are planning to "EXIT" option from dual-degree program shall also exercise this placement registration process. Placement Registration Process is divided into 2 steps: ** Process-1: Student Consent for placement registration ** Process-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. Process-1 Details: a) Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration b) Select the option “YES” if student agrees to register for Placements. Further, student will have to select the correct program category/discipline with which he/she is going to pass out in 2018. c) Select the option “NO” if the student does not want to avail University placement services. In this case, student will have to specify three reasons for not accepting university placement services. d) Click on Submit to complete Process-1. Only those students will be directed to Process-2, who gave their consent in Process-1. Process-2 Details: e) Student who accepts the placement policy during Process-1, will be automatically directed to Placement Portal for Process-2 (for updating student profile). However the student can also access the same from Placement portal (ums.lpu.in/placements) > Login using UMS username/password > Placement Process-2 registration (or follow the same placement registration link mentioned under Process-1) f) During Process-2, students will need to fill/confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. g) After marking all details as correct, click on submit to complete placement registration . h) The PEP fee will be made due in students’ account which the student can pay under the head PEP (Test) Fee along with their next term fee. i) Student will be further redirected to Skill Set interface where he/she can fill their skill-set details. Important Timelines (revised): Activity Start Date End Date Placement Registration Process-1 & II: 26th Oct 2016 15th Nov 2016 Placement Registration Process-1 & II : 16th Nov 2016 20th Nov 2016 with Compounding Fee Rs. 500/- Placement Registration Process-1 & II : 21st Nov 2016 31st Dec 2016 with Compounding Fee Rs. 2,000/- Students are advised to carefully read the placement policy attached herewith before enrolling for university placement services. title: Did you work on some project & are excited to share it with everyone? You are welcome to showcase it in Explorica 2016!! : (11/4/2016)
body: Every year Lovely Professional University organizes its annual event named 'Explorica'.This Event is organized so that young students showcase their talent on a larger platform. Explorica is more of a carnival for sharing your talent among the aspiring student community. In this event School of Computer Science and Engineering also host its Project Exhibition stall where projects developed by CSE/IT students is put on display. This is a huge platform to showcase your talent among more than 30000 visiting students across the North region. We invite project entries from the students of School of Computer Science and Engineering, who are interested in showcasing their project during Explorica-2016(November 22-23). Best 15-20 projects will be showcased on the Project Exhibition stall, which will be decided by a school technical committee from the submitted entries. Projects can be from any of the following categories but are not limited to: 1. Internet of Things, 2. Virtual Reality, 3. Augmented Reality, 4. Mobile based utility solutions, 5. Robotics or related embedded system projects, 6. Artificial Intelligence, 7. Computer/Mobile based Games, 8. Any other Cross-domain innovation etc. Also, if your project is under development, feel free to submit your entry and if selected, you have to complete it before the event. In case your project is selected for the exhibition stall, you will be entitled to following provisions: 1. Appreciation Letter for the event participation. 2. Lunch/Refreshment during the event. 3. Duty leave for the student present on the stall(even if the team size is more than one then only one student is allowed to stay on stall). Project Details Submission Link: http://tinyurl.com/Explorica2016 Last date for submission: November 18, 2016 In the case of any clarity, you can contact at anupinder.19385@lpu.co.in, rajkaran.singh@lpu.co.in.

title: OE/SSE Polling and Registration for Spring Term 2016-17 (Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/161103/005) : (11/3/2016)
body: The registration of Open Electives (OE) and Social Science Electives (SSE) for Spring Term of Session 2016-2017 shall start at 5:30 PM on Nov 05, 2016 and end at 5:30 PM on Nov 08, 2016. Students can register for the same through UMS either inside campus or from outside campus. The interface for registration will be available 24 hours a day till the end date. The registration of Open Electives (OE) and Social Science Electives (SSE) for Spring Term of Session 2016-2017 shall be as follows: 1. For all Honors students the polling cum registration interface will be open at 5:30 PM on Nov 04, 2016. This interface will remain deactivated from 03:30pm to 05:30pm on Nov 04, 2016 and Nov 05, 2016. 2. For all other programmes the polling interface will be open at 5:30 PM on Nov 05, 2016 and close at 5:30 PM on Nov 08, 2016. Students can register for the same through UMS either inside campus or from outside campus. The interface for registration will be available 24 hours a day till the end date as mentioned above. Please note that if a student does not participate in registration up to 5:30 PM on Nov 08, 2016, he/she will be allotted the course in which seats are left vacant as per system logic and no request for allotting his/her preference will be entertained. The detail of registration process has been attached with this announcement. In order to check whether OE/SSE is applicable in the next term, a student can refer to the attached file “Applicable programs for OE SSE polling of Spring Term 2016-17.xls” with this announcement. Important Note: All the students are informed to carefully study the course write-ups (available at link: UMS Navigation -> Learning Management System (LMS) -> Open/Social Sci. Elective Registration) in order to shortlist the course they would like to select. This careful analysis will help in making good choice of courses. The course write-ups will remain deactivated from 3:30 pm of Nov 04, 2016 to 05:30pm of Nov 05, 2016 for Non Honors students.

title: Workshop on Advanced Automotive Electronics Technologies : (11/3/2016)
body: After conducting many successful workshops in various IITs and NITs & reputed engineering colleges, here its your chance to learn & get hands on experience on latest engine technologies. This will enhance your practical knowledge. It is a great opportunity for the students of LPU to avail benefit though the training program provided by industrial automotive R&D experts. In cars, bikes & automobiles of this age, the emission limits & high performance requirement are increasingly shifting the focus to Electronic Control Units because of their flexibility. The mechanical control is being fast replaced by ECU based fuel management systems e.g. CRDi, MPFi, EFI . The technology is getting further advanced like Google Driverless car , Automatic Transmission (AMT), Cruise Control etc. Medhaavi in association with Department of Research & Development, LPU offers you to attend a workshop on latest technologies of automotive where students will be exposed to basic of ECU, and latest automotive technologies . As an engineer it gives you exposure to all new area which remains unexplored by Engineers & opens up a world of opportunities. Why you should attend? 1. Learn latest engine technologies which are the future (CRDi, MPFi, GDI, EFI, etc.) 2. This knowledge will help you bridge the knowledge gap. 3. Have practical look on CRDi engine being controlled from LAPTOP. 4. Learn basics of Engine Tuning. 5. Workshop is delivered by industry experts working in advanced engine projects. 6. Knowledge will be handy to clear interviews of Automotive Companies. Workshop Detail: Workshop Duration: 2 Days Dates: 8th – 9th November Venue: Block-38, Department of Research and Development, LPU Registration Process: 1.An amount of Rs. 1350 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Medhaavi” 2.Student need to fill the registration form on http://tinyurl.com/medhaaviworkshop by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3.Student once register cannot withdraw the application 4.Registration fees is non refundable 5.Seats are First Come First Serve basis. For any type of query contact: Mr. Vikash Kumar 7837113285 or visit Block 38, Room No. 305C

title: Student Enrolment for Placement Services – Batch passing out in 2018 : (10/26/2016)
body: Students Enrolment for University Placement Services is now open for the batch passing out in 2018. The policy is applicable to all the students passing out in 2018 except for Open & Distance Learning (ODL) programmes, Part-time programmes, M.Phil, Ph.D. programmes & International students. All students who are planning to "EXIT" from dual-degree programme shall also exercise this placement registration process. No separate policy would be floated for them. Placement Registration Process is divided into 2 steps: ** Process-1: Student Consent for placement registration ** Process-2: Placement Registration and Profile updating. Process-1 Details: a) Pathway for Student Registration: UMS Navigation > Placement Services > Placement Policy Registration b) Select the option “YES” if student agrees to register for Placements. Further, student will have to select the correct program category/discipline with which he/she is going to pass out in 2018. c) Select the option “NO” if the student does not want to avail University placement services. In this case, student will have to specify three reasons for not accepting university placement services. d) Click on Submit to complete Process-1. Only those students will be directed to Process-2, who gave their consent in Process-1. Process-2 Details: e) Student who accepts the placement policy during Process-1, will be automatically directed to Placement Portal for Process-2 (for updating student profile). Alternatively, the student can also access this interface from Placement portal (ums.lpu.in/placements) > Login using UMS username/password > Placement Process-2 registration (or follow the same placement registration link mentioned under Process-1) f) During Process-2, students will need to fill/confirm all the details pertaining to student profile as per the available fields. In case any details are incorrect, the student shall report in Examination Record Cell window (Block 32, Level 1) to get these details updated. Unless all details are marked as correct, the student will not be able to complete Process-2. g) After marking all details as correct, click on submit button to complete placement registration. h) The Professional Enhancement Programme (PEP) fee will be made due in students’ account which the student can pay under the head PEP (Test) Fee along with their next term fee. i) Student will be further redirected to Skill Set interface where he/she can fill his/her skill-set details. Important Timelines: Activity Start Date End Date Placement Registration Process-1 & II: 26th Oct. 2016 6th Nov. 2016 Placement Registration Process-1 & II 7th Nov. 2016 20th Nov. 2016 with Compounding Fee Rs. 500 : Placement Registration Process-1 & II 21st Nov. 2016 31st Dec. 2016 with Compounding Fee Rs. 2,000: Students are advised to carefully read the placement policy attached herewith before enrolling for university placement services. In case of any queries, students may contact their school Training & Placement Coordinators (TPCs).

body: Dear Students, The students of Jharkhand state can apply on Jharkhand scholarship portal through website link http://ekalyan.cgg.gov.in for Post Matric Scholarship scheme to SC/ST and OBC students for the session 2016-17. The last date for applying for this scholarship is 15th November 2016. Annual income of the parent of the SC student should not exceed Rs. 2.50 lac per annum and for OBC should not exceed 1 lac per annum from all sources. After submitting the application online on the scholarship portal, the students have to submit his/her print application form at Block No. 32- Room No. 102, Window No.-1 along with the following documents with Self attestation:- 1. Domicile certificate. 8. Bank Passbook copy of student. 9. Photocopy of Aadhar Card. 10. Fee Structure, Hostel Certificate (student can collect these documents from 32-101). 11. Fee Receipts (to be attested from accounts department, Block No.32, Room No. 103, Window No. 5). In case of any mistake or wrong information found, student application has been rejected by the concerned official from Jharkhand (Refer advertisement attached - Jharkhand Post Matric 2016-17 – guidelines). 2. If the student submits his/her application twice then scholarship form will be rejected by the concerned authority. 3. After the due dates no student will be able to apply for the scholarship. 4. Seeding of Aadhar card with Bank account is mandatory otherwise scholarship will not be released by the Jharkhand state Govt. 5. Scholarship holder under this scheme will not avail any other scholarship / stipend for pursuing the same course from any other government agencies/department. 6. title: Workshop on School Mental Health : November 11 to November 12, 2016. : (10/24/2016)
body: The 2-Day Workshop on School Mental Health organised by Human Resource Development Center and School of Arts and Languages, Lovely Professional University w.e.f. November 11 (Friday) to November 12 (Saturday), 2016. Psychological health issues can affect classroom learning and social interactions, both of which are critical to the success of students. However, if appropriate services are put in place to support students’ mental health needs, we can ensure maximize success and minimize negative impact for students. title: RedHAT Academy Program : (10/19/2016)
body: REDHAT ACADEMY PROGRAM We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with RedHat Academy has setup a RedHat Center of Excellence. It’s a Great Opportunity for the students of LPU to avail benefit through the training program provided by the RedHat Experts. ICT Skills and knowledge open a world of possibilities for students looking to gain a competitive edge. This training program will help students in a wide range of RedHatLinux career today and in future. Advantage of pursuing training in RedHat Center of Excellence: 1) Discount in RHCSA certification. 2) The course material, instruction manuals, tests, assessments, slides, notes, quizzes would be provided by the RedHat Academy either in printed or in an electronic format. 3) RedHat performance based certification exam. 4) Once the candidates are RHCSA certified either they can chose to upgrade to RHCE or to CL210 path. 5) 1 day training will be on “How to excel in RedHatCertification”. 6) Learning Services and support services provided as part of the Program. 7) Deliverables by RedHat includes RedHat Enterprise Linux, JBoss Enterprise Middleware and other software programs branded by Red Hat. 8) Student of any year any stream can join the training program. Why Red Hat Certification through LPU? Red hat is now officially in partnership with LPU to roll out this program.Only cost of exam fee is around Rs 15000 to Rs 20000 in market for single attempt excluding training. In market the training cost of 72 hours training is between Rs 12000 to Rs 15000 for one course and along with the certificate the cost would be Rs 27000 to Rs 35000 together. Whereas we are providing this training at Rs 22000+Service tax which is Rs 25,300/-. Red hat official trainers will give the training for this program Program Detail: 1) Duration of Training: 72 hours + 8 hours input on Certification Preparation on weekend only. 2) Date of Training: · Start Date:5th November, 2016 End Date: 4th December, 2016 No classes will be conducted on National holidays and during University examinations. 3) Training Covers:RHCSA: Online Content, Training & Certification. 4) Cost/Candidate for Training& Certification: Rs. 22,000/-plus Service Tax i.e. Rs25, 300/- 5) Training Timings: Days Shifts Session I Break Session II Saturday and Sunday 09:00am to 01:00pm Lunch 02:00pm to 06:00pm Payment Process: 1) An initial amount of Rs 5,300/- need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees head for “Red Hat Linux” as registration fee. 2) Rest of the fee shall be paid by 31st January 2017. 3) No certification will be provided in case of non submission and late fee submission. 4) Once a student is registered in this program he or she is entitled to pay the full fee even if he/she quits in between the program, the entire fee will be made due in student’s account. 5) Registration fee is non-refundable. 6) Registration dates: Opening Date: 19thOct 2016 Closing Date: 28th Oct 2016. Registration: Once student pays his/her registration fee he/she is required to deposit the copy of his payment slip at below mentioned for his registration confirmation before 28th Oct 2016: Contact Person: Mr. Mohit Venue : Block 27-204A

title: GOOGLE ASIA-PACIFIC 2017 UNIVERSITY TEST : (10/14/2016)
body: The Google APAC 2017 University Graduates Test is a tool designed to encourage young students majoring in Computer Science and related fields to test their coding skills.Last year, more than 10,000 students from 20+ countries joined our test.Roughly 1000+ students who scored highly on the programming challenges have also been invited to interview for Software Engineering and related roles in Google. This year, Google opened 2017 Google Asia-Pacific University Test to all University students in the region on June 17th, 2016 onwards till November 06,2016. Key points: 1. title: Summer Research Fellowship Programme 2017 For Students At Indian Academy of Science (SRFP 2017) : (10/5/2016)
body: If you are a student of one of the following courses, then you have an opportunity to attend the Summer Research Fellowship Programme at Indian Academy of Science affiliated institutions. Following is the list of eligible courses. BS / BSc / BVSc / BPharm (II and III years only) BE / BTech / BCA (II and III years only) MS / MSc / MVSc / MPharm (I year only) ME / MTech / MCA (I year only) (5-year integrated) MS / MSc /MTech / MBBS (II, III, IV years only) (dual degree) BTech + MTech (II/III/IV years only) (dual degree) BE + MSc (II, III, IV years only) (dual degree) BS + MS (II, III, IV years only) Integrated PhD (I, II years only) The minimum percentage of average marks in core subjects only (i.e. excluding languages) from X std. up to post-graduation (whichever years completed) should be 65% or above. Students doing PhD are not eligible. Applicants who have availed the Academies fellowship twice before are not eligible to apply. The applicant should include a write-up (in about 150-250 words) as to the specific area of the applicant and indicate what he/she would like to learn and achieve through this fellowship. It can also include the specific experiment or theory that the applicant wants to work on but NOT a general description of the area. The write-up should not be a "copy and paste" job from any source. The last date for receipt of online applications is 30 November 2016. For more information please visit the following link. http://web-japps.ias.ac.in:8080/fellowship2017/application_instructions.jsp

title: Boot Camp for ACM-ICPC 2017 : (9/23/2016)
body: School of Computer Science & Engineering is organizing a boot camp for ACM-ICPC-2017 event, in this we will be discussing about this International Code Tournament. The ACM ICPC is considered as the "Olympics of Programming Competitions". It is quite simply, the oldest, largest, and most prestigious programming contest in the world. The ACM-ICPC (Association for Computing Machinery - International Collegiate Programming Contest) is a multi-tier, team-based, programming competition. Headquartered at Baylor University, Texas, it operates according to the rules and regulations formulated by the ACM. The contest participants come from over 2,000 universities that are spread across 80 countries and six continents. In terms of prize money, the top team takes home $12,000 along with the ACM ICPC 2014 Gold medal. Three other teams getting Gold Medal are awarded $6,000. Each Silver Medal team gets $3,000 and each Bronze Medal team is awarded $1,500. Apart from that, Participants, coaches and registered staff (including volunteer helpers) receive complimentary membership to the ACM for a year. And more important than all, the winners also get some super bragging rights and job offers from some of the top software companies in the world! More Information regarding ACM-ICPC can be checked on following links: https://www.codechef.com/icpc https://icpc.baylor.edu/ Date and Venue Details: Dates: September 26 and September 27 Room No: 34-213 Timings: 5 pm onward Speaker: Mr. Raj Karan Singh Submit your details on following link if you are interested to receive more information regarding ACM-ICPC: http://tinyurl.com/prep-for-contestsLPU

title: Enthusiastic...!!! Form your own Student Organization : (9/8/2016)
body: A Student Organization is a student body initiated, managed and run by the students of the University. It comprises of a group of University students associating with each other and sharing and pursuing common interests. The University aims to provide varied platforms to the students that are of their liking's and enable them to carry out activities to pursue their dreams and goals, develop their dormant skills and experiment and experience to make their learning in the University truly holistic. LPU cares for the other skills, interests, and initiatives of students that may be beyond the purview of regular academic activities. It supports such enterprising students by providing them avenues to initiate, learn and execute project by themselves. Students with common interests are encouraged and allowed to form their organizations and work in areas of their choice. Presently there are over 70 student organizations. Categories: Student Organizations may be presently divided for administrative and logistical convenience into six categories. 1. Academics and Education 2. Cultural 3. Hobbies and Recreation 4. Media & Publication 5. Social Intiative 6. Technical A student who feels the need of forming a new Organization can become a promoter and apply for the same and can download the policy using the path mention below: UMS Navigation >>> Division of Student Affairs >>> Policies >>> Department wise >>> Student Organization Cell You can form your New Student Organization by following these steps: Step 1 - Organization Objective Step 2- Get the Feasibility Check Step 3 - Find the members Step 4 - Registration completed Students can form student organizations to pursue their common interests and work in student driven projects. we would be glad to have you as a new student organization of Student Organization Cell, there is an opportunity for you all to make your own organization to explore yourself. So come forward to join us. For any query you can contact: Mr Nitin Bhardwaj - 99 88 85 85 88 Mr Gautam Sachdeva - 99 88 44 55 90 Block No 13-208 Student Organization Cell

title: A Soft Skill Event- Vakyudh for students from Mittal School of Business (9/5/2016)
body: Dear Students Department of Soft Skills under the aegis of Centre for Professional Enhancement is going to organize a Soft Skill Event- Vakyudh for practicing the debate competition. Real time demonstration of behavioral skills is the basic rationale behind the inclusion of such competitions which includes personal behavior, communication skills along with knowledge of students. Debate is a great device for engaging students and bringing life to the classroom and debate helps learners to see the power of deploying rational, reasoned arguments and compelling evidence in action. Particularly considering the importance of good debates in manifestation of an ever growing society, Vakyudh- a debate competition will be organized to build a habit of constructively presenting and criticizing ideas. Students are given a topic for 2 weeks in advance, so that they can respond with their brimming opinion. The topic for the debate will be “Has the technology made the world a better place?” The students will have to showcase their valid arguments amongst the participants, which will boost their confidence to speak correctly. The purpose of conducting the competition:To let the students improve their communication.To hone the presentation skills of the students.To provide a learning platform for the students to understand the industry expectations.To inculcate the pragmatic approach amongst pupils regarding presenting both the pros and cons constructively. Registration link:https://tinyurl/vakyudh2016 DATE: 7th September 2016 VENUE BLOCK: 18-104.Attachment

title: To apply for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab for the session 2016-17 (Fresh & Renewal of scholarship)-reg. : (9/1/2016)
body: Dear Students, The Punjab Government has announced Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Central Government for SC & OBC category students of Punjab for the session 2016-17. The Punjab Govt. Aashirwad Scholarship Portal has been started w.e.f. 25-Aug.2016. All the students who have submitted their documents for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Punjab are hereby informed to apply online for the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for the session 2016-17 by creating their login id & password in Aashirwad Scholarship. For old students who have applied last year for this scholarship, the students have to use their old user login id & password for applying for the scholarship on the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. The user login id & password (renewal cases) will be sent to you in your my messages in UMS. In this scholarship portal you have to fill your complete information as mentioned in step 1, step 2 & step 3. The link for opening the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal is as under:- www.punjabscholarships.gov.in Step 1: For creating login id & password: The students are advised to fill the following information in the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal as per the class 10th certificate / DMC and certificates / documents issued by the Govt.: 1. Student’s Name 2. Father’s Name 3. Mother’s Name 4. Gender 5. Date of Birth 6. Religion 7. Category 8. Adhaar Card No. 9. Student’s Mobile No. 10. Student’s Email Address 11. Address with Pin Code Step 2: For entering University details, Bank details, Course Details etc.: The students are advised to click at Apply for Scholarship tab to fill the following details:- A. Institute / University Details (a) State - Punjab (b) District - Kapurthala (c) Tehsil - Phagwara (d) Institute /University - Lovely Professional University B. Scheme Related Detail (a) Academic Year – 2016-17 (b) Scheme – Post Matric Scholarship SC/OBC C. Application Related Detail (a) Course (b) Branch (c) Course Year – 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/etc. (d) Admission Date for Academic Year 2016-17 – 01/08/2016 (e) Enrollment Date – 01/08/2016 (f) University Registration / Enrollment Number (g) Special Category (h) Marks in Percentage (%) Obtained in Last Exam – (For new student’s percentage of qualifying examination & for renewal student’s percentage of previous year) D. 10th Class Passing Details (a) Select Board (b) Passing Year (c) 10th Class Roll Number E. Eligibility Related information (a) Family Annual Income (b) Do You Stay in Govt. /Institute Recognized Hostel?(Hostler/Day scholar) (c) Date of Admission in Hostel – 01/08/2016 (d) Caste Certificate No. (e) Caste Certificate Date (f) Caste Certificate Issuing Authority - Tehsildar F. Bank Account Details for Electronic Transfer of Funds (a) Enter IFSC Code (b) Bank Account Number Step 3: For uploading the compulsory documents on Portal: (a) Caste Certificate (b) Income Declaration Certificate / Affidavit (c) Bank Passbook Copy (d) Matric Certificate (e) Passport Size Recent Photograph Students are required to fill the adhaar card number of father & mother in the following tab as given below: Edit Mobile No. / Email Address / Adhaar Number The complete process for filling step 1, step 2 & step 3 is enclosed for your reference as PDF file. Moreover, FAQ’s are also enclosed for clarification & submitting the online application form on Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. After completing the above process, the students have to submit the duly signed print application form & Adhaar Card photocopy of Mother & Father in Block No.32, Room No. 101 on or before 15-Sep-2016 along with all relevant documents. Moreover, user login id & password should be mentioned on the top of the print application & this password should not be changed by the students. If any student has not applied for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab in the session 2015-16 and would like to apply for this scholarship in the session 2016-17 as a fresh candidate, such students can also apply for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab subject to satisfying the above conditions. The students can contact in 32-101. If any student fail to produce the desired documents for the renewal of Post Matric Scholarship for the academic year 2016-17 then their case will not be processed and the student will not be eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab. All the queries related with Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab will be handled at 32-101. In case of any confusion / problem in applying for Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Senior Officer, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102 (between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM). Reporting schedule to visit SSIV Cell already sent through UMS in your my messages box.

title: Measure to prevent viral fever : (8/27/2016)
body: At this time of the year, viral fever is common in occurrence. Its common symptoms include: *Chills *Sore throat *Running nose *Red & watering eyes *body aches *Cough *Headache Please observe following precautions as preventive measures: 1) Wash your hands frequently this will prevent spreading the disease through physical contact 2) Cover your mouth & nose with face mask when in company of infected patients 3) Don't use your palms to cover your mouth while coughing or sneezing as you will transfer virus to your hand which will subsequently transmit it to someone else 4) If you have fever, consult your doctor for advise

title: Workshop on Advanced Automotive Technologies : (8/26/2016)
body: In cars, bikes & automobiles of this age, the emission limits & high performance requirement are increasingly shifting the focus to ECUs because of their flexibility. The mechanical control is being fast replaced by ECU based fuel management systems e.g. CRDi, MPFi, EFI . The technology is getting further advanced like Google Driverless car , Automatic Transmission (AMT), Cruise Control etc. Medhaavi in association with Department of Research & Development, LPU offers you to attend a workshop on latest technologies of automotive where students will be exposed to basic of ECU, and latest automotive technologies. Training will provide student to learn & get hands on experience on latest engine technologies. This will enhance your practical knowledge. It is a great opportunity for the students of LPU to avail benefit though the training program provided by industrial automotive R&D experts. As a mechanical and electronics engineer it gives you exposure to all new area which remains unexplored & opens up a world of opportunities. Why you should attend? 1. To learn latest engine technologies which are the future (CRDi, MPFi, GDI, EFI, etc.) 2. This knowledge will help you bridge the knowledge gap. 3. Have practical look on CRDi engine being controlled from LAPTOP 4. Learn basics of Engine Tuning. 5. Workshop is delivered by industry experts working in advanced engine projects. 6. Knowledge will be handy to clear interviews of Automotive Companies. Registration Detail: Workshop Duration: 2 Days (Saturday and Sunday) Venue: Block-38, Division of Research and Development,LPU Workshop cost: Rs.1350/- Registration Process: 1. title: To apply for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab for the session 2016-17 (Fresh & Renewal of scholarship)-reg. : (8/25/2016)
body: Dear Students, The Punjab Government has announced Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Central Government for SC & OBC category students of Punjab for the session 2016-17. The Punjab Govt. Aashirwad Scholarship Portal has been started w.e.f. 25-Aug.2016. All the students who have submitted their documents for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Punjab are hereby informed to apply online for the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for the session 2016-17 by creating their login id & password in Aashirwad Scholarship. For old students who have applied last year for this scholarship, the students have to use their old user login id & password for applying for the scholarship on the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. The user login id & password (renewal cases) will be sent to you in your my messages in UMS. In this scholarship portal you have to fill your complete information as mentioned in step 1, step 2 & step 3. The link for opening the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal is as under:- www.punjabscholarships.gov.in Step 1: For creating login id & password: The students are advised to fill the following information in the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal as per the class 10th certificate / DMC and certificates / documents issued by the Govt.: 1. Student’s Name 2. Father’s Name 3. Mother’s Name 4. Gender 5. Date of Birth 6. Religion 7. Category 8. Adhaar Card No. 9. Student’s Mobile No. 10. Student’s Email Address 11. Address with Pin Code Step 2: For entering University details, Bank details, Course Details etc.: The students are advised to click at Apply for Scholarship tab to fill the following details:- A. Institute / University Details (a) State - Punjab (b) District - Kapurthala (c) Tehsil - Phagwara (d) Institute /University - Lovely Professional University B. Scheme Related Detail (a) Academic Year – 2016-17 (b) Scheme – Post Matric Scholarship SC/OBC C. Application Related Detail (a) Course (b) Branch (c) Course Year – 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/etc. (d) Admission Date for Academic Year 2016-17 – 01/08/2016 (e) Enrollment Date – 01/08/2016 (f) University Registration / Enrollment Number (g) Special Category (h) Marks in Percentage (%) Obtained in Last Exam – (For new student’s percentage of qualifying examination & for renewal student’s percentage of previous year) D. 10th Class Passing Details (a) Select Board (b) Passing Year (c) 10th Class Roll Number E. Eligibility Related information (a) Family Annual Income (b) Do You Stay in Govt. /Institute Recognized Hostel?(Hostler/Day scholar) (c) Date of Admission in Hostel – 01/08/2016 (d) Caste Certificate No. (e) Caste Certificate Date (f) Caste Certificate Issuing Authority - Tehsildar F. Bank Account Details for Electronic Transfer of Funds (a) Enter IFSC Code (b) Bank Account Number Step 3: For uploading the compulsory documents on Portal: (a) Caste Certificate (b) Income Declaration Certificate / Affidavit (c) Bank Passbook Copy (d) Matric Certificate (e) Passport Size Recent Photograph Students are required to fill the adhaar card number of father & mother in the following tab as given below: Edit Mobile No. / Email Address / Adhaar Number The complete process for filling step 1, step 2 & step 3 is enclosed for your reference as PDF file. Moreover, FAQ’s are also enclosed for clarification & submitting the online application form on Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. After completing the above process, the students have to submit the duly signed print application form & Adhaar Card photocopy of Mother & Father in Block No.32, Room No. 101 on or before 15-Sep-2016 along with all relevant documents. Moreover, user login id & password should be mentioned on the top of the print application & this password should not be changed by the students. If any student has not applied for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab in the session 2015-16 and would like to apply for this scholarship in the session 2016-17 as a fresh candidate, such students can also apply for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab subject to satisfying the above conditions. The students can contact in 32-101. If any student fail to produce the desired documents for the renewal of Post Matric Scholarship for the academic year 2016-17 then their case will not be processed and the student will not be eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab. All the queries related with Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab will be handled at 32-101. In case of any confusion / problem in applying for Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Senior Officer, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell (SSIV Cell) in 32-102 (between 10.00 AM to 04.00 PM). Reporting schedule to visit SSIV Cell will be sent through UMS in your my messages.

title: Workshop on Advanced Automotive Technologies : (8/25/2016)
body: In cars, bikes & automobiles of this age, the emission limits & high performance requirement are increasingly shifting the focus to ECUs because of their flexibility. The mechanical control is being fast replaced by ECU based fuel management systems e.g. CRDi, MPFi, EFI . The technology is getting further advanced like Google Driverless car , Automatic Transmission (AMT), Cruise Control etc. Medhaavi in association with Department of Research & Development, LPU offers you to attend a workshop on latest technologies of automotive where students will be exposed to basic of ECU, and latest automotive technologies. Training will provide student to learn & get hands on experience on latest engine technologies. This will enhance your practical knowledge. It is a great opportunity for the students of LPU to avail benefit though the training program provided by industrial automotive R&D experts. As a mechanical and electronics engineer it gives you exposure to all new area which remains unexplored & opens up a world of opportunities. Why you should attend? 1. To learn latest engine technologies which are the future (CRDi, MPFi, GDI, EFI, etc.) 2. This knowledge will help you bridge the knowledge gap. 3. Have practical look on CRDi engine being controlled from LAPTOP 4. Learn basics of Engine Tuning. 5. Workshop is delivered by industry experts working in advanced engine projects. 6. Knowledge will be handy to clear interviews of Automotive Companies. Registration Detail: Workshop Duration: 2 Days (Saturday and Sunday) Venue: Block-38, Division of Research and Development,LPU Workshop cost: Rs.1350/- Registration Process: 1. An amount of Rs.1350 need to be deposited in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Medhaavi Automotive Research Lab” 2. Student need to fill the registration form on http://tinyurl.com/medhaavilpu by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3. Student need to submit full amount before workshop. 4. Student once register cannot withdraw the application. 5. Registration fees is non refundable 6. Seats are First Come First Serve basis. For any type of query contact: Er. Jai Vikash Sharma (78371-13285) or visit Room No. 108, Block 38

Digital signal processing systems have long enabled interaction of the digital electronics world with the real, analog world. title: Workshop on Advanced Automotive Technologies : (8/20/2016)
body: In cars, bikes & automobiles of this age, the emission limits & high performance requirement are increasingly shifting the focus to ECUs because of their flexibility. The mechanical control is being fast replaced by ECU based fuel management systems e.g. CRDi, MPFi, EFI . The technology is getting further advanced like Google Driverless car , Automatic Transmission (AMT), Cruise Control etc. Medhaavi in association with Department of Research & Development, LPU offers you to attend a workshop on latest technologies of automotive where students will be exposed to basic of ECU, and latest automotive technologies. Training will provide student to learn & get hands on experience on latest engine technologies. This will enhance your practical knowledge. It is a great opportunity for the students of LPU to avail benefit though the training program provided by industrial automotive R&D experts. As a mechanical and electronics engineer it gives you exposure to all new area which remains unexplored & opens up a world of opportunities. Why you should attend? 1. To learn latest engine technologies which are the future (CRDi, MPFi, GDI, EFI, etc.) 2. This knowledge will help you bridge the knowledge gap. 3. Have practical look on CRDi engine being controlled from LAPTOP 4. Learn basics of Engine Tuning. 5. Workshop is delivered by industry experts working in advanced engine projects. 6. Knowledge will be handy to clear interviews of Automotive Companies. If an eligible student does not fill the option, then he/she will be considered in the category of “Continue with LPU” and NO further chance of opting for credit transfer will be given to such a student. 2. title: Counseling and Psychological Support System - CAPSS : (8/11/2016)
body: LPU is offering Confidential and Free Psychological Counseling support to all, in which a special assistance is provided to the individuals in dealing with their behavioral issues/concerns that may affect them negatively. By offering a wide range of counseling services in a friendly environment, we strive to help all, in achieving their academic, personal and relational goals. One may desire to have an empathetic support and genuine feedback for a difficult situation, learn useful self-management skills, improve social relationships, or resolve new or long-standing problematic situations. We are here to provide you all this and much more... CERTAIN SIGNS TO WATCH OUT FOR, WHERE YOU MAY NEED CAPSS SERVICES - Feeling extremely homesick. - Not able to manage with your work load and time. - Feeling lonely and sad. - Experiencing problems in relationships - Unprovoked anger and hostility. - Feelings of inferiority. - Feeling helpless or hopeless. - Despite best efforts unable to adjust. - Feeling stressed up most of the time. - Deterioration in quality of work. - Often feels shy and self-conscious. - Feeling no sense of belonging. - Thoughts about harming your own self or others. - Lack of concentration and confidence. - Excessive fatigue and sleep disturbances. - Experiencing constant anxiety, irritability or fearfulness. - Lack of communication skills. - Don't have any life goals or aims. - Lack of self-control, etc...... It is normal if you have any of the above mentioned signs. We all go through such phases of life where we don't feel equipped enough to help ourselves on our own. In such cases “IT IS OK TO SEEK HELP.” Services Offered: Individual Counseling, Group Counseling, Psychological Testing, and Psychiatric/clinical help. For Psychological Counseling sessions you may visit 1. Khushpinder Sharma Counseling Psychologist Cabin No. 7 (9am-5pm) Contact No: 9815181252 2. Samuel Masih Asst. Counseling Psychologist Cabin No. 10 (11am-7pm) Contact No: 9988278434 at Uni Hospital, Block 8C. LPU

title: CoCubes (Pre assess) Exam for (Engineering/MCA) placement registered students graduating in 2017. (8/5/2016)
body: Dear Aspirants, Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled a renowned exam named CoCubes (Pre Assess) for 2017 batch placement registered students(Engineering/MCA) on 08thAug , 2016. Good Score in CoCubes will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So come prepared and attempt the exam with full enthusiasm. Why CoCubes Exam is important: CoCubes is an industry renowned testing platform. Most of the companies use CoCubes as their testing platform during placement drives. CoCubes is India’s largest assessment and hiring platform. CoCubes helps us in gauging your current performance levels which will be utilized to design customized training inputs for the students. You can know more about CoCubes at: www.cocubes.com Important Instructions: It is mandatory for all the students. Total duration of the exam is 240 minutes approx. containing different modules. You must attempt every module. In case you miss any module your exam will not be considered as completed and will not be evaluated for final result. You can attempt any module at any time within the given time span (9 AM, to 11 PM). Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will help you to get shortlisted for upcoming placement drives. Score of this exam will also be considered for shortlisting students for special training and companies therefore students should attempt this seriously. Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not take this exam, hence attempt the test with full spirit. No Duty Leave will be provided for test attempts. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Therefore, don’t use any unfair means during exam. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. Passkey/Activation Key of exam will be shared with you through UMS my messages on the exam day itself (one hour prior to the exam). Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: SAP Courses to be offered to the Students of CSE/IT : (7/15/2016)
body: Dear Students, You will be pleased to know that LPU has recently tied-up with SAP and the SAP courses are being offered to all the students of CSE/IT. For the students of 3rd year CSE/IT, these courses will start from this coming term i.e. Aug-Dec 2016 and for final year students, courses will run in their 8th term. For the second year, these courses will be offered from next year. SAP is very beneficial for the students and its training costs near about Rs. 2.5 lacs to 3 lacs in open market but at LPU, training will be part of the curriculum without any extra cost.
