title: Counseling and Psychological Support System - CAPSS : (6/30/2016)
body: LPU is offering Confidential and Free Psychological Counseling Services to all, in which a special assistance is given to the individuals in coping up with all of the issues that may affect them negatively. By offering a wide range of counseling services in a friendly environment, we strive to help all, in achieving their academic, personal and relational goals. One may desire to have an empathetic support and genuine feedback for a difficult situation, learn useful self-management skills, improve social relationships, or resolve new or long-standing problematic situations. We are here to provide you all this and much more... CERTAIN SIGNS TO WATCH OUT FOR, WHERE YOU MAY NEED CAPSS SERVICES - Feeling extremely homesick. - Not able to manage with your work load and time. - Feeling lonely and sad. - Experiencing problems in relationships - Unprovoked anger and hostility. - Feelings of inferiority. - Feeling helpless or hopeless. - Despite best efforts unable to adjust. - Feeling stressed up most of the time. - Deterioration in quality of work. - Often feels shy and self-conscious. - Feeling no sense of belonging. - Thoughts about harming your own self or others. - Feeling lack of concentration and confidence. - Excessive fatigue and sleep disturbances. - Experiencing constant anxiety, irritability or fearfulness. - Lack of communication skills. - Don't have any life goals or aims. - Lack of self-control, etc...... It is normal if you have any of the above mentioned signs within you. We all go through such phases of life where we don't feel equipped enough to help ourselves on our own. In such cases “IT IS OK TO SEEK HELP.” Services Offered: Individual Counseling, Group Counseling, Psychological Testing, and Psychiatric/clinical help. For Psychological Counseling sessions you may visit Khushpinder Sharma Counseling Psychologist Uni Hospital (9am-5pm) Contact No: 9815181252

title: A career counseling Workshop by Mr. Deepak Jolly. (6/21/2016)
body: Dear Students In recent times, career counseling has got the recognition it needed. Career counselling in India had never been much popular amongst students. However, people like parents or students now become concerned about one’s career choices due to unsuccessful jobs and stressful lifestyle. Now, students are more inclined towards making a career in the field they are passionate about. And, the most reliable way to understand your career choices is career counselling. Division of Student Welfare, Lovely Professional Enhancement is going to organize A career counseling Workshop by Mr. Deepak Jolly Vice-President, Venturing and Emerging Brands (VEB), Coca-Cola India. Mr. Deepak Jolly will visit the campus to address LPU freshmen and he will speak to all the freshers about his aspirations, failures, and successes, and will motivate them to stay focused, never give up, and pursue their dreams and career with passion. He will share his real time experiences with the students to let them aware about his struggles during achieving his success. It will be a learning affair for the students where they will understand: the importance of dealing with complexities and adverse circumstances at the career frontstumbling blocks in life which halt career growththe espousing the ways to overcome career hurdles. title: ALLOTMENT OF RESIDENTIAL FACILITIES DURING SUMMER . (26th MAY 2016 TO 25th JULY 2016 ). (5/22/2016)
body: Students who seek residential facilities for PEP classes/ Re-appear exams / Summer Term / Training/ skill development classes / freshmen induction volunteer/sports and cultural activities / part time jobs etc. may avail the same as per the guidelines circulated in this notice. The whole process of allotment will be carried through University Management System and student has to use his/her login Id and password to book their seats. PHASE I: As mentioned above, this round will be available for only those students who have registered for PEP classes from 23rd May, 2016 to 15th June, 2016 and are currently hostellers. They will have a facility in the online interface to retain the same room till 15th June, 2016 by using scratch card/Scholar Card. The fee for stay during PEP classes will be a fixed amount of Rs. 2000/-. For booking the seat student should use “Hostel Booking for PEP Students” from UMS Navigation ->Residential booking ->PEP Hostel Booking. IMP: (a) The fee for stay in case of PEP classes i.e. Rs. 2000/- will remain same irrespective of whether student joins the classes on 23rd May itself or later. (b) Student will have to pay electricity charges as per the annexure I during no-dues clearance. (c) Student will get the no dues clearance on 15th June 2016, If he or she booked their hostel seat for PEP classes during round 1. PHASE II: This round will be available for all other categories like Summer term/Re-appear/Training/ skill development classes /freshmen induction/sports and cultural activities and part time jobs etc. The allotment of hostel for these activities will be available from 1st June 2016 onwards however the booking will start from 26th May onwards. For booking hostels during Phase – II, student should use “ Summer Vacation Hostel Booking” from UMS Navigation ->Residential booking ->Summer hostel booking In this booking process, the student has to select the date of stay, check the availability of seats and book the seat. Student can select single day or multiple days . Mode of Payment: payment of stay and electricity charges shall be done through the below mentioned modes:- 1. Scratch cards ( Available at block 33 basement Anil Kumar tuckshop) 2. Scholar Card ( Block 32, basement accounts section, window no. 3, 4 & 5. ) 3. title: Summer training in CISCO Network Academy at Lovely Professional University : (5/13/2016)
body: We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with CISCO has setup CISCO Network Academy in Division of Research and Development. It is a great opportunity for the students of LPU to avail benefit though the training program provided by networking experts. ICT skills and knowledge open a world of possibilities for students looking to gain a competitive edge. This training program will help students be successful in a wide range of networking careers today and in the future Advantages to pursue training program in CISCO Network Academy 1.Two different certificates on each module from CISCO after training 2.Discount in CCNA Certification after training 3.Packet Tracer Simulation Software facility by CISCO to all students 4.Hands on practice on CISCO 1841 series routers and switches 5.Access to Online Curriculum and interactive tools 24 x 7 from anywhere 6.CISCO Facilitates Placement Assistant to CCNA graduates 7.CISCO Course completion Certificate by CISCO after Each Module 8.State of the art online assessments Including quizzes, chapter and final exams, and simulation-based skills exams 9. Student of any year any stream can join the training Registration detail: Duration of training: 6 Weeks (15th June 2016 to 31st July 2016) Venue: Block-38 (Research and development) - Lovely Professional university Training Covers: CCNA 1 & 2 Routing and Switching · Module 1: Introduction to Networks · Module 2: Routing and Switching Essentials Training cost: Rs. 3500/Module Training timing: 2hrs/day (Monday to Friday) Registration Process: 1.An initial amount of Rs. 1000 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Cisco Network Academy” 2.Student need to fill the registration form on www.tinyurl.com/netacadlpu by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3.Student need to submit rest of the amount before 30th May 2016 4.Student once register cannot withdraw the application 5.Registration fees is non refundable 6.Seats are First Come First Serve basis. title: Polling and registration of OE/SSE courses for the Autumn Term 2016-17 (Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/160428/001) : (4/28/2016)
body: The registration of Open Electives (OE) and Social Science Electives (SSE) for Autumn Term of Session 2016-2017 shall start at 5:30 PM on April 30, 2016 and end at 5:30 PM on May 06, 2016. Students can register for the same through UMS either inside campus or from outside campus. The interface for registration will be available 24 hours a day till the end date. The registration of Open Electives (OE) and Social Science Electives (SSE) for Autumn Term of Session 2016-2017 shall be as follows: 1. For all Honors students the polling cum registration interface will be open at 5:30 PM on April 29, 2016. This interface will remain deactivated from 03:30pm to 05:30pm on April 29, 2016 and April 30, 2016. 2. For all other programmes the polling interface will be open at 5:30 PM on April 30, 2016 and close at 5:30 PM on May 06, 2016. Students can register for the same through UMS either inside campus or from outside campus. The interface for registration will be available 24 hours a day till the end date as mentioned above. Please note that if a student does not participate in registration up to 5:30 PM on May 06, 2016, he/she will be allotted the course in which seats are left vacant as per system logic and no request for allotting his/her preference will be entertained. The detail of registration process has been attached with this announcement. In order to check whether OE/SSE is applicable in the next term, a student can refer to the attached file “Applicable programs for OE SSE polling of Autumn Term 2016-17.xls” with this announcement. Important Note: All the students are informed to carefully study the course write-ups (available at link: UMS Navigation -> Learning Management System (LMS) -> Open/Social Sci. Elective Registration) in order to shortlist the course they would like to select. This careful analysis will help in making good choice of courses. The course write-ups will remain deactivated from 3:30 pm of April 29, 2016 to 05:30pm of April 30, 2016 for Non Honors students.

body: Aspiring Minds is hiring Research and Development Engineer for Technology team. Research engineers form the backbone of Aspiring Minds and hence it is looking for only the best minds of the country to fill these positions. It plans to be very selective in this hiring. Open Positions: Aspiring Minds is offering two positions in its technology team a) Research & Development Engineer b) Summer Research Intern Research & Development Engineer (2016 passout batch) Package Offered: The offered package for the roles is Rs 14 Lac per annum Registration Link: https://docs.google.com/a/aspiringminds.in/forms/d/1WPBXLnHaY8fCyY9mCci-HCy_JooVuPTf2GKCtfGDJ9A/viewform Summer Research Intern (1st, 2nd and 3rd year are eligible to apply) Stipend during Internship: Rs 25,000 per month. title: FOUR WEEK IN HOUSE SUMMER TRAINING ON PLC AND SCADA : (4/18/2016)
body: It is for the information of all 3rd Year ECE/EEE/EE students that Control and Instrumentation Department is organizing FOUR WEEK IN HOUSE SUMMER TRAINING ON PLC and SCADA in the month of June 2016 The students can easily explore further in Industrial Automation with the help such kind of training program. The training program is mainly designed for ECE/EEE/EE 3rd year B.Tech students, but others (B.Tech/M.Tech) can also register for the same. The highlights of the training are: 1) PLC hardware (Allen-bradley- Rockwell Automation) including measurements 2) Basic and Advance PLC programming (RS Logix 500) 3) Interfacing of PLC hardware and software (Human Machine Interface) 4) Concepts of SCADA system 5) SCADA software (Wonderware in-touch) for process supervision. Eligibility, Fee & other details: 1) Any B.Tech/M.Tech ECE/EEE/EE students are eligible (irrespective of CGPA/number of backlogs). 2) Total no. of seat is 30 (Thirty). If the application received is more than the total number of seats available then selection will be on the basis of the performance of the student in the written test (online). The link for applying for the training program is: http://tinyurl.com/j9ms8mh 3) The online test will comprise of 30 questions (in 45 minutes). The syllabus for the written test will be: Digital Electronics, Microprocessors/Microcontrollers, Basics of instrumentation & measurements. 4) Fee for the training program will be INR 5500/- (Five thousand and five hundred only). 5) Classes will be conducted in all the week days (except Sunday). Daily classes will be held from morning 10:00 AM to 04:00 PM with 1 hour lunch break from 1:00 PM-2:00 PM. 6) Students will get the certificate on successful completion of training fulfilling condition of completed project work & 80% attendance criteria. Important Dates: 1) Registration open: 6th April 2016 to 20th April 2016 2) Conduct of test: 22nd April 2016 (Tentative) 3) Announcement of Test result on UMS: By 25th April 2016 4) Submission of fee: On or before 30th April 2016. 5) Submission of fee against the non-filled seats by the waiting list candidate: By 5th May 2016. 6) The training will tentatively starts from 16th June 2016 & last till 15th July 2016. For Further details please contact: Mr. Pardeep Mittal (UID: 18341) Asstt. Professor /Certified Automation Engineer 9888342415 Room No: 36-201, Cabin: 8

title: Summer training in CISCO Network Academy at Lovely Professional University : (4/15/2016)
body: We are pleased to announce that Lovely Professional University in collaboration with CISCO has setup CISCO Network Academy in Division of Research and Development. It is a great opportunity for the students of LPU to avail benefit though the training program provided by networking experts. ICT skills and knowledge open a world of possibilities for students looking to gain a competitive edge. This training program will help students be successful in a wide range of networking careers today and in the future Advantages to pursue training program in CISCO Network Academy 1.Two different certificates on each module from CISCO after training 2.Discount in CCNA Certification after training 3.Packet Tracer Simulation Software facility by CISCO to all students 4.Hands of practice on CISCO 1841 series routers and switches 5.Access to Online Curriculum and interactive tools 24 x 7 from anywhere 6.CISCO Facilitates Placement Assistant to CCNA graduates 7.CISCO Course completion Certificate by CISCO after Each Module 8.State of the art online assessments Including quizzes, chapter and final exams, and simulation-based skills exams Registration detail: Duration of training: 6 Weeks (15th June 2016 to 31st July 2016) Venue: Block-38 (Research and development) - Lovely Professional university Training Covers: CCNA 1 & 2 Routing and Switching · Module 1: Introduction to Networks · Module 2: Routing and Switching Essentials Training cost: Rs. 3500/Module Training timing: 2hrs/day (Monday to Friday) Registration Process: 1.An initial amount of Rs. 1000 need to be submitted in accounts department 32-103 under fees for “Cisco Network Academy” 2.Student need to fill the registration form on www.tinyurl.com/netacadlpu by providing all basic information of student along with payment receipt number. 3.Student need to submit rest of the amount before 30th May 2016 4.Student once register cannot withdraw the application 5.Registration fees is non refundable 6.Seats are First Come First Serve basis. For any type of query contact: Gulshan Kumar 8146524362 Room No 203, Block 38

body: In an attempt to bring all lovers of literature under one banner, DSA has started LitSoc, Lovely Professional University's official Literary Society. English, Hindi and all regional languages. REGISTRATION AND MEMBERSHIP : Registration is open and free. Free - only for the month of April! So, Hurry Up! log on to http://tinyurl.com/LITSOC11 and fill up the form. Executive leadership positions up for grabs, early birds shall be given preference in office allocation. If you want to become better public speakers, we will help you polish your skills. If you are a writer, aching to be heard, we'll give you audience and guidance. If you are a poet, we'll listen to the musings of your heart and share in your experiences. If you are a quiz-master, we'll test you, tease your knowledge and push to become better. If you are tech-savvy, please come and make our media engagement a success. We'll provide your awesome performances, you provide us an online presence. If you are keen on learning, we'll make you aware of, and critically analyse all burning social and policy issues turning the country, in our weekly symposium meetings. WE ARE HERE TO FEED YOUR HUNGER FOR KNOWLEDGE AND SUCCESS IN DEBATES/ EXTEMPORE/ ELOCUTION/ QUIZ Et Al. So, PULL YOUR NERDY SWAGGER UP AND JOIN IN ASAP. title: Part Time Job as Admission Counselor : (4/14/2016)
body: Division of Admission is recruiting students for Part Time Job as Admission Counselor. The Requirements are as follows: 1. Nature of Job: Depends on the Task allotted to Concerned Counselor, it may be Counseling through walk in or telephonically or through web chat session or replying through email, entering enquiries in database, handling postal transactions, handling campus visit, Admission Processing etc. 2. Desired Qualification/Skill Set/Experience: a) Student of Diploma/UG/PG can apply( but no active backlogs) b) Students having any curriculum requirement(like Internship/PEP /Placement activity scheduled during the period of Job need not apply c) Student should have Good Communication Skills, ability to work in a Team, good information of LPU strengths, Processes and interfaces, good knowledge of using internet/computer/Social Networking/office tools. d) Students who have already worked or working in Division of Admissions may be preferred e) Exposure of handling telephonic Calls. 3. Date of Joining/Leaves/Salary etc. : a) After completion of End term examination i.e. 20th May 2016 or earlier if exam is over and Date of relieving will be one day before the start of Classes (Students who are interested to work only till mid/end of July but not in the first week of August need not apply) b) Salary will be Credited to student account on monthly basis c) 3 Casual Leaves are allowed in total. For leaves more than the prescribed limit, salary will be deducted as per University Policy. d) Estimated number of Days in a week are 6 e) Compensatory off will be Awarded in lieu of Working on Sundays and University Holidays. In case student does not avail compensatory leave, he will be compensated monetarily. f) Generally time Slot is 9 AM to 5 PM but in certain cases it may be on shift basis e.g. in call center- timings may be 7 AM-2 PM or 12 PM -7 PM. In certain cells, duties on rotation may be assigned to stay for more than 8 hrs on certain days. g) Stay for the duration of the service -- Rs. 1000/- per month(4 Seaters -Air Cooler) h) Food charges -- As per actual to be paid to Mess Contractor 3. Selection Procedure: Selection procedure may include written test on University facts, personal Interview. Interested Students can register through following link till 14/04/2016 http://tinyurl.com/studentcounselor2016 Information of the shortlisted students will be displayed on UMS

body: This is for the information of all continuing students that they can apply for Change of Programme as per the attached Guidelines and Timelines. All the students who have submitted their wish to change the higher degree under “Taking Option for Continuation and Discontinuation of higher degree” have to submit the signed applications as per timelines. The students should read the guidelines thoroughly before applying. The Application Form can be downloaded from attachment of Formats and must be submitted (i.e. Annexure-1 and Annexure-2 complete in all respects) along with Undertaking (i.e. Annexure-4) at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32, 102(window no.2) as per attached timelines. No applications will be entertained after that. A student may download the form and undertaking and fill it up in his/her own handwriting in CAPITAL LETTERS, get it signed from the parents, scan it and e-mail it to academic.aac@lpu.co.in. The email should be with subject “Change of Programme for Continuing Students-Registration No-” In the ‘Without Compounding Fee’ phase, immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rs.1,000/- will be debited to the account of the student as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee. The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32 ,102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rs.1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee to the Department of Accounts. In the ‘With Compounding Fee’ phase, immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rs. 3,000/- (upto 15th July, 2016) and Rs. 4000/-(upto 1st August, 2016) will be debited to the account of the student as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee. The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32,102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rs. 3,000/- (upto 15th July, 2016) and Rs.4000/-(upto 1st August, 2016) as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee to the Department of Accounts. All students whose Change of Programme who application is approved must pay the ‘Change of Programme Fee’ as per timelines. Failing to pay the fee as per timelines, the approval for their Change of Programme will stand cancelled and they shall continue in their current programme. The ‘Change of Programme’ Fee must be paid in person and no facility of online payment will be available. Students must plan their travel arrangements well in advance for this. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old programme after approval of Change of Programme request or after paying the ‘Change of Programme Fee’.Students must read the enclosed ‘Guidelines for Change of Programme’ carefully before they apply for change of programme. In case of any query, kindly report to DAA Window (Block 32-102).

body: Allotment of Residential Facilities for Academic Session 2016-17 has started from 25th March 2016 onwards. The whole process of allotment will be carried through UMS (University Management System) and student has to use his/her login Id and password to book the seats. The whole process has been divided into 3 Phases. Detail of Phases is given below. Phases Process Start date End date Purpose/Details Queries to be resolved at: Phase 1 Activation of Scholar Card- I Cash Card Detail is given in Annexure-2 25th Mar 2016 05th April 201 6 Registration fees of Rs. 1000/- required for participation in online hostel booking will be paid through Scholar Card/I Cash card only. So to initiate registration process (Phase-2) your must have recharge/TOP up minimum amount of Rs. 1000/- . The registration amount of Rs 1000/- will be adjusted in the residential fee. Block 32, basement accounts section, window no. 3, 4 & 5. Programme. List is attached in Annexure 12. b) Students with CGPA equal to or more than 8.0 (or Marks equal to or more than 75% as per the result declared. List is attached in Annexure 12. c) Students represented University in Sports/Cultural/Co-Curricular activities etc. List is attached in Annexure 13. OMC - Division of Residential services Block 29, Room No. 301 Round –II For all Boys At 18.00 hrs on 18th April 2016 At 23.59 hrs on 21st April 2016 For all students whether they are Hostelers or not Round –II For all Girls At 18.00 hrs on 19th April 2016 Important information: 1. Residential Facilities will be provided till the end of the regular academic session including regular exams or 10 months from the start of the session, whichever is earlier. Students can come and join two days prior to start of academic session and will be required to vacate Residential room/apartment within two days after regular exams. For availing Residential facility after the end of academic session for any purpose like summer school/reappear examination /PEP classes etc., additional proportionate residential fee will have to be paid by the student, subject to the availability and permission of Division of Residential Services. 2. Extra electricity bill due to the usage of these electrical items will be borne by the respective residents. 4. title: Register for Infosys India's: Infy Maker Awards - 2016 : (4/5/2016)
body: The Infy Maker Awards were started by the Infosys Foundation USA in September 2015, to support the maker movement in the United States. The awards aim to popularize the spirit of making in everyday learning and celebrate creative excellence. Following the success of the Infy Maker Awards in the United States, the program goes global with the launch of the Infy Maker Awards ‒ India to bring forth the concept of ‘making’ in India. In line with Infosys’ commitment to identify ideas and solutions to accelerate positive change in India, Infosys announced the launch of the Infy Maker Awards ‒ India, in February 2016. The Infy Maker Awards – India have been instituted with an objective to ignite the spirit of making in everyday learning and celebrate creative excellence. An extension of the Infy Maker Awards in the United States started by the Infosys Foundation USA, the Infy Maker Awards – India will recognize and reward deserving makers in India whose ideas and solutions have potential to solve real world problems. In its first edition, 20 winning ideas will be presented an award of INR 5 Lakh each. Through these awards Infosys aims to help create more makers to enable an ecosystem of forward-thinking innovation. This event will give student, a unique window to showcase their creativity, igniting in them, a passion to make. Key Mentions : 1. The Infy Maker Awards – India will run annually 2. The first cycle that starts on March 1, 2016 will be open to entries from adults (above 18 years) 3. Participants will be required to make submissions in the form of videos that can be uploaded on the Infy Maker Awards ‒ India website from March 1 ‒ April 15, 2016 4. Shortlisted entries will be judged on relevance to real world problems, innovative uses of technology, originality of ideas and quality of presentations For Registration and more info: http://www.infymakers.com/india/ Direct Registration Link: http://infosys.tallenge.com/

title: Vikrant Presents “National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)” : (4/4/2016)
body: Vikrant - Lovely Professional University presents the “National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)” team at campus. The NDRF Team will be interacting and demonstrating their working followed by an exhibition. The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) is a specialized force constituted "for the purpose of specialist response to a threatening disaster situation or disaster" under the Disaster Management Act, 2005. In the previous years, NDRF has proved its efficacy with its commendable performance during various disasters including the drowning cases, building collapses, landslides, devastating floods and Cyclones. NDRF has saved 133,192 human lives and retrieved 276 dead bodies of disaster victims in 73 response operations in the country. Event Details: Date: 5th April, 2016 Timing: 12:00 PM TO 05:00 PM Venue: Baldev Raj Mittal Auditorium Vikrant - Lovely Professional University invites you all to witness the event. (Duty Leave will be provided for the same)

body: Socio Startup is a social B-Plan competition of "Vikrant" that strives to create a positive societal impact by providing a forum for self-sustainable social entrepreneurship plans which seek to sensitize its participants about their responsibility and the potential difference that they can make towards the society. title: A Two Days workshop on Cloud Computing powered by IBM Business Partner : (3/31/2016)

title: Policy related to PG/rented accommodation (3/29/2016)
body: LPU has always strived to provide a composite educational environment to all its students. Students from all states of India and many countries across the globe study here. It becomes our responsibility to make sure that students get safe, hygienic, and conducive residential facilities on the campus itself. The prime objective here is to make sure that the students admitted in LPU must get a quality living experience that supports them throughout their career and provide every opportunity to develop them as individual. However, as per our experience students sometime decide to stay outside the university in privately owned room (PG) or shared accommodation, which apart from its safety concerns may tempt them to social evil, which at their young age appears to be very attractive but is harmful in long term. University has decided to enforce the following policy to ensure that all those students, who decide to stay outside the university in PGs / shared accommodation, get the appropriate accommodation and that after physical verification by their parent(s). a) Parents of all such students will be required to visit the PG / Shared accommodation (where their ward intends to stay) personally and submit the following documents on or before 30th June 2016. i. Two Photographs (Post Card Size) of PG / rented accommodation taken with parents present in the accommodation. One photograph showing building from outside and the second one showing the room. Parents should be part of the photographs and it should be clicked with parents present in PG / rented accommodation. ii. Duly filled form as per Annexure – I. iii. Undertaking by Parent(s) as per Annexure – II. iv. Undertaking by Owner of the PG/Rented Accommodation as per Annexure – III. b) The attendance for the next semester (commencing August 2016) will be activated only after submission of above mentioned documents by the due date. c) The documents will be submitted by Parent(s) in person only. d) The documents should be submitted in Block 30, Room No. 108. e) Documents as mentioned above cannot be submitted partially. f) International students may submit the documents as mentioned above after their own signatures in place of their parents. Similarly photographs may be submitted without presence of parents. NOTE: The above policy will not be applicable to. a) Students staying in University Residential Facilities. b) Students directly coming from their permanent residence within 60 Kms of university campus. In case of any queries, concerned may write at accommodation.verify@lpu.co.in or may visit at Record and Verification Cell, Block 30, Room No. 108. Attachment: Attach ListOfDocument.doc Uploaded By: Record and Verification Cell Block 30, Room No. 108.

title: Counseling and Psychological Support System - CAPSS : (3/29/2016)
body: LPU is offering Confidential and Free Psychological Counseling Services to all, in which a special assistance is given to the individuals in coping up with all of the issues that may affect them negatively. By offering a wide range of counseling services in a friendly environment, we strive to help all, in achieving their academic, personal and relational goals. One may desire to have an empathetic support and genuine feedback for a difficult situation, learn useful self-management skills, improve social relationships, or resolve new or long-standing problematic situations. We are here to provide you all this and much more... CERTAIN SIGNS TO WATCH OUT FOR, WHERE YOU MAY NEED CAPSS SERVICES - Feeling extremely homesick. - Not able to manage with your work load and time. - Feeling lonely and sad. - Experiencing problems in relationships - Unprovoked anger and hostility. - Feelings of inferiority. - Feeling helpless or hopeless. - Despite best efforts unable to adjust. - Feeling stressed up most of the time. - Deterioration in quality of work. - Often feels shy and self-conscious. - Feeling no sense of belonging. - Thoughts about harming your own self or others. - Feeling lack of concentration and confidence. - Excessive fatigue and sleep disturbances. - Experiencing constant anxiety, irritability or fearfulness. - Lack of communication skills. - Don't have any life goals or aims. - Lack of self-control, etc...... It is normal if you have any of the above mentioned signs within you. We all go through such phases of life where we don't feel equipped enough to help ourselves on our own. In such cases “IT IS OK TO SEEK HELP.” Services Offered: Individual Counseling, Group Counseling, Psychological Testing, and Psychiatric/clinical help. For Psychological Counseling sessions you may visit 1. Khushpinder Sharma Counseling Psychologist Cabin No. 11 (9am-5pm) Contact No: 9815181252 2. Samuel Masih Asst. title: Looking for a short term Research and Internship Program in United States? : (3/28/2016)
body: Global Experience & Training (GET) offers you a unique opportunity to get a short term research and internship program in United States. What Does a GET Opportunity Typically Include? Each GET opportunity is unique, however all opportunities offer fieldwork and a distinguished learning experience. Along with research and career-related opportunities, participants will be immersed in cultural experiences such as visits to museum exhibits, field trips to U.S. landmarks, recreational activities, theatre and musical productions, and national holiday events. GET opportunities include a combination of some or all of these activities: hands-on research, laboratory time, mentorship, industry-focused lectures, and site visits to companies and organizations relevant or influential to a specific field. Opportunities are full time, requiring 30-40 hours of work per week, and can range from six weeks to six months in duration. GET opportunities include: • Software engineering development for cancer research in Chicago • Design, construction and maintenance of sustainable infrastructure projects in New York City • Chicago-based technology companies using the Lean Startup method and entrepreneurial best practices • Voice-controlled robotic vehicle development in New Jersey's metropolitan area Eligibility/Requirements · English proficiency (TOEFL, IELTS or other exam preferred, a language assessment interview can be arranged, candidates who have completed a degree from a university in English are exempt from this requirement). · Statement of Purpose · Letter of Recommendation · Copy of Transcript · Copy of Passport · Resume/CV · Letter of Financial Support Costs The program costs range from $5,000 to $10,000, depending on the GET opportunity, length and location in the United States. title: Counseling and Psychological Support System - CAPSS : (3/21/2016)
body: LPU is offering Confidential and Free Psychological Counselling Services to all, in which a special assistance is given to the individuals in coping up with all of the issues that may affect them negatively. By offering a wide range of counselling services in a friendly environment, we strive to help all, in achieving their academic, personal and relational goals. One may desire to have an empathetic support and genuine feedback for a difficult situation, learn useful self-management skills, improve social relationships, or resolve new or long-standing problematic situations. We are here to provide you all this and much more... CERTAIN SIGNS TO WATCH OUT FOR, WHERE YOU MAY NEED CAPSS SERVICES - Feeling extremely homesick. - Not able to manage with your work load and time. - Feeling lonely and sad. - Experiencing problems in relationships - Unprovoked anger and hostility. - Feelings of inferiority. - Feeling helpless or hopeless. - Despite best efforts unable to adjust. - Feeling stressed up most of the time. - Deterioration in quality of work. - Often feels shy and self-conscious. - Feeling no sense of belonging. - Thoughts about harming your own self or others. - Feeling lack of concentration and confidence. - Excessive fatigue and sleep disturbances. - Experiencing constant anxiety, irritability or tearfulness. - Lack of communication skills. - Don't have any life goals or aims. - Lack of self-control, etc...... It is normal if you have any of the above mentioned signs with you. We all go through such phases of life where we don't feel equipped enough to help ourselves on our own. In such cases “IT IS OK TO SEEK HELP.” Services Offered: Individual Counselling, Group Counselling, Psychological Testing, and Psychiatric/clinical help. For Psychological Counselling sessions you may visit 1. Khushpinder Sharma Counselling Psychologist Cabin No. 11 (9am-5pm) Contact: 9815181252 2. Samuel Masih Asst. Counselling Psychologist Cabin No. 10 (11am-7pm) Contact: 9592395014 at Uni Hospital, Block 8C. LPU

title: Employability Diagnostic Test: Revised Schedule of Second & Third Test : (3/19/2016)
body: Enhance your aptitude, communication skills & general awareness by practice: Free of cost tests, scholarships on offer additionally In the modern evaluation system for any recruitment drive, shortlisting procedures or employability, the first hurdle that you need to cross is that of the trio – General Awareness, Numerical Aptitude & Verbal ability cum Logical reasoning. On the other hand, the fact cannot be denied that the above three cannot be learnt or taught, it can only be exercised. In order to keep your aptitude alive, your logical reasoning reasonable enough and your awareness updated, Department of Youth Capital, Division of Student Affairs in association with one of the best in the field, Career Launchers presents to you the following: 1. Verbal Ability & Logical Reasoning Test Second Test: 29th March 2016, 9.15 AM (Duty Leave shall be granted to the participants from 8:00 AM – 11:00 AM) Third Test: 30th March 2016, 9.15 AM (Duty Leave shall be granted to the participants from 8:00 AM – 11:00 AM) Syllabus of each of the set is attached. 2. Numerical Aptitude Test Second Test: 29th March 2016, 10.45 AM (Duty Leave shall be granted to the participants from 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM) Third Test: 30th March 2016, 10.45 AM (Duty Leave shall be granted to the participants from 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM) Syllabus of each of the set is attached. 3. General Awareness Second Test: 29th March 2016, 12.45 PM (Duty Leave shall be granted to the participants from 12:00 PM – 3:00 PM) Third Test: 30th March 2016, 12.45 PM (Duty Leave shall be granted to the participants from 12:00 PM – 3:00 PM) Syllabus of each of the set is attached. ********THERE IS NO REGISTRATION FEE FOR THIS COMPETITION******** The salient features of the test are: · Series will be divided into three tests each consisting of not more than 6-7 topics (so no pressure of long syllabus). Best two out of three shall be considered, hence does not matter in case you have missed out on the first. · Tests will be for all Students irrespective of year of study. · Two best of three tests will be taken into consideration for final evaluation. · All tests will be after 5 pm: so no need to miss out on any class · Proper test review sheet would be provided so as to enhance the weaker areas. · Tests have been strategically planned by Career Launcher. · Tests will be free of cost. We do understand that in this fast moving world, everyone is looking for added on features. So here it is. While you are becoming better with practice, recognizing your strengths & weakness, we have a handsome awards & felicitations of offer. Awards and Recognitions by Division of Student Affairs: a. The highest scorer & second highest scorer of each of the stages shall be awarded CERTIFICATE OF MERIT certified by DSA, LPU b. Overall highest scorer and runner up shall be awarded certificates & trophy. Awards and Recognitions through CAREER LAUNCHERS: · If a student is topper in all three stages, 50% scholarship on Total fee of Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses would be provided to the student. · If student is topper in any two stages, 40% Scholarship on Total fee of Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses would be provided to the student. · Topper of One stage will get 30% Off on Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses. · If a student is in the top 10 List of more than 1 stage, he will get 20% Scholarship on Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses. · 10% Scholarship would be provided to Top 10 students of each stage. · Scholarship of Rs. 1000 on our Prep. Courses would be provided to all the students who participate and score positive marks in any stage. · Toppers of any stage would get Goodies from Career Launcher as well, which may include bags etc. · Certificates would be provided to all the students. Hurry up and register at www.youthvibe.in/concoction or www.tinyurl.com/dyc-cl-test

title: United Nations Academic Impact Global Youth Forum Opportunity to Represent in New York : (3/15/2016)
body: Brief description: 2016 MANY LANGUAGES, ONE WORLD Student Essay Contest is open to international students around the world. Sixty students will be selected as delegates to the 2016 United Nations Academic Impact Global Youth Forum, 25-31 July 2016, where they will create action plans related to the United Nations 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. Location: United Nations Headquarters in New York City. Topic: Global citizenship and cultural understanding Number of Awards: 60 Target group: International students who are 18 and above Prize: Airfare, Room and Meals will be provided. Eligibility: You must be a full-time university student, recommended and endorsed by a Faculty Member or University Representative, and must be 18 years of age or older by the contest deadline. Application instructions: Write an original essay (2,000 words or less) discussing global citizenship and cultural understanding and the role that multilingual ability can play in fostering these. The essay should reflect your personal, academic, cultural and national context. Essays must be written in an official language of the United Nations that is not your first language or primary language of instruction during your primary or secondary education. The official United Nations languages are Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian and Spanish. You will need to demonstrate both written and verbal competency in the language of the essay. The submission deadline is 31 March 2016 at 11:59pm Eastern Standard Time (EST). It is important to visit the official website (link found below) to access the application form and for detailed information on how to apply for this scholarship. Website: Official Competition Website: http://www.els.edu/en/ManyLanguagesOneWorld Deadline: 31 Mar 2016 (annual) Location: New York, USA Forum Date: 25 – 31 July 2016

title: World Cultural Festival – Making Life a Celebration!!! : (3/9/2016)
body: The World Culture Festival 2016 is a celebration of The Art of Living's 35 years of service to humanity, spirituality and human values. The festival will celebrate the diversity in cultures from across the world while simultaneously highlighting our unity as a human family. Spread over a venue of 1000 acres and expected to be attended by 3.5 million people from 155 countries, the World Culture Festival will be one of the biggest cultural gatherings in the recent times. This is one whopping event that has got a mammoth team working on the ground now, coordinating with the compassionate earth to embrace a 7 acre long stage, the largest ever stage, almost the size of six football fields, that will see over 25,000 artists perform for the Festival. The very best of artists, directors and managers of sound, light, wind, water and earth are putting their best foot forward to stage the World Culture Festival 2016. Besides the big gamut of vivid cultures on display, there would be keynote addresses by luminaries, an interactive leadership forum, an inter-faith meet to boost humanitarianism, guided meditations, and musical and dance performances. The grand spectacle will witness a multitude of dancers, musicians, religious leaders, eminent personalities and people from all walks of life come together to celebrate our enormous diversity. The world’s biggest family is catching up, and we would love you to be a part of it. title: World Cultural Festival – Making Life a Celebration!!! : (3/5/2016)
body: The World Culture Festival 2016 is a celebration of The Art of Living's 35 years of service to humanity, spirituality and human values. The festival will celebrate the diversity in cultures from across the world while simultaneously highlighting our unity as a human family. Spread over a venue of 1000 acres and expected to be attended by 3.5 million people from 155 countries, the World Culture Festival will be one of the biggest cultural gatherings in the recent times. This is one whopping event that has got a mammoth team working on the ground now, coordinating with the compassionate earth to embrace a 7 acre long stage, the largest ever stage, almost the size of six football fields, that will see over 25,000 artists perform for the Festival. The very best of artists, directors and managers of sound, light, wind, water and earth are putting their best foot forward to stage the World Culture Festival 2016. Besides the big gamut of vivid cultures on display, there would be keynote addresses by luminaries, an interactive leadership forum, an inter-faith meet to boost humanitarianism, guided meditations, and musical and dance performances. The grand spectacle will witness a multitude of dancers, musicians, religious leaders, eminent personalities and people from all walks of life come together to celebrate our enormous diversity. The world’s biggest family is catching up, and we would love you to be a part of it. Event Date: 11 – 13 March 2016 Venue: New Delhi Entry Free, For Registration and Itinerary Contact: 9855255444, 98888846209, 9915474017 http://tinyurl.com/WCFLPU www.artofliving.org/world-culture-festival

title: Think-A-Thon " Hewlett Packard Enterprise Coding Contest " : (3/4/2016)
body: Dear Students, Hewlett Packard Enterprise is conducting second Think-A-Thon - a hackathon specifically for College Students. As the name suggests, this hackathon will involve a lot of work for your grey matter. This hackathon will put you through your paces and test you for your algorithmic skills. There will be a total of 20 Multiple choice questions and 4 Programming questions with varying difficulty levels, which should be solved over a duration of 6 Hours. Participants who solve the problems correctly in the shortest span of time will be adjudged the winner. In the Programming questions, usage of language is restricted to C, C++, Java and Perl. There are great prizes to be won(kindly refer to the attached file): 1st Prize: HP Pavilion x360 Laptop 2nd Prize: HP Pavilion x2 Detachable Laptop 3rs Prize: HP 7 Voice Tab Apart from this there are exciting internship opportunities up for grabs. So what are you waiting for? Indulge in 6 hours of intense coding fun and win amazing prizes. title: Notification from Department of Youth Capital Regarding Code of Conduct of Participants : (3/1/2016)
body: Stage is considered to be a Sacred Place for all the artists across the globe. Having an opportunity to be on that is treated to be one of the greatest gift in life of the artists. However, in the past and the present as well, it has been found that people are taking the stage for granted. In the lights of the recent activities, Department of Youth Capital, hereby notifies the following: a. It must clearly be noted by all participants, that we do not encourage (rather restrict) the use of Bollywood Tracks, music’s, dialogues, instrumental and all their variations. It must be taken as a RULE and it is as simple as that and should be considered as UNDEBATABLE. Similarly, it is also understood that for all University events, selection of tracks from non-Bollywood or Albums must also be sensible and reasonable. We believe our students are grown enough to differentiate between a good track and a bad one. Similarly use of foul language on stage (either in lyrics or action) too is a serious offence. b. Secondly, selection of one candidate / participant for stage performance is subject to rejection of some other, as there is a limited number of performances that can be put on stage. However, some students are taking this very casually and appear for auditions, get selected and do not appear on the day of the event. There are two major concerns in this regards, one is that the individuals are responsible for spoiling the show, or at least attempting to; secondly it spoils the mood of the judges and organizers and thirdly it is at the cost of someone else’s opportunity. We do understand that there can be enumerable unavoidable circumstances which can make one not turn up, such as medical issues, etc. but not informing the organizers about the same is highly irresponsible. Taking into account, the seriousness of this matter and its frequency as studied from the past, we have decided to take some action in this regards. The following are the immediate corrective measures that needs to be taken: a. Use of Bollywood tracks or its variations hereafter shall not only lead to disqualification but also to BAN on the individual / group for a minimum of 2 competitions / events. b. People who are selected after auditions shall be required to submit an undertaking that they shall compete in the right spirit and in case of any unavoidable circumstances which may lead to absence or delay in performance shall inform to the concerned organizers. c. All absentees of LPU’s Got Talent who did not turn up to the competitions on the respective day of competition shall EXPLAIN in WRITTEN, their justification for the same within 72 hours to Block 13-203, failing which they can be banned from all activities of Department of Youth Capital, Division of Student Affairs which may also include Youth Vibe 2016, Concoction 2016 & Magnitude 2016. For kind information of all concerned.

body: In the modern evaluation system for any recruitment drive, shortlisting procedures or employability, the first hurdle that you need to cross is that of the trio – General Awareness, Numerical Aptitude & Verbal ability cum Logical reasoning. On the other hand, the fact cannot be denied that the above three cannot be learnt or taught, it can only be exercised. In order to keep your aptitude alive, your logical reasoning reasonable enough and your awareness updated, Department of Youth Capital, Division of Student Affairs in association with one of the best in the field, Career Launchers presents to you the following: 1. General Awareness (Set of three test, each with distinct syllabus on 16th, 23rd & 30th March. 2016: Syllabus of each of the set is attached. The salient features of the test are: · Series will be divided into three tests each consisting of not more than 6-7 topics (so no pressure of long syllabus) · Tests will be for all Students irrespective of year of study. · Two best of three tests will be taken into consideration for final evaluation. · All tests will be after 5 pm: so need to miss out on any class · Proper test review sheet would be provided so as to enhance the weaker areas. · Tests have been strategically planned by Career Launcher. · Tests will be free of cost. We do understand that in this fast moving world, everyone is looking for added on features. So here it is. While you are becoming better with practice, recognizing your strengths & weakness, we have a handsome awards & felicitations of offer. Awards and Recognitions by Division of Student Affairs: a. All the students who have applied for PMS 2015-16 are hereby informed to start marking your Bio-Metric attendance in the respective blocks allotted to you in the university on regular basis w.e.f. 14-03-2016 on wards. The rights of marking Bio-Metric attendance will be given to the students after updating the Id. Card by the Division of Admissions. The students can mark their attendance between 10.00 a.m. and 04.00 p.m. at least once before leaving the university on all working days. If the students will fail to mark their attendance on daily basis and unable to maintain their attendance up to 80% in the current semester on wards then their PMS case may be rejected by the Welfare Department, Chandigarh & no scholarship will be given to them. Moreover, it is compulsory for the PMS students to appear in the End term exams of both the semesters of the University for release of their scholarship. If the students are unable to appear in the exams, then their scholarship may not be released by the Welfare Department, Chandigarh. So, it is advised to all the PMS students that they must maintain 80% attendance and appear in both the end term exams conducted by the University. Moreover, it is to inform you that the record of the exams appeared status for the current session 2015-16 will be updated on the Ashirwad scholarship portal of Punjab for the release of the scholarship. title: Employability Diagnostic Test: Enhance your aptitude, communication skills & general awareness by practice: Free of cost tests, scholarships on offer additionally : (2/25/2016)
body: In the modern evaluation system for any recruitment drive, shortlisting procedures or employability, the first hurdle that you need to cross is that of the trio – General Awareness, Numerical Aptitude & Verbal ability cum Logical reasoning. On the other hand, the fact cannot be denied that the above three cannot be learnt or taught, it can only be exercised. In order to keep your aptitude alive, your logical reasoning reasonable enough and your awareness updated, Department of Youth Capital, Division of Student Affairs in association with one of the best in the field, Career Launchers presents to you the following: 1. Numerical aptitude test (Set of three test, each with distinct syllabus on 14th, 21st & 28th March. 2016): Syllabus of each of the set is attached. 2. Verbal Ability & Logical Reasoning Test (Set of three test, each with distinct syllabus on 15th, 22nd & 29th March. 2016: Syllabus of each of the set is attached. 3. General Awareness (Set of three test, each with distinct syllabus on 16th, 23rd & 30th March. 2016: Syllabus of each of the set is attached. The salient features of the test are: · Series will be divided into three tests each consisting of not more than 6-7 topics (so no pressure of long syllabus) · Tests will be for all Students irrespective of year of study. · Two best of three tests will be taken into consideration for final evaluation. · All tests will be after 5 pm: so need to miss out on any class · Proper test review sheet would be provided so as to enhance the weaker areas. · Tests have been strategically planned by Career Launcher. · Tests will be free of cost. We do understand that in this fast moving world, everyone is looking for added on features. So here it is. While you are becoming better with practice, recognizing your strengths & weakness, we have a handsome awards & felicitations of offer. Awards and Recognitions by Division of Student Affairs: a. The highest scorer & second highest scorer of each of the stages shall be awarded CERTIFICATE OF MERIT certified by DSA, LPU b. Overall highest scorer and runner up shall be awarded certificates & trophy. Awards and Recognitions through CAREER LAUNCHERS: . If a student is topper in all three stages, 50% scholarship on Total fee of Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses would be provided to the student. · If student is topper in any two stages, 40% Scholarship on Total fee of Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses would be provided to the student. · Topper of One stage will get 30% Off on Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses. · If a student is in the top 10 List of more than 1 stage, he will get 20% Scholarship on Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses. · 10% Scholarship would be provided to Top 10 students of each stage. · Scholarship of Rs. 1000 on our Prep. Courses would be provided to all the students who participate and score positive marks in any stage. · Toppers of any stage would get Goodies from Career Launcher as well, which may include bags etc. · Certificates would be provided to all the students. Hurry up and register at www.youthvibe.in/concoction or www.tinyurl.com/dyc-cl-test

title: Enhance your aptitude, communication skills & general awareness by practice: Free of cost tests, scholarships on offer additionally : (2/23/2016)
body: In the modern evaluation system for any recruitment drive, shortlisting procedures or employability, the first hurdle that you need to cross is that of the trio – General Awareness, Numerical Aptitude & Verbal ability cum Logical reasoning. On the other hand, the fact cannot be denied that the above three cannot be learnt or taught, it can only be exercised. In order to keep your aptitude alive, your logical reasoning reasonable enough and your awareness updated, Department of Youth Capital, Division of Student Affairs in association with one of the best in the field, Career Launchers presents to you the following: 1. Numerical aptitude test (Set of three test, each with distinct syllabus on 14th, 21st & 28th March. 2016): Syllabus of each of the set is attached. 2. Verbal Ability & Logical Reasoning Test (Set of three test, each with distinct syllabus on 15th, 22nd & 29th March. 2016: Syllabus of each of the set is attached. 3. General Awareness (Set of three test, each with distinct syllabus on 16th, 23rd & 30th March. 2016: Syllabus of each of the set is attached. The salient features of the test are: · Series will be divided into three tests each consisting of not more than 6-7 topics (so no pressure of long syllabus) · Tests will be for all Students irrespective of year of study. · Two best of three tests will be taken into consideration for final evaluation. · All tests will be after 5 pm: so need to miss out on any class · Proper test review sheet would be provided so as to enhance the weaker areas. · Tests have been strategically planned by Career Launcher. · Tests will be free of cost. We do understand that in this fast moving world, everyone is looking for added on features. So here it is. While you are becoming better with practice, recognizing your strengths & weakness, we have a handsome awards & felicitations of offer. Awards and Recognitions by Division of Student Affairs: a. The highest scorer & second highest scorer of each of the stages shall be awarded CERTIFICATE OF MERIT certified by DSA, LPU b. Overall highest scorer and runner up shall be awarded certificates & trophy. Awards and Recognitions through CAREER LAUNCHERS: . If a student is topper in all three stages, 50% scholarship on Total fee of Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses would be provided to the student. · If student is topper in any two stages, 40% Scholarship on Total fee of Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses would be provided to the student. · Topper of One stage will get 30% Off on Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses. · If a student is in the top 10 List of more than 1 stage, he will get 20% Scholarship on Career Launcher’s CAT, GRE Prep. Courses would be provided to all the students who participate and score positive marks in any stage. · Toppers of any stage would get Goodies from Career Launcher as well, which may include bags etc. · Certificates would be provided to all the students. title: Update regarding placement policy 2017 : (2/11/2016)
body: Dear Students, This announcement is concerned to all B.Tech students who have registered for the placements and have CGPA below 5.5 We are very much aware of the fact that you have registered for the placements with high hopes and for better future. According to the policy your CGPA should be at least 5.5 but you are not meeting the required criteria right now. As per placement policy you should be debarred from the placements. Management has taken lenient view considering the fact that this was the first time such an academic restrictions was imposed regarding Placements, hence all such students have been exempted and are not debarred as of now. Make sure you meet the next checkpoint that is by the end of this semester result, you should have a CGPA of at least 6 and no more than 4 E/F/G grades. title: An amazing gift for LPU Students by Ronnie Screwwala : (2/11/2016)
body: Dear students, Rohinton Soli "Ronnie" Screwvala is an Indian entrepreneur and philanthropist. He was the founder and CEO of UTV Group, the Managing Director of Disney- UTV India, Managing Trustee of the Swades Foundation and Founder & Advisor: at Unilazer Ventures Ltd. He has been named on Esquire's List of the 75 most influential people of the 21st Century and ranked amongst the 100 most influential people in the world on the Time 100. He was also listed amongst 25 Asia’s Most Powerful by Fortune Magazine, titled the Jack Warner of India by Newsweek and named Entrepreneur of the year by Ernst & Young. In his recent publication ‘Dream with Your Eyes Open’, first generation entrepreneur and UTV founder Ronnie Screwvala details his vast experiences and the myriad lessons learned from more than two decades of building successful businesses, bringing clarity to a quickly changing business landscape and making an impassioned case for the role of entrepreneurship in Indian’s incandescent future. Dream with Your Eyes Open shares failures, triumphs, thoughts and anecdotes, in a simple narrative that could help you have better insight and give you a fighting chance. As a special gesture towards our university, ‘Ronnie Screwvala’ has sent the copies of his new publication ‘Dream with Your Eyes Open’ as gift for all LPU Students. This book will be distributed to all of you, through your respective faculty members during regular academic period on 11.2.2016 (Thursday). It is our strong appeal to all of you to ensure your presence in the classes to collect your copy of this magnificent publication.

title: 'CineSpace' Short Film Competition by NASA and Houston Cinema Arts Society : (2/10/2016)
body: NASA and the Houston Cinema Arts Society invite professional and aspiring filmmakers to share their works inspired by -- and using -- actual NASA imagery. The “CineSpace” competition will accept submissions of all genres, including narrative, documentary, comedy, drama, animation, experimental and others, of up to 10 minutes running time. Entries must use at least 10 percent publically available NASA imagery. Entries will be judged on creativity, innovation and attention to detail. Cash prizes of $26000 will be awarded to the top three submissions as well as the two films that best demonstrate the themes "Benefits of Space to Humanity" and "Future Space Exploration." All entries should be submitted to Division of Research and Development by 15th May 2016 in CD/DVD medium. The best entry would be submitted to the competition. For more details, please visit http://www.nasa.gov/press-release/cinespace-short-film-competition-returns-for-2016 Students and Faculty members can contact Mr. Rajeev Kanday, Dr. Anubhav in DRD, Block 38, Room No 203

title: IBM Business Partner, Allsoft Solutions and Services Pvt Ltd offering 5 Days workshop based on Open source technology – PHP in LPU Campus : (2/8/2016)
body: PHP is a general-purpose server-side scripting language originally designed for Web development to produce dynamic Web pages. It is one of the first developed server-side scripting languages to be embedded into an HTML source document rather than calling an external file to process data. MySQL is the world's most used open source relational database management system (RDBMS) that runs as a server providing multi-user access to a number of databases. This is a ten days workshop designed for the beginners and students interested in learning PHP Programming, its use with MySQL and designing an application using Wordpress. PHP enables fast implementation of complex solutions. The benefit? The faster a new application enters the market, the higher your cost-efficiency and the greater your competitive advantage. Sometimes a specific Web building platform jumps out at us as a good fit for a particular project; perhaps Weebly for a simple but attractive brochure site, or Joomla for a portal site. However, there’s one Content Management System (CMS) that we all use more than any other, and that system is Wordpress. Topics to be covered Installation, PHP Basics, Using PHP with MySQL, Working with Databases and Tables, Hands on & Project Documentation, Detailed introduction of Wordpress, HTML 5, MVC, Javascript.HTML5, CSS3, JQuery, Ajax, Bootstrap. Benefit to Participants - Delivery through professionals. - Hands on exposure. - Develop a custom website. - Certificate thru us after successful completion of workshop. - Up gradation of overall profile of participants. Certification Policy: - Certificate of training completion will be given to students attended the session. - At the end of this workshop, a small competition will be organized among the participants and winners will be awarded with goodies and appreciation letter. Timings: 5:30 pm – 7:30 pm. Date of workshop: February 15th to 19th, 2016. Amount: INR 500. Venue: LPU campus, block . -Interested candidates please contact or fill a short form available at. Dhruvakant Yadav: +91 9501430842; Avinash- +91 9041770191. It is a place to express yourself to the world. A place to share your thoughts and your passions. Really, it’s anything you want it to be. Blog is a short form for the word weblog and the two words are used interchangeably. WHO BLOGS AND WHO NEED IT? Once you have the technical know-it-all’s, blogging has suddenly caught-on as a legitimate hobby and has entered the mainstream. Bloggers have the opportunity of reaching hundreds or even thousands of people each and every day. Today’s blogs can provide hair tips, up-to-date news, technical information, politics gets people involved in volunteering, advice on investments as well as there being blogs on cooking, health, gardening, sport, blogging blogs and of course many personal blogs. - If you’re a business owner, it’s a great way to connect with customers. - Finding new clients. - Getting better things done. - Blogs are the news vehicle of the future. - Blogging can boost productivity in unforeseen areas. - Blogs are a great way to measure success. - Because everyone else is. body: Lovely Professional University invites student registrations for on-joint-campus placement drive by TCS on 27th January, 2016. Designation: Graduate Trainee Job Profile: Networking, IT-IS Support, Testing, Development and Production Support Salary Package: Rs 1.86 lac per annum Eligibility Criteria: ** Pass-out batch: 2016 ** Streams: BCA, B.Sc. (Physics, Maths, Electronics, Statistics, Computer Science, Computer Applications, IT) ** Throughout 50% in academics (class 10th, 12th and Graduation) with no standing reappears/backlogs ** All academic courses must be done in FULL TIME mode ** Class 12th must be completed in Science OR Commerce with Maths / Statistics ** No gaps in studies ** All courses must be completed within normal stipulated course duration and there must not be any extended education. Selection Process: Online Tests (Aptitude + English) followed by Interviews (Technical and HR) Documents Required during the drive: Students must dress-up in formals and bring the following documents along with them during the placement drive ** Updated Resume/CV (2 copies) with candidate's photograph pasted on each CV ** Mark-sheets of class 10th/12th/Graduation results till date (originals with 2 photocopies each) ** Passport sized photographs (2 nos.) ** ID card issued by college/university (original and a photocopy) ** Photo-ID proof issued by Govt. (original and a photocopy) Registration Process: ** Step 1: Ensure that you meet all the norms of Eligibility Criteria mentioned above ** Step 2: Register on TCS Next Step Portal ** Log on to http://www.careers.tcs.com/ ** Under Entry Level Fresher section, hit "Click Here" link in the middle of the webpage. This will route you to TCS Next Step portal. ** On Next Step portal, click on "New Candidate - Register Here" link ** In the next page, click on Off Campus Applicants ** In the next webpage, click on IT profile button ** Carefully fill all your details on the registration form ** Take a note of your DT reference number generated when you submit your registration form. Note: Applicants who have already registered in NextStep portal may log on with a valid DT reference number to update their profile: https://nextstep.tcs.com > Off Campus Applicants ** Step 3: Submit your DT Reference Number (generated during step 2 above) at the following link: http://tinyurl.com/tcs2016lpu Registration Deadline for eligible and interested students: 25th Jan 2016, 9:30 AM. Reporting details will be shared with registered students by 26.01.16. Students of LPU (not registered for placements or debarred from placements) shall follow the above stated process to register for the drive. Students of LPU who are registered and ACTIVE for placement assistance must follow the registration guidelines stated in placement drive notice on Placement Portal. Looking at the growing use of online spaces in India, Pahal..an initiation in collaboration with Centre for Social Research, New Delhi and supported by Facebook came together and initiated this programme. Safe Social Surfing intends to initiate the dialogue on how the user has complete control over the security and access to his/her profile. title: Early Detection Cancer Campaign “PRANATRANA…SAVING LIFE” Organized by World Cancer Care Charity on 21st January 2015. (1/19/2016)
body: Cancer is a leading cause of death worldwide, accounting for 8.2 million deaths, there were 14 million new cases were reported in 2012 (WHO). In 2015, about 589,430 Americans are expected to die of cancer. Cancer is the second most common cause of death in the US and accounts for nearly 1 of every 4 deaths. The awareness of early signs and symptoms (for cancer types such as breast, oral, prostate cancer, colon and rectum cancer, cervix cancer and pancreatic cancer) in order to get them diagnosed and treated at early stage. title: Pahal..an initiation presents workshop on “Social Surfing” : (1/19/2016)
body: “ Awareness is the enemy of sanity, for once you hear the screaming, it never stops ". Looking at the growing use of online spaces in India, Pahal..an initiation in collaboration with Centre for Social Research, New Delhi and supported by Facebook came together and initiated this programme. Safe Social Surfing intends to initiate the dialogue on how the user has complete control over the security and access to his/her profile. Creating a culture of positive gender sensitive online environment, by promoting use of counter speech, through sensitive campaigns and listing user-driven best practices. The workshop duration would be of two hours divided into four sessions: 1- Session 1 : Access the empowerment (30 Minutes) 2- Session 2: User’s Control Over online information (30 Minutes) 3- Session 3: Counter speech in the Indian context (30 Minutes 4- Session 4: Youth rules + competition presentations (30 Minutes) Registration fees: Rs 30/- only Venue: SBRM Auditorium Date: 29th January 2015 Timings: 5-7 pm **Late entry permission will be provided to hosteller girls registering in the event and certificates will be provided to all the students attending the workshop** Visit our helpdesk at 14,36 and 55 block from 12 noon to 5 pm and in front of hostels BH3, BH5, GH6 and GH3 in evening hours for registration. title: AMCAT diagnostic exam on 21 Jan 2016 for placement registered students passing out in 2017. (1/18/2016)
body: Dear Aspirants, This is to inform you that the Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled your AMCAT diagnostic exam on 21st Jan,2016 for placement registered students passing out in 2017. A good score in AMCAT will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So consider it very important as this is your first step towards a great career ahead. About AMCAT: AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates based on their core skills which include reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Aspiring Minds conducts the AMCAT exam for engineering freshers who apply for IT jobs. The objective of the AMCAT exam is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information, you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com. Key Pointers AMCAT exam is mandatory for all students (as per the attached list). Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not appear in this exam, hence attempting it with full spirit. AMCAT exam timings will be shared through “UMS-My Message” one day before the test. Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will be helpful for you to get shortlisted in the upcoming drives. Hence participate in this exam with full enthusiasm. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. Duty leave will be provided for attempting the exam. So attempt accordingly. body: Dear Civil Services Aspirant!! Greetings!! The Civil Services are considered to be one of the most prestigious & glorious careers in our country. Lacs of aspirants appear every year but only few hundred have their dream realized of getting through this highly competitive exam which many consider one of the toughest to crack. It gives me great pleasure to introduce you to Mr. Vamsi Krishna Chaudhary, a mentor, guide and coach par excellence who inspires confidence in the civil service aspirants making them crack the exam even in their very first attempt. Vamsi is a 8 times CAT qualifier with 100%tile (Quant /DI), GATE Topper and Gold Medalist in Math Olympiad besides a Civil Services qualifier. He has developed the technique of making learning simple with his Imaginative Visual approach that can be used to crack any competitive exam. He has helped hundreds of aspirants to clear Civil Services, CAT, GATE and other exams with top grades. So I strongly recommend and suggest all the serious Civil Services aspirants to get themselves enrolled in his coaching institute with a very fair chance of clearing the exam in the first attempt itself. CONCEPT NOTE I am writing this to all intellectual Aspirants who want to be successful in their career. They might be dreaming to become an IAS officer or might be looking for an admission into a top B school, or whatever be the case, they have to appear in a competitive exam. But, there is a misconception that these competitive exams are difficult. Are exams like Civil Services and CAT really difficult? No doubt, these exams are highly competitive, but it does not mean that they are difficult. Even if one can answer 55 – 60% of the questions correctly, one can be among the top. Then why many aspirants even after working hard for years are unable to clear these exams? Many aspirants spend a lot of time in gathering information and gaining knowledge. They certainly learn so many facts but they fail to understand the mindset of the paper setter. The paper setter is looking for sensible candidates who just know the basics but have right understanding ability and commonsense. Most of the faculty members are experts in their respective subjects, so they just deliver the subject knowledge but are unable to make these aspirants learn the way of learning. So the aspirants are unable to improve their understanding ability and logical thinking. As a result, if an aspirant works in the conventional way, at the most he/she can be a walking encyclopedia but neither can clear competitive exams nor can put this knowledge to use to benefit the society. Keeping the above things in mind, we have developed a new technique called “Imaginative Visual Approach”, which helps the candidate “Learn the way of learning”, “Catch the nerve of the paper setter”, and “Enhance Understanding and Logical ability”. After going through this module, he/she can answer any question in any exam or can solve any issue in life, not because he/she has read it somewhere or someone has told him/her but his/her own sense guides him/her to do so. And we assure one can clear any Competitive exam in the first attempt! For more details, please contact Ms Smriti, Center Manager, School of Mentorship & Life Skills at…. 87250-18188 or meet her in Block No 13, Room No 206, LPU Campus(with appointment) Wishing You all dear aspirants a very bright career in 2016 Ahsanul Haq Director, School of Mentorship & Life Skills www.schoolofmentorship.in

title: UNISYS Cloud 20/20 V7.0 - Innovative Idea Competition : (1/12/2016)
body: Cloud 20/20 has traditionally been a collaboration between Unisys and academia. This contest, is open to both engineering students and experienced professionals across the IT industry, with the aim of bringing these groups together to develop innovative, path-breaking ideas and take them to the next level. Unisys Cloud 20/20 V7.0 has two sections: 1.) Student Innovation Projects (SIP): It is open to research students, post-graduates as well as pre-final and final year engineering students in Computer Science, Information Technology, and other related fields. Students can submit project ideas in broad technical areas as per the contest guidelines. These ideas will be evaluated by the Unisys Technical team, and based on the innovation/merit of the idea, selected for the next round, where students will work on their project idea and demonstrate it. List of topics for SIP: http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/SIP-topic.html Important Timelines: http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/SIP-Timelines.html 2). Targeted Innovation Projects (TIP): This contest aims to spur innovative, fresh thinking in the industry and academia, and is open to both engineering students and experienced technology professionals. Research problems around the latest disruptive trends are proposed by Unisys engineers, in a prescribed format. Project ideas will be evaluated and selected for the next round by the Unisys Technical team, based on the innovation/merit of the idea. List of topics for TIP: http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/SIP-topic.html Important Timeline: http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/TIP-Timelines.html Winning teams stand a chance to win prizes amounting to INR nine lakhs. Additionally, they also get an opportunity to intern and explore career opportunities with Unisys. Registration Link: http://utfi.co.in/login/signup.php General GuideLines(Important Read): http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/guidelines.html Last date to submission(ABSTRACT ONLY): January 26, 2016 In case you require assistance after registering for contest, share your details at anupinder.19385@lpu.co.in Unisys Cloud 20/20 V7.0 has two sections: Unisys Cloud 20/20 V7.0 has two sections: Unisys Cloud 20/20 V7.0 has two sections: Unisys Cloud 20/20 V7.0 has two sections:
