title: UNISYS Cloud 20/20 V7.0 - Innovative Idea Competition : (12/12/2015)
body: Cloud 20/20 has traditionally been a collaboration between Unisys and academia. This contest, is open to both engineering students and experienced professionals across the IT industry, with the aim of bringing these groups together to develop innovative, path-breaking ideas and take them to the next level. Unisys Cloud 20/20 V7.0 has two sections: 1.) Student Innovation Projects (SIP): It is open to research students, post-graduates as well as pre-final and final year engineering students in Computer Science, Information Technology, and other related fields. Students can submit project ideas in broad technical areas as per the contest guidelines. These ideas will be evaluated by the Unisys Technical team, and based on the innovation/merit of the idea, selected for the next round, where students will work on their project idea and demonstrate it. List of topics for SIP: http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/SIP-topic.html Important Timelines: http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/SIP-Timelines.html 2). Targeted Innovation Projects (TIP): This contest aims to spur innovative, fresh thinking in the industry and academia, and is open to both engineering students and experienced technology professionals. Research problems around the latest disruptive trends are proposed by Unisys engineers, in a prescribed format. Project ideas will be evaluated and selected for the next round by the Unisys Technical team, based on the innovation/merit of the idea. List of topics for TIP: http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/SIP-topic.html Important Timeline: http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/TIP-Timelines.html Winning teams stand a chance to win prizes amounting to INR nine lakhs. Additionally, they also get an opportunity to intern and explore career opportunities with Unisys. Registration Link: http://utfi.co.in/login/signup.php General GuideLines(Important Read): http://www.app3.unisys.com/common/about__unisys/Cloud20_20V7/guidelines.html Last date to submission(ABSTRACT ONLY): December 24, 2015 In case you register or require assistance after registering for contest, share your details at anupinder.19385@lpu.co.in.

title: Opportunity to be the part of INDIRA GANDHI MODEL UNITED NATIONS AND chance to become FUTURE DIPLOMAT : (12/4/2015)
body: LOVELY PROFESSIONAL UNIVERSITY is hosting “INDIRA GANDHI NATIONAL MODEL UNITED NATIONS CONFERENCE 2015” conducted by IGMNMUN Jalandhar Chapter in campus from 26th DEC-28th DEC. IGNMUN is an elite conference conducted nationwide every year with the motive of providing students with the best MUN (MODEL UNITED NATIONS) experience. MUN is a simulation of United nations, which is an intergovernmental organization consisting of 192 countries in the world. It simulates certain bodies of the United nations, predominantly the deliberative bodies where countries send delegates to meet and discuss international policy on a variety of issues. The 3 days event will have amazing speaker series on global issues, intolerance etc and will have ultimate fun series. The chief guest will be Smt. Shiela Dixit, Sh. ShivrajPatil, Sh. Buta Singh, Ms. BarkhaDutt. So interested Students can be the part of this global summit and be the future diplomats. The best delegate will be get a chance to meet Madam Sonia Gandhi (Congress President) with a cash prize of Rs.5000/-. title: Uploading soft-copy of final reports of Projects (including capstone), Dissertations, and similar courses by the students to their supervisors.(Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/151119/003) : (11/19/2015)
body: It is for the information of all the students registered in Projects, Dissertations, and similar courses in this term that they need to upload the soft copy (in pdf format) of their final report in three parts i.e. PDF File-1 PDF File-2 and PDF File-3 via their UMS interface by visiting following link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project. PDF File-1:- Complete Project Report. PDF File-2:-Only Content Pages from Project Report without any Identifying Information of the student. PDF File-3:- Plagiarism Report IMPORTANT NOTE: 1. In PDF File-2, Content Pages should only include Table of Content, Chapter-1-to-Chapter-N and References,without any identifying information, e.g. Student’s Name, Registration Number, Title Pages, and Acknowledgement/Declarations etc. 2. In both the files final project topic title must be added by the student in the header area of the final report. 3. If in the PDF File-2, any identifying information related to the student is found, then the file will be treated as: NOT SUBMITTED. 4. To upload PDF File-3 is mandatory only for the students registered in Dissertation-II/Dissertation (single term) courses. 5. Students are advised to upload both the files, at least one week prior to the last date of report submission without fine, so that the supervisor gets enough time for recommendation. 6. In case supervisor does not recommends the file, the student needs to upload both the files again. Uploaded files, will be available for download in the UMS account of the supervisor for evaluation.The last date to upload the soft copy of both the files will be as per academic calendar applicable to the respective School (refer UMS Announcement Ref.No.LPU/DAA/IC/151107/002 dated 11/7/2015. title: Student regrouping and Upgradation process outline for Hostelers : (11/18/2015)
body: Rooms have been allocated to the students as per their demands of different seaters in the University residential facilities. Due to some reasons few rooms have not been occupied as per the maximum number of occupancy possible i.e. 4 seater room is occupied by 1/2/3 student(s) only. In such cases, to avoid the situation where in students in completely filled rooms think that the student in partial filled rooms are getting facilities for which they are not entitled (as per the seater plan), we have started the process of regrouping or upgradation as per the information shared in prospectus/hostel allocation policy uploaded in UMS on 27th March 2015 (Annexure 11: Undertaking by students for hostel booking). For this purpose the following process outline will be followed:- Phase 1: Till 31st October 2015 – Students staying in partial filled rooms will be given option to shift to the other partial vacant room of the same/upgraded seater with their friends of choice in their present hostel after informing their hostel warden. Students can mutually decide the selection of the room where they wish to shift. e.g. If 2 four seater rooms are occupied by 2 students in each room, students in these rooms can mutually decide the final room out of these 2 rooms where they wish to shift. Hostel Warden will send the compiled report of shifting to ODRS on 1st Nov. for online processing. Phase 2: From 01st November to 21st November 2015 – Students who do not shift by their own choice then will be shifted at Warden’s level or ODRS’s level. Phase 3: From 22nd November to 24th November 2015 – Still if some student does not want to shift to other room, then his/her room will be upgraded to the seater corresponding to the occupancy at that time. In such case, the difference of the fee will be paid by the student whose room is upgraded. Note:- (1) In view of Mess, Laundry and electricity charges intra hostel shifting is strongly promoted. (2) If some student wants to shift to some partial vacant room with upgraded category, it will be processed with difference of fee being paid by the student who demanded the upgradation.

body: Dear Students Over the last decades, innovation and creativity have become critical skills for achieving success in developed economies. The need for creative problem solving has arisen as more and more management problems require creative insights in order to find suitable solutions. Creativity goes hand in hand with innovation. While creativity is the ability to produce new and unique ideas, innovation is the implementation of that creativity - thats the introduction of a new idea, solution, process, or product. Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences We have planned a 6 day event based on each category, where student/team will give their presentations. A student or team that want(s) to participate should: a. Gather some friends and create a team of up to three participants. b. Choose a Nobel Prize Winner. c. Research the person and his work. d. Create a presentation of the chosen person and his/her work and justify why he/she got the Nobel prize e. The parameter for judging are i. Research content ii. Data iii. Comparison with other scientists iv. Valid justification for winning the Nobel Prize on the chosen person v. Presentation skill Process for participation 1. Registration through webform ( http://tinyurl.com/phmnrov) 2. Submission of presentation at research_events@lpu.co.in 3. Initial Screening based on ppt 4. Announcement of shortlisted participant 5. Final presentation to external experts. The student with best presentation will be awarded. For each of the category, 3 prizes would be given. I prize - Rs. 5000 II prize - Rs. 3000 III prize - Rs. 2000 Time Line Registration: 5th Nov. 2015 (Extended) Submission of presentation: 10th Nov. 2015 (Extended) Dates of the event: 16th Nov. 2015 to 21st Nov. 2015 (2 pm to 5 pm) For queries contact: Mr. Gulshan Kumar at 8146524362

title: The Great Debate-Competition : (10/28/2015)
body: All the students of LPU are encouraged to participate in the competition. Participation can be at individual level or in a group of 03 max. We all know that Nobel prize is the most prestigious award given every year and is given in different categories as mentioned below 1. Nobel Peace Prize 2. Nobel Prize in Physics 3. Nobel Prize in Literature 4. Nobel Prize in Chemistry 5. Nobel Prize in Physiology and Medicine 6. Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences We have planned a 6 day event based on each category, where student/team will give their presentations. A student or team that want(s) to participate should: a. Gather some friends and create a team of up to three participants. b. Choose a Nobel Prize Winner. c. Research the person and his work. d. Create a presentation of the chosen person and his/her work and justify why he/she got the Nobel prize e. The parameter for judging are i. Research content ii. Data iii. Comparison with other scientists iv. Valid justification for winning the Nobel Prize on the chosen person v. Presentation skill Process for participation 1. Registration through webform ( http://tinyurl.com/phmnrov) 2. Submission of presentation at research_events@lpu.co.in 3. Initial Screening based on ppt 4. Announcement of shortlisted participant 5. Final presentation to external experts. The student with best presentation will be awarded. Time Line Registration: 2nd Nov. 2015 Submission of presentation: 7th Nov 2015 Dates of the event: 16th Nov. 2015 to 21st Nov. 2015 (2pm to 5 pm) For queries contact: Mr.Gulshan Kumar at 8146524362

title: IBM Business Partner, Allsoft Solutions and Services Pvt Ltd offering 10 Days workshop based on Open source technology – PHP in LPU Campus : (10/6/2015)
body: PHP is a general-purpose server-side scripting language originally designed for Web development to produce dynamic Web pages. It is one of the first developed server-side scripting languages to be embedded into an HTML source document rather than calling an external file to process data. MySQL is the world's most used open source relational database management system (RDBMS) that runs as a server providing multi-user access to a number of databases. This is a ten days workshop designed for the beginners and students interested in learning PHP Programming, its use with MySQL and designing an application using Wordpress. PHP enables fast implementation of complex solutions. The benefit? The faster a new application enters the market, the higher your cost-efficiency and the greater your competitive advantage. Sometimes a specific Web building platform jumps out at us as a good fit for a particular project; perhaps Weebly for a simple but attractive brochure site, or Joomla for a portal site. However, there’s one Content Management System (CMS) that we all use more than any other, and that system is Wordpress. Topics to be covered Installation, PHP Basics, Using PHP with MySQL, Working with Databases and Tables, Hands On & Project Documentation, Detailed introduction of wordpress, HTML 5,MVC, Javascript. Benefit to Participants - Delivery through professionals. - Hands on exposure. - Develop a custom website. - Certificate through us after successful completion of workshop. - Up gradation of overall profile of participants. Certification Policy: - Certificate of workshop completion will be given to students attended the session. - At the end of this workshop, a small competition will be organized among the participants and winners will be awarded with goodies and appreciation letter. Workshop Duration: 2 hrs a day Timings: 5:30 pm – 7:30 pm. Date of workshop: October, 16th 2015 to October, 25th 2015 . Amount: INR 1100. title: Rocksport is an adventure-based research organization : (10/6/2015)
body: Rocksport is an adventure-based research organization, continuously involved in the process of finding innovative uses of adventure activities in the positive transformation of kids. With the vision of making adventure accessible to masses, Rocksport made its modest beginning in the year 2001. Today, it is a strong brand that stands synonymous with safety, reliance and professionalism deriving its strength from the dynamism of its team. ‘Train the trainer’ is our annual activity to invite youngsters to make their career in adventure education industry. This is going to happen in punjab for the first time. Step 1 : Candidates enroll themselves for Train the Trainer Program Presentation and Enrollment session to be held on 7th October, 2015 at LPU at 5.30 pm at Block 13, 306. (Note: Annual enrollment fee for TTT is Rs. 500/- per candidate) Step 2 : Take part in the 1st ‘Train the trainer’ Program Program format for 1st ‘Train the trainer’ training program on 11th October, 2015 at LPU. Name of the program - Train the Trainer3 Duration - Appx. 5 hours Venue - Assembly at LPU Inclusions - Ice Breakers, About Rocksport & Its products, Activities, Team members and their work profile, Equipment Knowledge, Tent Pitching, Safety @ Adventure activities, Meals Step 3 : Candidates undergo practical training programs. Step 4 : Candidates start working as an assistant group instructors at camps and are paid for the each program. As shared above, after the training candidates join us as free lance instructors and they are paid for the camps. Normally a good instructor get a chance to take part in 40-50 camps in six months. Also, our camps take place in Summer holidays, Autumn brake, Weekends and other holidays and that is why this is a good opportunity for LPU students as well. And in future these instructors join us as permanent team members to work in operations, sales & marketing, office back end and etc. So this opportunity leads to great career option for the students in adventure education industry. Please update with your phone number, your presence for presentation and enrollment session and get in touch with the undersigned for any further details. title: Workshop on Internet of Things (IoT) 1.0 : (10/5/2015)
body: Prelude: Technology today is seeing a sea change as it is experiencing a paradigm shift where in the THINGS are not just intelligent but are smart enough to talk to each other making life and humanity easy and exciting. IoT is the next big thing after the great internet revolution and will need the basic understanding of the framework in all so as to derive the best out of it. Objective: The workshop is meticulously designed to impart understanding of the IoT framework starting at the beginner level and then seamlessly migrating to make the participant pro in designing, developing and implementing the smartness in devices. There are TWO phases one for initiating the basic and concept building and the second for diving deep. The entire deliberations will be on the Do it yourself (DIY) approach where in week days would be lecturing and the Sundays would be five hours of rigorous bench working resulting in four minor and one interdisciplinary project. Version 1.0: It starts 12.10.2015 and will end on 22.11.2015. Lectures will be delivered every MON, WED and FRI evening 1715 to 1815 Hours and five hours work bench sessions 1000 to 1600 Hours summing up to 30 hours. The intent is to build concepts from basics and instilling the confidence of doing on own. Who all can attend? Any one, belonging to any discipline, domain, category and congregate with a passion to learn new things and the zeal to explore the horizons where the world is looking forward to. Registration process: Follow the registration link mentioned below, fill in your details, deposit the fee in accounts section and get your laptop on. Get ready to take off!!! Registration Link: http://tinyurl.com/IoTwg-LPU Fees: INR1500 Non-refundable, a kit with boards, basic components and other requisite accessories would be provided to each registered participants. Once the fees is paid, photocopy of the receipt is to be deposited with Mr. Gaurav Dhand in Room No. 36-204 for confirmation of participation. Seats: Workshop is open for 100 participants only on first register, first pay basis. Do go through the White Paper for details of the workshop and also look into the introduction video for better understanding about the workshop. Video Link: https://youtu.be/NhKz-Gv--OE For more inquiry write to iotwg@lpu.co.in or contact Mr. Bikash Kant - 9878581982 Get ready for the exciting and enthralling times ahead.

title: Xerox Research Centre India (XRCI) - Data Science Research Innovation Challenge : (10/2/2015)
body: Xerox Research Centre India (XRCI) is calling all Data Science enthusiasts to participate in the Research Innovation Challenge. The Challenge is an unprecedented competitive forum to design innovative models and algorithms for real life analytics problems, have fun and win exciting prizes. Entire challenge will be conducted in multiple phases: Phase -1: A Data Science Challenge on hacker rank(Only Top 10 teams will continue after this), Phase -2: moving to a preparatory school on Machine Learning hosted at XRCI, Phase -3: grand challenge to design novel machine learning models and algorithms for big data in healthcare. Eligibility: Contest is open to all for participation, but only students across all disciplines in their pre-final and final year of an undergraduate or Master’s and PhD program are eligible for prizes and career opportunities. Salient Points: 1. Students can form teams of up to 3 members for participation (They do not encourage teams of less than 3 members). 2. Top 10 teams in this challenge will be hosted at XRCI for 3 weeks for the Winter School and Grand Challenge. Challenge Dates: October 12 – 25, 2015 Duration: 2 weeks Winners of the final round will receive: 1. A MacBook for each member of the winning team and an iPad for each member in the Runner-up team. 2. Invited Participation at XRCI Open 2016 and Internship opportunities at XRCI 3. Opportunity to publish the results with XRCI scientists in top-tier international conferences/journals Link for More Details & Registration: https://www.hackerrank.com/xerox-research-innovation-challenge-2015 In case you register for this event do share your details at: anupinder.19385@lpu.co.in

title: Engineer Infinite 2016 - Student Project Competition : (9/28/2015)
body: Engineer Infinite 2016(EI16) is the Student Project Competition to be held in conjunction with ELECRAMA 2016 exhibition to be held from 13th to 17nd February 2016 at Bangalore International Exhibition Centre, Bengaluru. EI16 invites project ideas from ALL branches of Engineering & Technology. Project ideas are welcome from Students of Diploma, Undergraduate, Post Graduate and PhD Scholars of these branches. The critical requirements of the project idea are that these project ideas must pertain to Electrical energy sector and be application focussed rather than product focussed. This competition is an opportunity to the students of engineering (Diploma, UG, PG and Research Scholars) to leverage their theoretical knowledge and creativity to address diverse real life issues that need attention, in the electrical energy sector. Flow of Competition 1. The project ideas are to be submitted as Abstracts (Synopsis) 2. After scrutiny by expert teams, a set of project ideas are selected and placed in Grant list. 3 The Grant list project ideas are required to make a working prototype or a simulation model of their idea. 4. The prototypes displayed in the Student Pavilion of ELECRAMA-2016 are evaluated. Rewards & Support 1st Prize: 2,00,000 2nd Prize: 1,00,000 3rd Prize: 50,000 More Details are available at: http://www.ei.elecrama.com/ Registration link: http://www.ei.elecrama.com/registration/ Important Dates: Submission Deadline: October 4, 2015 Announcement of Grant List: November 17, 2015 Deadline for prototype Submission: Feb 09,2016 Evaluation & Display: Feb 13, 2016 Winner Announcement: Feb 16, 2016 In case you register, do share your details at anupinder.12985@lpu.co.in

title: To apply for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab for the session 2015-16 (Fresh & Renewal of scholarship)-reg. : (9/28/2015)
body: Guidelines should be strictly adhered Dear Students, The Punjab Government has announced Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Central Government for SC & OBC category students of Punjab for the session 2015-16. The Punjab Govt. Aashirwad Scholarship Portal has been started w.e.f. 26-Sep.2015. All the students who have submitted their documents for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme in Division of Admissions (fresh cases) or Block No.32, Room No.102 (renewal cases) are hereby informed to register for the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme by creating their login id & password in Aashirwad Scholarship portal of Punjab for the session 2015-16. For old students who have applied last year for this scholarship, the students have to use their old user login id & password for applying for the scholarship on the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. The user login id & password (renewal cases) has already been sent to you in your my messages in UMS. In this scholarship portal you have to fill your complete information as mentioned in step 1, step 2 & step 3. The link for opening the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal is as under:- www.punjabscholarships.gov.in Step 1: For creating login id & password: The students are advised to fill the following information in the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal as per the class 10th certificate / DMC and certificates / documents issued by the Govt.: 1. Student’s Name 2. Father’s Name 3. Mother’s Name 4. Gender 5. Date of Birth 6. Religion 7. Category 8. Aadhar Card No. 9. Student’s Mobile No. 10. Student’s Email Address 11. Address with Pin Code Step 2: For entering University details, Bank details, Course Details etc.: The students are advised to click at Apply for Scholarship tab to fill the following details:- A. Institute / University Details (a) State - Punjab (b) District - Kapurthala (c) Tehsil - Phagwara (d) Institute /University - Lovely Professional University B. Scheme Related Detail (a) Academic Year – 2015-16 (b) Scheme – Post Matric Scholarship SC/OBC C. Application Related Detail (a) Course (b) Branch (c) Course Year – 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/etc. (d) Admission Date for Academic Year 2015-16 – 01/08/2015 (e) Enrollment Date – 01/08/2015 (f) University Registration / Enrollment Number (g) Special Category (h) Marks in Percentage (%) Obtained in Last Exam – (For new students percentage of qualifying examination & for renewal students percentage of previous year) D.10th Class Passing Details (a) Select Board (b) Passing Year (c) 10th Class Roll Number E. Eligibility Related information (a) Family Annual Income (b) Do You Stay in Govt. /Institute Recognized Hostel? (Hostler/Day scholar) (c) Date of Admission in Hostel – 01/08/2015 (d) Caste Certificate No. (e) Caste Certificate Date (f) Caste Certificate Issuing Authority - Tehsildar F. Bank Account Details for Electronic Transfer of Funds (a) Enter IFSC Code (b) Bank Account Number Step 3: For uploading the compulsory documents on Portal: (a) Caste Certificate (b) Income Declaration Certificate / Affidavit (c) Passport Size Recent Photograph The complete process for filling step 1, step 2 & step 3 can be downloaded from the announcement from UMS dated 28.9.15. Moreover, FAQ’s can also be downloaded from the UMS announcement or from the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. After completing the above process, the students have to submit the duly signed print application form in Block No.32, Room No. 102 on or before 12-Oct-2015 along with pending documents (If any). If any student fail to produce the desired documents for the renewal of Post Matric Scholarship for the academic year 2015-16 then their case will not be processed and the student will not be eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab. All the queries related with Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab will be handled at 32-102. In case of any confusion / problem in applying for Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Senior Officer, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell in 32-102. Note: If you have already submitted all the required documents then you need not to submit it again. If any document is still pending from your side then it must be attached with the print application form. If you required the scan copy of your documents then update your request on following link:- http://goo.gl/forms/BCkC0UY6vC The scanned documents will be sent to you on your email id within 2-3 working days.

title: ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest - "Olympics of Coding Contest" : (9/23/2015)
body: The ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest(ACM-ICPC) is a multitier, team-based(3 members), programming competition operating under the auspices of ACM and headquartered at Baylor University. The contest involves a global network of universities hosting regional competitions that advance teams to the ACM-ICPC World Finals. The contest fosters creativity, teamwork, and innovation in building new software programs, and enables students to test their ability to perform under pressure. Quite simply, it is the oldest, largest, and most prestigious programming contest in the world. It's a three tier contest: -Preliminary (Online contest. Can be attempted from the univeristy itself) -Regionals (Kolkata, chennai, Amritapuri) -World Finals Complete registration and Payment Details can be found in the regional center's local website.Following are the region-wise links to register and participate for this event in india: -Kolkata: http://www.icpckolkata.in/registration.html -Chennai: https://icpc.baylor.edu/regionals/finder/chennai-2015 -Amritapuri: http://icpc.amrita.ac.in/2015/-Global website: https://icpc.baylor.edu/ Following are the websites, which can be used to practice for the ACM-ICPC event: https://www.codechef.com/ http://www.topcoder.com/ https://www.hackerrank.com/ For any queries, contact: Tarun Maganti - tarunmaganti@hotmail.com Anupinder Singh - anupinder.19385@lpu.co.in

title: To apply for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab for the session 2015-16 (Fresh & Renewal of scholarship)-reg. : (9/16/2015)
body: Dear Students, The Punjab Government has announced Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Central Government for SC & OBC category students of Punjab for the session 2015-16. The Punjab Govt. Aashirwad Scholarship Portal has been started w.e.f. 01-Sep.2015. (At present portal is closed for students for a few days) All the students who have submitted their documents for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme in Division of Admissions (fresh cases) or Block No.32, Room No.102 (renewal cases) are hereby informed to register for the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme by creating their login id & password in Aashirwad Scholarship portal of Punjab for the session 2015-16. For old students who have applied last year for this scholarship, the students have to use their old user login id & password for applying for the scholarship on the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. The user login id & password (renewal cases) will be sent to you in your my messages in UMS. In this scholarship portal you have to fill your complete information as mentioned in step 1, step 2 & step 3. The link for opening the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal is as under:- www.punjabscholarships.gov.in Step 1: For creating login id & password: The students are advised to fill the following information in the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal as per the class 10th certificate / DMC and certificates / documents issued by the Govt.: 1. Student’s Name 2. Father’s Name 3. Mother’s Name 4. Gender 5. Date of Birth 6. Religion 7. Category 8. Aadhar Card No. 9. Student’s Mobile No. 10. Student’s Email Address 11. Address with Pin Code Step 2: For entering University details, Bank details, Course Details etc.: The students are advised to click at Apply for Scholarship tab to fill the following details:- A. Institute / University Details (a) State - Punjab (b) District - Kapurthala (c) Tehsil - Phagwara (d) Institute /University - Lovely Professional University B. Scheme Related Detail (a) Academic Year – 2015-16 (b) Scheme – Post Matric Scholarship SC/OBC C. Application Related Detail (a) Course (b) Branch (c) Course Year – 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/etc. (d) Admission Date for Academic Year 2015-16 – 01/08/2015 (e) Enrollment Date – 01/08/2015 (f) University Registration / Enrollment Number (g) Special Category (h) Marks in Percentage (%) Obtained in Last Exam – (For new students percentage of qualifying examination & for renewal students percentage of previous year) D. 10th Class Passing Details (a) Select Board (b) Passing Year (c) 10th Class Roll Number E. Eligibility Related information (a) Family Annual Income (b) Do You Stay in Govt. /Institute Recognized Hostel? (Hostler/Day scholar) (c) Date of Admission in Hostel – 01/08/2015 (d) Caste Certificate No. (e) Caste Certificate Date (f) Caste Certificate Issuing Authority - Tehsildar F. Bank Account Details for Electronic Transfer of Funds (a) Enter IFSC Code (b) Bank Account Number Step 3: For uploading the compulsory documents on Portal: (a) Caste Certificate (b) Income Declaration Certificate / Affidavit (c) Passport Size Recent Photograph The complete process for filling step 1, step 2 & step 3 is enclosed for your reference as PDF file. Moreover, FAQ’s are also enclosed for clarification & submitting the online application form on Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. After completing the above process, the students have to submit the duly signed print application form in Block No.32, Room No. 102 on or before 30-Sep-2015 along with all relevant documents. Moreover, user login id & password should be mentioned on the top of the print application & this password should not be changed by the students. If any student has not applied for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab in the session 2014-15 and would like to apply for this scholarship in the session 2015-16 as a fresh candidate, such students can also apply for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab subject to satisfying the above conditions. The students can contact in 32-102. If any student fail to produce the desired documents for the renewal of Post Matric Scholarship for the academic year 2015-16 then their case will not be processed and the student will not be eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab. All the queries related with Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab will be handled at 32-102. In case of any confusion / problem in applying for Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Senior Officer, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell in 32-102. (Window No.1) Note: If you have already submitted all the required documents then you need not to submit it again. If any document is still pending from your side then it must be attached with the print application form. If you required the scan copy of your documents then update your request on following link:- http://goo.gl/forms/BCkC0UY6vC The scanned documents will be sent to you on your email id within 2-3 working days.

title: Accessing UMS (9/15/2015)
body: Dear All This is for your information that after 15.Sep.2015 UMS and other IP based application are accessible from https://ums.lpu.in/lpuums and https://ums.lpu.in/<application> respectively. If user is facing any problem accessing then they are requested to reset the browser cache and browser history. User can contact to Lab technician for your respective blocks for the same. How to Clear History and Cache Google Chrome • In the top-right corner of Chrome, click the Chrome menu. • In the dialog that appears, select the checkboxes for the types of information that you want to remove. • Use the menu at the top to select the amount of data that you want to delete. Select beginning of time to delete everything Firefox • From the History menu, select Clear Recent History. ... • From the Time range to clear: drop-down menu, select the desired range; to clear your entire cache, select everything. • Next to "Details", click the down arrow to choose which elements of the history to clear; to clear your entire cache, select all items. Internet Explorer • Select Tools (via the Gear Icon) > Safety > Delete browsing history. • Make sure to uncheck Preserve Favorites website data and check both Temporary Internet Files and Cookies then click Delete. Safari • In the Safari menu bar, click the Safari option. • Select the Preferences link. • In the Preferences window, click the advanced tab. • At the bottom of the window, select the Show Develop menu in menu bar checkbox. • Return to the Safari menu bar and click the Develop option. • Select the Empty Caches link. Uploaded By: Vinay Anand Division of Infotech

body: Dear Students, Seating plan is attached herewith for your reference. The sections for the tests and the classes that you need to attend between 9 AM to 5 PM are different.E.g. The test would contain 55 questions. 25 questions of Verbal(English),16 questions of Quants and 14 questions from Logic, to be answered in 56 minutes. 2. All the test would be adaptive based which means the level of difficulty of the next question would depend on whether the student has attempted the previous question correct or incorrect.If the former question is attempted correctly the later question level would be difficult else it would be easy. 3. There would be No Negative Marking, since the test is adaptive. 4. Kindly bring your own rough copy for the calculation purpose.No rough pages would be provided for the calculation purpose. 5. No Calculators,Mobile Phones (even in switched off mode are not allowed ), no Electronic device would be allowed inside the labs.Student found having any of the device would be penalized as per the clause mentioned in the Placement Policy for 2016 passing out batch. 6. title: To apply for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab for the session 2015-16 (Fresh & Renewal of scholarship)-reg. : (9/9/2015)
body: Dear Students, The Punjab Government has announced Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Central Government for SC & OBC category students of Punjab for the session 2015-16. The Punjab Govt. Aashirwad Scholarship Portal has been started w.e.f. 01-Sep.2015. All the students who have submitted their documents for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme in Division of Admissions (fresh cases) or Block No.32, Room No.102 (renewal cases) are hereby informed to register for the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme by creating their login id & password in Aashirwad Scholarship portal of Punjab for the session 2015-16. For old students who have applied last year for this scholarship, the students have to use their old user login id & password for applying for the scholarship on the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. The user login id & password (renewal cases) will be sent to you in your my messages in UMS. In this scholarship portal you have to fill your complete information as mentioned in step 1, step 2 & step 3. The link for opening the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal is as under:- www.punjabscholarships.gov.in Step 1: For creating login id & password: 1. Student’s Name 2. Father’s Name 3. Mother’s Name 4. Gender 5. Date of Birth 6. Religion 7. Category 8. Aadhar Card No. 9. Student’s Mobile No. 10. Student’s Email Address 11. Address with Pin Code Step 2: For entering University details, Bank details, Course Details etc.: The students are advised to click at Apply for Scholarship tab to fill the following details:- A. Institute / University Details (a) State - Punjab (b) District - Kapurthala (c) Tehsil - Phagwara (d) Institute /University - Lovely Professional University B. Scheme Related Detail (a) Academic Year – 2015-16 (b) Scheme – Post Matric Scholarship SC/OBC C. Application Related Detail (a) Course (b) Branch (c) Course Year – 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/etc. (d) Admission Date for Academic Year 2015-16 – 01/08/2015 (e) Enrollment Date – 01/08/2015 (f) University Registration / Enrollment Number (g) Special Category (h) Marks in Percentage (%) Obtained in Last Exam – (For new students percentage of qualifying examination & for renewal students percentage of previous year) D. 10th Class Passing Details (a) Select Board (b) Passing Year (c) 10th Class Roll Number E. Eligibility Related information (a) Family Annual Income (b) Do You Stay in Govt. /Institute Recognized Hostel? (Hostler / Day scholar) (c) Date of Admission in Hostel – 01/08/2015 (d) Caste Certificate No. (e) Caste Certificate Date (f) Caste Certificate Issuing Authority - Tehsildar F. Bank Account Details for Electronic Transfer of Funds (a) Enter IFSC Code (b) Bank Account Number Step 3: For uploading the compulsory documents on Portal: (a) Caste Certificate (b) Income Declaration Certificate / Affidavit (c) Passport Size Recent Photograph The complete process for filling step 1, step 2 & step 3 is enclosed for your reference as PDF file. Moreover, FAQ’s are also enclosed for clarification & submitting the online application form on Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. After completing the above process, the students have to submit the duly signed print application form in Block No.32, Room No. 102 on or before 18-Sep-2015 along with all relevant pending documents (if any). Moreover, user login id & password should be mentioned on the top of the print application & this password should not be changed by the students. If any student has not applied for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab in the session 2014-15 and would like to apply for this scholarship in the session 2015-16 as a fresh candidate, such students can also apply for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab subject to satisfying the above conditions. The students can contact in 32-102. If any student fail to produce the desired documents for the renewal of Post Matric Scholarship for the academic year 2015-16 then their case will not be processed and the student will not be eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab. All the queries related with Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab will be handled at 32-102. In case of any confusion / problem in applying for Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Senior Officer, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell in 32-102. Note :- If you have already submitted all the required documents then you need not to submit it again. If any document is still pending from your side then it must be attached with the print application form.If you required the scan copy of income affidavit then you can send your request through email on davinder.singh@lpu.co.in . It will be sent to you through email.

title: To apply for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab for the session 2015-16 (Fresh & Renewal of scholarship)-reg. : (9/7/2015)
body: Dear Students, The Punjab Government has announced Post Matric Scholarship Scheme of Central Government for SC & OBC category students of Punjab for the session 2015-16. The Punjab Govt. Aashirwad Scholarship Portal has been started w.e.f. 01-Sep.2015. All the students who have submitted their documents for Post Matric Scholarship Scheme in Division of Admissions (fresh cases) or Block No.32, Room No.102 (renewal cases) are hereby informed to register for the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme by creating their login id & password in Aashirwad Scholarship portal of Punjab for the session 2015-16. For old students who have applied last year for this scholarship, the students have to use their old user login id & password for applying for the scholarship on the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. The user login id & password (renewal cases) will be sent to you in your my messages in UMS. In this scholarship portal you have to fill your complete information as mentioned in step 1, step 2 & step 3. The link for opening the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal is as under:- www.punjabscholarships.gov.in Step 1: For creating login id & password: The students are advised to fill the following information in the Aashirwad Scholarship Portal as per the class 10th certificate / DMC and certificates / documents issued by the Govt.: 1. Student’s Name 2. Father’s Name 3. Mother’s Name 4. Gender 5. Date of Birth 6. Religion 7. Category 8. Aadhar Card No. 9. Student’s Mobile No. 10.Student’s Email Address 11.Address with Pin Code Step 2: For entering University details, Bank details, Course Details etc.: 1. Institute / University Details (a) State - Punjab (b) District - Kapurthala (c) Tehsil - Phagwara (d) Institute /University - Lovely Professional University 2. Scheme Related Detail (a) Academic Year – 2015-16 (b) Scheme – Post Matric Scholarship SC/OBC 3. Application Related Detail (a) Course (b) Branch (c) Course Year – 1st/2nd/3rd/4th/etc. (d) Admission Date for Academic Year 2015-16 – 01/08/2015 (e) Enrollment Date – 01/08/2015 (f) University Registration / Enrollment Number (g) Special Category (h) Marks in Percentage (%) Obtained in Last Exam – (For new students percentage of qualifying examination & for renewal students percentage of previous year) 4. 10th Class Passing Details (a) Select Board (b) Passing Year (c) 10th Class Roll Number 5. Eligibility Related information (a) Family Annual Income (b) Do You Stay in Govt. /Institute Recognized Hostel? (c) Date of Admission in Hostel – 01/08/2015 (d) Caste Certificate No. (e) Caste Certificate Date (f) Caste Certificate Issuing Authority - Tehsildar 6. Bank Account Details for Electronic Transfer of Funds (a) Enter IFSC Code (b) Bank Account Number Step 3: For uploading the compulsory documents on Portal: (a) Caste Certificate (b) Income Declaration Certificate / Affidavit (c) Passport Size Recent Photograph The complete process for filling step 1, step 2 & step 3 is enclosed for your reference as PDF file. Moreover, FAQ’s are also enclosed for clarification & submitting the online application form on Aashirwad Scholarship Portal. After completing the above process, the students have to submit the duly signed print application form in Block No.32, Room No. 102 on or before 18-Sep-2015 along with all relevant documents. Moreover, user login id & password should be mentioned on the top of the print application & this password should not be changed by the students. If any student has not applied for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab in the session 2014-15 and would like to apply for this scholarship in the session 2015-16 as a fresh candidate, such students can also apply for Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab subject to satisfying the above conditions. The students can contact in 32-102. If any student fail to produce the desired documents for the renewal of Post Matric Scholarship for the academic year 2015-16 then their case will not be processed and the student will not be eligible for the Post Matric Scholarship of Punjab. All the queries related with Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab will be handled at 32-102. In case of any confusion / problem in applying for Post Matric Scholarship, Punjab, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Senior Officer, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell in 32-102.

title: Blood Donation Camp on 07th September, 2015 organize by “Samarpan …a lifeline” : (9/4/2015)
body: Rarely do we get a chance to serve the society especially if it is a matter of saving some one’s life. Luckily on the 07th September, 2015 each one of us is getting a chance to save three lives. title: Ordinary student or an AIESECer ; AIESEC Recruitment 2015 Cycle 2 : (9/2/2015)
body: AIESEC is the world's largest youth run organization run by students and graduates or recent graduates. Here it is with one of its program. Have you heard of the Global Leaders Program? The Global Leaders Program allows young Indians like you to gain relevant professional experience that can supplement what is being pursued in university. It is a development model by youth for youth, where members are encouraged to share knowledge, co-create projects, and work on delivering experiences that tend to sensitize them about issues persisting in the world. Studies show that the leadership organizations, institutions and the world need requires young people to not merely lead themselves and serve a purpose but empower others, be self-aware and solution oriented. This is what the Global Leaders Program is designed to offer. Additionally, the program gives young people the chance to be world citizens, by unveiling to them a whole new world of international youth and opportunities. Register today to stand out of the crowd tomorrow: www.tinyurl.com/aiesec-rec2015. Note : To become an AIESEC member, you need to go through an AIESEC meet and a couple of Personal Interviews, which shall be conducted in 34th block itself after your classes, the form cost rupees 100/- For further details, contact: Saurabh Srivastava Email: saurabh.srivastava@aiesec.net Contact no.: 9501753983 Website: www.aiesec.in

title: CSE/IT Seating Plan for Skill Rack Online Test Series from 24th August to 28th August. : (8/23/2015)
body: Dear Students, This is for the information for all the Day-1 eligible students that the Day-1 Specific Online Test series is being conducted from 19th August to 12th September 2015. The test would be conducted on the Skill Rack Testing interface.The login Details and password is shared with all the students on UMS under My message Option. The seating plan is attached herewith for your reference. The change in the test time slots as per the requests will be applicable from Tuesday onwards. Therefore, till Monday(24/08/2015) take your test as per the attached old student grouping. The groupings of the students in respective sections will be changed from Tuesday onwards the same will be floated through UMS announcement on Monday. Important Updates for the ELQ Test : 1. The test would contain 55 questions. 25 questions of Verbal(English),16 questions of Quants and 14 questions from Logic, to be answered in 56 minutes. 2. All the test would be adaptive based which means the level of difficulty of the next question would depend on whether the student has attempted the previous question correct or incorrect.If the former question is attempted correctly the later question level would be difficult else it would be easy. 3. There would be No Negative Marking, since the test is adaptive. 4. Kindly bring your own rough copy for the calculation purpose.No rough pages would be provided for the calculation purpose. 5. No Calculators,Mobile Phones (even in switched off mode are not allowed ), no Electronic device would be allowed inside the labs.Student found having any of the device would be penalized as per the clause mentioned in the Placement Policy for 2016 passing out batch. 6. If the Student is found opening any of the website other the test link would again be penalized as per the clause mentioned in the Placement Policy for 2016 passing out batch.

title: Update: VenturePact is organizing a full 24-Hour Hackathon, VentureHack. (8/21/2015)
body: UPDATE Participants are requested to report in 29-304 at sharp 10:45 am on 22nd August 2015. The registration will close on 21st August 2015 at 12:00 midnight. NOTE: THIS IS NOT A HACKING WORKSHOP VentureHack is a Hackathon where participants are expected to build an application in 24 Hours. If you are a developer, designer, hacker or you have any skill that is used in web or mobile application development, this event is a great fit for you. The registration is free (no registration fee) and open for all the students irrespective their stream or education year. Those who are interested can fill out the registration form here : https://goo.gl/2gPvkz The last day for registration is 21st of August 2015 till 12:00 midnight. The event is going to start from 22nd of August 2015. On 22nd August, there will be a Pre-Hackathon challenge that participants have to go through. The participants who gets selected in this round will participate in the Hackathon, which will be Non-Stop 24 Hours Hackathon. What will be offered? # Challenges If you love challenges, this event will be the best fit for you. It's a great event that has been planned, where the participants will face challenges, solve real world problems, sit together and brainstorm on their ideas and more. # Food and Caffeine To keep the final Hackathon going for 24 Hours their will be a huge supply of caffeine and snacks available for all the participants. # Guidance Our Tech team will always be there to assist you in the way if you get stuck somewhere in the middle. # Internet There will be LAN / Wi-Fi access available to everyone, so the participants won't face any internet issues. Participants can use internet as well during the Hackathon for any resources or online help. # Awards 2 winners will be selected from the finalists and will be awarded. 1st Prize : Rs 10,000/- 2nd Prize : Rs 5,000/- To get the basic details about the event, check out our website : https://venturepact.com/hackathon For further query, feel free to contact: Shardendu Kumar +91 96464 06083 shardendu.kumar@venturepact.com Devesh Jadon +91 97800 80358 devesh.jadon@venturepact.com Uploaded By: Vinay Anand Associate Director

title: Invitation to form a New Student Organization : (8/21/2015)
body: A Student Organization is a student body initiated, managed and run by the students of the University. It comprises of a group of University students associating with each other and sharing and pursuing common interests. The University aims to provide varied platforms to the students that are of their likings and enable them to carry out activities to pursue their dreams and goals. Students with common interests are encouraged and allowed to form their organizations and work in areas of their choice. Presently there are over 40 student organizations. Categories: Student Organizations may be presently divided for administrative and logistical convenience into six categories. 1. Academic & Education 2. Career & Placement Oriented 3. Personality Development 4. Literacy Skills 5. Hobbies and Recreation 6. Publication & Article writing A student who feels the need of forming a new Organization can become a promoter and apply for the same. The policy is available on the following link: UMS Navigation >>> Student Affairs >>> Policies >>> Department wise >>> Student Organization Cell Students can form student organization to pursue their common interests and work in student driven projects. we would be glad to have you as a new student organization of Student Organization Cell, there is an opportunity for you all to make your own organization to explore yourself. So come forward to join us. In case of any query you may write at soc.dsa@lpu.co.in or you may contact Mr Gautam Sachdeva, Block No 13-208, Student Organization Cell, Division of Student Affairs or call at 9988445590.

title: Gyandeep Teaching Project Recruitment Open : (8/19/2015)
body: “As students who are receiving quality education, it is our responsibility to pass on our knowledge to those who are deprived of it due to financial constraints.” You can be a ray of hope for kids... Join hands with Community Service Cell, Division of Student Affairs to achieve your desires and bring smile on the faces of the children who think their dream will remain a dream. Register now for this noble cause: http://tinyurl.com/gyandeepteachingproject About Gyandeep Teaching Project: · AIM: Upliftment of the community by making it self-reliant at-least in terms of education. · CHALLENGE: The challenge is to spread awareness among the dwellers about the value of education. · PATH: We provide help to the kids of adopted slums and Mess Workers not just by imparting education but to instill in them love for education so that they may excel in their future endeavors. Extra-curricular activities are organized regularly to appreciate and enhance the talent of the kids there. · Volunteering: Volunteers are required for going to slums or University Mess and teach the Worker or kids Computer, Maths and Language. title: VenturePact is organizing a full 24-Hour Hackathon, VentureHack (8/19/2015)
body: NOTE: HACKATHON DOES NOT MEAN HACKING. WE ARE NOT TEACHING HOW TO HACK FACEBOOK, GMAIL, ETC ACCOUNTS. VentureHack is a Hackathon where participants are expected to build an application in 24 Hours. If you are a developer, designer, hacker or you have any skill that is used in web or mobile application development, this event is a great fit for you. The registration is free (no registration fee) and open for all the students irrespective their stream or education year. Those who are interested can fill out the registration form here : https://goo.gl/2gPvkz The last day for registration is 21st of August 2015 till 12:00 midnight. The event is going to start from 22nd of August 2015. On 22nd August, there will be a Pre-Hackathon challenge that participants have to go through. The participants who gets selected in this round will participate in the Hackathon, which will be Non-Stop 24 Hours Hackathon. What will be offered? # Challenges If you love challenges, this event will be the best fit for you. It's a great event that has been planned, where the participants will face challenges, solve real world problems, sit together and brainstorm on their ideas and more. # Food and Caffeine To keep the final Hackathon going for 24 Hours their will be a huge supply of caffeine and snacks available for all the participants. # Guidance Our Tech team will always be there to assist you in the way if you get stuck somewhere in the middle. # Internet There will be LAN / Wi-Fi access available to everyone, so the participants won't face any internet issues. Participants can use internet as well during the Hackathon for any resources or online help. # Awards 2 winners will be selected from the finalists and will be awarded. 1st Prize : Rs 10,000/- 2nd Prize : Rs 5,000/- To get the basic details about the event, check out our website : https://venturepact.com/hackathon For further query, feel free to contact: Shardendu Kumar +91 96464 06083 shardendu.kumar@venturepact.com Devesh Jadon +91 97800 80358 devesh.jadon@venturepact.com Uploaded By: Vinay Anand Office Management Cell (Division Of Infotech)

title: Gyandeep Teaching Project - Recruitment Open : (8/18/2015)
body: “As students who are receiving quality education, it is our responsibility to pass on our knowledge to those who are deprived of it due to financial constraints.” You can be a ray of hope for kids... Join hands with Community Service Cell, Division of Student Affairs to achieve your desires and bring smile on the faces of the children who think their dream will remain a dream. Register now for this noble cause: http://tinyurl.com/gyandeepteachingproject (Copy and paste this URL into the browser) About Gyandeep Teaching Project: · AIM: Upliftment of the community by making it self-reliant at-least in terms of education. · CHALLENGE: The challenge is to spread awareness among the dwellers about the value of education. · PATH: We provide help to the kids of adopted slums and Mess Workers not just by imparting education but to instill in them love for education so that they may excel in their future endeavors. Extra-curricular activities are organized regularly to appreciate and enhance the talent of the kids there. · Volunteering: Volunteers are required for going to slums or University Mess and teach the Worker or kids Computer, Maths and Language. Also volunteers will be needed for designing the content and planning the extra-curricular sessions. · Mentors: You need to be a mentor, adviser, confidant, counselor and most importantly, a friend to the mentee assigned. You need to take back-up classes, maintain attendance and keep their parents updated about their performance. · Timings: 5:30 pm to 7:30 pm (For Out Campus) 08:00 PM to 10:00 PM (For In Campus) · Days: Daily in Slums and Saturday and Sunday for Mess Workers · Venue: DIPS Slums, 20 minutes walk from University Gate (near DIPS School) and Girls and Boys Messes For more details call at 8283877997 or visit facebook.com/lpunss

body: Dear Students, Online applications are invited from students belonging to minority communities (Sikhs, Muslims, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis & Jains) pursuing studies in Govt. or Private Colleges / Universities including residential institutes, Polytechnics, ITI's, Industrial Training Centres affiliated with NCVT, approved by an competent authority, for awarding scholarships under Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the session 2015-16, on website: www.scholarships.gov.in. Portal Start Date:- 01st June 2015 Last Date:- 15th September 2015 (For Fresh Applications) 10th October 2015 (For Renewal Applications) Eligibility & Conditions for Scholarship:- i) Annual income of the parent or guardian of the student should not exceed Rs. 2.00 lacs from all sources. ii) Scholarship is to be awarded to the students who have secured not less than 50% marks in the previous final examination. iii) Scholarship will not be given to more than two students in a family. iv) A Scholarship holder under this scheme will not avail any other scholarship/ stipend for pursuing the same course. v) The student should be resident of Punjab State and regular in attendance. vi) Continuation (Renewal) of the scholarship will be paid to those students who secure not less than 50% marks in the previous final examination. vii) Income certificate should be on self certification basis by way of an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper for self-employed parents/guardian and from employer for employed parents / guardian. Time Lines for Fresh/ Renewal Applications:- Last date for submission of online applications to the Schools/Colleges/Institutes for fresh scholarships by students is 15th September, 2015 and hardcopies to the Welfare Department by Schools/Colleges/Institutes is 25th September, 2015. Similarly for renewal scholarships for students is 10th October, 2015. How to Apply:- a) The eligible students can apply online on the website www.scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarships Portal is open for registrations -- Click on Student Login -- Register here) .Students will forward their applications online to the Colleges/institutions and fresh students will take a print out of the same. body: The last extended date for applying for Change of Programme was 20th July, 2015.However, as a special gesture, University has extended the Change of Programme for continuing students as per following timelines: 1. All students whose Change of Programme application is approved must pay the ‘Change of Programme Fee’ within two days, failing which approval for their Change of Programme will stand cancelled and they shall continue in their current programme. title: Cognizant Certified Student Programme (CCSP) Test : (8/12/2015)
body: It is for the information of all the Final Year students of B.Tech (all streams), M.Tech (all streams) and MCA registered for Placements and eligible for Day-1 placement drive that the Cognizant Certified Student Programme (CCSP) Test will be conducted on 14-Aug-2015 at LPU. The seating plan for the same is available in their UMS account under Examination Seating Plan section. About the CCSP: Cognizant Technology Solutions (CTS) conducts CCSP to assess these aspirants’ readiness for employment in IT sector. The test would help the aspirants to: ** Identify important topics and types of questions expected in CTS placement drive test. ** Evaluate self-readiness and identify their weak areas. ** It is a preliminary test whose structure coincides with that of actual CTS placement drive test. ** There will be no pass marks/cut off on score for further eligibility to appear in drive but appearing for the test is mandatory in order to test your readiness. ** Top Performers in CCSP are awarded with certificates from CTS. Eligibility Criteria: ** Open only to Final year (2016 passing out batch) students of B.Tech, M.Tech and MCA from all branches ** Students must have 60% throughout their academics (class 10th, 12th/Diploma, Graduation, Post Graduation, if applicable) ** 5% relaxation in ANY ONE of the education qualifications preceding the pursuing degree (and not in pursuing degree) ** Open only to INDIAN nationals Refer attached files for the details of the topics/modules to be attempted in CCSP. For any queries contact your school Training and Placement Coordinators. NOTE: Any student registered (and ACTIVE) for placements who meets the eligibility criteria defined above but does not get his/her seating plan for CCSP test must report to respective school TPCs latest by 11 AM of 13-Aug-2015.

title: Urrgent Announcement for Students staying in Rented/PG Accomodation : (8/4/2015)
body: It is for the information of all the students (existing and new) staying or intending to stay in rented/PG accommodation outside the campus, that as per the order of the police administration authorities, no landlord/owner of any house or property can rent out any accommodation to any person without getting the police verification with the police station concerned. Landlords as well as tenants living in rental/PG accommodation without police verification will be booked under Section 188 of the Indian Penal Code and it could also lead to the arrest of the landlord and the tenant. (Ref. News in ‘Jalandhar Tribune’ dated 3rd August, 2015) So, all such students are advised to ensure that their landlords get their tenants (i.e. students staying in such accommodations) verified immediately with the local police station.

title: Tuition Fee Refund for Continuing and Non-Promoted Students (Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/150731/001) : (7/31/2015)
body: Tuition Fee Refund may be applied by students as per timelines mentioned below: (1)For Continuing Students: A continuing student is a student satisfying the promotion criteria as prescribed in University Rules.He/she is on “ACTIVE” status. 1.1 A Continuing student may apply for Tuition Fee Refund before the start of the term. Start of term shall also include induction and or /pre-term, as applicable to the programme. 1.2 If the continuing student applies for Tuition Fee Refund after the start of term, NO REFUND SHALL BE GIVEN. (2) For Non-Promoted Students: A non –promoted student is a student not satisfying the promotion criteria as prescribed in University Rules. He/she is on status N(non-promoted) or NH(Not permitted to higher degree). 2.1 A Non-Promoted student can apply for Tuition Fee Refund before the start of term. Start of term shall also include induction and or /pre-term, as applicable to the programme. 2.2 If the Non-Promoted student applies for Tuition Fee Refund after the start of term within the same term he/she shall be given Tuition Fee Refund after deduction of Rs.1000/- as processing fee. 2.3 If the Non-Promoted student does not apply for Tuition Fee Refund in the same term,then he/she can only adjust his/her Tuition Fee in the fee of backlog courses or future term fee. NO REFUND SHALL BE GIVEN. In case of any clarification, kindly report to DAA Window located at Block 32-102.

title: Seating Plan Schedule & Important Updates regarding the Evaluation on 30th,31st July and 2nd August for the B.Tech MCA M.Tech students passing in 2016 attending the Slot-2 Summer Preparatory Input : (7/25/2015)
body: It is for the information of the B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech 2016 passing out batch attending the Slot-2 Summer Preparatory Inputs that the Sitting plan for the evaluation of ELQ Proctored Test and Soft Skills Plan is attached below.The seating plan would remain the same for all the three days. The Clash of Re-appear exam on 30th July,31st July and 2nd August 2015 with the Online ELQ Test as well the Soft Skills evaluation has been taken care off. Attendance of the three proctored Test of ELQ161 and Soft Skills (SOF161)(students who were taught Soft Skills Input) would be counted along with teaching Input Attendance of ELQ161 and SOF161. Important Updates for the ELQ Test : 1.The ELQ Online Proctored Test would be conducted on three consecutive days (30th,31st July ,1st August). It is mandatory to appear in all the three Proctored Test for all the students. 2.On all the three days it would be a full syllabus Test covering the questions from English, Logic & Quantitative Aptitude.The pattern would be similar to the Day-1 companies. 3.All the ELQ test would be adaptive based which means the level of difficulty of the next question would depend on whether the student has attempted the previous question correct or incorrect.If the former question is attempted correctly the later question level would be difficult else it would be easy. 4.There would be No Negative Marking, since the test is adaptive. 5.Kindly bring your own rough copy for the calculation purpose.No rough pages would be provided for the calculation purpose. 6.Bring your ID cards along while appearing for the Online Test. 7.No Calculators,Mobile Phones (even in switched off mode are not allowed ), no Electronic device would be allowed inside the labs.Student found having any of the device would be penalized as per the clause mentioned in the Placement Policy for 2016 passing out batch. 8.If the Student is found opening any of the website other the test link would again be penalized as per the clause mentioned in the Placement Policy for 2016 passing out batch. 9.The list of topics from which the questions would be asked is attached below. Important Updates about Soft Skills Evaluation : 1.Soft Skills Evaluation is only for some set of students who were eligible for the Summer Soft Skills Input. 2.Soft Skills Evaluation for a student is planned only for one day for a particular student. 3.All the students appearing for the Soft Skills Evaluation are required to be in formals and students without ID Card would not be evaluated.

Subjects Allocated : ELQ161 (English ,Logic , Quantitative Aptitude) Input. SOF161 (Soft Skills Input) to some selected students only. Students would be attending the ELQ161 Input everyday for 5hours for next 12 days .It would be a 60 Hours Input -20hours of English,20 hours of Quantitative Aptitude and 20 hours of Reasoning Aptitude. Soft Skills Input would be imparted to some selected students every day for 1.5 hours 18th July would be off as EID holiday.In lieu of this 19th July (Sunday) would be working. Students would be taking 12 Topic wise Online non-proctored Test every day (16th July to 31st July).For the topics that would be taught in the class every day for the same very topics the student would be giving the Online Non-proctored test sitting back at any place. The sitting plan for the same would be uploaded with in few days. All the Online Test (12 Non Proctored +3 Proctored Test) are not practice test.All the tests would be evaluative and would be used for debarment and other analysis. Login Id and Password details for the Online test would be shared soon for individual student in the My Message option of the Student. Cycle Qualifying Marks Criteria Qualifying Attendance Criteria Cycle-I Aggregate Marks >= 40 % Aggregate Attendance >= 90 % (12 Non-Proctored + 3 Proctored) If both the conditions are satisfied then the student is eligible for placements and promoted to next cycle else debarred from placements. Note that the Attendance of the Teaching Input of (ELQ+ Soft Skills(applicable to certain students) ) and the Attendance of the Online tests would be aggregated. For every test given by the student on daily basis the attendance would be counted. Find below the list of documents attached : 1) ELQ 60 hours Input 2) Soft Skills Input. title: Further Extension in dates of Change of Programme for Continuing Students (Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/150709/002) : (7/9/2015)
body: The last date extended for applying for Change of Programme was 24th June, 2015.However, as a special gesture, University has further extended the Change of Programme for continuing students as per following timelines: 1. A student may apply from 9th July,2015 to 20th July,2015 by making a payment of Rs.4000/- as compounding fee.This is in addition to the processing fee of Rs.1000/- and Change of Programme fee of Rs.5000/-. 2. After the above timelines,no change shall be allowed. The guidelines and forms are attached along for your reference. The forms may be downloaded from the UMS. Application Form (i.e. Annexure-1 and Annexure -2 complete in all respects) along with Undertaking (i.e. Annexure 4) must be submitted at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32 ,102(window no.2) as per the above mentioned timelines. All students whose Change of Programme application is approved must pay the ‘Change of Programme Fee’ within two days, failing which approval for their Change of Programme will stand cancelled and they shall continue in their current programme. The ‘Change of Programme’ Fee must be paid in person and no facility of online payment will be available. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old programme after paying the ‘Change of Programme Fee’.Students must read the enclosed ‘Guidelines for Change of Programme’ carefully before they apply for change of programme. This is an exceptional additional chance/opportunity being provided to the students and no further exceptions will be allowed.Students are advised to adhere to the timelines. In case of any query,kindly report to DAA window located at Block 32-102(Window No. 2).

title: iTech 2015 - IoT Hackathon (from ITC Infotech) : (6/20/2015)
body: Attention - Students of B.Tech CSE/IT and MCA (all semesters) ITC Infotech has launched its first annual technology conference - iTech 2015. The theme for iTech 2015 is Internet of Things (IoT), and it shall be a 30 hour hackathon on Saturday, 4th July and Sunday, 5th July 2015, at the ITC Infotechpark campus in Bengaluru. The best and the brightest brains from startups, professional developers and the student community will compete at this hackathon. Details of the event can be viewed at http://www.itcinfotech.com/itech/. Entries close on Thursday, 25th June, 2015! Participants are invited to share their IoT solution idea around following key themes: ** Smart Retail ** Smart Manufacturing ** Smart Supply Chain ** Smart Agriculture ** Open Category for other ideas Entries will be shortlisted on the basis of business impact, innovation and ease of implementation. 25-30 shortlisted teams will be invited to participate in the hackathon, and create their prototypes using IoT kits which will be provided by ITC Infotech. Winners will be shortlisted by an external jury of industry experts. This is a prototype building contest, with: ** cash prize of Rs, 2,00,000 for the winner and Rs. 1,00,000 for the runner up. ** shortlisted teams will also get to retain the IoT kit provided by ITC Infotech to build the solution prototype. ** iTech 2015 will provide participants the unique opportunity to interact with business leaders, mentors, and advance stage start-ups, to understand how technology can be successfully leveraged to enhance business value. Note: Participation is free and open for all B.Tech CSE/IT and MCA students. This is a team-based competition. Each team should have a minimum of 2 members and maximum 4 members.

title: International yoga Day on 21st June 2015 (6/15/2015)
body: Dear AllYoga is often partially understood as being limited to asanas or poses, and its benefits are only perceived to be at the physical level. However, we fail to realize the immense benefits yoga offers in uniting the body, mind, and breath. When you are in harmony, the journey through life is calmer, happier and more fulfilling. So, if you are keen to lose weight, develop a strong and flexible body or being at peace, then yoga can help you achieve it all.PM Modi, during his speech at the UNGA, said, Yoga is an invaluable gift of ancient tradition of India. It embodies unity of mind and body; thought and action; restraint and fulfilment; harmony between man and nature; a holistic approach to health and well-being. It is not about exercise but to discover the sense of oneness with yourself, the world and the nature. By changing our lifestyle and creating consciousness, it can help in well-being. Let us work towards adopting an International Yoga Day.Lovely Professional University is organizing mega event, International yoga Day, with the theme Promoting Yoga as per the below mentioned details:Date: 21st June 2015Venue: Lovely Professional University CampusTime: 06:00 AM.All Heads, Staff and students are cordially invited to grace event.Attachment

body: It is for the information of the B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech 2016 passing out batch attending the Slot-1 Summer Preparatory Inputs that the Sitting plan for the evaluation of ELQ Proctored Test and Soft Skills Plan is attached below and also available under My Message Option of UMS.The seating plan would also be available on the Link : UMS Navigation - Examination-Examination Seating Plan The Clash of Re-appear exam on 8th ,9th or 10th with the Online ELQ Test as well the Soft Skills evaluation has been taken care off. Attendance of the three proctored Test of ELQ161 and Soft Skills (SOF161)(students who were taught Soft Skills Input) would be counted along with teaching Input Attendance of ELQ161 and SOF161 Important Updates for the ELQ Test : 1.The ELQ Online Proctored Test would be conducted on three consecutive days (8th,9th ,10th June). It is mandatory to appear in all the three Proctored Test for all the students. 2.On all the three days it would be a full syllabus Test covering the questions from English, Logic & Quantitative Aptitude.The pattern would be similar to the Day-1 companies. 3.All the ELQ test would be adaptive based which means the level of difficulty of the next question would depend on whether the student has attempted the previous question correct or incorrect.If the former question is attempted correctly the later question level would be difficult else it would be easy. 4.There would be No Negative Marking, since the test is adaptive. 5..Kindly bring your own rough copy for the calculation purpose.No rough pages would be provided for the calculation purpose. 6.Bring your ID cards along while appearing for the Online Test. 7.No Calculators,Mobile Phones (even in switched off mode are not allowed ), no Electronic device would be allowed inside the labs.Student found having any of the device would be penalized as per the clause mentioned in the Placement Policy for 2016 passing out batch. 8.If the Student is found opening any of the website other the test link would again be penalized as per the clause mentioned in the Placement Policy for 2016 passing out batch. 9.The list of topics from which the questions would be asked is attached below. Important Updates about Soft Skills Evaluation : 1.Soft Skills Evaluation is only for some set of students who were eligible for the Summer Soft Skills Input. 2.Soft Skills Evaluation for a student is planned only for one day for a particular student. 3.All the students appearing for the Soft Skills Evaluation are required to be in formals and students without ID Card would not be evaluated.
