title: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minority Students from all states -2015-16. : (6/1/2015)
body: Dear Students, Online applications are invited from students belonging to minority communities (Sikhs, Muslims, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis & Jains) pursuing studies in Govt. or Private Colleges / Universities including residential institutes, Polytechnics, ITI's, Industrial Training Centres affiliated with NCVT, approved by an competent authority, for awarding scholarships under Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the session 2015-16, on website: www.scholarships.gov.in. Portal Start Date:- 01st June 2015 Last Date:- 15th September 2015 (For Fresh Applications) 10th October 2015 (For Renewal Applications) Eligibility & Conditions for Scholarship:- i) Annual income of the parent or guardian of the student should not exceed Rs. 2.00 lacs from all sources. ii) Scholarship is to be awarded to the students who have secured not less than 50% marks in the previous final examination. iii) Scholarship will not be given to more than two students in a family. iv) A Scholarship holder under this scheme will not avail any other scholarship/ stipend for pursuing the same course. v) The student should be resident of Punjab State and regular in attendance. vi) Continuation (Renewal) of the scholarship will be paid to those students who secure not less than 50% marks in the previous final examination. vii) Income certificate should be on self certification basis by way of an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper for self-employed parents/guardian and from employer for employed parents / guardian. Time Lines for Fresh/ Renewal Applications:- Last date for submission of online applications to the Schools/Colleges/Institutes for fresh scholarships by students is 15th September, 2015 and hardcopies to the Welfare Department by Schools/Colleges/Institutes is 25th September, 2015. Similarly for renewal scholarships for students is 10th October, 2015. How to Apply :- a) The eligible students can apply online on the website www.scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarships Portal is open for registrations -- Click on Register here) .Students will forward their applications online to the Schools/Colleges/institutions and fresh students will take a print out of the same. This print out along-with all requisite documents (as prescribed in the print out) will be submitted to the concerned institution. Student will get a temporary ID, which he/she will retain/ keep with him/her for any further correspondence etc. Renewal candidates will upload the prescribed scanned documents at the time of apply. b) The Colleges/institutions will scrutinize & forward all these applications online by login on the same website with User IDs and Passwords (provided to them earlier by Welfare Department) by 5th October, 2015 for fresh and 31st October, 2015 for renewal applications. For any Query/ Clarification you can contact on Toll Free No. 1800-137-0015. c) The printout of the application form along with relevant documents must be submitted in Block No. 32, Room No. 101 (Window No. - 1) two days before the last date of applying for this scholarship. In case of any problem for applying for the above scholarship, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Sr. Administrative Officer, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell or Ms. Shalini Kapoor , Dy Administrative Officer in Block No. 32, Room No. 102.
uploaded_by: Office of HOD Office Management Cell ( Academic Services) *This is computer generated notice, not requiring signature

title: Scheme of Merit-Cum-Means Based Scholarship Scheme for Minority Students from all states - 2015-16 : (6/1/2015)
body: Dear Students, Online applications are invited from students belonging to minority communities (Sikhs, Muslims, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis & Jains) pursuing Technical or Professional courses at graduate/ post graduate level approved by an competent authority under Merit-cum-Means Based Scholarship Scheme for the Session 2015-16, on website: www.scholarships.gov.in. Portal Start Date:- 01st June 2015 Last Date:- 30th September 2015 (For Fresh Applications) 15th November 2015 (For Renewal Applications) Eligibility & Conditions for Scholarship:- 1. Annual income of the beneficiary/parent or guardian of beneficiary should not exceed Rs. 2.50 lacs from all sources. 2. Scholarship is awarded to the students who have secured not less than 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous final examination. 3. Renewal of scholarship depends on successful completion of the course during the preceding year and securing not less than 50% marks. 4. A scholarship holder under this scheme will not avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the same course. 5. A student residing in Punjab State is entitled for scholarship under the quota of the State irrespective of his place of study. 6. Income certificate should be on self certification basis by way of an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper for self-employed parents/guardian and from employer for employed parents/guardian. Time Lines for Fresh/ Renewal Applications:- Last date for submission of online applications to the institutions for fresh scholarships by students is 30th September, 2015 and hard copies to Welfare Department by the institutes is 10th October, 2015. Similarly for renewal scholarships, the last date for students is 15th November, 2015 and for the institutes is 20th November, 2015. How to Apply :- a) The eligible students can apply online on the website www.scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarships Portal is open for registrations -- Click on Register here) Students will forward their applications online to the institution and will take a print out of the same. This print out along-with all requisite documents (as prescribed in the print out) will be submitted to the concerned institution. Student will get a temporary ID, which he/she will retain/ keep with him/her for any further correspondence etc. b) The institution will scrutinize & forward all these applications online by login on the same website with User IDs and Passwords (provided to them earlier by Welfare Department) by 20th October, 2015 for fresh and 25th November, 2015 for renewal applications. For any Query/ Clarification you can contact on Toll Free No. 1800-137-0015. c) The printout of the application form along with relevant documents must be submitted in Block No. 32, Room No. 101 (Window No. - 1) two days before the last date of applying for this scholarship. In case of any problem for applying for the above scholarship, you can contact Mr. Anil Dhawan, Sr. Administrative Officer, State Scholarship Information and Verification Cell or Ms. Shalini Kapoor , Dy Administrative Officer in Block No. 32, Room No. 102.

title: Freshmen Induction 2015 – Call for Student Organizers : (5/30/2015)
body: A busy season is just ahead for the fun manufacturing unit of Division of Student Affairs!!! Freshmen Induction 2015, the biggest festival of the season with an objective to help the 'Freshmen' acclimatize and incubate to their new and the most happening home Lovely Professional University, is scheduled from 28th of July 2015 to 08th of August 2015. Owing to the high intensity event prolonging for 10 days, Division of Student Affairs is in need of dedicated Student Volunteers. All students who are interesting in being a part of the organizing team are required to register themselves on the link http://tinyurl.com/freshmeninduction2015 Note the following: 1. The selection of students as part of the organizing team is subject to the eligibility criteria set by the Division of Student Affairs at the back end and cannot be regarded as a matter of right. 2. Final list of selected students shall be uploaded on the UMS latest by 16th June, 2015. 3. The students shall be facilitated with the following: a. Free food (3 meals per day) throughout Freshmen Induction b. Free accommodation in hostels (subject that you are here exclusively for Freshmen Induction and not for attending training, re-appear exam, summer courses, etc.) c. body: InterGlobe Technologies (IGT) is going to conduct a pool campus placement drive for all the students of B.Tech, M.Tech and MCA passing out in 2015. IGT is a leading BPO & IT Services provider committed to delivering innovation and business excellence across the entire spectrum of the travel, transportation and hospitality domain. The company offers integrated IT-BPO services comprising of Application Development and Maintenance, Contact Center Services, Back Office Services, Consulting Services and Solution Frameworks to the travel industry worldwide. title: UPDATED ALLOTMENT OF RESIDENTIAL FACILITIES DURING SUMMER . (25th MAY 2015 TO 25th JULY 2015 ) (5/26/2015)
body: Updated! Students who seek residential facilities for PEP classes/ Re-appear exams / Summer Term / Training/ skill development classes / freshmen induction volunteer/sports and cultural activities / part time jobs etc. may avail the same as per the guidelines circulated in this notice. The whole process of allotment will be carried through University Management System and student has to use his/her login Id and password to book their seats. Phases Set of Students for whom Round will be open Interface starts on Interface Close on Phase I For those students who have registered for PEP classes and already staying in Hostels Starts: 21st May,2015 (4.00 pm onwards) Close: 26th May,2015 Phase II For all other purposes like Summer term/Re-appear/Training/ skill development classes /freshmen induction volunteer/sports and cultural activities and part time jobs etc. Starts: 27th May,2015 (11.00 am onwards) Close: 25th July 2015 PHASE I: As mentioned above, this round will be available for only those students who have registered for PEP classes from 25th May, 2015 to 10th June, 2015 and are currently hostellers. They will have a facility in the online interface to retain the same room till 10th June, 2015 by using scratch card/Scholar Card. The fee for stay during PEP classes will be a fixed amount of Rs. 1500/-. For booking the seat student should use “Hostel Booking for PEP Students” from UMS Navigation ->Residential booking ->PEP Hostel Booking. IMP: (a) The fee for stay in case of PEP classes i.e. Rs. 1500/- will remain same irrespective of whether student joins the classes on 25th May itself or later. (b) Student will have to pay electricity charges as per the annexure I during no-dues clearance. PHASE II: This round will be available for all other categories like Summer term/Re-appear/Training/ skill development classes /freshmen induction/sports and cultural activities and part time jobs etc. The allotment of hostel for these activities will be available from 4th June 2015 onwards however the booking will start from 27th May onwards. For booking hostels during Phase – II, student should use “ Summer Vacation Hostel Booking” from UMS Navigation ->Residential booking ->Summer hostel booking This booking process will be like railway booking, where the student has to select the date of stay, check the availability of seats and book the seat. Student can select single day or multiple days and pay the fee using scratch cards only. If PEP students also fall in the above mentioned categories, then they have to book their hostel seat again through summer vacation hostel booking interface and also shift their to new allotted hostels after the PEP classes. For Boys BH-1 and BH-3 will be available. In the case of Girls GH-3 will be available. Other Important Instructions:- • In Phase II student will have to pay electricity charges in advance during booking as per the annexure I. • Damage charges will be charged at the time of No dues to be processed at the time of vacating the hostel. •Scratch Card is Pre-requisite for summer term hostel booking(for Phase II), the student has to purchase this Scratch Card (Scratch Coupon) from the tuck shops. •Group booking facility will not be available. • These charges are exclusive of food facility. Food charges will have to be paid to the Mess Contractor directly. BH-1, BH-2 and GH-3 will be operational for availing food facility. •The students can stay in hostel during summer vacation till 25th July, 2015 only. After that they will have to move to their respective hostel blocks for forthcoming session 2015-16. •For the detailed process, students must go through the attached annexure thoroughly before using the UMS interfaces for booking residential facilities during summer vacation. •The UMS link for booking will be and the same will be operational on the day of booking. body: It is for the information of students and faculty that to support academics and research access of following e-resources I available in LPU campus. Which can be accessed on wifi or LAN network throughout the LPU campus without any username and password. 1. Springer Journals: 1500+ journals of Springer providing full text articles from 1997 till date covering almost all disciplines. Website:http://link.springer.com/ 2. PROQUEST:Complete package covering all disciplines, Website:http://search.proquest.com/pqcentral/index 3. JSTOR: This database is procured through UGC-INFLIBNET and also provides access to selected journal articles. This database provides achieved contents. Website:http://www.jstor.org/ 4. J-Gate Plus: This is a single interface database which provides access to almost all abstract of different journal of various publishers and you need not to visit the site of individual publisher. This feature makes it an abstracting database and discovery tool. Moreover all open access articles and journals will be available in this link and all subscribed resources can be integrated in it. Website:http://jgateplus.com/search/ 5. IEEE:For accessing IEEE journals and conference proceedings Website:http://ieeexplore.ieee.org/Xplore/home.jsp, Go to “what can I access” button to see the contents which we are subscribed to 6. Journals of American Society of Mechanical Engineers(ASME), Website:http://asmedigitalcollection.asme.org/ (all Journals are subscribed) 7. American Society of Civil Engineers. Website:http://ascelibrary.org/journals/all_journal_titles (all Journals are subscribed) 8. Manupatra : Very useful database for students doing research in the field of legal study. body: It is for the information of all students registered in Project, Dissertation, and Internship courses that Final ETP Viva Evaluations (by internal faculty) for the same have been scheduled and communicated via UMS my messages.In this regard, all of the concerned students may please pay special attention to the points mentioned in the attached files. Any student who have not made the final report submission and have not gotten the uploaded soft-copy recommended by the respective supervisors for submission in AO Office shall directly be awarded with R Grade and regular ETP Viva shall not be conducted. body: Dear Students, There is an opportunity for you to study Masters in Memorial University Canada under the Queen Elizabeth II Golden Jubilee Scholarship program. Memorial University is amongst the topmost universities in Canada. The scholarship given would be a full funding scholarship including tuition fee and accommodation to study in Canada for the students who get selected. Final year students of below mentioned programs having CGPA above 8 are eligible to apply for the program: - 1. B.Sc ( Biotechnology, Microbiology, Food Technology and zoology) 2. M.Tech (Biotechnology) To apply for the program students need to fill the registration form attached in the announcement and submit the same to DIA Block 32-308 or send the soft copy at international@lpu.co.in. There are three stages for shortlisting of candidates: - Stage 1 – Shortlisting on the basis of statement of purpose written in the Application Form. The last date of submission of the form is 15th May 2015. Stage 2 – One on One interview by the LPU panel to further shortlist top students (approximately 10) amongst the students who have qualified stage 1. body: It is for the information of all the students registered in Capstone Project and similar courses in this term that they need to upload the soft copy (in pdf format) of their final report in three parts i.e. PDF File-1 PDF File-2 and PDF File-3 via their UMS interface by visiting following link: UMS Navigation-->LMS-->Upload Research Project. PDF File-1:- Complete Project Report. PDF File-2:-Only Content Pages from Project Report without any Identifying Information of the student. PDF File-3:- Plagiarism Report IMPORTANT NOTE: 1. In PDF File-2, Content Pages should only include Table of Content, Chapter-1-to-Chapter-N and References,without any identifying information, e.g. Student’s Name, Registration Number, Title Pages, and Acknowledgement/Declarations etc. 2. In both the files final project topic title must be added by the student in the header area of the final report. 3. If in the PDF File-2, any identifying information related to the student is found, then the file will be treated as: NOT SUBMITTED. 4. To upload PDF File-3 is mandatory only for the students registered in Dissertation-II/Dissertation (single term) courses. 5. Students are advised to upload both the files, at least one week prior to the last date of report submission without fine, so that the supervisor gets enough time for recommendation. 6. In case supervisor does not recommends the file, the student needs to upload both the files again. Uploaded files, will be available for download in the UMS account of the supervisor for evaluation.The last date to upload the soft copy of both the files will be as per academic calendar applicable to the respective School. title: AMCAT diagnostic exam on 26 april 2015 for placement registered students passing out in 2016. (4/24/2015)
body: Dear Aspirants, This is to inform you that the Centre for Professional Enhancement has scheduled your AMCAT diagnostic exam on 26 April, 2015 for placement registered students passing out in 2016. A good score in AMCAT will give you many benefits like better career opportunities, better Training sessions etc. So consider it very important as this is your first step towards a great career ahead. About AMCAT: AMCAT or Aspiring Minds Computer Adaptive Test evaluates candidates based on their core skills which include reasoning skills, quantitative aptitude, English and technical skills. AMCAT is also known as an employability assessment test. The Skills of the candidates will be measured in a Statistical Approach if they attend the test. Aspiring Minds conducts the AMCAT exam for engineering freshers who apply for IT jobs. The objective of the AMCAT exam is to grade the students based on their performance. For more information, you can also visit on web link: https://www.myamcat.com. Key Pointers AMCAT exam is mandatory for all students (as per the attached list). Action will be taken as per PEP policy against those who will not appear in this exam, hence attempting it with full spirit. AMCAT exam timings will be shared through “UMS-My Message” one day before the test. Scores of this exam will be shared with companies and will be helpful for you to get shortlisted in the upcoming drives. Hence participate in this exam with full enthusiasm. Exam will be in auto-proctored mode. Kindly read the instructions/guidelines carefully before taking the exam. Duty leave will be provided for attempting the exam. So attempt accordingly. Login Credentials for the exam will be shared with you through UMS my messages on the day of the exam. Upload By:-Centre for Professional Enhancement

title: Change of Programme for Continuing Students (Ref.No. LPU/DAA/IC/150411/003) : (4/11/2015)
body: This is for the information of all continuing students that they can apply for Change of Programme as per the attached Guidelines and time lines. All the students who have submitted their wish to change the higher degree under “Taking Option for Continuation and Discontinuation of higher degree” have to submit the signed applications as per timelines. The students should read the guidelines thoroughly before applying. The Application Form can be downloaded from attachment of Formats and must be submitted (i.e. Annexure-1 and Annexure-2 complete in all respects) along with Undertaking (i.e. Annexure 4) at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32, 102(window no.2) latest by 0May 30st, 2015 (with late fee)5:00 PM on May 05th, 2015 (without late fee) and by . No applications will be entertained after that. A student may download the form and undertaking and fill it up in his/her own handwriting in CAPITAL LETTERS, get it signed from the parents, scan it and e-mail it to academic.aac@lpu.co.in. The email should be with subject “Change of Programme for Continuing Students-Registration No-” In the ‘Without Compounding Fee’ immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rupees 1,000/- will be debited to the account of the student as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee. The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32 ,102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rupees 1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee to the Department of Accounts. In the ‘With Compounding Fee’, immediately on the receipt of the e-mail Rupees 3,000/- will be debited to the account of the student (i.e. Rupees 1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee and Rupees 2,000/- as Compounding Fee). The form along with undertaking can also be submitted personally at the window of Division of Academic Affairs located at Block 32 ,102(window no.2) after payment of fee of Rupees 3,000/- (i.e. Rupees 1,000/- as Non Refundable Application Processing Fee and Rupees 2,000/- as Compounding Fee) to the Department of Accounts. All students whose Change of Programme application is approved before May 20th, 2015 must pay the ‘Change of Programme Fee’ by May 30th, 2015 and all those whose COP is approved on June 10th, 2015 must pay the COP fee by June 18th, 2015. Failing to pay the fee in above timeline the approval for their Change of Programme will stand cancelled and they shall continue in their current programme. The ‘Change of Programme’ Fee must be paid in person and no facility of online payment will be available. Students must plan their travel arrangements well in advance for this. No student will be allowed to transfer back to the old programme after approval of Change of Programme request or after paying the ‘Change of Programme Fee’. Students must read the enclosed ‘Guidelines for Change of Programme’ carefully before they apply for change of programme.

title: SEMINAR & SCHOLERSHIP TEST ON HYBRID VEHICLE DESIGN & MANUFACTURING TECHNIQUE (EEE/ECE/CSE/Mechanical/Automobile) : (4/10/2015)
body: Imperial Society of Innovative Engineers bring seminar 1st time in LPU on Hybrid Vehicle Design and Manufacturing techniques. Hybrids use two powertrains--in that's generally a gasoline engine and electric motors. Together, they aim to reduce fuel consumption by using smaller engines which spend less time running, while maintaining or improving performance. title: A workshop based on Software Testing (Manual and Automation) Presented by Allsoft Solutions and Services Pvt. Ltd., IBM Business Partner : (4/4/2015)
body: A workshop based on Software Testing (Manual and Automation) Presented by Allsoft Solutions and Services Pvt. Ltd., IBM Business Partner Software Testing is necessary because we all make mistakes. Some of those mistakes are unimportant, but some of them are expensive or dangerous. We need to check everything and anything we produce because things can always go wrong – human make mistakes all the time. Ideally, we should get someone else to check our work because another person is more likely to spot the flaws and most importantly it is required for an effective performance of software application or product. Over the last one decade the profile of software tester has undergone tremendous changes. Testing has become show-stopper for several application/product implementations. Technical resources with capabilities to evaluate automation tools, create automation framework and reusable components are on demand. What you will learn:- Introduction to Software Engineering ,Introduction to SDLC and SDLC Models, Introduction to Waterfall Model, Introduction to Software Testing, Why Software testing?, Who should test?, Difference between “Error”, “Bug”, and “fault” The Testing team (Different roles) Phases in STLC Introduction to Test Plan and Test Cases Types of Testing Verification and validation Quality Assurance and Quality Control What is a BUG? Bug Life Cycle When to Stop Testing?, Difference between Manual & Automation Testing Different kinds of Automation tools, Getting Started with Automation Testing, Manual Testing tricks, Automated testing using tools, QTP, RFT and Selenium, Uses of tools in automation testing Scripting in Real Time Validation commands with examples,Types of Testing - Black Box - White Box - Grey Box, Introduction to Automation, Tool selection criteria, Introduction to QTP, Overview of Quick Test Pro, Starting Quick Test, Quick Test Window,Quick Test Window Layout, Using Quick Test Commands, Different ways of Developing, Automation Tests, Recording a test, Standard Recording, Analog Recording, Low Level Recording,Writing Script, Descriptive Programming, Working with Test Objects, Object Spy, Configuring Object Identification, Smart Identification, Merging Shared Object Repositories, and a lot more.. Fee: 350 (Per head) Date:17th,18th,19th April Duration:5:00PM-7:00PM Benefits:- Required software (s) will be given free Participation certificate from Allsoft will be provided to all the candidates attended every session. Workshop thru expert in Software Testing Tips to attend the certification program. title: Workshop on “Cloud Computing” By Technophilia Systems Pvt. Ltd. : (4/3/2015)
body: Cloud Computing involves aggregation of multiple computing, storage and network resources into a single entity called "cloud"; into which location as well as device independent computing is performed. title: Reminder: Student Poster Presentation competition 2015 : (3/25/2015)
body: To create a research environment and inspire faculty and students to make LPU as one of the leading research intensive universities in India and the world, Division of Research & Development has initiated Student Poster Presentation competition. Timeline: 1. Announcement and Providing Template for Poster: 7th March 2015 2. Mail the posters as per prescribed template to: poster@lpu.co.in till: 7th April 2015 3. Public voting: 8 - 10 April 2015 4. Announcements of Results: 13th April 2015 5. Poster Presentation Competition: 20 – 21 April 2015 Who should participate? All Master students who will be submitting their thesis in April 2015. Procedure: 1. Students will prepare the poster as per the template provided by DRD. (Template attached) 2. The Poster to be vetted by Supervisor and after his/her consent, it should be mailed to poster@lpu.co.in under relevant category. The categories are Mechanical, Computer Science, ECE/EEE, Civil, Sciences (Biotech, Biosciences, Agriculture, Physical Sciences), Arts & Humanities / Social Sciences, Pharmacy/Paramedical/Physiotherapy. Uploading of posters on the interface will be done from our side. 3. When public voting is called, every student and faculty shall vote for one poster only. 4. 50 % of the posters short listed from each category will be called for final poster presentation based on public voting results. 5. Competitors shall plot the poster on a 3ft x 3ft sheet of paper and present the same during the competition. 6. Final decision will be taken by external expert committee during poster presentation competition. 7. Under each category three prizes will be distributed. First Prize: Rs. 5000 , Second Prize: Rs. 3000 and Third Prize: Rs. 2000. 8. All short listed poster presenters will be eligible for 100 % USCG grant from University for publication indexed by Scopus/WOS to the maximum extent of Rs. 20000. Rules: 1. The idea that is submitted for the contest should not be previously published or presented at any other place that secures copyright of the idea. If any sort of plagiarism or copyright issues found for your submission, we would not be considering them. 2. All short listed poster presenters are expected to physically participate in the competition on 20 and 21st April 2015. 3. In case of absenteeism 100% USCG grant could not be provided. 4. All are requested to follow the deadlines.

body: With organizations emphasizing more on lowering the expense of ownership, rising reliability and redundancy and minimizing in-house infrastructure, getting into Cloud is important for any organization. To benefit organizations to adventure the advantage of cloud computing, IT industry need a transformation from traditional development, production and management of in-house application to remote and all time accessible Online gateway. There are many leading companies like IBM, Amazon, Salesforce, Google and Microsoft offering services on Cloud. Allsoft Solutions and Services Pvt Ltd is the only IT company in North India providing services on Sales force and IBM Cloud. To nurture the benefits of cloud and generate the importance of Cloud for an engineer we are organizing 2 Days workshop for students interested in getting an hands-on exposure in cloud. The workshop will cover these aspects:- What is Cloud, Introduction, Feature and Types of Cloud Computing, Role of IBM Cloud, Customer Relationship Management, Introduction of salesforce.com platform, Create an App with salesforce.com builder, Apex, Visual force, Reports and Dashboard, Standard controller and Custom controller, Work flow and Approvals, Security and sharing data, Data Management Tools like Data Loader, Triggers, Static Resources, Custom Label. title: A workshop on Cloud Computing presented by Allsoft Solutions & Services Pvt. Ltd, IBM Business Partner : (3/14/2015)
body: With organizations emphasizing more on lowering the expense of ownership, rising reliability and redundancy and minimizing in-house infrastructure, getting into Cloud is important for any organization. To benefit organizations to adventure the advantage of cloud computing, IT industry need a transformation from traditional development, production and management of in-house application to remote and all time accessible Online gateway. There are many leading companies like IBM, Amazon, Salesforce, Google and Microsoft offering services on Cloud. Allsoft Solutions and Services Pvt Ltd is the only IT company in North India providing services on Sales force and IBM Cloud. To nurture the benefits of cloud and generate the importance of Cloud for an engineer we are organizing 2 Days workshop for students interested in getting an hands-on exposure in cloud. The workshop will cover these aspects:- What is Cloud, Introduction, Feature and Types of Cloud Computing, Role of IBM Cloud, Customer Relationship Management, Introduction of salesforce.com platform, Create an App with salesforce.com builder, Apex, Visual force, Reports and Dashboard, Standard controller and Custom controller, Work flow and Approvals, Security and sharing data, Data Management Tools like Data Loader, Triggers, Static Resources, Custom Label. title: Student Poster Presentation Competition 2015 : (3/7/2015)
body: To create a research environment and inspire faculty and students to make LPU as one of the leading research intensive universities in India and the world, Division of Research & Development has initiated an Student Poster Presentation competition. Timeline: 1. Announcement and Providing Template for Poster : 7th March 2015 2. Interface to upload Posters will be opened on : 30th March 2015 3. Students to upload posters on or before : 7th April 2015 4. Public voting : 8 - 10 April 2015 5. Announcements of Results : 13th April 2015 6. Poster Presentation Competition : 20 – 21 April 2015 Who should participate? All Master students who will be submitting their thesis in April 2015. Procedure: 1. Students will prepare the poster as per the template provided by DRD.(Template attached) 2. The Poster to be vetted by Supervisor and after his/her consent, it should be uploaded on the interface under relevant category. The categories are Mechanical, Computer Science, ECE/EEE, Civil, Sciences (Biotech, Biosciences, Agriculture, Physical Sciences), Arts & Humanities / Social Sciences, Pharmacy/Paramedical/Physiotherapy. 3. When public voting is called, every student and faculty shall vote for one poster only. 4. 50 % of the posters short listed from each discipline will be called for final poster presentation based on public voting results. 5. Competitors shall plot the poster on a 3ft x 3ft sheet of paper and present the same during the competition. 6. Final decision will be taken by external expert committee during poster presentation competition. 7. Under each category three prizes will be distributed. First Prize: Rs. 5000 , Second Prize: Rs. 3000 and Third Prize: Rs. 2000. 8. All short listed poster presenters will be eligible for 100 % USCG grant from University for publication indexed by Scopus/WOS to the maximum extent of Rs. 20000. Rules: 1. The idea that is submitted for the contest should not be previously published or presented at any other place that secures copyright of the idea. If any sort of plagiarism or copyright issues found for your submission, we would not be considering them. 2. All short listed poster presenters are expected to physically participate in the competition on 20 and 21st April 2015. 3. In case of absenteeism 100% USCG grant could not be provided. 4. All are requested to follow the deadlines.

title: 2013 B.Tech (Intake Batch) - Important Announcement regarding Placements : (2/26/2015)
body: As per the feedback from the industry and also based on the eligibility criteria mentioned by various companies coming for Placements, it has been observed that 60 %( 6.67 CGPA) marks are bare minimum score that a company sets as the minimum criteria to allow students to attend drives. No good company entertains the students with CGPA anything lesser than that. Keeping this in consideration and to inculcate the element of seriousness to ensure that only quality students register for Placements, a cut off criteria of 5.5 CGPA (with or without arrears) has been introduced (for B.Tech) students only. This means that at the time of declaration of result of 5th Semester any student who does not have a minimum CGPA of 5.5 will not be allowed to register for Placements. It would be applicable on 2013-2017 B.Tech batch (currently in 4th sem) onwards. All concerned students are required to take note of the same and prepare accordingly.

All the matches will be played according to the Chess Federation of India rules. 1.2. All the participants will report to the event coordinator before the start of the match. 1.3. It is a one on play and each match is ends in 10-15 minutes. 1.4. If there are 3 illegal moves there will be an action taken. 1.5. It is a touch and play game, you have to move the piece you touch. 1.6. In case of tie, The sum of scores in each game in a match is referred to as board points. 1.7. The draw of color will be done by the organizer. 1.8. In exceptional circumstances (e.g. extremely bad weather) the match may be postponed 1.9. Any match postponed may be re-arranged 1.10. Venues can be changed and informed to the players 24 hrs before the match 2. Registration Process: 2.1. The registration fee of the event will be received by the official of LPU-NSS. 2.2. The registrations of the event will take place through the help desks in front of the Block-13 and All Boys and Girls Hostels. 2.3. The registration fee to participate in the event is Rs 100/- only. 2.4. No refund shall be made in case of backs out after registration and payment of fees 3. Fixtures 3.1.The decision of the tournament director is final. 3.2.All matches scheduled for next rounds will be played at a venue to be decided by the Tournament Director. These venues will be decided and conveyed to the players together with the fixture list, and will not be changed. 3.3.All matches must be fulfilled. 3.4.Last date of registration 20th Feb, 2015 3.5.Date of fixtures will be 21st Feb, 2015, Saturday 4. Prizes and Certification: 1. Cash Prize of Rs. 1000/- for the Champion. 2. Cash Prize of Rs. 500/- for the runner up. 3. Certificate of Participation to all. For any other queries contact Mr. SYAM @ 8437193977

US President Barack Obama- the Chief Guest of the Republic Day Celebrations, US first lady Michelle Obama, President Shri Pranab Mukherjee, PM Narendra Modi interacted with the invitees. Prominent personalities who shared their tables included Vice President Hamid Ansari, former PM Manmohan Singh, Cabinet Ministers and their spouses among elite guests from across India including LPU Chancellor Mr Mittal. This grand invitation is in turn an honour to LPU students, members of staff and the whole LPU family.

title: Prevention from Swine Flu : (2/9/2015)
body: Swine influenza, also called swine flu, hog flu, pig flu or H1N1 virus, is an infection caused by any one of several types of swine influenza viruses. It is highly contagious, spreading quickly from person to person. Most symptoms are the same as seasonal flu. They can include: cough. fever. sore throat. stuffy or runny nose. body aches. headache. chills. fatigue. Below are a few tips to steer clear of swine flu, apart from vaccination: Wash hands: Wash your hands often in hot soapy water. Also avoid touching your nose, eyes and mouth. Avoid contact: Stay home if you are sick. And if you have to be around someone who is sick, avoid physical contact and try to stay a few feet away from them. Because the virus can spread when particles are dispersed into the air through a cough or sneeze. Therefore, cover your nose and mouth with a tissue when coughing or sneezing. Sleep: Get enough sleep of 8 hours every night to keep your immune system strong and ready to fight infection. Drink water: Keep your body hydrated by drinking water of about 8-10 glasses daily. Eat whole grains, fresh fruits and vegetables and other vitamin-rich foods to keep your body strong and nourished. Avoid fatty foods : as these can slow your metabolism and weaken your immune system. In case of any queries, please contact Dr N K Gupta, 9878426871

body: Note: A. Last chance to register. Registration extended till today 5:00 pm B. Classes Starting on 29th Jan, 2015. C. title: ALLOTMENT OF RESIDENTIAL FACILITIES (TRAINING STUDENTS) for ACADEMIC SESSION 2014 – 2015. : (1/5/2015)
body: All the students those were on training in the autumn term (Aug 2014 to Dec 2014) and the other students who did not avail the hostel facility earlier and now interested to avail hostel facility may apply for the same from 09th January,2014 to 15th Jan 2014. The whole process of allotment will be carried through University Management System and student has to use his/her login Id and password to book their seats. For the detailed process and charges, students must go through the attached annexures in thoroughly before using the UMS interfaces for booking residential facilities. The UMS link for booking the will be: UMS Navigation>>Residential booking>>Online hostel booking and the same will be operational on the day of booking. The annexures attached with this announcement are: Annexure 1: Detail of fee structure 2014-2015 (Fee for One1 semester(Only for Training. Or 6 months Prog). Annexure 2: How to use interface. Annexure 3: List of Tuck Shops from where scratch Cards will be available. Annexure 4: Process to pay fee. Annexure 5: Undertaking by students. Other Important Instructions: * Scratch Card of Rs. 1000/- is Pre-requisite for online hostel polling, the student has to purchase this Scratch Card (Scratch Coupon) from the tuck shops. If student gets room through online polling, then Rs. 1000/- consumed as scratch card will be adjusted towards the payment of hostel fee. * Laundry facility will be compulsory for all except 2011 batch. * No refund policy will be applicable for this 6 months hostel allocation. * Last date for depositing the fee will be 20th Jan,2015. * Multi Seat/Group booking facility is available. * The allotment would be on first come first serve basis. In case students face any ambiguity in understanding the process or any other related annexure, they must approach Office of Division of Residential Services in Block 29, Room No :301 during official hours from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
